title: TTC Massage, Bangkok
ownerDescription:
TTC Massage Bangkok offers professional Thai massage and internationally recognised massage training in Bangkok, Thailand.

We provide Thai Traditional Massage, Foot Reflexology, Oil Massage, and Herbal Massage in a clean, comfortable, and relaxing environment. Our experienced therapists deliver high-quality treatments suitable for both locals and visitors.

TTC Massage Bangkok is also home to TTC Spa School Bangkok, an international massage school offering professional Thai massage courses. Training is delivered by highly experienced instructors and follows standards recognised by the Ministry of Public Health and the Ministry of Education of Thailand.

Visit TTC Massage Bangkok for authentic Thai massage or professional massage training.
address: 1617 New, Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand
plusCode: PHX5+V9 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Maciej Tylkowski
reviews.text:
This is very good school.
Small groups with a very professional and friendly, personalized approach.
This isn't my first massage school in Thailand, but it's one of the top ones.
It's also excellent for beginners even with limited English.
One of my parallel classes was a student who constantly used Google Translator and exams.
I highly recommend studying at this school.
Thanks a lot for all TTC’s team (with Brendan in front) for great journey true the massage’s  environment !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review Max, it was a pleasure to have you with us 😊🙏

reviews.name: Lucy Watson
reviews.text:
My daughter and I did the 6 day basic massage course and found it to be more than expected.
We came away having the tools to give a full body 2 hour massage. There was a lot of information to absorb in a short time. The one thing I regret is not knowing more about anatomy before doing the course. Anyone who does will find it a great asset.
The staff and instructors are very friendly, patient and understanding and are very generous with their knowledge.
I benefitted intellectually and physically. Thank you Brennan and all the ladies that helped us. It was a fun educational week with many great stories too.
I recommend this school all day long. I would love to go back and do all the levels with them.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words and thoughtful feedback! It was a real pleasure teaching you both. You did an excellent job throughout the week and brought great energy to the class. You’re absolutely right — a bit of anatomy study over time can make a big difference in understanding the work more deeply. We’re thrilled you found the course rewarding and would love to welcome you back anytime to continue your journey. 😊🙏

reviews.name: Ladas Cvach
reviews.text:
We completed a six-day Traditional Thai Massage course at TTC Spa School in Bangkok, and it was an outstanding experience.

Our instructor, Brendan was exceptional. He explained everything clearly and thoroughly, showed incredible patience, and it was obvious that he genuinely loves what he does. His passion and professionalism made a huge difference in our learning experience.

The entire team of instructors was warm, welcoming, and supportive. The atmosphere felt friendly and almost family-like, which made the whole week even more enjoyable and comfortable.

We highly recommend taking any course at this Bangkok branch — you truly won’t regret it. We gained valuable hands-on experience and practical skills that we can confidently use in the future. The value for money is unmatched.

We will definitely be coming back for more courses.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind review.

It was a pleasure teaching you both. I was genuinely impressed with your dedication throughout the course. Your approach to learning was fantastic and I am genuinely proud of your accomplishments this week. 

We look forward to welcoming you back in the future 😊🙏

reviews.name: Tereshchenko Tatiana
reviews.text:
Perfect experience!

I took a Thai massage course for 9 days. It was informative, smooth, and intense at the same time! Very attractive price and excellent location! You will immerse yourself in the authenticity and simplicity of the atmosphere, with professional teachers.
Get ready for the fact that it is not easy, but if there is a desire to study the body and be closer to it, it is more useful - you are here.
Thank you to everyone for such a great course🙏🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your thoughtful review,

We appreciate your kind words about the atmosphere of the school. We're happy to hear that you value the skills you have obtained, 

We wish you success in your continued practice 😊🙏

reviews.name: Aurora Cavallo
reviews.text:
As a certified yoga teacher, I wanted to learn Thai massage to deepen my understanding of the body and help my students experience greater relaxation. I was deciding between this school and another, and I’m so grateful I followed my intuition and chose TTC School.

The staff and teachers are exceptional—professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly supportive. What makes this place truly special is the balance between high-quality training and the Thai spirit of sabai sabai. Nothing feels rushed; the learning process is calm, enjoyable, and well guided.

I took the one-day course due to time limitations and was amazed by how much I learned. The atmosphere feels genuine and purpose-driven, creating an experience that is both authentic and inspiring.

I highly recommend TTC School, whether you want to become a massage therapist or simply bring this beautiful practice into your life.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review Aurora. It was a pleasure to have you with us 😊🙏

reviews.name: Maria
reviews.text:
This place is definitely my new favorite massage shop, the shop is really close to my house and it is located on a good location only around 5-10 minutes walk from Petchaburi MRT.

I came in to get 1.5hr Thai massage and 1.5hr body scrub and it was the best experience ever! The Thai massage was amazing, she massaged my body throughly even with the muscles I didn’t know existed and the body scrub was amazing, the scrub has coffee and salt in it which makes my body felt so soft afterwards and I can see that my skin is slightly brighter after the scrub, the scrub also includes 30 minutes oil massage to help hydrate your skin afterwards. The lady who did for me name Kate, what a sweet lady and she also mentioned that she likes to do body scrub the most! If you want to get a proper body scrub, get it with Kate!!💕🫶🏻
I’ll definitely be back for another body scrub.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review Maria 😊 🙏

reviews.name: Leo Tannam
reviews.text: I’m so glad I found TTC Massage School. The Thai Massage course was amazing. Brendan is a fantastic teacher—super knowledgeable, friendly, and patient. I highly recommend it, and I can’t wait to return to Ireland and put everything I learned into practice.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review Leo, it was a pleasure to have you study with us. 😊🙏

reviews.name: Elian Aitken
reviews.text:
Had an absolute blast taking the 6 day Traditional Thai Massage course. Amazing value for money, and tonnes of videos and a workbook to take home so you can continue practicing. So much more respect for Thai massage therapists now, its really easy to hurt someone if youre pressing in the wrong places. Also learned so much generally speaking about how massage functions and why the body benefits from it. The shared knowledge of all the teachers, with backgrounds in Western and Eastern knowledge was absolutely invaluable, and I felt lucky to have been able to attend.

Thanks for having me guys!! Hope to be back for level 2 someday!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Elian,

Thank you for your wonderful review! 😊 🙏 We're glad you enjoyed your course, and appreciate the nuance behind the art of Tha massage,

It was great having you with us, and we look forward to seeing you for level 2. 😁

reviews.name: Juliano Wakahisa
reviews.text:
I took a one-day foot massage course there and absolutely loved it. The teacher, Brandon, is awesome. As a former paramedic, he has a really in-depth understanding of human anatomy. I was impressed by how clearly he explained complex concepts and how much practical knowledge he shared.

Obviously, you can only learn so much in a single day, but the course gave me a great routine that I can use on family/friends. It was a fun and informative experience, I'd definitely recommend it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your thoughtful review, Juliano. It was a pleasure to teach you, and I'm happy to hear you're putting it to good use 😊🙏

reviews.name: Hang Nguyen
reviews.text:
The massage course was truly wonderful. I learned everything I needed and even more than I expected. A special thank you to Brendan for generously providing extra training beyond what was included in my registered course — I really appreciate the additional knowledge and support.

The entire team was incredibly helpful, kind, and welcoming throughout the experience. You can genuinely feel that they teach from the heart, which makes a big difference.

I would highly recommend this school to anyone looking for quality training and a supportive learning environment. Thank you so much
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words – it was a pleasure having you on you with us 😊🙏

reviews.name: Qianyi Wang
reviews.text: Sooo good! I had a lot of massages here in Bangkok, I can say this one it’s definitely the top 3!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Qianyi! 😊 Top 3 in Bangkok is a pretty good compliment — we’ll happily take that! Really glad you enjoyed your massage, and thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. 🙏

reviews.name: Assaf Cohen
reviews.text:
For a massage:
Highly professional, not expensive, it’s not in the main tourist area but if you’re looking for something that is more traditional and professional, I would recommend coming in.

For the massage course:
Had such a great time so I just decided to go through for oil massage course for six days, staff was really professional, took the time to go over each movement, class was very small. You really get that personal one on one experience. Different structures for different types of massages. I really enjoyed it and I would recommend anyone that’s thinking about becoming a therapist to come here for their training.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Assaf. It was a pleasure having you on the course. We're glad you appreciated the small class format and detailed guidance. We wish you continued success in your work. 😊🙏

reviews.name: Foo Jia Xin
reviews.text:
I came for a 3 day course and the school was very flexible about arrangements (I had to accommodate my work schedule and enrol in non-consecutive days). They are serious about teaching and experienced in educating in various languages, especially English and Japanese. It was really worthwhile! The teachers are very jolly too so I had much fun at the sessions.

Note that the school only accepts cash payment.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review 😊 🙏 It was lovely having you with us.

reviews.name: Maribel Abellán Lucas
reviews.text: Best place for a massage in Bangkok! The workshop was wonderful and the massages and tips helped me a lot with my shoulder problems. Very knowledgeable and professional staff, highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words Maribel. We're happy to hear that you loved your workshop, and wish you continued improvement with your shoulder. 😊🙏

reviews.name: Daniele Trasatti
reviews.text: Great school with two English-speaking teachers. Great competence, attention to details and patience in teaching. It is taught not only what to do but also how and why.   They are also available to adapt to customer needs. Useful courses documentation is also provided. The final certificates are recognized by the Thai ministries of education and healthy. Good choice
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review, Daniele. It was a pleasure to have you with us. 😊🙏

reviews.name: molinie marine
reviews.text:
I completed a Thai massage initiation and a lymphatic massage training. It was a pleasure to discover the methods, theories, and practices at TTC Massage School.

The training was comprehensive, with teachers who were always available to go deeper into topics such as anatomy and the human body. All of this took place in an amazing atmosphere, full of smiles and a welcoming, comfortable environment.

I highly recommend this school to anyone who is eager to learn. Thank you so much, I will definitely be back again someday!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Marine. It was a pleasure having you for both courses. We're glad you enjoyed the depth and atmosphere. you're welcome back any time. 😊🙏

😊🙏

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for such a wonderful review! We look forward to seeing you next time 😊

reviews.name: Latisha Hill
reviews.text: I had a great experience at TTC Massage School in Bangkok. During my visit, I signed up for a one-day class in Traditional Thai Massage. The ladies and Brendan were amazing at explaining everything in simple, easy-to-understand terms. We also got to practice our new skills on a model, which was really helpful. I’m excited for my certificate to arrive and hope to come back soon for more lessons! It’s a wonderful cultural experience and a fun place to learn. improvements could be made on providing beverages & food during our class!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Latisha! We’re delighted that you enjoyed your learning experience with us and appreciated the support from our instructors.

We appreciate your helpful feedback regarding refreshments. We do have facilities available downstairs for making tea and coffee, and when you visit us next time, we’d be happy to show you where they are.

For food options, we rely on the many local businesses nearby — including 7-Eleven, street vendors, and restaurants — and students are welcome to bring food and drinks into class. Since our training is highly practical, maintaining good blood sugar levels is important for learning, so students are encouraged to snack whenever needed.

Your comfort during training is important to us, and we always encourage students to take good care of themselves while learning.

Thank you again for your kind words and for sharing your experience. We look forward to seeing you again for more training!

reviews.name: Nino Raota
reviews.text: A really nice place.. 5 swimming pools, a nice restaurant, tennis court, pool table etc. Former mango plantation so you see a lot of mango trees still growing there. The staff is very nice and the place is extraordinarily well maintained. Go there if you like it peaceful. If you are playing golf, black mountain is like a 5 min drive from there. Have fun.. 😊⛰️

reviews.name: Helenachou
reviews.text: I made my reservation via booking.com looking to stay somewhere close to black mountains golf course. However I did not realize that this particular unit that was posted under the name “Mango Paradise in der nahe black mountain golf clubs” is more of a private residence managed and maintained by Mango spa and resort. The interior is old and tattered with mold everywhere. I was expecting a resort where there is proper bedding, towels, toiletries etc… there is just old used towels and ripped mattresses and not even hand soaps for general cleaning. Various small corners brings hygiene concerns and just in really|Poor condition. Safety also poses as a great issue as the front door is just held together by an old fashion doorknob lock. I would not ever stay here. The resort staff is very nice and felt really sorry for us as the owner also grossly overcharged us for our stay. My bad for not doing more research. This is a no no no no no, and makes holiday inn looks like a six star establishment.

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: Even checking in late they still have waited you there

reviews.name: pjb27301
reviews.text: We didn’t stay here but rather we live nearby so we rode our scooter here to have dinner in the restaurant.|We ordered red curry fish and long beans, mango style spring rolls and minced beef and basil. We ordered 2 house white wines to wash it down.|The restaurant was nearly empty and our orders and drinks came fast.|The food we asked for “ Khun Thai” or spicy like the Thais eat and we were not disappointed - all had a lovely spicy kick and it was delicious! |The white wines were wonderfully cold after a hot day and it was the perfect end to our day.|Thanks for a wonderful meal which was served perfectly by Khun Morn ! |We will be back as we live in the neighbourhood!

reviews.name: Julie Lapierre
reviews.text: We had an amazing 4-nights stay. The resort is a real haven of peace. We loved walking in the beautiful gardens of the resort. The pools were very nice, as you swim in pure nature. Food in the restaurant of the resort was also very tasty and nicely prepared by the staff. All team members delivered great service. Rooms are on the old style, but totally comfortable. We can't recommend enough this resort for a lovely and peaceful stay.

reviewContext.Hotel highlights: Great view, Romantic, Quiet, Great value

reviews.name: Amrita Tatobarita
reviews.text: This is a nice and beautiful place. The rooms are cozy and very quiet except for holidays. But, I really didn't like the service. There was no water in the shower in our room, the staff was very reluctant to solve this problem. The floors were dirty and there was a lot of dust.

reviews.name: Chye de Ryckel
reviews.text: Beautiful, peaceful grounds. Very comfortable bed and room and friendly staff. Being only 5 minutes from Black Mountain, this is a great place and I plan to come back again soon.

reviews.name: David
reviews.text: Lovely big spread out resort. Beautiful gardens and several pools infront of the rooms. Houses or bungalows to choose from. On site working restaurant with tasty food. Nice staff. The rooms are a little dated but in top condition.

Just a beautiful example of a boutique property nestled away from the all the noise. The quiet pace was much appreciated as was the simple, quick and easy check-in and check-out. Thank you to all the staff.

reviews.name: 454henrikd
reviews.text: I like this place. |Nice and quiet and a very good place to relax and spend some quality time. |Bungalow type houses with shared pool. |Very good value. |Near Black Mountain golf course and water park. 20-30 min from downtown Hua Hin, but there is free shuttle service several times a day. |Restaurant is fairly good. |Service from staff is very good, friendly and helpful. |Good place for singles, couples and family's.

reviews.name: Billy Fyfe
reviews.text: It’s a little out of the way with about a 20-30 minute drive into the city. Great spot if you need to get away from it all. Staff are super friendly.

reviews.name: O7863USlizs
reviews.text: Stayed at the mango spa for 4 nights, it was nestled in a quiet place just outside hua hin. Rooms were lovely, ac was good, pools were great and all around quite peaceful. The wifi was not the best but other than that it was a lovely hotel! The staff were always very helpful! The reasteraunt was also exceptional. Overall would recommend!

reviews.name: liz-corr
reviews.text: We opted to stay in the Hua Hin countryside this time as my husband wanted to play Black Mountain and Mango spa was only a few minutes drive away. We had a top floor room with a view over one of the pools to one side and the pineapple fields to the other. The room was clean with a good bed and the quiet location allowed for a good nights sleep between days of golf. The pools were great and the gym okay. We also played boules one evening. We didn’t get a chance to hit the tennis court. We rented a motorbike from the hotel (manual Honda wave, so much better than the usual automatic scooters that are the usually offered to us in Thailand) but since it rained quite a bit the free shuttle to town was a good extra. |Unfortunately the restaurant was closed but they offered to organise lunch and dinner delivery from a nearby restaurant if pre ordered a few hours before hand. |Would defo stay again.

reviews.name: Casey
reviews.text: Looks nice in the pictures, but was totally understaffed and falling apart.  When I arrived there was only one person working - she was the waitress, the cleaner, working the front desk and who knows what else.  Needless to say, the service was terrible even though the girl doing all this was working as hard as she could.  The room was a disaster - the AC was leaking on the bed and all over the night stand, the drain in the shower and the sink did not work and so water everywhere!  Nobody available to help - I will NEVER go there again!

reviews.name: SvenOtto
reviews.text: A wonderful little resort away from it all but still just minutes away from Asia’s best golf course Black Mountain and 20 minutes from Hua Hin. Well maintained rooms and lovely pools. And great staff. Highly recommended and a great value for money.

reviews.name: calvary architect
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for an affordable yet high-quality massage experience in Phuket, Seawasdee Massage is a must-visit! We stumbled upon this charming spa while wandering around, and it completely exceeded our expectations.

What sets Seawasdee apart is its unique concept. The ambiance is relaxing, with a perfect blend of traditional Thai decor and a cozy, welcoming atmosphere. Despite the budget-friendly prices, the service feels premium — the therapists are skilled, attentive, and know exactly how to ease away the stresses of travel.

Whether you're a first-timer or a massage aficionado, Seawasdee offers a range of treatments that will leave you feeling rejuvenated without breaking the bank. The experience feels far more luxurious than the price tag suggests, making it an excellent value for anyone visiting Phuket.

Highly recommend trying it out — it’s a true hidden gem that shouldn't be missed!

reviews.name: rob lee
reviews.text:
I do not like to give bad reviews, but people need to know.

My wife and I went to this spa and signed up for 2 deep tissue massages. The place is nice and clean and the front desk lady was very nice. She did at least mention that the pressure may not be hard enough, but I have gotten well over 1,000 massages in my life and this was a top 3 worst. The pressure was non existent and there is no way they should be calling this a deep tissue massage. Within 5 minutes on the massage starting i asked for more pressure and got zero effort to give more pressure. Because I paid first I stayed and let them finish the massages, but as stated it was a top 3 worst massage ever.  If you look at my reviews I give lots of glowing reviews so I’m not that customer that always complains, but I need to let people know that this place is not the place you want to go for a good massage. If you want to lay in a quiet room and have 10 gallons of Diddy oil rubbed on you with zero pressure then this would be the spot. If you want a real massage that does the job look else where.

reviews.name: Kyra
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough good things about this spa.
My boyfriend and I had been walking around all afternoon. After dinner we were super tired and looking for a way to wind down. It was late so I called ahead of time to see if they might be able to accommodate two guests for a foot massage. The woman gladly accepted us without hesitation, despite it being around 7:30pm.

When we arrived we were given indoor slippers and bottled water. Then we were taken into a room with two big, fluffy reclining chairs that we sank into. We agreed that this had been the best foot massage either of us ever had. Each masseuse was friendly, attentive and careful to ask about pressure or sore spots.

After the session we came back out into the lobby area, which was equally as relaxing a place as the massage room. The concierge gave us two cups of hot tea drink before sending us on our way.

The experience was great from start to finish: incredible customer service, pleasant ambiance and effective massages!

reviews.text: Our experience at Peak Spa was amazing. We did initially have some difficulty finding the place, but that is primarily due to our lack of research in advance determining the location before we walked from our hotel. Once we arrived, we found a very warm atmosphere. The staff was very pleasant and helpful. Both my wife and I received massages at the same time. They did it in the same room as a couples massage. The decor in the massage room was amazing. The quality of the massage was unsurpassed. The cost for a 90 minute massage for both of us was approximately one hundred US dollars.

reviews.text: Heavenly!!! This was one of the best massage treatments I have ever received.  The staff was super friendly, spoke English, very attentive, and the spa was immaculate!!  From the moment you entered you could feel the relaxation taking over your body.  The therapy room was private with a private shower, low lighting, peaceful music and the smell of the oil that I pick out as part of the treatment.  The Peak treatment was 2.5 hours and worth every baht...treat yourself, you deserve it !!

reviews.name: Fe Vidal
reviews.text: I have visited Chiang Mai 3 times, and every time I book a massage at Peak Spa. Since my last visit in 2019  they have decreased in size (probably a result of the pandemic challenges), but the rooms and service remain exceptional. Although the spa is a 10 min walk or 3 minutes tuktuk ride from old Chiang Mai town (next to the Shangri la hotel), it is worth the minor effort. I have tried other cheaper places but it  was false economy,  as you share the room with other people and masseuses were not as good as the therapists in this spa. The therapists at this spa are very polite, professional as you can feel they know what they are doing. My husband and I tend to have massages together and have tried a variety, all very good. Iconsider a 90 minutes massage of this standard for 800 bht  (£20) a bargain. Love the traditional Thai massage and the oil one. You are also treated with tea before and after the treatment. Can't wait to return . Thank you girls.

They picked us up from the hotel and took us to the airport after our 3 hour treatment which included hair wash and styling:) I highly recommend Peak Spa if you are in need of some pampering and sore muscle treatment after all the traveling and adventures in Chiang Mai!! reviews.name: Jacques Mouton
reviews.text:
A Hidden Gem in Patong – Serene, Professional, and Utterly Relaxing

We stumbled upon this serene oasis of a spa completely by chance, while wandering down a quiet back alley in search of somewhere to eat. As we passed what turned out to be the back entrance, we noticed a pricing sign and were greeted with a warm smile and a gentle "hello" from one of the masseuses. It was such a refreshing change from the typical aggressive street-front touting you often get in tourist areas.

After dinner, curiosity got the better of us and we returned—again down the alley, thinking that was the main entrance! To our surprise, we were welcomed once more and led through the spa to the beautifully designed front area, where our experience began with a soothing foot wash before our foot scrub.

From that first visit, we were hooked. The staff were genuinely lovely—friendly, inviting, and so attentive. We ended up returning multiple times during our stay in Patong, indulging in a mix of services: foot scrubs, massages, manicures, and pedicures. Each time, the service was consistent and professional, and the atmosphere never failed to put us at ease.

The parlour itself was thoughtfully laid out, with calming music playing in the background, soft LED lighting, and air conditioners placed just right to keep things cool and comfortable. The whole vibe was one of understated luxury and tranquility—perfect for escaping the chaos of the streets outside.

If you’re looking for a spa experience that feels personal, peaceful, and polished, this hidden gem is well worth seeking out. We'll definitely be returning on our next trip to Patong.

Been here 2 times.  two different massage therapists did the massage.  both did the massage very professionally - I am a massage therapist myself and I know what I’m talking about.  specialists feel the muscles very well and know how hard to press.  After such a massage you feel lightness and a charge of vigor.
the premises require renovation.  there are no partitions between the beds.  but this does not affect the quality of the massage, especially since it costs very little.  They work from 8 am to 10 pm and it is very convenient.  the administrator was very friendly and smiling.  helped after the heat, was attentive.  Mantras sounded in the background and it was very pleasant.  thank you for the massage - it seems that I have become your regular client while I live in Thailand.😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much. We are happy to serve you as well.🥰🥰🙏

This place was enough clean to relax myself.
There are no beds, but soft and clean dick blanket on which I could lie comfortably. The massage clothes they gaved are always clean.

Actually I visited here every day when I was in Pattaya, means 5 times. Location (I stayed in Cape dara where is only ca. 3 Min. from here) was also very beneficial for me. xD

Thai traditional -  1hr. 180 Baht  in temperature conditioned room, one can also choose 2 hrs with double price. Good quality massage with  reasonable price.

Most of all, the atmosphere of the place was very light-hearted. They are blind so I was bit sorry for this.  But they seem much happier than me. ;)
So I enjoyed myself there.

reviews.name: Clara Ho
reviews.text:
We decided to visit this place after spending some time walking around the Chillva Night Market. I have to say, the massage experience was not great—it really depends on the quality of the masseuse you get. My dad and brother had a male masseuse who was quite focused and managed to hit all the right acupuncture points, while my mum and I were less fortunate.

During my session, the staff were chatting among themselves and seemed unfocused. At one point, my masseuse paused for several minutes to snack on some food before returning to her conversation and laughter. My masseuse also started 15 minutes later but I ended the same time as my family.

I eventually had to stop her because it felt like she was just applying an excessive amount of oil to my legs and feet without providing a proper massage. This made my legs and feet feel incredibly greasy, which was quite uncomfortable, especially in the hot and humid weather. When I asked her to wipe off some of the oil, she carelessly used a wet cloth to do so. I ended up using a wet wipe to remove the remaining oil myself.

I paid 250 baht for a 60-minute foot massage. While that’s an affordable price, it certainly wasn’t an enjoyable experience. I wanted to try this place because I had seen several good reviews, but unfortunately, the quality of service was inconsistent.

reviews.name: Charalambos Bourgoutzis
reviews.text:
Highly Recommended – My Go-To Massage Place in Pattaya!

I’ve been a regular customer for over 3 years now and visit almost daily whenever I’m in Pattaya. Why? Because the service is incredibly friendly and welcoming—starting from the therapists to the manager and all the way up to the management.

Whether you choose a foot, back, or oil massage: you get a budget-friendly, deeply relaxing escape with a guaranteed feel-good factor. I have always been completely satisfied here. (Friendly reminder: if you are happy with the service, make sure to leave a good tip! 😉)

I’m already super excited for my next visit at the new location. Warmest regards to Sai and the whole team—and a special thank you to Nat for the wonderful massages in April 2026! Keep up the fantastic work! 🌸

reviews.name: Worratha Jantaban
reviews.text:
Even after reading the owner’s response, it is clear that the core issue has still not been acknowledged. This establishment urgently needs to improve its service standards, particularly in terms of professionalism, courtesy, and customer respect.

The owner’s reply itself demonstrates rude and unprofessional language toward a customer who simply described their real experience. Instead of addressing the problem constructively, the response shifts blame and accuses the customer, which is highly inappropriate for a business owner.

The service I received was extremely poor. During the massage, excessive force was applied, including forceful stepping and stomping on my back. This resulted in physical injury that required medical treatment at a hospital and medication prescribed by a doctor after leaving your shop. This is not a matter of opinion, but a factual consequence of the service provided.

A professional business should listen to feedback, take responsibility, and prioritize customer safety. Refusing to accept reality and responding with accusations only reinforces the lack of professionalism shown throughout the entire experience.

Based on both the service received and the owner’s inappropriate response, this business demonstrates serious deficiencies in customer care and professional conduct, and should carefully reconsider whether it is fit to continue operating without significant improvement.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Nonsense. You directed therapist to apply much greater pressure. Instructed her to stand above. Nobody walks on head and neck. Its dangerous,  life threatening. Present yourself with medical bills, dated, original, authentic. We know our staff, strengths and weaknesses and your claim is rubbish. We are 10 years operating next to Walking Street with many, many return and satisfied customers. Present yourself and discuss, by appointment,  rather than online. Your massage was discussed with the therapist involved. You are Thai. You directed the therapist to stand above and increase pressure on your back, as this is the only way to deliver very strong pressure. Nobody walks on anyone's back, or on anybody's head. That is irregular, and dangerous. Our therapists all have the appropriate massage certificates and we test their skill and massage steps before we accept them to our massage team. Start and finish times are always written, noted by cashier, so the insinuation we shorten the massage time, or wander away from the client for extended periods is not true and not possible. At finish of the body massage steps, for hygiene, the therapist always goes to wash her hands, then begins head and shoulder steps. Our reviews are good because our shop is clean, is safe, is professional. We take extra care with this point. Finally, Thai don't usually review (this is unusual), its usual they speak, and complain, at the time. I'd guess you are a jealous competitor with malicious intent to harm our good reputation.
Every comment, feedback, review is discussed by our management team. Your review is malicious nonsense.

Sometimes, taking care of your body doesn’t have to wait until something feels wrong.

At HUG YOGA Chiang Rai, we take time to move gently, stretch, breathe, and listen to the body.

You don’t have to be flexible.

One practice at a time. 🤍

HUG YOGA Chiang Rai, Thailand

At HUG YOGA Chiang Rai, Thailand we take a Therapeutic Approach to Yoga, using yoga as a way to care for the body and mind.

Our teaching begins with the practitioner — not with the pose.

We consider each person's symptoms, physical condition, individual needs, and experience. We focus on mindful movement, appropriate body alignment, breathing, and overall body–mind balance.

Yoga is not about making the most difficult pose, looking perfect, or copying someone else's body.

It is about learning to listen to your body, understanding its needs and limitations, and finding a practice that is appropriate for you.

Yoga that begins with listening to the body.

Yoga practice is not only about how a pose looks.

At HUG YOGA, we pay attention to foot placement, weight distribution, alignment, and how the body moves during practice.

Warrior 1, Warrior 2, and Warrior 3 offer different ways to observe and understand our body while moving and balancing.

With a Therapeutic Yoga foundation, the focus is on practicing with awareness and understanding the body.

Yoga is not about forcing your body.
It’s about understanding your body. 🌿

At HUG YOGA Chiang Rai, we believe that every body is different — with different needs, abilities, and starting points.

Whether you are new to yoga, returning after a long break, active in other sports, or simply looking for a more comfortable way to move, your practice should begin by listening to your body.

At HUG YOGA Chiang Rai, all of our yoga practices are based on a therapeutic approach — including Hatha Yoga, Vinyasa Yoga, Yin Yoga, Iyengar Yoga, Chair Yoga, and Water Therapeutic Yoga.

We don’t focus on making your body fit into a pose.

We adapt the practice to help you understand your body.

We don’t teach you to force your body.

We teach you to understand your body.

— HUG YOGA Chiang Rai 🌿

Another day of moving, breathing, and reconnecting with the body.

With personalized guidance and a mindful approach, we help you move better, build strength and flexibility, and take better care of your body. 🌿

Instead I ended up with a painful kink in my neck after the back massage that was lightly worked on after that luckily allowed me to leave slightly discomforted rather than in abject pain!

reviews.name: Thai Truong
reviews.text: We came here on our first full day in Phuket. I wanted a 2 hour Thai massage but they could only squeeze me in for an hour. The lady who did it was excellent I was worried she wouldn't be strong enough but I had nothing to worry about. After an hour I left feeling refreshed and a new man. I came back the next day with my wife and had a foot scrub and the same lady is a miracle worker. My feet felt like a new babies skin after she had finished with them. Let me tell you it's no exaggeration when I say my feet were like the grand canyon. They were dry and cracked around the heels after numerous attempts at different holiday spots she had by far been the best. We have booked to come back for a 3 hour session to get the full works before we leave Phuket and cannot wait. I would 1000% recommend coming here for whatever your needs you will be looked after.

reviews.name: 晚秋
reviews.text: Had my WORST ever massage in Thailand (Chiangmai & Phuket)! The person was literally only spreading coconut oil on my body—no serious massage at all until I couldn’t endure (as I pay twice as much compared to Thai massage!) and reminded her. Compared to all other massages I had in Thailand (including an aromatic oil massage I had at Kim’s 5 just two days ago), the person I got this time doesn’t have systemic knowledge or experience of massaging people. She was doing dramatically different on left/right and upper/lower sides of my body. She lacked patience for dealing with my body reaction when it hurt too much as well. All in all, I’m extremely disappointed by the massage level in Phuket. Chiangmai is much better, plus even cheaper.

reviews.name: Brenda Sanders
reviews.text: I thought this place would be okay since it’s close to where we stay, but unfortunately it was highly disappointing.  The staff isn’t friendly or welcoming, and even though I had a 4:00 booking for a 2-hour foot masssge, I ended up waiting an additional 35 minutes, because they forgot about me.  They always claim they’re full, but I didn’t see hardly any customers at all.  Finally, one girl washed my feet, and started to give me a massage, only to walk away a couple times to talk to one of the other staff members.  She walked away again,, and another male masseuse took her place.  All he did was apply oil and barely rubbed my feet and ankles the remainder of the time.  Hd seemed unmotivated and distracted as well.  The problem is Moon Massage has an adjacent hotel and restaurant.  The place was fancy and very clean, but I felt an immediate chill upon walking in, and it wasn’t from the air conditioning. The lady at the reception made me pay in advance, so this way, they have their money regardless of the experience customers have.  When I booked the night before, she had me write my name on a piece of paper and take a screenshot of it to prove I had a booking.  I thought that was a bit odd.  The massage wasn’t professional, and the staff isn’t properly trained.  They never offered any type of refreshments either, such as water or tea.  Every other place I’ve gone to does that, as well as ask how our massage wasn’t professional.  I’ve been doing tough workouts all week, and my legs were very sore, and I was really looking forward to a good massage, but I was highly disappointed.  Tomorrow I plan on going to one of my other places where I feel welcome.  Do yourself a favor, avoid this place. There are so many better ones in Phuket.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Brenda Sanders,
​On behalf of the management at The Moon Massage, thank you for your honest feedback. We would like to extend our deepest apologies for the disappointing experience you had with us.
​Following your review, we conducted a thorough internal investigation and found that your feedback is accurate. We take full responsibility for the lapses in our service and sincerely regret that we failed to meet the high standards we strive to uphold.
​We are taking immediate action to improve based on your experience:
• ​Service Excellence: We have addressed the issues regarding our hospitality, refreshments, and the lack of continuity during treatments. We are committed to ensuring every guest feels welcomed and professionally cared for throughout their visit.
• ​Staff Retraining: Your comments on the massage technique and professionalism have been integrated into our immediate staff retraining program to ensure our team remains motivated and skilled.
• ​Operational Improvements: We are refining our booking and communication procedures to make them more professional and seamless for all our guests.
​We are truly sorry that we let you down. We value your feedback as it helps us identify our weaknesses and work towards making The Moon Massage a better place for everyone.
​Sincerely,
Management Team, The Moon Massage

reviews.text:
I initially brought my husband here for a pedicure after noticing their "scrape and polish" service on the menu. It turned out to be one of the best pedicures we've ever seen! While my son and I were waiting, we decided to indulge in a foot and scalp massage for ourselves. The experience was absolutely fantastic—professional, relaxing, and just amazing all around.

In fact, we loved it so much that for the next five days of our stay in Pattaya, we returned every single day. Each day, we tried something new—Thai massage, hot oil massage, regular oil massage, foot massage, head and shoulder massage, you name it. Even though the place was a bit far from our resort, it was absolutely worth the trip every time.

All three of us had a fantastic experience on each visit, and we can't recommend this place highly enough. Next time we're in Pattaya, we’ll definitely be back!

reviews.name: Tan Wei Hong
reviews.text:
Came in while just walking around town. Many staffs were sitting outside. I spoke to the first lady who asked if i wanted to get a massage.

tried a 1hr foot massage. initially, i was taken aback when asked to pay first. after that, everything was as expected. foot wash, seated, foot massage, and ending with a shoulder massage.

strength was good enough and the staff (Su) was quite attentive. i could feel that she worked out the tensed muscles and was also patiently pressing at the acupuncture points with her hands, and sometimes, a wooden stick tool.

i left genuinely satisfied. it was very affordable at 200thb. there wasnt any pressure for a tip at anytime even i as was walking out of the store. i was impressed, and tipped anyway.

The front is full of chairs for foot massages which can fit dozens of people at once, while the back are rooms for body massages. while i was there, customers were coming in and going out. seems like a good reputable place.

overheard some korean and chinese tourist commenting about visiting again, or having visited a few times.

title: Nuru Massage
ownerDescription:
We are the only spa in Phuket dedicated to Nuru Massage and we'll provide you with a unique experience.
Nuru massage is something far different from any traditional massage performed by hands: when using this japanese technique, the masseuse uses her entire body and employs an extremely slippery massage oil based on water and chamomile extract that allows for ease of movement and will intensify every sensation and ease any ache.
Every part of your body will be explored and stimulated with utmost care by your therapist, her smooth warm skin gliding over yours, her skilled hands soothing away any pain and ache buried deep within your muscles.
A memorable blend of healing and intimacy an experience that will stay with you forever.

reviews.name: Vincent Lin
reviews.text:
Last night I returned to Nuru, ready to see if the legends of this place still lived up to the hype. Spoiler: they do… and then some.

From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by a squadron of Thailand’s finest, all flashing smiles so warm they could melt steel. My chosen lady was an absolute vision — silky hair, flawless skin, and a smile that promised I was about to experience something biblical.

The royal treatment began immediately. A warm, thorough shower scrub left me feeling reborn, followed by an indulgent session where the most luxurious unscented oils were worked into every inch of me with precision and care. These women don’t just do massages — they perform art.

The ambience was equal parts opulence and comfort, like a five-star spa with just the right amount of naughty. Every minute was orchestrated to perfection, leaving me in a blissed-out haze where time lost all meaning.

Only downside? Once again, the schnob got wrapped before the magic — but judging by my grin in the photo, you can tell I left Nuru floating several inches above the ground.

Would I recommend? Absolutely. Would I return? Already planning it.

reviews.name: Hallo Freiheit
reviews.text:
Wir waren 3 mal da. Die ersten beiden Male war es super. Ich kann nicht mehr sagen als: die beste massage die ich hier (und in anderen asiatischen Ländern) hatte. Es war perfekt. Das dritte Mal war alles andere als gut. Ellenbogen rieb über Wirbelsäule statt Muskeln, Bänder im Fußgelenk wurden nachhaltig so überdehnt, dass es drei Tage später noch weh tut. Ich wollte täglich hin gehen, aber daraus wurde durch die Erfahrung denn nichts.

Ein wirklich großes Dankeschön geht an die Frau im Foto. Sie hat sehr gute Arbeit geleistet, und macht ihre Sache wirklich super. Individuell auf problematische Stellen eingegangen. Und sie weiß wo man ansetzen muss.
Ich fand es schade nicht nochmal hin gekommen zu sein. Es ist jedoch immer die Frage wer da ist. Von "alles perfekt" bis "nachhaltig schlimm" ist leider alles möglich. Deshalb halte ich 3sterne für fair. Es ist wie Lotto.

Danke an die guten und an die schlechten sei gesagt: bildet euch bitte weiter.
reviews.textTranslated:
We went there three times. The first two times were fantastic. I can't say more than: it was the best massage I've had here (and in other Asian countries). It was perfect. The third time was anything but good. My elbow rubbed against my spine instead of my muscles, and the ligaments in my ankle were so severely overstretched that it still hurts three days later. I wanted to go every day, but that experience made that impossible.

A huge thank you goes to the woman in the photo. She did a great job and is truly excellent at what she does. She addressed problem areas individually and knows exactly where to start.

I was disappointed that I couldn't go back. However, it always depends on who's there. Unfortunately, anything is possible, from "everything perfect" to "recently awful." That's why I think three stars is fair. It's like the lottery.

Thanks to the good ones, and to the bad ones: please continue your education.

Personally, I had a mixed Thai Oil massage and Mrs. Ae found by herself all my prevailing back and shoulder issues which were handled very, very well. I had one of my best and also a painfree sleep the night after. Thank you so much!!!

reviews.name: Ricardo Monteiro Holanda
reviews.text: One of the worst places for massage I’ve ever been in Thailand. I come to Thailand almost every month and I always do massage. I’ve been to great places and not very good ones, unfortunately this one enters the list of one of the worst places. I came as a friend recommended and said it would be the best massage of my life, I wish it was the case but definitely wasn’t. The therapist itself wasn’t that bad, but seemed not very thorough with his technique. The place is extremely noisy, that’s the worst part! They allowed an infant in the foot massage area. And it was the opposite of relaxing with all the noise the infant was making. When went upstairs for a aroma oil massage there was a group of Chinese talking extremely loud and none of the workers seemed to care. As a matter of fact even some Thai ladies who I believed work there were also speaking super super loud. So I can say that I didn’t leave relaxed and the money was not worth, even tho it’s quite cheap. So to sum up I don’t recommend!

reviews.text:
Just had a massage at Radamanee Massage in Chalong and it was really, really good. The place is clean, quiet, and has a very relaxing vibe without trying too hard. The massage itself felt super professional and effective — not just relaxing, but you can feel your body loosen up right away. Everything felt smooth and well-organized, and the price is honestly great for the quality you get. Definitely one of those places you want to come back to again.

title: Banyan Spa & Wellbeing Academy
ownerDescription:
Set amongst tranquil gardens in Phuket, Thailand, Banyan Tree Spa & Wellbeing Academy celebrates the art of touch and focuses on an exotic blend of ancient health and beauty practices passed down through the generations.
The academy empowers students to start or advance their career in the spa & wellbeing industry. Nurturing a hands-on approach to bestow confidence and skills, practical theory combines with bodywork techniques and treatments for a holistic focus and an innovative approach to wellness. Dedicated therapists oversee each academy training program with meticulous attention to detail.
address: 33 Cherngtalay, 33/27 Srisoonthorn Rd Bang Tao Beach, Choeng Thale, Thalang District, Phuket 83110, Thailand
plusCode: 276W+4M Choeng Thale, Thalang District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Rizki fiana Lestari
reviews.text: My training sessions at Banyan Tree Academy Phuket was an inspiring and transformative experience. From the moment i arrived, i felt the academy’s strong commitment to excellence, professionalism, and personal growth. The training environment was well-organized and welcoming. The trainers were knowledgeable, supportive, and highly experienced in the hospitality industry. One of the most valuable aspects of the training was learning about core values and service philosophy behind the Banyan tree brand.  Overall, my experience at Banyan tree Academy Phuket enhanced my skill, broadened my perspective on hospitality excellence, and motivated me to continuously improve myself. It was not just training, it was a valuable step forward in my professional development. I would like to say many thanks for all of the trainers there.

reviews.name: Marin Tapnoi
reviews.text: I had an excellent learning experience at Banyan Tree Spa Academy. The course "Thai Herbal Holistic Spa Care For Elderly" is well-designed, practical, and highly professional. The instructors are very knowledgeable and experienced, the learning environment is excellent, and all training equipment is complete and professional. The skills learned can be applied directly in real practice. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: เบญญาพร การิมการ
reviews.text:
I would like to sincerely thank Banyan Tree Academy for organizing such a wonderful activity. The learning atmosphere was enjoyable, friendly, and not stressful, yet still focused and rich in knowledge. It allowed participants to gain both practical skills and genuine understanding.

The course provided comprehensive knowledge in both theory and practice, especially the applied Thai massage techniques designed specifically for elderly body structures — promoting relaxation while prioritizing safety.

In addition, we learned how to prepare herbal tea suitable for seniors, create herbal massage oils, and understand the fundamentals of selecting and blending essential oils according to different conditions. All of these can be effectively applied in professional services as well as in caring for family members.

The instructors explained clearly, paid close attention to details, and guided us through hands-on practice at every step, which gave me greater confidence to apply what I have learned in real situations. 🤍

reviews.name: Kanyapat Pattanapokinsakul
reviews.text: We spent five days studying Thai herbal holistic care for the elderly course. It was truly a wonderful experience. Both theoretical and practical examinations were included, which helped strengthen confidence and skills.
I am very happy and grateful to have the opportunity to return and study at Banyan tree Spa Academy once again.🤗🙏🤍🫶

It's conveniently located near the bypass road with easy access from multiple routes. Practicing yoga here is a wellness retreat, perfect for escaping the hustle and bustle, immersing yourself in nature, and practicing yoga and meditation for complete physical and mental well-being.

hotelDescription:
A 13-minute walk from Patong Beach, this polished hotel is 13 km from Phuket FantaSea theme park and 19 km from the Wat Chalong temple complex.
 Airy rooms offer free Wi-Fi, plus minifridges, cable TV and coffeemakers. Some rooms add balconies, whirlpool tubs and/or separate living areas. Family rooms have extra beds.
 There's a casual dining room with a bar and a terrace. The hotel offers 2 outdoor pools, including a rooftop pool with city views, plus a business center and motorbike rentals.

reviews.text:
WORST experience ever.
I booked 3 rooms, and the quality of the hotel was completely unacceptable. The rooms were extremely dirty, and the washrooms were absolutely filthy totally unhygienic and shocking.

There is a street in front of the hotel, so I asked the person standing outside to let me bring my car inside briefly to unload luggage. Instead of helping, he started arguing and fighting with me. He behaved as if he owned the entire street he is the king of that street and was extremely rude and aggressive.

Despite booking three rooms, I was not allowed to take my car inside to load my luggage, and they refused to help. The person who is outside the street used abusive language and showed zero professionalism. This is not how guests especially foreign tourists should ever be treated.

If you want to spoil your vacation, you can choose this hotel. Otherwise, stay far away.

Never staying here again. Highly not recommended.

reviewContext.Nearby activities: The person standing outside of the street extremely rude and he don't know how to speak with foreigners

reviews.name: Natasha Marsh
reviews.text:
SCAM ALERT!
FAULSE ADVERTISEMENT ONLINE!

Do not book this hotel.
Just look at my pictures.

This is the most unsafe I’ve ever felt in a hotel in my entire life, banging and screaming throughout the night, no lock on the doors either.
Shoved into a construction site building away from the main building. It was boreded up with metal sheets, with wood planks everywhere and leaks dripping from the roof.
Pool looks like it’s never been cleaned. Stagnant water is extremely dangerous but it says it’s open for use…
The room itself is vile. Mould around the entire room is painted over, stains on the curtains and towels. Disgusting bathroom with no water pressure, I had to wash my hands with the shower.
The pictures on their website are false advertisement, I don’t know how they get away with it. Don’t waste your money or time.

reviews.name: mohammad asadi
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at this hotel and had an absolutely wonderful experience from start to finish. The rooms were spotless, comfortable, and beautifully maintained. The amenities were top-notch, and the location was perfect for both relaxing and exploring the area.

What truly made my stay exceptional, though, was the staff—especially one standout team member: Win at the front desk. From the moment I checked in, Win was warm, professional, and incredibly helpful. Whether I had questions about local recommendations or just needed a friendly face after a long day, Win went above and beyond every time.

It’s rare to find such genuine hospitality, and Win truly made me feel welcome and cared for. I’ll definitely be returning—and I hope to see Win again on my next visit!

Highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for comfort, quality, and outstanding service.

reviews.name: Igor M
reviews.text:
There is almost nothing there like in the pictures. Whole place is runned down, which itself is not a problem, since the price was adjusted.
The problem is no maintenance, unhygienic conditions, dirty rooms, mold everywhere, just see the pictures.
We left the room immediately, and the lady at the check in desk just returned our deposit, and told us to ask for money on the site where we booked the hotel. Which we did immediately, after a few days of them trying to contact the hotel, and some back and forward, we got full refund

reviewContext.Noteworthy details: Mold in the bathroom, and indifference of hotel staff about it

reviews.name: thehalligantool !
reviews.text: Honestly, for the price, this place was a steal. The location is great relative to downtown and is 100% walkable. The restaurant on site was yummy and the morning breakfast is worth including in your room price. The rooftop pool is a little sad and in need of repair with many loose and missing tiles. If you book a standard room, you don't stay in the main building, but further up the alley in a different building that's a tad older, but it really wasn't a big deal to us. The AC was cold and that's what we wanted! Our showerhead didn't have a mount on the wall so you had to hold it to shower and the in room safe didn't work, but for the single night, the location, and the price we really couldn't complain.

reviewContext.Rooms: Adequate for the price and location.
reviewContext.Nearby activities: Very close to the walking street and a short walk to the beach.
reviewContext.Food & drinks: The attached restaurant was good and I'd recommend getting the available breakfast with your booking.

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: The worst experience i ever had in my life… I end up booking another hotel 🙁 The room was dirty, pretty old without tv, refrigerator no good wifi no signal for using mobile data totally different from the photos that i see once i book! My opinion avoid at any cost this place

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: This hotel location was great, right in the middle of everything.  It is only a few minutes walk to the beach.  There are plenty of shops and restaurants around.  However, we could not get in  our room because the door lock didn't work.  It took a long time for them to change us to another room.   Then we found that the A/C  remote control was not working...took another hour or so for them to change the remote...Also the wifi in our room was not working during our stay.

reviews.name: Taju
reviews.text:
1. "This was hands down the worst hotel experience I’ve ever had. The room was filthy, the bathroom smelled horrible, and the staff were rude and unhelpful. I wouldn’t stay here again if it was free."

2. "Avoid this place at all costs. The pictures online are completely misleading. Dirty sheets, 🦎 in the room, and zero soundproofing — it felt like I was sleeping on the street."

3. "If you care about your comfort, safety, or sanity, do yourself a favor and book somewhere else. This hotel is a scam, plain and simple."

title: Nava Balance Pilates and Yoga - พิลาทิสโยคะบางแก้ว บางพลี บางนา

reviews.name: Chonrinee SR.
reviews.text:
จากประสบการณ์ส่วนตัว คือ เริ่มเรียนพิลาทีสครั้งแรกในชีวิตกับที่นี่ และเลือกเป็นเรียนแบบ private หลังจบคลาสแรก ครูบอกว่า ลองเข้าแบบ group class ได้นะ ความประทับใจแรกเลยคือ ครูประเมินและแนะนำเราตามจริง ไม่Hard sellที่จะขายคอร์ส ทำให้เรารู้สึกสบายใจและไม่อึดอัด จากตอนนั้นจนถึงตอนนี้ก้เรียน group class มาตลอด สำหรับใครที่กำลังมองหาที่ทดลองเรียน หรือ อยากเปลี่ยนบรรยากาศมาสตูแบบโฮมมี่ แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ ไม่รู้สึกอึดอัดหลังจบคลาสแน่นอน

ที่นี่มีคลาสและเวลาให้เลือกเล่นเยอะพอสมควร ครูในแต่ละคลาสก็จะมีสไตล์การสอนของตัวเอง แต่ที่ครูทุกคนมีเหมือนกันคือ ความใส่ใจและสายตาที่คอยสอดส่องท่าทางของเราประดุจเหยี่ยว ว่องไวเกินคาด 55555

ด้วยความที่คลาสที่นี่รับแค่ไม่เกิน4คน ทำให้ครูดูแล คอยปรับท่าทางให้เหมาะสมได้อย่างทั่วถึง และที่ชอบอีกอย่างนึงคือ ต่อให้คนจะลงเรียนในแต่ละคลาสไม่ถึง 4 คน ครูก้สอน ไม่เทไม่ยกเลิกตาราง ทำให้เราเหมือนได้เรียนแบบ private ไปเลยค้าาา

ในเรื่องของความสะอาดและความสะดวกสบายในการจอดรถ ให้100/100 ทั้งสะอาด และจอดรถได้บริเวณสตู จะฝนตกแดดออกก้ไม่ต้องลำบากเดินไกล เข้าคลาสทันเวลาแน่นอนค่าาาา 😆😆
reviews.textTranslated:
From my personal experience, I started my first ever Pilates class here, initially choosing private lessons. After my first class, the instructor suggested I try a group class. My first impression was that the instructor assessed and advised me honestly, without hard-selling me courses. This made me feel comfortable and at ease. Since then, I've consistently taken group classes. For anyone looking to try a class or wanting a change of pace to a homey studio atmosphere, I highly recommend this place. You definitely won't feel uncomfortable after a class.

They have a good variety of classes and times to choose from. Each instructor has their own teaching style, but what they all have in common is their attentiveness and keen, observant gaze—like a hawk, surprisingly quick!

Because classes only have a maximum of 4 people, the instructors can provide thorough attention and adjust your posture. Another thing I love is that even if there are fewer than 4 people in a class, the instructors will still teach; they won't cancel or cancel the session. It feels just like a private lesson!

Regarding cleanliness and parking convenience, I give it 100/100. It's very clean, and there's parking right by the studio, so you don't have to walk far whether it's raining or sunny. I'll definitely be in class on time! 😆😆
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมาก ๆ ค่า

reviews.name: SUCHADA W
reviews.text:
เราเรียนพิลาทิส Group Class ของที่นี่อย่างต่อเนื่องมาเข้าปีที่ 2 แล้ว คลาสที่นี่ค่อนข้างเล็กเลย เรียนรอบละ 3-4 คน ทำให้ครูดูแลได้ทั่วถึง เข้าจัดท่าให้ได้ครบทุกคน ไม่ต้องกังวลว่าจะทำท่าผิดแล้วบาดเจ็บ สงสัยอะไร? ปวดตรงไหน? คุยกับครูได้ตลอดคลาส

หากเรียนต่อเนื่องมาเรื่อยๆ ครูที่นี่จะจดจำปัญหาของนักเรียนแต่ละคนได้ค่ะ บางคนอกตึง บางคนขาตึง บางคนไม่ค่อยมีแรง ครูก็หาท่ามาแก้ให้ในคลาสตลอด ให้การบ้านด้วย เรียนที่นี่ไม่ค่อยมีท่าซ้ำเลย ปรับเลเวลให้เรื่อยๆ ซึ่งตรงนี้ให้ความรู้สึกเหมือน Private Class ค่ะ (ที่เราไม่เรียน private เพราะราคาสูงไปทำให้เรียนต่อเนื่องไม่ได้)

เราเองเล่น Group ใหญ่ตามฟิตเนส (24 เตียง) ควบคู่กับที่ Navar ไปด้วย เวลาไปเล่นรวมที่อื่นทำให้ระมัดระวังตัวเองได้ดีขึ้น และเข้าท่าได้ถูกต้องมากขึ้นค่ะ

เรียนอย่างน้อยสัปดาห์ละ 1 ครั้ง Navar ก็ทำให้ร่างกายพัฒนาขึ้นได้ค่ะ ❤️
reviews.textTranslated:
We've been consistently attending Pilates Group Classes here for almost two years now. The classes are quite small, only 3-4 people per session, allowing the instructor to provide personalized attention and ensure everyone's form is corrected. You don't have to worry about incorrect form and injury. If you have questions or experience any pain, you can talk to the instructor throughout the class.

If you continue to attend classes, the instructors here will remember each student's individual needs. Some might have tight chests, some tight legs, some lack strength – the instructor will find exercises to address these issues in class, and they also give homework. The exercises here are rarely repeated, and the difficulty level is gradually increased, which feels similar to a private class. (We don't take private classes because they're too expensive for us to continue.)

I also train in larger group gyms (24 benches) alongside at Navar. Training in group classes here helps me be more careful and maintain better form.

At least once a week at Navar, you can definitely improve your physical condition. ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณพี่นิ้มพี่วินมากๆเลยค่ะ 2026 ไปกันต่อค่า 😻❤️

reviews.name: Natthanan Intharat
reviews.text:
ถ้าย้อนกลับไปก่อนหน้านี้ เราเคยเรียนทั้งโยคะและพิลาทิสในฟิตเนสมาหลายที่ แต่ยังไม่ค่อยเจอที่ที่รู้สึก “ใช่” เพราะคลาสมีคนเยอะ ทำให้ผู้สอนไม่สามารถดูแลได้ทั่วถึง บางครั้งทำท่าถูกหรือผิดก็ไม่แน่ใจ และไม่ได้รับคำแนะนำมากนัก

จนได้มาเจอ Nava Yoga ตอนแรกตั้งใจจะสมัครเรียนแค่ 2-3 เดือน แต่ตอนนี้กลายเป็นเรียนต่อเนื่องมาเกือบ 2 ปีแล้วค่ะ

สิ่งที่ประทับใจที่สุดคือคลาสขนาดเล็ก คุณครูใส่ใจนักเรียนทุกคนจริง ๆ คอยปรับท่า แนะนำรายละเอียดเล็ก ๆ น้อย ๆ และดูแลตามสภาพร่างกายของแต่ละคน หากใครมีอาการบาดเจ็บหรือข้อจำกัดด้านสุขภาพ คุณครูก็จะช่วยปรับท่าให้เหมาะสมและคอยสังเกตเป็นพิเศษ

อีกอย่างที่ชอบมากคือบรรยากาศการเรียนที่ไม่กดดัน ไม่มีการเปรียบเทียบหรือแข่งขันกับใคร แต่เป็นการค่อย ๆ พัฒนาตัวเองในแบบของเรา ทำให้รู้สึกว่าการออกกำลังกายเป็นเรื่องที่สนุกและยั่งยืน ทุกครั้งที่กลับมาเรียนก็ได้เห็นพัฒนาการของตัวเองทีละนิด ซึ่งเป็นความรู้สึกที่ดีมาก

สำหรับใครที่กำลังมองหาสถานที่เรียนโยคะที่อบอุ่น ใส่ใจ และให้ความสำคัญกับคุณภาพการสอนจริง ๆ Nava Yoga เป็นที่ที่เราอยากแนะนำจากประสบการณ์ตรงค่ะ 🤍
reviews.textTranslated:
Looking back, I've taken yoga and Pilates classes at several fitness centers, but I hadn't quite found a place that felt "right" for me. The classes were often too crowded, making it difficult for instructors to provide individual attention. Sometimes I wasn't sure if I was doing poses correctly, and I didn't receive much guidance.

Then I discovered Nava Yoga. Initially, I only intended to enroll for 2-3 months, but now I've been attending classes continuously for almost 2 years!

What I appreciate most is the small class size. The instructors truly care for each student, adjusting poses, providing small details, and taking care of each individual's physical condition. If anyone has injuries or health limitations, the instructors will help adjust poses and pay special attention to them.

Another thing I love is the relaxed learning atmosphere. There's no pressure, no comparisons, or competition; instead, it's about gradual self-improvement. This makes exercising feel fun and sustainable. Every time I return to class, I see gradual progress, which is a wonderful feeling.

For anyone looking for a warm, caring yoga studio that prioritizes quality instruction, I highly recommend Nava Yoga based on my personal experience. 🤍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 🙏🏻🥹❤️ขอบคุณมากๆเลยค่า

reviews.name: Jaraschom Dechkajon
reviews.text: เลิสๆเลยหละ Pilates ในหมู่บ้าน บริทาเนียเมกะทาวบางนา คุณครูน่ารักใส่ใจทุกรายละเอียด สถานที่สะอาดสวยงามมมม

reviews.name: Phakawadee Kanjanapibool
reviews.text:
ไม่เคยมีประสบการณ์ในการเรียน Pilates มาก่อน เลยลองหาที่เรียนใกล้บ้านและอยู่ในโซนที่เดินทางสะดวก (หลังเมกาบางนา) จนได้มาเรียนที่นี่กับเพื่อนซึ่งเป็นการลองเรียน Pilates ครั้งแรกทั้งคู่ไม่มีประสบการณ์มาก่อนเลย😅

ประทับใจตั้งแต่แอดมินเลยค่ะ ทั้งการดูแล ความสะอาดของสถานที่ และบรรยากาศโดยรวม ที่สำคัญคุณครูทุกคนเฟรนลี่มาก เข้าใจนักเรียน ใจเย็นในการสอน และมีการสอบถามถึงจุดประสงค์ในการมาเรียน รวมถึงอาการบาดเจ็บต่าง ๆ ก่อนเริ่มคลาส

ส่วนตัวได้เรียนคอร์สกับ ครูแจมมี่ รู้สึกว่าครูมีความชำนาญและเป็นมืออาชีพมาก ใจเย็น คอยดูแลและช่วยปรับท่าทางต่าง ๆ เพื่อป้องกันการบาดเจ็บให้กับนักเรียน

ถึงแม้ว่าจะเป็น คอร์สแบบกลุ่ม แต่ก็ยังรู้สึกว่าได้รับการดูแลและเข้าถึงนักเรียนทุกคนอย่างทั่วถึง ทำให้รู้สึกมั่นใจและสนุกกับการเรียนมากค่ะ 🤍
reviews.textTranslated:
I had never taken a Pilates class before, so I looked for a place near my home in a convenient area (behind Mega Bangna). That's how I ended up learning here with a friend – it was both our first time trying Pilates, and we had no prior experience at all 😅

I was impressed from the moment I arrived. The care, cleanliness of the place, and overall atmosphere were all excellent. Most importantly, all the instructors were incredibly friendly, understanding, patient, and always inquired about our learning objectives and any existing injuries before each class.

I personally took a course with Instructor Jammy. I felt she was very skilled and professional, patient, and attentive, helping to adjust postures to prevent injuries.

Even though it was a group class, I still felt well-cared for and received personalized attention from everyone. It made me feel confident and enjoy the class very much! 🤍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากๆเลยค่ะ ❤️

reviews.name: Renu Lekawat
reviews.text: ครูสอนดีมาก ถึงจะเป็นกรุ๊ปคลาส แต่ครูดูแลทั่วถึง เอาใจใส่นักเรียนทุกคน ไม่ต่างจากไพรเวทเลย เหนื่อยทุกครั้ง แต่ก็สนุกทุกครั้ง มาเล่นกับลูกสาววัยรุ่น ลูกชอบมาก แม่ก็แฮปปี้มากค่ะ 😘😘
reviews.textTranslated: The teacher is excellent. Even though it's a group class, the teacher is attentive and caring towards every student, just like a private lesson. It's tiring every time, but also fun. I came to play with my teenage daughter, and she loved it. I'm very happy too! 😘😘
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมาก ๆ ค่า ❤️

reviews.name: Chanutr CCN
reviews.text: ครูเก้าใจดี เข้าใจเงื่อนไขร่างกายของนักเรียนพร้อมอธิบาย สถานที่สะอาด รู้สึกโฮมมี่ ชิลๆ แนะนำให้มาลองเรียนโยคะที่นี่ ที่สำคัญคลาสกลุ่มราคาน่ารัก
reviews.textTranslated: Teacher Kao is kind and understanding of students' physical conditions, always ready to explain. The place is clean, feels homey and chill. I recommend trying a yoga class here. Importantly, the group classes are affordably priced.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากๆเลยค่า

reviews.name: Duangkamon Naklop
reviews.text:
ดีใจมากที่ได้มาเรียนที่นี่ค่ะ จากเดิมที่ดวงมีภาวะเส้นเลือดในสมองแตก ทำให้ร่างกายแข็ง ชาครึ่งซีก ขยับได้แต่ไม่ค่อยคล่อง พอเริ่มพิลาทิสที่นี่ประมาณ 2–3 เดือน รู้สึกถึงความเปลี่ยนแปลงแบบชัดเจนเลย ขยับตัวได้ดีขึ้น เดินได้ตรงขึ้น และตอนนี้เริ่มกลับมาวิ่งเบา ๆ ได้แล้ว

ครูเก้าและครูเบียร์ใจเย็นมาก อธิบายเข้าใจง่าย และมีความรู้ลึก คอยปรับท่าให้เหมาะกับสภาพร่างกายของดวงจริง ๆ ที่สำคัญคือให้กำลังใจตลอด ทำให้รู้สึกว่าค่อย ๆ พัฒนาได้ทีละนิดแบบไม่กดดัน

โฮมสตูดิโอในหมู่บ้าน ไพรเวท เงียบ สะอาด และเป็นส่วนตัว เหมาะมากกับคนที่ต้องการการดูแลใกล้ชิดค่ะ

โดยรวมคือเป็นที่ที่ทำให้ดวงรู้สึกว่าร่างกายมีหวัง และเดินหน้าได้อีกครั้งจริง ๆ ค่ะ 🧡
reviews.textTranslated:
I'm so glad I came to study here. Before this, I had a stroke that left me stiff, numb on one side of my body, and with limited mobility. After starting Pilates here about 2-3 months ago, I've noticed a significant improvement. My movement is much better, I can walk straighter, and now I've even started light jogging again.

Teachers Kao and Beer are incredibly patient, explain things clearly, and have deep knowledge. They constantly adjust the poses to suit my physical condition and, most importantly, provide constant encouragement, making me feel like I'm gradually improving without pressure.

The home studio in the village is private, quiet, clean, and very private – perfect for those who want close supervision.

Overall, this is a place that has given me hope for my physical recovery and a chance to move forward again. 🧡
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ใจฟู ❤️ ขอบคุณน้องทั้ง 2 คนมากๆเช่นกันนะจ๊ะ

reviews.name: Michael Kongedam
reviews.text:
Phu Massage: An Absolute Farce - Save Your Money!

Phu Massage deserves less than one star – if only that were an option. My wife, daughter, and I sought a relaxing oil massage, and what we got was a complete mockery of the service. The staff members tasked with our "massages" were incredibly unprofessional, dedicating far more time to gossiping and laughing with each other than to actually massaging us. Their inattention was insulting, and the entire experience felt like a rip-off. Honestly, a brief sit in a vibrating airport chair would have provided infinitely more relief and value than this disgrace. This place is a joke, and not a funny one. Do yourself a favor and go literally anywhere else.

reviews.name: Sue Duong
reviews.text:
02-01-2025
My husband and I decided to treat ourselves to an afternoon relaxation before dinner. We decided to come here. It was the right choice.

My husband enjoyed his 300 baht Thai massage. He was laughing and having a blast chatting with Oil, his masseuse.

As for me, the soreness on my
upper back went away at the end of the 400 baht oil massage session. I asked my masseuse to focus on the problem area; she did what I asked and offered to apply tiger balm. I agreed and I totally felt relieved. Too bad we had to leave to Phuket Old Town the next day otherwise I would have gone back for another massage.

reviews.name: Ana
reviews.text:
If I Could Give Zero Stars, I Would

I came here because of back pain after several days of strenuous water sports and was very clear about my needs. The receptionist told me to wait 20-30 minutes for their best therapist, even though others were available. I assumed it was worth the wait.

When the massage started, it was basic and extremely soft, nothing like what I needed. When she told me to turn over, I politely asked if she could focus on my back pain, and she bluntly said she only did relaxing massages for the 1-hour rate—then asked me to pay more and stay longer if I wanted real treatment. I had a flight to catch and couldn’t extend my time, so I reminded her that I had clearly communicated my needs from the start. Instead of showing any empathy, she got angry and just left—leaving me lying there, naked, without a word of explanation.

I understand that tourists are a revenue source, but sometimes the way we’re treated feels dehumanizing—like all that matters is how much you’ll pay, not whether you’re in pain or even deserve basic respect. Avoid this place.

reviews.name: Christine Quah
reviews.text:
Great place for massages - clean beds and comfortable environment, spa music, clean toilets, friendly male boss and very experienced therapists. We spent a few hours here everyday.

Our favourites were Bo and Cheun - both are fantastic therapists who know the right points to press and are very skilled. They were incredibly attentive to our needs and really caring. Thank you so much.

reviews.name: evaherzog1992
reviews.text: This massage was amazing! Good prices, but the place is so much more clean and nice looking than most other places. After entering, your feet are washed and you step up a nice wooden staircase. We had a back/neck/shoulder massage which was amazing. Can highly recommend this!

reviews.name: Csenge Bárdos
reviews.text: We visited this place on our last day unfortunately, it was so good I should have gone here every day 😭 really friendly masseuses and manager and really clean massage place!

reviews.name: Mariska Basson
reviews.text: Between my husband and me, we went for 4 different massages and I can recommend every one of them. They are professional and friendly and definitely got rid of a few aches and pains. Just choose your massage carefully - a Thai massage is not for the feint-hearted. For something more relaxing, choose the coconut oil massage.

reviews.name: GEOFFREY GIBBS
reviews.text: I was there twice during our stay.  One massage was good and the other only so-so.  Both were oil massages, the first masseuse was focused on pressure-points and did a good job hitting hot spots.  The second massage was not great.  Light hands without any real technique.  Lined up beside two others and the  staff spent their time yakking between themselves.  Very distracting.  Overall adequate massage given the price.

reviews.name: baka gabriela
reviews.text: Totally recommend- very good massage! We took back, shoulder and neck and it was more than that! 1h of very intense professional massage in really nice calming atmosphere. Place was bigger that we expected with private rooms where 2 people can have massages simultaneously. At the beginning they washed our feet and at the end  we were served green tea.

reviews.text:
เป็นการทำกายภาพครั้งแรกในชีวิต เกิดจากการยกเวทแล้วกล้ามเนื้อแถวสะบักฉีกขาด

1.คือ พี่ๆกายภาพ วิเคราะห์ต้นตอของกล้ามเนื้อให้ ว่าสาเหตุที่เจ็บเพราะอะไร แล้ว มาสอนท่าออกกำลังกายเชิงกายภาพที่ถูกต้อง

2.สอนท่าบริหารกล้ามเนื้อ การโฟกัส หายใจ ให้ถูกจังหวะ เพื่อไม่ให้เกิดการบาดเจ็บซ้ำอีก

3.มีการ ultrasound ร่วมด้วยในแพ้คเกจ หลังการบริหาร เป็นช่วงที่ฟินมากๆ เพราะแค่นอนให้พี่ๆกานภาพทำ

4. มีนักกายภาพบำบัดทั้งผู้ชายและผู้หญิง สบายใจได้ทุกท่านเลยจ้า

5.ใส่ใจ เทคเเคร์ดีจนจบคอส

บอกได้เลยว่าคุ้ม มืออาชีพ และ ได้ความรุ้มากมายครับ
reviews.textTranslated:
This was my first ever physical therapy session. It stemmed from a tear in my shoulder blade muscles while lifting weights.

1. The physical therapists analyzed the root cause of the muscle injury and taught me the correct physical therapy exercises.

2. They taught me proper muscle exercises, focusing, and breathing techniques to prevent reinjury.

3. The package included ultrasound therapy after the workout, which was incredibly relaxing as I just lay there while the therapists worked on me.

4. There were both male and female physical therapists, so I felt completely at ease.

5. They were very caring and attentive throughout the course.

I can honestly say it was worth it – professional, and I gained a lot of knowledge.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอขอบคุณมากนะคะ ยินดีที่ได้ดูแลค่า

reviews.name: Park Seo-joon
reviews.text: ก่อนหน้าเรียนเดินแล้วเจ็บขาเนื่องจากสะโพกเสื่อม เดินได้แค่ในระยะสั้นๆหลังจาก เรียนคอร์ส5ครั้ง รู้สึกถึงการเปลี่ยนแปลง ดีขึ้นเดินคล่องเดินได้นานโดยไม่เจ็บขา ครูสอนใจดีและเป็นกันเองมากค่ะ ขอบคุณเทคนิคดีๆ สามารถนำมาปรับใช้ในชีวิตได้ดีมากๆ
reviews.textTranslated: Before taking the walking course, I experienced leg pain due to hip osteoarthritis and could only walk short distances. After completing 5 sessions, I feel a significant improvement; I can walk more easily and for longer periods without pain. The instructor was very kind and friendly. Thank you for the valuable techniques that I can apply to my life.

ยินดีที่ทำให้สามารถกลับไปใช้ชีวิตประจำวันได้ดีขึ้น คล่องขึ้น และป้องกันความเสื่อมที่อาจเกิดมากขึ้นก่อนที่ควรจะเป็น 🙏🏻😊

reviews.textTranslated: It started with problems walking and knee pain. After consistent training for a year, my knees improved significantly within the first 3-4 months, training twice a week. I still come today to strengthen my muscles and improve my posture for daily activities.
