reviews.name: Kaewkwan Tanthai
reviews.text:
ก่อนหน้านี้มีอาการเจ็บเข่า ไปพบแพทย์ ทั้งเอกซเรย์ ทั้ง MRI ผลออกมาปกติทั้งหมด หมอเช็คดูพบว่าเอ็นดี ข้อเข่าดี แต่ตัวเองปวดมาก เดินได้ประมาณ 5 นาทีต้องพัก ขึ้นบันไดไม่ได้เลย มาทำกายภาพที่นี่ ตอนนี้วิ่งได้แล้วค่ะ เพิ่งรู้เหมือนกันว่าใช้กล้ามเนื้อไม่สมดุลมีผลกระทบด้วย
น้องใส่ใจดีมากค่ะ สอบถามอาการเราตลอดและช่วยปรับท่าทางการยืน สอนใจเย็นมากค่ะ แนะนำๆ
reviews.textTranslated:
Previously, I had knee pain and went to see a doctor. X-rays and MRIs were all normal. The doctor checked and found that my ligaments and knee joint were fine, but I was in a lot of pain. I could only walk for about 5 minutes before needing to rest, and I couldn't climb stairs at all. I came here for physical therapy, and now I can run! I just learned that unbalanced muscle use can have consequences.
The staff here are very attentive. They constantly ask about my symptoms and help adjust my posture while standing. They are very patient and caring. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบคุณมากๆนะคะ

I'll be coming often! ❤️❤️❤️

reviews.name: cozy land
reviews.text: เคยมากายภาพที่นี่และ ได้รู้จักพิลาทิสครั้งแรกที่นี่เลยค่ะ พิลาทิสทำให้ได้เรียนรู้ร่างกายตัวเองมากขึ้น ปรับสรีระ และท่าทางในการใช้ชีวิตประจำวัน รู้สึกกล้ามเนื้อยืดหยุ่น และแข็งแรงขึ้นมาก อาการปวดหลัง คอ บ่า ไหล่ ดีขึ้นมากๆ  ที่นี่คลาสเล็ก ดูแลทั่วถึง ครูใส่ใจ ไม่ต้องกลัวบาดเจ็บ เพราะสอนด้วยผู้เชี่ยวชาญ  ต่อคอร์สที่นี่หลายคอร์สแล้วค่ะ อยากแนะนำให้มาลองค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I used to come here for physical therapy and that's where I first learned about Pilates. Pilates has helped me learn more about my body, improve my posture and body movements in daily life. I feel my muscles are much more flexible and stronger, and my back, neck, shoulder, and upper back pain has improved significantly. The classes here are small, allowing for personalized attention. The instructors are attentive, and you don't have to worry about injury because they are experts. I've taken several courses here already. I highly recommend trying it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ดีใจที่ได้ดูแลนะคะ ขอบคุณมากๆค่ะ 🙏🏻🥰

reviews.text: ตัดสินใจเลือกกายภาพบำบัดกับที่คลีนิกนี้เพราะรู้สึกมั่นใจกับการอธิบายให้ข้อมูลของคุณหมอ พอมาจริงๆก็คิดว่าเลือกไม่ผิดเลยค่ะ คลีนิกสะอาด คุณหมอบิวเก่ง ใจเย็น ไม่กดดันคนไข้ อธิบายดี ติดตามผลการฝึกตลอด ทำให้ผลการฝึกมีพัฒนาการดีขึ้นเรื่อยๆค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I decided to choose physiotherapy at this clinic because I felt confident with the doctor's explanations and information. And I'm glad I made the right choice. The clinic is clean, Dr. Bew is skilled, calm, and doesn't pressure patients. She explains things well and consistently monitors progress during the training, leading to continuous improvement in my performance.

reviews.text: แนะนำคลาสพิลาทิสที่นี่ค่ะ มีทั้งไพรเวทและ คลาสรวม ตั้งแต่เรียนโยคะมาหลายที่ รู้สึกว่าวางใจที่นี่ที่สุดค่ะ เพราะผู้สอนเป็นนักกายภาพบำบัดโดยตรง ทำให้รู้สึกว่านอกจากมีความรู้ด้านโยคะพิลาทิสแล้ว ยังมีวิทยาศาสตร์การแพทย์มาควบคู่ด้วยค่ะ คุณครูใจดี แก้ไขได้ตรงจุด ตัวเองเรียนมาจะครบปีนึงแล้วค่ะ รู้สึกอาการออฟฟิศซินโดรมของตัวเองดีขึ้นมากๆ ค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I highly recommend the Pilates classes here. They offer both private and group classes. Having studied yoga at many places, I feel this is the place I trust the most. The instructor is a physical therapist, which means they not only have knowledge of yoga and Pilates but also medical science. The instructor is kind and addresses my specific needs. I've been studying here for almost a year now, and I feel my office syndrome symptoms have improved significantly.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบคุณมากๆเลยนะคะ

reviews.textTranslated: A friend recommended this clinic, saying it was excellent. After using their services, I can say it's truly amazing! I'd been to several other clinics without finding the cause of my symptoms. This clinic was able to explain and solve the problem very effectively. Overall, I'm very impressed! 💖💯🥰

title: Yellow Massage
subTitle: เยลโล่ มัสซาส
address: Red light district, Pattaya Soi 6, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
plusCode: WVVP+32 Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri, Thailand

reviews.name: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)
reviews.text:
Clean and good quality massage service.  Staff seem to know what they are doing.
Prices are very reasonable.

reviews.name: Paul White
reviews.text:
I have often walked passed Yellow Massage as it is in an unmissable, big, bold premises on the corner of Beach Road & Soi6/1 alley, which are prime tourist spots.
I thought it would be overpriced & not very good as its on the edge of the red light district.
However, I was asked to go by a female friend who assured me all was above board and it was a good, well run, professional establishment. So we paid Yellow Massage a visit.
I was pleasantly surprised. It was spacious, nicely decorated, on three floors. The staff freindly and professional.
While my companion took a body massage, I elected for a foot massage, which should, in reality, be called a foot & leg massage as it includes both, and also includes a short, complimentary shoulder and neck massage.
It was definitely one of the better foot massages I have had in Pattaya. Both soothing and relaxing while firm enough to take the ache and tension from my feet and legs.
At 300 baht for one hour, it is competitive with other parlours while offering the most comfortable and modern reclining chairs. Soft, squidgy but supportive.
I would recommend anyone to go and sample Yellow Massage.
My visit changed my perception of this place, but I still think the bright, gawdy, 'McDonalds' type exterior is in conflict with the cool, calm, roman/Greek-esque interior and that the exterior, whilst being unmissable, can be of putting for many people, such as myself, as, if it were not for my freind, I would never have ventured inside.

reviews.name: Rina
reviews.text:
Do not come here. My parents went in and both especially my dad were harassed by the staff.

My dad was told he can’t leave without “living a tip for the nails” this is literally what she said to him and blocked the door, she was a big woman and would not let my dad out when my mum was already outside

My mum is disabled and she asked to make her sit more up as she can’t lay down fully on the chair, staff was very upset they had to do extra work, when my mum asked please change the towel as it was visibly dirty, at first staff pretended they didn’t speak English and only on the third time she changed it as my mum simply would not sit down.

Just disgusting do not go here

reviews.name: Viktor
reviews.text: Great experience,! Probably, the best massage we had in Pattaya :) All three of us liked it the same. The space is also spacious, clean and comfortable.

reviews.name: H V
reviews.text: For the price you can’t beat this massage place.  I received a head and shoulder massage and it was worth the money.  They know what they are doing.  The one hr seen like forever when they massage you.  But Next time I would get a full body.

reviews.name: Alina SV
reviews.text:
The best massage so far. Aloe Vera massage is really worth it especially after being in the sun. Ms. Noi and Toh are experienced massage therapists and do their job well.
The place is very big and the rooms and bathrooms were very clean. The price in my opinion is good considering it’s on the coast and really well maintained.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Ms Alina SV. You are welcome to visit our place once again.

reviews.name: AURELIO MAXIMUS
reviews.text: This is a Tourist Trap. I paid 300 BAHT for 1 Hour Foot Massage. The massage was ugly and the Girl finished after 40 Min. They cheat you, this I why you have to pay before. Unfriendly Staff.

reviews.name: Janusz Daga
reviews.text: Amazing location front of the beach, you can get a foot massage and admire the sunset at the same time. My masseur was perfect. Clean place and nice overall experience.

reviews.name: Vincenzo Petrillo
reviews.text: Worst massage place in Thailand. Burned my feet with massage balm, irritation and bad manners.

reviews.name: Stevie D
reviews.text:
A previous reviewer said this place takes your money and doesn't deliver. So I went in and asked to pay after but the rude woman on the desk said no.
I explained they are getting a bad reputation on Google but she didn't care.
All I can say is the 20 masseuses sitting outside won't be sitting there for long at this rate.

reviews.name: Alpesh Patel
reviews.text: Had a 90 minute oil massage on day one. The therapist was outstanding and really worked the knots in my shoulders. The rating is because, I visited the following day and the therapist talked to her colleague throughout the massage and kept making inappropriate comments about my body which I found very annoying.

reviews.name: Hamid Azinfar
reviews.text:
We visited Yellow Massage on Soi 6 in Pattaya on Wednesday, December 11, at about 10 PM.
We were three friends, and all of us wanted foot massages. The massages were very good, and all three of us were satisfied. However, after the massage, I had an unpleasant experience when I wanted to tip my masseurs . I intended to give her 40 baht, but she demanded 100 baht.

I believe that tipping should be up to the customer to decide. This put me in an uncomfortable situation, and I ended up giving her 100 baht. Then, the other lady who massaged my friend—despite already receiving a 50-baht tip—also demanded more because I had given her colleague 100 baht. Feeling pressured, my friend gave her another 60 baht.

We have visited many massage shops before but have never encountered a situation like this. I hope this feedback helps Yellow Massage improve their customer service.

reviews.name: Tony Winter
reviews.text:
My wife and I decided to use the services of the Yellow Massage shop. We explained that we were staying next door at D-Beach for 6 nights and would be keen to come everyday to this large clean premise.
We were happy with the full body oil massage for the first 3 days but on the fourth visit both our masseurs were less than satisfactory. My girl left the room from the start while my wife’s girl began, it was at least 3 or 4 minutes before she came back and seemed to be on a go slow campaign.
She spent about 5 minutes on my back before moving to my legs. She seemed to be labouring during the back massage. After finishing on my legs she left the room again and was gone for another 3 - 4 mins with no discussion. She started working on my arms and flexed my arm past being comfortable, I groaned quietly in pain to which she chuckled.
My neck and shoulders needed some ongoing work but she spent more time massaging my scalp! The whole massage was really only a squeeze and release method which did little to address my neck and back muscles. My wife had a very similar experience.
There was no discussion at any stage with any of the massage girls as to what we wanted. We had different girls each day even though we came around the same time the first 3 times.
After the massage I approached the manager to tell her that this massage was the worst we had had in the 4 times, she made no attempt to ask me why or offer any discussion. We left disappointed but didn’t want to do anything but give her feedback. We would not recommend this service.

reviews.name: Abhishek Shah
reviews.text:
They rely on having a great location and an attractive building. The massage is horrible at best by untrained staff. The manager is extremely rude and forces you to pay before the service because they know the service is subpar.

Most of the staff are rude, uninterested and untrained, specially on the first floor. Avoid please.

reviews.name: Pat P
reviews.text: I was there today around 1 pm. The big lady who gave me massage was very rude. She was rude from the beginning. I just didn’t want to leave in the middle of the massage to make things worse. But I had to tolerate her every time she yell at me when I tell her about my pain or breath abnormally due to my asthma. Very poor service. Hope management take this complaint very seriously.

reviews.name: davia mtz
reviews.text: Worst massage in my 10 months in Thailand. The masseaue was very rude and provided poor service. There is reason why they make you pay before. Because the service quality is so bad (just read other reviews), but they still want to collect money from you. Avoid this place at all cost.

reviews.name: Aaron T
reviews.text: An ok place if you want a massage, depends on the person you get.  Personally, I like a heavier hand. There was quite a bit of rain that evening and the staff were concerned about my well being upon trying to leave.

reviews.name: Zhi Wee
reviews.text: This is always one of my favorite massage place to go. They have a wide variety of package to choose from and plenty of staff ready to give you the heavenly massage. Despite the price could be higher than those near beach road or near walking street but definitely worth the money.

reviews.name: Harvey Dent
reviews.text: Very clean and nice facilities (downstairs as well as the upstairs rooms). A Thai oil massage costs 400 per hour, so 100 baht more as usual. But, my massages were just great.

reviews.name: Raghav kochhar
reviews.text:
The best massage so far. Aloe Vera massage is really worth it especially after being in the sun. Ms. Noi and Toh are experienced massage therapists and do their job well.
The place is very big and the rooms and bathrooms were very clean. The price in my opinion is good considering it’s on the coast and really well maintained.

title: Chantra Luna Massage (Karon Phuket)
ownerDescription: Chantra Luna Massage (Karon Phuket) offers professional Thai massage, oil massage, and relaxing treatments in a clean and comfortable environment. Located near Karon Beach, we provide high-quality massage services by experienced therapists. Perfect for relaxation, stress relief, and muscle recovery. Walk-ins welcome.
address: 242 ถนน กะรน Karon Beach, Tambon Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83100, Thailand
plusCode: R7XV+FC Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: jenise ong
reviews.text:
Had an amazing experience at Chantra Luna Massage!! The staff were incredibly professional and the place is so clean! They really made me feel so relaxed and comfortable throughout the entire session. I opted for the 60 minute hot oil massage, and wow my body feels so much lighter and refreshed now.

I also had the chance to speak with Wei Wei, the owner, who was so friendly, welcoming and genuinely so lovely to chat with. You can really tell that a lot of care goes into making sure every guest has a great experience. Would definitely recommend Chantra Luna Massage and would happily come back again!

reviews.name: วชิรเมษฐ์ พัชระแสงกาญจน์
reviews.text:
Went for a massage on their opening day , Super impressed.
The place is clean, relaxing, and the massage was really good with great pressure.
Definitely coming back!

reviews.name: Haixia Qu
reviews.text: Nice & clean. Good price. Good atmosphere. Nice and friendly people. We were very happy with the services.  We went there a couple of times, had Thai massage, pedicure, & oil massage. Thanks

reviews.name: Natalia Strelkov
reviews.text: This is my second visit to Thailand, and I go for massages exclusively at this salon. The entire staff is top-notch; they provide wonderful massages—exactly the way I like it! During this trip, I also tried the acupressure facial massage—and oh my, what pure bliss it was! As someone who spends all day working in front of screens, I found the treatment incredibly relaxing for my face and eyes—so much so that I was finally able to fall asleep without any muscle pain around my eyes. My sincere thanks go to the salon owner, Kris, for creating such a wonderful establishment and assembling such a fantastic team!

reviews.name: Preeyawee Thumthong
reviews.text: One of the highlights of my trip! The massage was outstanding, the staff were warm and welcoming, and the service exceeded my expectations. Clean, professional, and incredibly relaxing. 🫶🏻🙏🏻

reviews.name: Orange
reviews.text:
I've been to this place twice.

On my first visit, I got a full-body massage, and it was excellent. The facilities were clean and well maintained as well.

Because of that positive experience, I came back for a second visit and chose a foot massage. Unfortunately, this time was very disappointing. The therapist barely looked at my legs the entire session. She spent most of the time chatting with another therapist or looking outside the curtain. It didn't feel like I was receiving a massage at all. The pressure was either painfully strong or I couldn't feel anything..

Overall, the facilities are nice, and the prices are okay. However, the quality seems to vary greatly depending on which therapist you get.

reviews.name: yyying
reviews.text: I’m a tourist from Malaysia, and I was really drawn to the atmosphere of this massage place. As soon as we walked in, the staff were all very friendly. We were the last group of customers, but the owner was still very kind and even offered us snacks and drinks. When the owner saw us filming, they thoughtfully turned on the lights to make it easier for us. The massage was incredibly comfortable and done with great care—definitely worth the price. The next time I visit Phuket, I would love to come back again!

reviews.name: Alexandr
reviews.text: We visited Chantra Luna Massage three times, and every visit was fantastic. The Thai massage and foot massage were outstanding, and the therapists are true professionals. The cozy three-story salon has a beautiful and unique atmosphere. We also had a facial treatment, which was excellent, using high-quality products and delivered with great care. Highly recommend this place if you're visiting Karon!

reviews.name: Alina Stanciu
reviews.text: Amazing massage, professional and relaxing 🤗

reviews.name: Albina Nasyrova
reviews.text: I was there 2, and hope to get more massages. Both times it was a fantastic experience, I liked the smell of the oil, the music, the light, the guy who’s promoting - everything is just great 💯

reviews.name: Axel's reviews
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend Chantra Luna Massage enough! I have been traveling all over the country, and this is easily the best service I have found in Thailand.

The facility is incredibly clean and modern, which made me feel comfortable the moment I walked in. Unlike many other busy spots in Karon, this place is remarkably quiet and peaceful it’s a true sanctuary to escape the heat and noise.

The staff is professional, attentive, and highly skilled. I loved it so much that I ended up coming back every single day of my journey. If you are in Phuket, do not miss this place!

reviews.name: Tyler Russell
reviews.text: Best massage we had in Phuket by far. Very good pricing and friendly staff. You must go here!

reviews.name: Alexander Kim
reviews.text: Very good massage, visited with my wife, oil massage 10/10

reviews.name: Kevin Darren
reviews.text: Amazing massage and hospitality. Felt very welcomed there

reviews.name: ammmint mint
reviews.text: Feeling sooo relaxed! The warm hot oil massage was absolutely amazing.

reviews.name: Diana Perepeliak
reviews.text: Had an Aloe Vera massage here, my masseuse was a bigger and mature lady. Not trying to fat-shame anyone, although when she was moving on my body I could feel her weight and it was just too heavy and uncomfortable. Massage was sloppy, she didn’t press the right muscles and pressed wrong spots, for example she pushed her elbow on my spine which was painful. Her massage lacked attention, for example she didn’t give my head a good massage, she just scratched my temples. She BARELY even touched my palms and my feet. It just felt like she was rushing. During my massage I could hear her belly rumble all the time (she probably was hungry) which was distracting. The place itself is nice and clean. It’s such a shame I ended up with this massage lady.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your massage experience did not meet you expectations. We take all comments seriously and will review your concerns with our team to improve our service quality and attention to detail. We are glad you found our facility clean and comfortable we hope to have opportunity to provide you with a better experience in the future 🙏🏻🙇🏻‍♂️🙇🏻‍♂️

reviews.name: Xinyi Li (Alice)
reviews.text: Came here with friends. They kept doing small talks and giggling all the time which was annoying enough, not to mention the massage itself was not as relaxing as I would expect. Would not come again, not recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Xinyi,
Thank you for your feedback. We’re truly sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations. We sincerely apologize for the noise and any discomfort you felt during your visit

Your comments are very important to us , and we will address this with our team to 
improve our service and environment. We hope to have another opportunity to welcome you again and provide you with a much more relaxing experience 

Kind regards 
Chantra Luna Massage 🙏🏻🙇🏻‍♂️

reviews.name: gwen lim
reviews.text: came here twice during my phuket trip in may! Staff are so friendly, did a 90min full body thai massage for 525baht, the masseuse really knows where and how to press those points on your body. did a classic mani here as well for 350baht, she was so detailed and careful with the cuticle clean up, loved it! They do use normal nail lacquer only though so you do need to be careful and let it dry properly. other than that the whole place is really new, modern, bright and clean, would definitely come back if I ever come back to Karon :-)

reviews.name: Jeeva Bharathi .Roossoe
reviews.text: Amazing massage, amazing ambience, very good price.

reviews.name: Stace
reviews.text: This is the best massage place in Phuket!!!Everything from the beautiful interior, to the service, to the massage itself is next level. The massage therapists are super skilled and put pressure on the exact areas that are strained. I left feeling both relaxed and full of new energy!

title: Sculpt Reformer Pilates - Bangtao

reviews.name: Neila You
reviews.text:
I was lucky to participate in a class on the studio's first anniversary. The manager and her team are fantastic. It's a welcoming place, the equipment is perfect and suitable for all levels. Don't hesitate to book a reformer class there.
Thanks a lot
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Neila, we love that you made it on our first anniversary and enjoyed the class too ☺️ Thank you for your amazing review!

reviews.name: Elena
reviews.text: The best Pilates studio 🤍 I’ve been coming here since it first opened! Kitty and Arm are highly knowledgeable instructors, the reformers are excellent, and every time I come it feels just like home. I always feel like a valued part of the community, and I truly want to thank the management team and the administrator for that. Every class helps me discover new possibilities in my body, as the trainers always bring fresh exercises into the workouts — something that’s truly rare in any sport 💪🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Elena 🤎 You have been with us from the very beggining and we adore you ☺️✨

reviews.name: Yumi S
reviews.text:
A truly standout Pilates studio in the Bang Tao area. Bright, elegant, and impeccably clean, everything is maintained to a high standard. I usually take private lessons, and I’m consistently impressed by the instructors: knowledgeable, attentive, and skilled at tailoring sessions so you feel both supported and challenged.

What really sets this studio apart is how thoughtfully and professionally it’s run. The team is accommodating within reason, making the entire experience smooth and stress-free. It’s a place you can trust and return to with confidence. Highly recommend!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Yumi! We can’t wait to welcome you back ☺️

reviews.name: Nina Hughes
reviews.text:
I absolutely loved my sessions at Sculpt Reformer Pilates Phuket with Kitty! 💪✨
The studio is beautifully clean, calm, and modern — the perfect balance of luxury and focus. Kitty is an exceptional instructor — encouraging, precise, and full of positive energy. She takes the time to correct your form, explain movements clearly, and tailor each session so you feel both challenged and supported.

After just a few classes I could already feel the difference — stronger core, better posture, and that amazing “sculpted” feeling! It’s easily the best reformer Pilates experience I’ve had in Thailand.

Highly recommend to anyone visiting Phuket who wants to keep fit or reset their body in the most uplifting way. 🧘‍♀️💫
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your incredible review. We are so happy we made such a positive impact and we loved having at the studio ✨

reviews.name: Zairah Khurshid
reviews.text: Loved the flex and flow class I did! Both challenging and refreshing. A must when staying in bangtao :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much for your incredible review Zairah. It was a pleasure having you at the Studio 🙂

reviews.name: Vixxen Studios
reviews.text: Had an amazing class here! Such a beautiful studio with high quality equipment. Also loved the instructor and class flow for the Lower Body & Glutes class! Thank you ⭐️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Freya, thank you so much for your lovely review. Hopefully we get to welcome you back next time you’re in Phuket 🌺

reviews.name: Emma Nilson
reviews.text: This must be one of the most beautiful spaces in Phuket, wow! I did Pilates for the first time ever today, and Am was so kind & helpful. Yelena, the owner, was incredibly welcoming, as was their receptionist. Can’t wait to come again! 🤍✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Emma ☺️ We appreciate your review and feedback 🙏🏼

reviews.name: Stacey Smiler
reviews.text: The most wonderful Pilates reformer experience! Amazing teachers and beautiful studio. I will be back on my next visit to Phuket.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Stacey, 

Thanks so much for coming to visit us and for your wonderful review. We can’t wait to have you back in the Studio ✨☺️

reviews.name: Jennifer A
reviews.text: I tried three classes at Sculpt, all were very enjoyable. The studio is clean with new equipment. Kru Kitty was very calm and knowledgeable, Kru Am was also great and focused on form and foundational muscles, Kru Mike was a jokester and brought high-energy and fun to the class! Fabulous instructors.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Jennifer, thank you so much for your incredible review. We are so glad you enjoyed the fruits of all our instructors. We can’t wait to welcome you back ☺️✨

reviews.name: Denise Meryl Castro
reviews.text: I went here and it was my first time doing Pilates. The studio is so beautiful and cozy and the instructor was wonderful!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Denise, we love that your first Pilates experience was amazing. We can wait to welcome you back!

reviews.name: Christine Thomason
reviews.text: I recently attended some reformer classes at Sculpt and absolutely loved it. The studio, equipment and instructors are all first class. Can’t recommend them enough!!!! Would definitely attend again next time I’m in Phuket. Christine
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much Christine ☺️ We can’t wait to welcome you back ✨

reviews.name: Natashia Sandow
reviews.text: What a beautiful studio! Thank you, Kru Kitty, for making my first Pilates experience so memorable. High energy and smiles all round! 🌸
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much Natashia. You were a joy to have at the studio and we can’t wait to see you again ☺️💖

reviews.name: S B
reviews.text:
I came to Phuket for a 2-month holiday and signed up for private Pilates sessions 3x/week. From start to finish, the experience was absolutely incredible.

The customer service is on another level — the team was so flexible with scheduling, which is such a contrast to many other studios I’ve visited while traveling. They always found a way to make things work for me, and they were genuinely warm and welcoming every single time.

The studio itself is beautiful, clean, and has such a calming atmosphere that makes every session enjoyable. My trainer, Kitty was absolutely lovely. She regularly attends advanced trainings to stay up to date, and it really shows. She paid such close attention to my posture and form, always making sure I was safe and getting the most out of each movement.

Overall, I can confidently say this is one of the best studios I’ve been to anywhere in the world. The training is excellent, the service is outstanding, and the people make it extra special. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review. It was a joy having you at the studio over the last two months and we hope to see you again soon 😊

reviews.name: Pearl Pichapach
reviews.text:
Beautiful studio, convenient location with plenty of parking in Bangtao soi 2.

I joined Amm’s class, she’s very kind, great instructor - clear instructions and she helped adjusting my form in the best way possible 🤍

Highly recommended if you want to do pilates reformer while in Phuket (:
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Pearl ☺️🙏🏼✨

reviews.name: Kyle Addison
reviews.text: I joined Am’s class. The studio is warm and inviting, beautiful and modern with high quality reformers and equipment. Extremely friendly and skilled trainers. Highly recommend Sculpt!! 💪🏻

reviews.name: Chelvan Veloo
reviews.text: Great Staff.Instructor Kitty was professional and very attentive to individual needs. The class atmosphere was really fun and relaxed , even while doing the challenging workout. Always a good mixture of students, reflective of the welcoming staff and instructors. Highly recommend Sculpt Reformer Pilates to newcomers and experienced practitioners.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Chelvan for your lovely review. We loved having you at the studio and contributing to your rehab. We hope to see you again soon 😊

reviews.name: Adah EA
reviews.text: So pleased I found Sculpt Reformer when I was in Thailand. Gorgeous, clean and super friendly staff- loved my lessons with Kitty 💕
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your lovely review Adah. You were a joy to have at the studio and we can wait to welcome you again ✨

reviews.name: Jacob Quinn
reviews.text: Sculpt is a beautiful studio. The classes are great, instructors are very professional and friendly, the facilities are super clean and I leave there feeling energised and stronger in my body. Definitely recommend!!

reviews.name: Debra Kim Liwiski
reviews.text: Lovely (and clean!) boutique studio with warm and professional staff. They can work across a variety of levels and languages! It's so nice there that I hesitated to post a review because I don't want it to become overrun 😁, but they really deserve some compliments.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review Juliet. We absolutely love having you at the Studio 🥰🫶🏼

reviews.name: Yoshi A.
reviews.text:
ฝากเรื่องปรับปรุงพัฒนายิมครับ

1.อยากให้มีสแลนกันแดดที่ลาดจอดรถ
2.ด้านทิศตะวันออก ตอนเช้าแดดส่องเครื่องวิ่ง
3.kettlebell ไม่ครบคู่ เวลาให้งานจริง ต้องใช้คู่
4.ตอนเช้า ยิมไม่ค่อยเปิดแอร์ ถึงคนจะเล่นน้อย แต่ก็ร้อน
5.มีกลิ่น/ขนสัตว์ในยิม
6.อยากให้เพิ่มเครื่องเล่น
7.อยากให้เปิดยิมเร็วขึ้น
8.เพิ่มความสว่างในยิม

ขอบคุณครับ
reviews.textTranslated:
Here are some suggestions for gym improvements:

1. I'd like a sunshade for the parking lot.
2. The treadmills face east in the mornings.
3. There aren't enough kettlebells in pairs; they're needed for actual use.
4. The gym isn't always air-conditioned in the mornings, making it hot even with few people using it.
5. There's a smell/pet hair in the gym.
6. I'd like more exercise equipment.
7. I'd like the gym to open earlier.
8. Increase the lighting in the gym.

Thank you.

title: Curve Pilates Phuket Studio
address: 9, 447 ถ.ศักดิเดช, Tambon Talat Nuea, เมือง, Phuket 83000, Thailand
plusCode: V9FM+8R Phuket, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Katarzyna Faber
reviews.text: A perfect place for Pilates princesses who want to feel strong and chilled at the same time! 🎀✨ The studio is so aesthetic, making every session an absolute pleasure. Classes are cozy with a max of 5 participants, and the trainers speak English, which makes everything super comfortable. My trainer Chin is amazing - I always leave feeling refreshed and energized! Highly recommend! 🤸🏻‍♂️✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind review. Our team is very happy to hear that you were impressed with our service. ❤️✨🙏

reviews.name: V.C. AF
reviews.text:
Pros:
- High-quality Merrihew SPX equipment💜
- Easy to park
- Quiet atmosphere
- Privates available on a Cadillac system
- The gym itself is fairly decent with a weights area, sauna and pool 🏊‍♀️

Cons:
- Not a traditional Pilates class, e.g. no footwork, no 100s, etc.
- Lack of clear, cohesive training  structure per class
- Limited English instruction
- Not appropriate for experienced Pilates practitioners
- Expensive (800 baht per class)🤑

VERDICT: If you're Thai and new to PILATES, this could be a good class to try as long as you understand that this is NOT traditional Pilates instruction and this class is very basic/beginner.

If you're an experienced practitioner, this class will be disappointing.  The teacher struggles to communicate the anatomical concepts clearly, and she has a habit of touching without asking for permission first.  English is also not a strong suit here, so it's really targeted toward local Thai.👎

For 800 baht per group class 💰, I'd recommend going to a more experienced and professional Pilates studio like Abbysan.

Aside: The gym itself is fairly nice so you can join for a decent weight room, sauna and pool, too.

reviews.name: Sarojinee Somboonsap (Jule)
reviews.text:
จูลเริ่มฝึก Pilates เมื่อช่วงกลางปีที่แล้วค่ะ
เพราะด้วยลักษณะงานที่ต้องก้มทำเลเซอร์ให้คนไข้หลายเคสต่อวัน ทำให้มีอาการปวดท้ายทอย คอ บ่า และไหล่เรื้อรัง

และอยากจะพัฒนาบุคลิกภาพของตัวเองให้ดูดีมากขึ้น
เลยตัดสินใจเริ่มเรียน Private Pilates ที่ "Curve Pilates Phuket" ค่ะ
.
ที่นี่คุณครูทุกท่านน่าร้าก และใจเย็นมากกกก 😚
สอนละเอียดและเข้าใจง่าย พอได้ฝึกต่อเนื่องก็รู้สึกว่า…
•	ท่าทางเดินและบุคลิกภาพดีขึ้นอย่างเห็นได้ชัด
•	แกนกลางลำตัวแข็งแรงขึ้น ทำให้เจ็บปวดน้อยลง
•	ที่สำคัญคือ ได้ฝึกสมาธิ โฟกัสกับสิ่งตรงหน้า เหมือนเป็นการบำบัดไปในตัวค่ะ
.
สำหรับใครที่อยากเริ่ม  จูลอยากบอกว่า…
ที่ Curve Pilates Phuket เหมาะมากสำหรับมือใหม่
คุณครูค่อยๆ พาไปทีละสเต็ป ไม่กดดัน รู้สึกสบายใจมากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
Jules started practicing Pilates in the middle of last year.
Because the nature of my work requires me to bend over and perform laser treatments on many patients every day, I experienced chronic pain in my neck, shoulders, and upper back.

I also wanted to improve my posture and overall appearance.
So, I decided to start private Pilates classes at "Curve Pilates Phuket."

The instructors here are all incredibly lovely and patient 😚
They teach in detail and are easy to understand. After consistent practice, I've noticed that…
• My walking posture and overall appearance have improved significantly.
• My core has become stronger, reducing pain.
• Most importantly, I've learned to concentrate and focus on the task at hand, which feels like therapy in itself.

For anyone who wants to start, Jules would say…
Curve Pilates Phuket is perfect for beginners.
The instructors guide you step by step, without pressure, making you feel very comfortable.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากนะคะสำหรับรีวิวดีๆ ทางทีมงานดีใจมากที่คุณประทับใจในบริการของเรา ค่ะ❤️✨🙏

reviews.name: Nalinrat Payabchaikul
reviews.text:
ได้มาทดลองเรียนที่ Curve Pilates Studio ที่นี่ให้เราเข้าใจกลไกร่างกายผ่านการฝึกพิลาทิส โดยครูผู้สอนที่มีความรู้และประสบการณ์โดยตรง มีอุปกรณ์เครื่องพิลาทิสที่ได้มาตราฐาน สถานที่เรียนสะอาด ที่จอดรถสะดวกสบาย

เรามาที่นี่ด้วยอาการออฟฟิศซินโดรม เมื่อยตึง และร่างกายไม่สมดุลเนื่องจากการออกกำลังกาย ครูพีชช่วยปรับ-ฝึก พร้อมให้ความรู้ ทำให้เข้าใจและดูแลร่างกายตัวเองมากขึ้น ตอนนี้สมัครเรียนต่อเนื่องเพราะเห็นการเปลี่ยนแปลงของอาการและร่างกายที่ดีขึ้น

น้องๆทีมงานแอดมินก็น่ารัก ให้ความช่วยเหลือดูแลตารางเรียนตามเวลาที่ต้องการ แจ้งเตือนคิวเรียนล่วงหน้าให้เราไม่พลาดการเรียน บริการดีเยี่ยม👍
ขอบคุณมากๆค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
I had a trial class at Curve Pilates Studio. Here, I learned about body mechanics through Pilates training, guided by knowledgeable and experienced instructors. They have standard Pilates equipment, a clean studio, and convenient parking.

I came here with office syndrome, stiffness, and body imbalances from exercise. Instructor Peach helped me adjust and train my body, providing knowledge that helped me understand and take better care of my body. I've now enrolled in ongoing classes because I see positive changes in my symptoms and overall well-being.

The admin team is also lovely, helpful, and manages my class schedule according to my needs. They even send reminders so I don't miss any classes. Excellent service! 👍
Thank you so much!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอขอบคุณความคิดเห็นของคุณลูกค้ามากๆนะคะ Curve Pilates ดีใจและยินดีที่ได้ดูแลสุขภาพให้คุณลูกค้าแข็งแรงขึ้นค่ะ 🙏🏻❤️

reviews.name: Ppang onyen
reviews.text: ตัดสินใจมาลองเรียนพิลาทิสเพราะมีอาการปวดหลัง ไหล่ จึงไม่ชอบออกกำลังกายที่มีการกระแทกเยอะๆ  อีกทั้งต้องการปรับรูปร่าง และออกกำลังกายดูแลสุขภาพไปพร้อมๆกัน ได้ลองเรียน Pilates Private session มา 10 ครั้ง รู้สึกร่างกายดีขึ้นมากค่ะ คุณครูน่ารักใจเย็นมากๆ คอยปรับท่าและแก้ปัญหาเฉพาะจุดให้ ทีมงานก็น่ารัก ให้ความดูแลดี เป็นกันเอง สถานที่สะอาดมาก ที่จอดรถเยอะ สะดวกสบายค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I decided to try Pilates because I had back and shoulder pain, and I don't like high-impact exercises. I also wanted to improve my physique and maintain my health at the same time. After 10 private Pilates sessions, I feel a significant improvement in my physical condition. The instructor is very kind and patient, always adjusting my posture and addressing specific issues. The staff is also lovely, attentive, and friendly. The facility is very clean, and there's plenty of parking, making it very convenient.

reviews.textTranslated: I started learning Pilates because I have rather poor posture and wanted to try a new exercise, so I decided to try Curve Pilates Studio for the first time. The instructor was lovely, taught well, and was very patient. They adjusted my posture for beginners or those needing to address specific issues like mine. The admin staff was also lovely, helpful, and attentive. The place was clean and there was plenty of parking.

reviews.text: พิลาทิสสตูดิโอในเมืองภูเก็ต สถานที่สวยงามและเครื่องออกกำลังมาตรฐานโลก ที่สำคัญคุณครูเทรนเนอร์มีความprofessional มาก ปรับดีไซน์เทรนนิ่งตามสภาพร่างกายและปัญหาของแต่ละบุคคล😊👍
reviews.textTranslated: This Pilates studio in Phuket City has a beautiful location and world-class equipment. Most importantly, the trainers are highly professional, designing training programs tailored to each individual's physical condition and problems. 😊👍

reviews.name: Karen
reviews.text:
Did a few sessions of introductory private yoga lessons here. Right from the start, ABBY Society was quick to respond to my queries over WhatsApp, which made the booking smooth (Thanks Prince!).

My instructor was Geng. He incorporated breathworks and Hatha style foundational postures with smooth transitions between each pose. As someone who is totally clueless about yoga, I found these private sessions very beneficial. Geng’s corrections to my angles, poses, and stretches (however minor) made a world of difference in how they felt. I also appreciated his approach with a new student during the first session - respectful, and always saying "sorry" before making any physical adjustments, never taking it for granted. (Thanks Geng!)

The studio itself is charming and cozy. Personally, I much prefer this intimate setting over a massive studio packed with people. It is situated in a lovely green space and I really love that the studio uses plenty of potted plants to beautifully spruce up the environment. I was there both weekdays and weekends, in the morning and afternoon too. On the noise level issue that I read from some reviews, to be fair, the noise level from traffic tapered down once peak hours ended so that was not much of a hindrance.

Definitely an amazing experience for a beginner here! It did changed certain perception that I have of yoga. Thanks Geng and ABBY Society! Keep up with your passion and the good work!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for taking the time to share your lovely feedback. We hope to welcome you back to ABBY Society whenever you are in Chiang Mai again. 🙂💗

reviews.text: The Abby team is so friendly and welcoming. I took three classes here during my time in Chiang Mai, each with a different instructor, and all flows were strong and creative. Easy, quick booking via WhatsApp.

reviews.name: Watcharobon Sumitpaibul
reviews.text: พาแฟนไปเรียน open water ครูโชคน่ารักมาก พอดีมีอุปกรณ์ที่ไม่ได้ใช้มาหลายปี ครูโชคก็เช็คให้ฟรี คุยเป็นกันเอง ไม่มีกดดัน สอนสบายๆ ใครสนใจแนะนำมาเรียนที่นี่เลย เลือกเรียนตามเราสะดวก ออกสอบตามเราสะดวกได้เลย ไม่จำเป็นต้องตรงเสาร์อาทิตย์ แถมตอนออกสอบ ได้ขึ้นเรือ liveaboard ด้วย มีห้องแอร์ให้พักผ่อน สบายๆระหว่างพักน้ำ
reviews.textTranslated: I took my girlfriend to learn open water with Instructor Chok, who was incredibly nice. We had some equipment we hadn't used in years, and Instructor Chok checked it out for free. He was very friendly and easygoing, not at all pushy, and taught in a relaxed manner. I highly recommend this place to anyone interested. You can choose your class schedule and exam dates to fit you, even if it's not on a weekend. Plus, for the exam, you get to go on a liveaboard boat with air-conditioned rooms to relax in between dips.

reviews.name: Mr. Psycho
reviews.text: เริ่มจากไปเจอบูทจากงานไทยเที่ยวไทย แล้วได้คุยกับครูโชค ซึ่งอยากเรียนกันแฟนแต่แฟนมีปัญหาเรื่องกลัวน้ำ ซึ่งครูโชคบอกว่า "มเชื่อว่าทุกคนดำน้ำได้" ซึ่งครูโชคก็ทำได้จริงๆ สอนจากคนกลัวน้ำกลายเป็นไม่กลัว จนสามารถทำได้และสอบ open water ผ่านและเจ้าตัวอยากดำน้ำอีก ครูโชคใส่ใจและดูแลดีมากๆ และสอนเทคนิคต่างๆเพิ่มเติมอีก รวมถึงอุปกรณ์ต่างๆ ก็ของดีๆทั้งนั้นเอามาให้ใช้แบบไม่กลัวนักเรียนทำพังเลย
reviews.textTranslated: It all started when I came across a booth at the Thailand Travel Fair and spoke with Instructor Chok. My girlfriend and I wanted to learn to dive, but she had a fear of water. Instructor Chok said, "I believe everyone can dive," and he really did. He taught someone who was afraid of water to the point where she was no longer afraid, and she was able to dive and pass her Open Water exam. Now she wants to dive again. Instructor Chok is very attentive and caring, teaching additional techniques and providing top-quality equipment that he lets her use without worrying about her damaging anything.

reviews.textTranslated: I took my open water course elsewhere, but after finishing, I felt I still couldn't float well in the water. I searched on Instagram and found Sea Sun Scuba. I added them on Line to ask for more information and spoke with Instructor Chok, who answered all my questions very well. I decided to enroll them in a course to improve my buoyancy. The first thing they adjusted was weights and underwater buoyancy control. After completing the course, I felt much more confident on my Northern Andaman trip and enjoyed diving immensely. I wasn't disappointed at all! I highly recommend their service. You have to try them to see how attentive they are to their customers.

reviews.text:
If you think every yoga studio is the same, you should see this one. It's in the city center but still quiet and peaceful, especially in the morning when you can hear birds singing.

The instructors are remarkably skilled, and really good at balancing kindness and expertise. They adeptly guide classes of mixed levels, making everyone from beginners (like me) to experienced students feel at home.

If you're looking for a peaceful spot in the busy city, Yogasana Room is the place to go. Highly recommend. It's your perfect escape to peace :)

Master Sagar is always greeted us with warmed welcome smiles.  The teachers here are seasoned and experienced and the weekly classes are well planned with variations to suit practitioners.  All in all, this would be the place for me to practice yoga for years to come.

reviews.name: Irene Pereyra
reviews.text: I’ve been doing yoga for many years, and this is by far my favorite place to practice in all of Bangkok (and I have tried almost all of them!). A combination of clear and firm instructions by a team of extremely good teachers has elevated my yoga practice allowing me to go deeper while also helping me better understand how to keep expanding my own practice. With a max of 10 students, you also get a lot of hands-on assists that take into consideration your own abilities. Plus the space is very comfortable, a wooden interior along with a view of the tropical foliage in front makes you forget you are actually in the middle of Ekkamai.

reviews.name: Alex Carson
reviews.text:
If you're searching for a top-notch yoga studio in the heart of the city, Yogasana is the place to be.

One of the standout features of Yogasana Studio is the expertise of Master Sagar, the experienced instructor. His vast knowledge and understanding of yoga are evident in the way he meticulously sequences movements to ensure the best results for practitioners. With his guidance, I felt supported and motivated throughout the session.

Master Sagar's assistance with the use of props and adjustments was truly invaluable. He effortlessly guided me through postures, making sure I achieved proper alignment and avoiding any potential strain. His attention to detail and commitment to each student's individual needs is commendable.

The studio itself is spacious, providing ample room for everyone to practice comfortably. The serene atmosphere creates an environment conducive to deep relaxation and focus. Additionally, Yogasana is well-equipped with resources.

Yogasana Studio is located within walking distance of the BTS sky train.

แนะนำชาวฝั่งธน ที่นี่เลยค่ะ Soulfit Pilates Charoen nakorn

Beautiful pilates studio, top-notch equipment, and a trainer who truly cares.

Soulfit is a brand-new Pilates studio in the Thonburi area, conveniently located in the same building as Riva Vibe Hotel. Parking is never a hassle here, which is a big plus. The studio itself is spotless, decorated in refreshing shades of aqua green that make every corner photogenic while still giving off a calming vibe. Each training room is spacious, equipped with top-quality, brand-new machines and accessories. I especially love the large wall mirrors that allow you to clearly check your form during practice.

I purchased a 30-session package and have been training with Coach Aom, who pays close attention to every detail. She not only ensures accuracy and safety in each posture but also prepares homework, creates tutorial clips, and explains every movement thoroughly. She even takes beautiful photos and videos during sessions, which is perfect for content lovers!

Highly recommend Soulfit Pilates Charoen Nakhon for anyone in the Thonburi area looking for a great Pilates experience.

reviews.name: A Dhayumanee
reviews.text:
เริ่มจากคำถามในใจที่เถียงกับตัวเอง
ว่าจะเปิดร้านอาหารเวียดนาม แต่เอ๊ะ ถ้าเราใช้กุ๊กที่จ้างมาแล้ว วันหนึ่งถ้ากุ๊กลาออกกระทันหัน
Question -    เราจะทำอย่างไร?
Answer -       เราก็ต้องรู้ด้วยสิ จะได้แก้สถานการณ์ทัน โดยไม่กระทบกับร้าน
Question -    อ้าว แล้วจะไปเรียนที่ไหนล่ะ ที่สอนแล้วเข้าใจง่าย สอนแล้วสนุก มีทริคและคำแนะนำให้เรา นำไปใช้กับร้านได้ ไม่มากก็น้อย
Answer -  ว่าแล้วก็ เสิร์ชหาใน internet ทันที เจอ international cooking center อ่ะถ้า inter จะมีเวียดนามรึป่าว ปรากฏว่ามี เลยตัดสินใจเรียนกับ international ทันที

ความประทับใจ และความรู้สึกที่ได้เรียนกับ อ.สายพิณ และ อ.หนุ่ม
- วันแรกที่มา ลูกศิษย์มาสายจ้า แต่ อาจารย์ ต้อนรับด้วยรอยยิ้ม
- ความพร้อมของโรงเรียน อาจารย์ เตรียมให้หมด วัตถุดิบ อุปกรณ์ พร้อมมาแต่ตัวสิครับ
- ความเข้าใจหลังจากได้รับการสอนจาก อาจารย์ทั้ง 2 ท่าน ทางโรงเรียนมี สูตรอาหารที่ได้รับการอัพเดทให้ทันสมัย (แอบดูจากวันที่อัพเดทในเอกสารสูตร) และ อาจารย์จะอธิบายขั้นตอนการทำก่อนว่า ส่วนผสมไหน ก่อน หลัง และให้ลูกศิษย์ปฏิบัติจริง จำง่ายเลย
- รสชาติอาหาร ที่ปฏิบัติตามสูตรของโรงเรียน ทุกเมนู รสชาติอร่อย ถูกปาก (เท่าที่สังเกต อาจารย์จะคงความเด่นของรสชาติแต่ละเมนูไว้ เช่นเมนูนี้ต้องออกหวาน ก็จะคงความออริจินัล นั้นไว้)
- ความสนุก เรียนไป เรียนมา ลูกศิษย์กับ อาจารย์ สนิทกันซะงั้น เลยไม่รู้สึกเกร็ง เพราะ อาจารย์เป็นกันเอง และช่างสังเกต ว่าลูกศิษย์ติดปัญหาอะไร ถามได้ ตอบได้ สุดยอด

วันนี้เรียนจบแล้ว จะได้ใบประกาศ ไม่อยากกลับเลย กำลังสนุก สงสัยต้องหาเรื่อง เปิดร้านอาหารเพิ่มซะแล้ว

สรุปเลย มาเหอะ รับรองว่า International Cooking Center นั้น ไม่ได้มีดีแค่อาหาร แต่มีทริคแห่งความสำเร็จ และสนุกทุกขั้นตอนการเรียนรู้ คุ้มครับ

*** เจอกันที่ร้านอาหารผมครับ So Saigon @ เมืองทองธานี ***
reviews.textTranslated:
It all started with a question I was arguing with myself about:
I was thinking of opening a Vietnamese restaurant, but what if I hired a chef and they suddenly quit?
Question - What would I do?
Answer - I'd need to know what to do so I could handle the situation without affecting the restaurant.
Question - So where could I learn? Where could I find a place that teaches in an easy-to-understand and fun way, with tricks and advice that I can actually use in my restaurant?
Answer - I immediately searched the internet and found the International Cooking Center. I wondered if they offered Vietnamese cuisine, and it turned out they did! So I decided to study with the International Cooking Center right away.

My impressions and feelings about learning with Professor Saiphin and Professor Num:
- On the first day, I was late, but the professor welcomed me with a smile.
- The school and professors prepared everything. All the ingredients and equipment were provided; I just needed to bring myself.
- My understanding after being taught by both professors was excellent. The school provides updated and modern recipes. (I secretly checked the update dates on the recipe documents) and the instructor would explain the steps beforehand, indicating which ingredients to add first and last, and then have the students practice. It was easy to remember.
- The taste of the food, prepared according to the school's recipes, was delicious and suited my palate. (From what I observed, the instructor maintained the distinctive flavor of each dish; for example, if a dish was supposed to be sweet, they would retain that original flavor.)
- The fun part was that the students and instructor became close friends. I didn't feel nervous at all because the instructor was friendly and observant, always ready to answer any questions the students had. Amazing!

Today is the end of the course, and I'm getting my certificate. I don't want to leave! I'm having so much fun. I think I need to start opening another restaurant!

In summary, come! I guarantee that the International Cooking Center isn't just about the food; it has tricks for success and every step of the learning process is fun. It's worth it!

*** See you at my restaurant, So Saigon @ Muang Thong Thani ***

title: Siam Home Cooking Class
subTitle: Siam Home Cooking Class and Chef's Table

plusCode: QW8V+Q4 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Keshia Kan
reviews.text: We had Nancy and the team over to our villa for private catering for over 20 people. The team makes DELICIOUS food. So tasty and authentic. Thanks Nancy for keeping us well fed during our stay!

reviews.name: Roba Ofili
reviews.text: We just had a wonderful cooking class with Siam Home Cooking Class. Nancy was lovely, and an excellent guide.  We cooked Tom yum, pad thai, green curry paste and green curry and finished with mango sticky rice. Delicious and all to our dietary requirements and limitations.  Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Doron Shauly
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of attending a cooking class with Nancy, and it was an incredible experience! From the moment we walked in, Nancy created a warm and welcoming atmosphere that made everyone feel comfortable.

Her passion for cooking is truly infectious, and she skillfully guided us through each step of the recipes. The dishes we prepared were not only delicious but also beautifully presented. Nancy shared valuable tips and techniques that I am excited to take back to my own kitchen.

What I appreciated most was her ability to cater to all skill levels, ensuring that everyone in the class was engaged and learning something new. The interactive nature of the class allowed for a great exchange of ideas and creativity among participants.

Overall, this cooking class was an amazing experience, and I can’t wait to attend another session with Nancy. Highly recommend it to anyone looking to enhance their culinary skills while having a great time!

reviews.name: Hanna
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We had such a wonderful day at Siam Home Cooking Class! We were picked up from our hotel by Nancy and taken to the local markets, where she shared her knowledge of Thai herbs and flavours, such an authentic experience. Back at the kitchen, we each chose 5 dishes to learn: Coconut Chicken Soup, Papaya Salad, Drunken Noodles, Jungle Curry, and my absolute favourite, Banana in Coconut Milk Syrup. We may have gotten a little carried away with the number of chillies in the Jungle Curry...let’s just say we well and truly blew our heads off - and loved every bite! I couldn’t believe how simple the recipes were, yet so incredibly delicious. After cooking each dish, we sat down to enjoy them, then Nacy was so kind to drop us off at the night markets to end a perfect evening of cooking, laughter, and authentic Thai flavours. Highly recommend! 🙏

reviews.name: Starsailor
reviews.text: This is the second year I have come to Nancy's cooking school. In contrast to other schools, it is a small, informal place where cooking is usually done in very small groups or in individual lessons. Nancy is a gifted cook with a big heart. I'm already looking forward to the next time.

reviews.name: Dakota Isaak
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience! Nancy was so fun to talk to and the food was all so incredible and she made it easy to cook. My favorite was the mango sticky rice and the pad Thai. I would definitely do this again!

Tip: make sure to arrive hungry and not hungover for the best possible eating experience.

reviews.name: Juli Ratatouille
reviews.text: Nancy is the best. It was such a pleasure to cook with you. Everything was so delicious and so well explained. Such a wonderful lovely experience!!!

reviews.name: Caroline Grabo
reviews.text: I did this cooking class once two years ago and now came back to do it with my friends. Its usually small groups, we basically had a private class for the three of us. We all really enjoyed it and the food was really great! I was able to cook everything vegan and my friends vegetarian

reviews.name: Gabe
reviews.text: Very friendly teacher! Amazing food options and great ingredients. Authentic Thai dishes that are fun and easy to cook.

reviews.name: LIZA BOBBATO
reviews.text: Nancy is an excellent teacher. She makes everything simple to understand and the class is a good pace. Lots to eat and you will really believe you can be a Thai chef at the end of it all.

reviews.name: Maruel Zain
reviews.text:
Amazing experience, we would definitely do it again!

Took the full day class, booked through our hotel. Nancy, the owner, is an extremely nice and friendly person and she actually tells many jokes during the class, making it fun and dynamic! By the way, you literally cook in her home and you get to chat with her in a relaxed environment, so if you want to learn about Thai culture you'll get that as well.

Make sure that you don't eat too much for breakfast as you will be definitely full by the end!

Positives:
+ Market visit was actually cool! Unlike the classes in the town centre, were it looked like they were parading the people taking the class, we went to a market for locals outside of town, and they explained to us the important basics about ingredients in Thai cooking. The market visit is necessary because they get fresh ingredients for the day class.
+ Each person can cook their own dishes, unlike some other classes where the entire group has to decide on what to cook.
+ Nancy is a great teacher and would happily respond to all the questions we asked.
+ The food was amazing, and all cooked by ourselves with just a little help here and there. This gives me the confidence that I will be able to cook real Thai food at home (even make our own curry base) provided we find the right ingredients.
+ It wasn't stated on the leaflet, but we did get a detailed cook book with all the recipes (essential as after 7 dishes it would be impossible to remember), information about the basic (but again very important!) ingredients and how they are paired, even with pictures if you are like me and cannot really remember what a Thai eggplant or bitter eggplant is afterwards.
+ Water is provided, as much as we needed. Nancy even made us good coffee after the desserts!
+ Any leftover food can be taken back to your hotel in doggie bags.

reviews.name: Kwiwoon Lee
reviews.text:
I didn't expect before going there because google rate was a bit low. But I met Nancy in the local market and she explained about ingredients so professionally.

I made tom yang gai, pakapao muu, kao soi and kao niaw gap mat muang. They are all delicious and easy to make! I have experienced the thai cooking class before and both were good!

Nancy's class were more freedom and time to talk with classmates.

So do not hesitate to do this! You will have fun!!!!

reviews.name: Laura Bennett
reviews.text: Participated in the full day course and cooked 7 wonderful Thai dishes including my favorite, Khao Soi. Nancy was amazing and explained all the ingredients and paced the class nicely. We received a recipe book which included not just what we chose to make but all the dishes available in the program. There is even and option where she will book and transfer you to a massage after you are done cooking and eating.

reviews.name: Markéta Brtková
reviews.text: Today we visited evening lesson with lovely chef Oj. Oj cooked with us 5 different Thai meals. She was patiente and explained everything,so we can cook like Master chefs now. After lesson we got also cook book, so it will be more easy to cook these meals after at home. Thanks for this great lesson,Oj!!!

reviews.name: Valerie Ramos
reviews.text: My family loved Nancy and her class! Myself and my 2 children had a great morning with her  and our food was incredibly delicious. She is a great cook who is very kind, knowledgeable and speaks great English! Her driver picked us up right on time and took us to a market to meet Nancy. She explained many fruits, vegetables and herbs to us and then let us explore the market on our own for 10-15 min. Then the driver took us from the market to her cooking home where we picked out our food dishes. We loved all 8 of our menu items and had such fun making and eating them! Totally recommend this to others. My children are 5 & 7 and they had a blast...but they do love cooking and Thai food so it was a good fit for them. Nancy was very sweet and helpful to them. If this is something your kids would enjoy I’d consider bring them here for sure!

reviews.name: becca97
reviews.text: What a great class! I had the best foods here. Needless to say that I will be cooking thai food only. Nancy was amazing. The price is reasonable and the food generous. Don't eat before coming.

reviews.name: Miriam Maher
reviews.text: Most intimate and authentic cooking class I've ever done! Food is delicious and Nancy is so kind and energetic, highly recommend!

reviews.name: Nathan O'Brien
reviews.text: Go hungry, you're going to cook a lot of food! Nancy was a great host and this class is a must do if you're in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: bob denard
reviews.text:
Siam home - thanks nancy !!
So nice experience
We recommend evening course with 5 dishes.
Choose what you want to cook and  cook it!

reviews.name: Amber George
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time at Nancy’s cooking class! It was only the two of us so felt like a private lesson. We did the dinner course and made 5 dishes and I’ve never been more full in my life. Nancy is a great teacher and made the whole experience so much fun for us - will definitely be making the recipes soon!

reviews.name: Kelvin Kelvin
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Fitness First Siam Paragon branch located in Siam Paragon today!

I arrived at the gym at around 20:00 and placed my belongings in a locker in the changing room. The club closes at 22:00. However, when I returned to collect my items at 21:59, they had already been removed. On this occasion, I had only placed my card inside the locker, and it had been taken out before the official closing time.

It is unacceptable for lockers to be opened and cleared while the gym is still operating and before closing hours. This situation made me feel unsafe and concerned about the security of members’ personal belongings.

I strongly urge management to review their locker-clearing procedures and ensure that staff do not remove members’ items before closing time. Due to this incident, I am considering terminating my membership, as I no longer feel comfortable working out here.

reviews.name: Pomme Saowarose
reviews.text:
I visited Fitness First using a free trial and was impressed by the variety of group exercise classes and the overall quality of the facilities.

That said, my first impression was somewhat affected by the experience at the front desk. During my visit on the morning of May 20, 2025, the receptionist—specifically a woman with long straight hair—was noticeably unfriendly and rude. Although she answered my questions, her tone was curt, and she avoided eye contact, making the interaction feel cold and unwelcoming. For potential members trying out the gym for the first time, a warm and helpful reception can make all the difference. I hope the management takes this into consideration to better align the customer service with the high standards of the gym itself.

reviews.name: Matt David
reviews.text: This a really fancy gym. 1070 baht for a day pass but was happy to pay
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your feedback! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our facilities and felt the experience was well worth it. We hope to welcome you back again soon!

reviews.name: Eliss W
reviews.text: Good environment and space. Many choice of machine. Crowded in da evening. Provide towel and gym attire for member.

reviews.name: Rich Campbell
reviews.text:
Clean and excellent gym with just about every piece of equipment.  Mostly Technogym older models but in good shape.

Reasonable 350 baht entry for tourists if you buy a pack of 10 passes.

reviews.name: Gunta Bogdane
reviews.text:
Was staying in Bangkok for two days so decided to go for a free trial as per their website advertisement.
Filled in the form, it was asking for Thai mobile number which we did not have (been using eSIM while travelling), and there was no option to change the country code however the application still went through even with skipping this step.
Booked a taxi,  20min drive and were there just after 6am when the gym opens.
Receptionist was very unwelcoming, she did not greet us, whole time she was using the phone for translating.
Showed her the confirmation email to say that free trial has been confirmed, she asked if we had registered to which we said yes, there is the confirmation. She then rang someone (bear in mind all this time we were not told anything), and then she asked us for Thai mobile number which we did not have, obviously as we had eSIM while travelling. She then shows Google translate which states - “contact 1-2 days”.
Basically someone will get in touch.
We then asked how much is one days pass?
1070 Thai Bhatt per person. Daylight robbery!
Anyway - if you offer free trials, be ready for tourists to apply and do not expect them to have Thai SIM card and world is more advanced now and people can get eSIM before the traveling.
Also, why do not you make the whole experience easier and simple. If I want to do a days gym session, I am not going to wait for 2 days until someone gets in touch with me.
Also, if you do not want to interfere with customers and find it difficult to be welcoming etc - don’t work in the public service sector.

Best place to practice Muay Thai in Ekkamai! Friendly and welcoming staff who make you feel comfortable from day one.

The best part is you don’t need to rent gloves or other gear—it’s all provided.

Highly recommend
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind review! We’re delighted to hear that you consider Cheeks Thai Boxing the best place to practice Muay Thai, and that our friendly team made you feel comfortable right from the start.  

It’s wonderful to know that having gear provided added to your positive experience. Your recommendation means a great deal to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for more training sessions at Cheeks Thai Boxing!

reviews.name: yesran
reviews.text:
🥊An intense but beginner-friendly Muay Thai class. (5/5)
Located on the 3rd floor of the building right next to Ekkamai Health Land, this Muay Thai gym is one of those places I must’ve walked past a hundred times and had no idea it was up there.

The 90-minute class is run by four rotating coaches, and more than half of it is basically 1-on-1. Each one had a different style and focus, which kept things interesting and dynamic.

They were all incredibly kind and motivating, and adjusted the intensity based on each person’s level. I’m a total beginner, but there were also regulars who’ve been coming for over a year. Everyone seemed to be learning at their own pace.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Yesran,

Thank you very much for taking the time to share your experience with us. We're truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed the class and appreciated the personalized attention from our coaches. It’s wonderful to know the environment felt welcoming and motivating—especially for beginners and regulars alike.

Fah

reviews.name: Raksha
reviews.text: It was okay. After a brief warming up, you are left on your own to entertain yourself. Instructors will come and collect you to do padwork. In total everyone gets 3 rounds. I've trained at gyms in Thailand where padwork is also only done by instructors (which I like) but at least at other gyms they make sure you train properly in between rounds by giving out exercises to help improve your skills (kicks, knees, etc.). At Cheeks, most people were just sitting and waiting for the instructors, who were more occupied with each other. What I did like was that the instructors made sure to meet everyone at their own level and pace during padwork. Wouldn't train here again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Raksha,

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience you experienced and truly appreciate your valuable feedback. Please rest assured that we will take your comments into careful consideration to further improve our training and services. Once again, we extend our heartfelt apologies, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future.

Warm Regards,
Cheeks Thai Boxing Club

reviews.name: Wal B.
reviews.text:
Tried pretty much every Muay Thai gym in the central Bangkok area (multiple times each). Cheeks have always come out on top. Top rating in every possible category for Muay Thai gym. THE BEST in Central Bangkok area.
If you're here to train professionally, do let them know otherwise it's standard training for the general public. They adjust the training for all your needs. Just communicate. They're all wonderful!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback! We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed your training experience with us and that our team could meet your expectations. At Cheeks, we always strive to provide the best possible environment for every guest—whether you’re here for professional training or simply to enjoy Muay Thai as part of your fitness journey.  

Your kind words mean a lot to our trainers and staff, and we’re grateful for your appreciation. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon and continuing to support your training goals.

reviews.name: Ann Annika

title: Luktupfah Muay Thai and Muay Boran school
subTitle: ลูกทัพฟ้า มวยไทยและมวยไทยโบราณ
description: Traditional Muay Thai boxing & martial arts training center offering classes & teaching courses.
ownerDescription:
Authentic Muay Thai and Muay Boran school and camp, with professional and enjoyable classes that cater to all levels, from beginner to advance/fighter.

Also offering muay thai instructor (Kru) Certifications under the Kru Muaythai Association, which is the world leading muay thai teacher khan system founded by Thai masters.

Luktupfah is the official gym and headquarters for Kru Muaythai Association, World Muayboran Federation & World Muaythai Organization.
Located on the outskirts of Bangkok, just 20minutes from Suvarnabhumi airport & 40minutes to the city.
address: 15 On Nut 65 Alley, Lane 8, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand
plusCode: PMGM+GR Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: H H
reviews.text:
A friend introduced Luktupfah Muay Thai gym to me since i was keen to try Muay Thai during my bangkok holiday.

I visited for a 7am Muay thai session on 20 Jan 2026 and I had a productive session with instructor Dew. As a beginner, he taught me the stances and moves for muay thai and we did bag work and pad work. He also incorporated some upper body strength training at the end before cool down. I noticed they have accomodation for visitors too. I would come back again if I want to do muay thai in bangkok. 🥊🥊

Recommended to take grab or bolt there as the nearest station Ban Thap Chang on Airport Rail Link is 2 km away.

Also.. they have a very cute cat meowing around in the gym. 🐈😻

reviews.text:
This gym/school is highly recommended for those seeking detailed explanation of techniques/footwork. Also teachings are done with an emphasis of knowledge about the roots of muaythai.
I went back to Luktupfah for 3 staying visits within 6 months because I throughly enjoyed and appreciated the knowledge given by their dedicated teachers. The hospitality shown by GM Woody, family and team was warm and genuinely felt. Thank you for having me there, will keep coming back.

reviews.name: jose montano
reviews.text: First thing I want to say is, if you are looking for a real Muay Thai gym and looking for that real Thai experience. No matter what level you are beginner, intermediate, advanced. You need to come this gym. These amazing people  will work you to the ground in a good way lol, but then also teach you a lot of what they know. Also the biggest thing for me before I came to this gym is “will I be welcomed because I am foreigner and will they treat me different?” Well let me tell you what I have never felt so welcomed in a gym even in the states as much as I did here. They trainers were amazing, loving, and once you meet Kru war he is the funniest guy in the world lol. I loved this gym so much I didn’t want to leave. It’s away from city which I loved, and it was the best experience you can ask for. Thank you Luktupfah for such an amazing experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind review Jose. It was great to have you here and we hope to see you again :) All the best from us at Luktupfah!

reviews.name: theo Renou
reviews.text: It has been 2 times that i went training and staying there (2 months in 2024 and 1 month in 2025) as a beginner and then as a fighter. I have always been taken care of very well. The coachs are really Kind and experienced. I enjoyed every training i had there!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your positive review :) we look forward to seeing you again

reviews.name: Thomas Swartz
reviews.text:
Wonderful gym-- like a second home. People might stay here for 3 days, 3 weeks, or 3 months, but it always seems like, when it comes time to leave, they end up extending their stay.

In the morning classes, sometimes it'll just be you and four of the Krus. This level of private instruction and attention is extremely unique. A similar experience at a tourist resort might cost 50 times what it does here.

The Krus themselves are all incredibly experienced, knowledgeable, and friendly. It's cliche to say that "everybody from beginners to pro fighters is welcome," but in this case it's really true. During a training drill, you might be paired with a local high school student for one exercise, and then with a pro national champion the next.

There is nothing but 'good vibes' here; we train hard, but, for example, this morning Kru War *asked* us if we wanted to do another set of bodyweight exercises. We said yes! This mindset is not something you really find in the west; during athletic practices, conditioning is a whip to your back rather than something you do because you enjoy. But here, with the open-air facility, constant sunshine, and friendly people, you forgot about all the physical challenges of training and instead focus on the joy of it.

The accommodations are clean and spacious. Each room has a private bathroom, desk, wardrobe, and mini-fridge, and there is a kitchen available to any guests who want to cook-- there is ample cookware for this purpose as well as utensils and Thai condiments. Within three minutes walking distance, there is also a cafe open all day that is both cheap and high-quality-- and multiple grocery stores.

Luktupfah has anything a professional fighter, amateur fighter, or total beginner might want. I wholeheartedly recommend it.

reviews.name: Dan Ho
reviews.text: Well equipped gym with many experienced, professional and friendly instructors. We came as a group training class of 10 students. There were many international students training. We didn’t stay in but there is an option to do so. Highly recommended to take part in an advance level of Muay Thai training.

reviews.text: Luktupfah is among the elite class in the world of martial arts. A true gem of Bangkok and Thailand in general. Master Woody has made a WORLD CLASS academy with THE BEST instructors. reviews.text:
I can't speak more highly of this gym. It made me fall in love with Muay Thai all over again over the couple weeks I was training there. They are respectful and very dedicated trainers. I felt a true connection to their work ethic and love for the sport. Grand Master Woody was very welcoming and helpful as well as all the people running the gym. reviews.text:
Great gym. Grandmaster Woody is both very welcoming and exceptionally professional.

Master Bpu leads all classes with extreme knowledge and patience. Classes are done in both Thai and in English.

Ms. Patree is very welcoming and assists at all levels to students, fighters and visitors and explains the courseware with clarity.

I have enjoyed my 2 months stay at Luktupfah Muaythai Academy and I would recommend this Academy/Gym to anyone who is interested in following or starting a Muaythai or Muay Boran carrier and also as a fighter.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words Lloyd, it’s been a pleasure having you.

reviews.name: Jason Bender
reviews.text: I am a lifelong martial artist that owns an Academy on the Northside of Chicago. My trip to Luktupfah was everything I dreamed of in a martial artist adventure and more.  My air-conditioned room was clean and the camp has a real family feel. Kindness is the top commodity and Grandmaster Woody, his lovely wife Jill and his rock star daughter Jade Sirisompan lead the way while Kru Ton and Kru Bpu and Kru War lead AMAZING classes! They are patient and clear with their instruction. Even during times when an interpreter was not available; it was barely an obstacle and only made for some laughs and a memorable fun learning experience. As soon as I arrived I ate some bad street food while seeing the gorgeous temples and Patree, the Superwoman that helps with everything, made certain that I had medicine and kept checking on me. Passing the Kru certification course was an amazing experience where I learned a ton! I could have went to any camp and learned how to smash pads better and I am certain I would have had a great time...but here I learned how to be a teacher of Muay Boran, not just Muay Thai. I consider this one of my great accomplishments and I cherish the memories and I hope to return.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Jason, thank you so much for your kind review. We are more than thrilled to have provided you a great experience at Luktupfah, you were a delight to have here and we look forward to seeing you again in the future.

During my 3 months stay i met many colleagues who stayed in the camp from fighters to tourists, to coaches coming from different countries, exchanging different cultures and styles of teaching and playing Muaythai. It is a very safe and healthy environment to be in.

reviews.name: Tracey C
reviews.text:
My second favourite boxing venue in the city - great local vibe with a good mixture of local and foreign talent.

I watched 3 or four good quality and well matched bouts and it's another place with traditional five round muay Thai, and a great atmosphere.

The public is much more local than some of the bigger stadiums and as a result it has a nicer atmosphere with people chearing and applauding there favourite fighters.

reviews.name: Michael Nappo
reviews.text: Me and my daughter had a great time. For $ 1000 baht you are sitting front row. The fighters fought hard and was definitely not rigged. We liked it so much we went back the next day and had an even better time. You can meet all the fighters and the food and drink is cheap. Was the highlight of our trip to Thailand.
