reviews.name: Eve Akinyemi
reviews.text: Had a great night here, all seat give a good view so no need to get in too early. Great atmosphere and food and drink available.

reviews.name: Jens Walter
reviews.text:
It was our first time attending a Muay Thai boxing event, and we had a truly wonderful and entertaining evening at Thaphae Boxing Stadium in Chiang Mai. I especially enjoyed the ritual movements of the fighters in the ring at the beginning and the unique atmosphere.

I was surprised by how fast some of the knockouts happened — some even in the first round. As a layperson, I couldn’t even see many of the effective hits and strikes that quickly. It is a very diverse sport that combines skill, discipline, strength, speed, endurance, and the right fighter’s heart and mindset.

My favorite fight was the international match between Jean from CMA.academy/France and the Thai boxer Petchsuraj Rambongmuaythai/Thailand, in which Jean won by knockout in the first round.
A very special highlight for me: as a VIP guest, I was allowed to officially greet both fighters shortly before their fight. Simply fantastic. I would love to come again. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Nathan Yu
reviews.text: Had a great time catching a Thursday night muay thai fight here! I loved the live music which set the rhythm for the fights and there was a good variety of fighters. The younger thai fighters went absolutely insane with fast paced offense and made for very exciting fights
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ❤️Thank you for the review. Glad you like it. I will improve even further.

reviews.name: jamie clarke
reviews.text:
Fixed fights, children fighting, blindfolded fight? Literally a mockery of Muay Thai, I cant express how terrible this place is.

Of the 5 fights we watched every single one ended with the fighter taking a dive and not even convincingly. Three fights were literally children, not even older teens, one with two girls that actually made us uncomfortable to watch because they can’t have been older than 12-13.

We walked out after the “main event” ended with a dreadful dive after a couple of minutes of tippy tapping. I don’t think I saw a serious punch thrown all night. There was a fake “blindfolded” fight at one point with three people in the ring, to call it a circus would be an insult to circuses. They then come and ask for money from everyone in the audience after the blindfolded fight.

The lack of integrity in pandering to tourists has gotten so extreme that I don’t understand how even tourists could think this was real or enjoyable. It’s such a shame as from what I’ve read the place has some actual history.

We were baffled by how poor the “stadium” itself is as soon as we got there, it’s literally a dingy room down a narrow alleyway with maybe 50-100 seats. It was mostly empty, everyone else presumably had the sense to go to a different stadium. An absolute robbery for 600 baht but it still would’ve been a robbery if it was free.

Legitimately the worst hour I’ve spent in Thailand, do not go here.

reviews.name: Tim
reviews.text: Some of Saturday night fights were really good, the atmosphere is very cozy and the traditional live music was great.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ❤️Thank you for the review. Glad you like it. I will improve even further.

reviews.name: O H
reviews.text:
A good touristy evening of Muay Thai. Good entertainment but it is not real Muay Thai. 7 matches overall with 5 ended in the first round including the main fight.

Aside from 3/5 rounds across the entire evening, the rest is just pure theater like American WWE but Thai style with most fights ended in KOs in the first rounds by amateur fighters.

If you are after real fights, this is not the place for you. No need for ring side seating and save yourself 400 THB for beers and food.

Nonetheless, it was an entertaining evening without any blood spilled and a good introduction to Thai boxing.

reviews.name: cengiz
reviews.text: If you’re naive enough to believe that every single promoted foreigner can knock out the Thai fighters in two-three rounds flat, then you might enjoy this. A space to work, read, connect, or relax for a while. We host yoga classes, workshops, community events, and weekly men’s circles.
Popular among local residents, commuters, and travellers looking for good coffee and a calm atmosphere.
address: 127 M10, Nam Phrae, Hang Dong District, Chiang Mai 50230, Thailand
plusCode: MVFR+W7 Nam Phrae, Hang Dong District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
Love the coffee at Sacred Grounds? Now you can take it home.
Our coffee is now available as whole coffee beans the very same arabica beans we use at the café every day.
Pick up a bag on your next visit and enjoy your Sacred Grounds coffee wherever you brew.

We honour Lord Ganesha by celebrating the beginning of every day with devotion, pausing and remembering that life is much more than which demands our attention, and that deeper things are worth stopping for.
May we meet every beginning with sharpness and clarity.
May we move through our obstacles with fierceness and wisdom.
May we remember to honour the sacred, not only in extraordinary moments, but in the rhythm of everyday life.
From our garden at Sacred Grounds, wishing you a beautiful Ganesh Chaturthi.

Have you tried our Signature Orange Cinnamon Honey Americano?

Coffee, fresh orange, cinnamon and honey made in-house and definitely worth the stop.

If you’re heading out of Chiang Mai, come find us in Hang Dong.

Join us next Saturday June 20 for another Saturday Men's Morning, designed to help you reconnect with your body, regulate your nervous system, and share with a community of grounded men.
8:00am - Hatha Yoga for Men
9:15am - Internal Alchemy for Men

Join one session or stay for the full morning experience.
Limited spaces available. Booking necessary. Message us on WhatsApp to sign up.

Looking for authentic Hatha Yoga in Chiang Mai? Join us weekly for lineage-based Hatha Yoga classes focused on strength, mobility, breath awareness, and inner balance. Classes are suitable for both beginners and experienced practitioners. Spaces are limited, so booking is strongly advised.
To reserve your spot, simply send us a WhatsApp message using the link below.
We look forward to practicing with you.

Finding your True North Workshop - 9:15am

Message us to reserve your spot.

This Saturday at Sacred Grounds CNX, our Saturday Men's Morning happens again:

Hatha Yoga for Men - 8:00am
Habit Identity Workshop - 9:15am
Men's Circle - 10:30am

Come for one session or stay for the full morning of movement, reflection, growth, and connection.

Message us to reserve your spot.

New at Sacred Grounds CNX!
Starting this Saturday, we’re offering a full Saturday morning experience for men:
🧘🏽‍♂️Hatha Yoga for Men - 8:00am
✍🏽FreeWriters Workshop - 9:15am
⭕️Men’s Circle - 10:30am

Booking recommended.

Yoga classes are now happening at our new studio. 
Starting this week, May 26-31, we’re opening the space for regular Hatha Yoga and Yin Yoga practices, designed to support balance, strength, flexibility, and inner grounding.
All levels are welcome, including beginners.

Looking for something refreshing?
Try our Lemon Honey Soda, made in-house with real lemon, natural forest honey from Chiang Mai, and sparkling water. Light, crisp, and perfect for hot days. Available now at Sacred Grounds.

reviews.name: Sunil P
reviews.text:
A friendly coffee shop with authentically tasting pastel de natas, açaí bowls and more.

Walking in you may think it’s just a small coffee shop but pop out to the garden and it’s a sanctuary in the making. Hangout tables to enjoy your drink and food and a soon to be yoga and wellness studio in the making too.

Lovely owners a Portuguese and Thai couple who are super friendly and passionate about what they’re creating. Pop in for a coffee, stay for the community ☺️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Sunil, for this beautiful review!
We’re truly grateful you felt the spirit of what we’re creating here: not just a coffee shop, but a little sanctuary slowly taking shape. Knowing that you enjoyed an Açaí Bowl, our genuine Pastel de Nata, and the garden space, means a lot to us.
And thank you for your kind words about us as well: building this space as a Portuguese-Thai couple has been a labor of love, and it’s wonderful to see people connect with that intention.
We hope to see you again soon! ☺️🙏🏽

reviews.name: Bodha Nidhi
reviews.text:
Cozy place in Chiang Mai that offers coffee AND yoga. What a combo.
The yoga classes offered here are amazing. It is quite rare to find true traditional yoga from India to begin with, but finding it here almost unassumingly hidden, makes it all the more authentic. The owner has studied yoga extensively and has also organised many travels in India as a tour guide, and the experience he brings to class as a teacher is clearly evident.
Definitely recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Bodha Nidhi for your thoughtful review! We're so happy you enjoyed the combination of coffee and yoga. It really is at the heart of what Sacred Grounds is all about.
Your appreciation for our traditional approach to yoga means a great deal. We strive to honor the depth and authenticity of the practice while making it accessible in a welcoming environment. Thank you for recognizing the experience and intention behind the classes.
We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back soon, whether it's for a practice, a coffee, or both!

reviews.name: Marie-Pierre Gay
reviews.text: A place with a special heart, run by dedicated and passionate people. Their matcha is excellent, and their yoga shala is a haven of peace and tranquility in a city that can sometimes be hectic. It's wonderful to be able to find spaces that seem to exist outside of time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your beautiful words, Marie-Pierre. We're deeply grateful for your recognition of what we're trying to create here. Knowing that you experienced the yoga shala as a place of peace and tranquility means a great deal to us.
Our hope is that Sacred Grounds can not just a café or a yoga space, but a place where people can slow down, reconnect, and step outside the rush of everyday life, even if only for a little while.

Thank you for your support, your presence, and your kind encouragement. We look forward to welcoming you back to our little corner of stillness soon.

reviews.name: Matt Thomson
reviews.text: I had the yoghurt and granola, tasty and good portion size. The staff are genuine and friendly, they have peaceful place to sit outside behind the cafe.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Matt for your kind review! We’re delighted that you enjoyed the yogurt and granola, and that the portion size hit the mark. It’s especially nice to hear that you found our team genuine and friendly, as creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere is truly important to us.
We’re glad you discovered our peaceful garden as well. We hope to welcome you back soon for another relaxing visit at Sacred Grounds!

reviews.name: Poncho Cottier
reviews.text: Beautiful little cafe with amazing and authentic Portuguese pasteis de natas. If you don’t know what that is, just go and try them! Sacred Grounds also holds Men’s circles (on Saturday) and yoga and other activities in their beautiful sala behind the cafe. Enjoy some nice coffee, food and one of their sessions
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Poncho, thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're delighted that you enjoyed our Pasteis de Nata. Hearing them described as authentic is one of the nicest compliments we can receive, as it is truly a Portuguese recipe! 

Thank you as well for highlighting the men's circles, yoga, and other community gatherings in our shala. Our vision has always been to create a space where great coffee, nourishing food, and meaningful connection can come together.
We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back soon for another pastel de nata, coffee, or community session. ☺️🙏🏽

reviews.name: My Two Cents
reviews.text:
We stopped here on a Sunday morning. Unfortunately, there were no bakes for sale :( The coffee was okay, but the mocha was terrible.. It didn’t taste like there was any coffee in it at all and lacked any taste. Not too sure if we just caught it on a bad day.
That said, the outside area was lovely and the yoga studio looked very cute.

EDIT: thank you for such a kind response from the owner! Can I clarify what time the bakes are usually ready for, incase of a future visit? 😊

And yes! We did ask about the mocha… the staff told us they added coffee and chocolate, but no follow up after. If it happens again, we’ll ensure to ask for it to be made again 🙏

+1 star simply for a lovely response! 🥰thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you Charlene, for taking the time to leave a review. We're sorry to hear that the mocha didn't meet your expectations. On the morning of your visit, we were indeed still baking our fresh pasteis de nata, which is why they weren't yet available when you arrived. We understand that was disappointing.

Regarding the mocha, we're genuinely sorry to hear it wasn't enjoyable. We wish we had known while you were here, as we would have gladly remade it or prepared something else for you. Feedback like this helps us improve, and we always want our guests to leave happy.

We're glad you enjoyed the outdoor area and the yoga studio, and we hope you'll give us another opportunity to provide the experience we're known for.

EDIT: Thank you so much, Charlene, that's incredibly kind of you, and we really appreciate you updating your review! 🥰🙏🏽

Our pasteis de nata are usually ready between 9:00 and 9:30 AM, depending on the morning's baking schedule, and sometimes they are gone shortly after that. This is when we normally bake a few more again. If you're planning a special visit for them, feel free to message us beforehand and we'll happily make sure they are out of the oven when you arrive. 😊

And thank you for clarifying about the mocha. In that case, we owe you an apology. Our staff should have followed up after your feedback to make sure you were happy with your drink. This much we learned from your feedback. We used this as a learning opportunity for the team so we can do better in the future.

We truly appreciate your understanding and your generosity in giving us another star. We honestly hope we'll have the chance to welcome you back soon for a fresh pastel de nata and a much better mocha! ☕

reviews.name: Roy Beauquesne
reviews.text: We were craving coffee on our way from our elephant stay in the mountains to Chiang Mai and stumbled upon this lovely spot. We were welcomed with a big warm smile into a very charming and trendy little coffee house. The owners are incredibly kind and friendly. They gave us great local tips and served us truly delicious coffee. We had an açaí bowl, a pastel de nata, and a coffee. All three were absolutely five out of five. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Roy! We’re so happy you found us on your way down from the mountains and that everything, from the coffee to the açaí bowl and pastel de nata, hit the spot! It was a real pleasure welcoming you and sharing a few local tips. Wishing you a beautiful journey ahead, and we hope to see you again next time you’re in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Ariane Grigo
reviews.text:
A wonderful little café with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The coffee is excellent, the breakfasts are fresh and healthy, and the cakes, pancakes, and toast are absolutely delicious.

What I loved most is how quickly you feel at home here. A cozy place with friendly people and great food. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your beautiful review, Ariane! Reading that you felt at home here means the world to us. Creating a warm, welcoming space where people can relax, connect, and enjoy good food and coffee is exactly what we hope to offer.

We're delighted that you enjoyed the coffee, cakes, pancakes, toast, and even more grateful for your kind words about the atmosphere and our team. 🥰❤️

Thank you for your recommendation. We can't wait to welcome you back to Sacred Grounds for another cozy visit! 😊🙏🏽

reviews.name: Elo Diaz
reviews.text: If you are looking to experience a hidden pearl, then head to this lil authentic café. And ... the most stricking is that you can find there a true traditionnal yoga offer, not shallow gymnastics! But a connexion to a valid lineage and a place where real self inquiry and healing take place. I recommend!! ♥
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this beautiful review, Elo Diaz!  We're deeply touched by your words. It means a lot to know that you experienced Sacred Grounds not only as a café, but as a place for authentic spiritual practice, self-inquiry, and genuine connection.
We're especially grateful that you recognized the lineage-based approach behind our Hatha Yoga practice. Our intention is to create a space where people can slow down, reconnect with themselves, and engage in practices that carry real depth and meaning.

Thank you for your recommendation and for being part of the journey. We look forward to welcoming you back soon for a yoga practice, a coffee, or simply a quiet moment in the garden.

reviews.name: Sofañah Draycott
reviews.text:
Small café with outdoor seating, Coffee is a real good!  and their pastries are super tasty 😋, especially Pastel de nata( Portuguese egg  tart) authentic flavour. There have other snack too.
The owner and his wife( and their staff) are super nice and welcoming. I highly recommend if you pass by the area,it's place that you should stop by.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re really happy you enjoyed the coffee and pastries, especially our original pastel de nata, it means a lot to hear it felt authentic.
Your kind words about our team truly touch us. It’s a pleasure to welcome customers you, and we’re deeply grateful for the recommendation.
We hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Philipp Bernhard
reviews.text: Cute little Cafe with great service, very good coffee and tasty little snacks 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words! We’re really happy you enjoyed the experience: coffee, food and service. We hope to welcome you back again. ☺️🙏🏽

reviews.name: Mike
reviews.text: Delicious coffee and matcha. They have a yoga class and a men's circle on Saturday mornings. I attended both, and it was a great experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review, Mike! We're delighted that you enjoyed both the coffee and the matcha, and even more so that you joined us for the Yoga class and the Men's Circle. It means a lot to hear that you had a great experience.
Creating a space for connection, reflection, and community is a big part of what Sacred Grounds is all about. We hope to welcome you back again soon, whether for a coffee, a practice, or a circle. 🙏🏽

reviews.name: RK
reviews.text: Coffee is good, but I mostly visit on Saturday mornings for their events. The events (most are men only) are done in a safe and trusting environment and provide a great option for self reflection and self improvement. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much RK for your thoughtful review! We're glad you enjoy the coffee, and we're especially grateful to hear that the Saturday Men's Morning events have been valuable for you. Creating a safe, respectful, and trusting environment where men can reflect, connect, and grow is among the things we care deeply about.
Thank you for being part of the community. We look forward to seeing you again soon at Sacred Grounds! ⭕️🙏🏽

reviews.name: Michael
reviews.text: Really enjoyed the Hatha yoga class. The class was well taught, welcoming, and left me feeling relaxed and refreshed. The coffee afterward was excellent too. Great spot for yoga and a good cup of coffee.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review, Michael!
We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed the Hatha yoga class and left feeling relaxed and refreshed. Creating a welcoming space for practice is very important to us, so it's wonderful to know that came through in your experience.
And we're glad the coffee afterward completed the morning! We hope to welcome you back again soon for another practice and a great cup of coffee.  ☺️🙏🏽

reviews.name: Gennady Gram
reviews.text: Apart from the cute coffee place, this place offers amazing activities and workshops! I found great value in the Men circle, it was done very professionally 👌
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Gennady, for your kind review! We're delighted that you enjoyed both the café and the men's circle. It means a great deal to hear that you found the experience valuable and professionally held.
Our intention is to create a space where people can not only enjoy soul food and great coffee, but also find meaningful opportunities for connection, reflection, and personal growth.
Thank you for your recommendation, and we hope to welcome you back soon, whether it's for a coffee, another circle, or one of our upcoming workshops. 🙏

reviews.name: Roland Rohrle
reviews.text: We recently visited Sacred Grounds. I enjoyed the coffee so much that I had two. The Portuguese tarts are delicious. The owners are lovely people and the service was great.  Thank you
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words! We’re so happy you enjoyed the coffee (two cups - that’s the best compliment!) and loved the Portuguese Tarts too. It was a real pleasure having you, and we truly appreciate your warm feedback. Hope to welcome you back soon!

reviews.name: S B
reviews.text: My wife and I stopped at this great little cafe and so glad we did. Perfect coffee and we had their freshly baked cinnamon rolls. So good. Very welcoming friendly owners too. Drop in.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely words! We’re so happy you and your wife stopped by, and even happier that you enjoyed the coffee and cinnamon rolls! We hope to welcome you again soon!

reviews.name: Xue ying
reviews.text:
This coffee shop uses paper cups for cold drinks and it is so cool, I really hope other shops can learn it from them, it is good for protecting the environment, The Thai government could tell people that they use less plastic to protect the earth.

Plus Matcha latte is very good with beautiful clay cups.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your visit and thoughtful message! 🌍💚 We truly believe that small choices like using paper cups for cold drinks can make a big difference for the country and our planet. We’re grateful you noticed, and we hope more places join the shift toward sustainability too.

And we're so happy you enjoyed the matcha latte! Serving it in our beautiful clay cups is part of what makes it special indeed. We hope to welcome you back again soon for more mindful moments together. 🍵

reviews.name: Lucy McGown
reviews.text: Love this little coffee shop. Just on the side of a highway easy to pull over and grab a great coffee for a good price.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! We’re really happy you loved the shop and found it an easy stop along the way. Glad you enjoyed the coffee. Hope to see you again!

reviews.name: Chris Teo
reviews.text: We drove past and wanted some coffee. My husband had the Latte while I had the Matcha Latte. It was very good. My husband makes his own coffee at home and he said the coffee is solid.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for stopping by! We’re really happy to hear you both enjoyed your drinks. And if your husband makes his own coffee at home and still calls ours “solid,” we’ll take that as a big compliment! 
Glad you liked the matcha latte as well. We hope to welcome you both again next time you’re in the area!

title: Miss Fitness At Pump Fitness 2.0 near Chiang Mai Gate
ownerDescription: Gym in Chiang Mai, Thailand located in the old Chiang Mai City area has been incorporated into Pump Fitness 2.0 near the South Gate of the Old City. Pump Fitness 2.0 is a welcoming, fully air conditioned, 700+ sqm gym for man and women which, in mid-January 2026 will have LADIES' ONLY Group Classes.
address: 89 89/1-3 Bumrung Buri Rd Old City Phra Sing, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXJP+J9 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Amber Sahlberg
reviews.text: I love love this gym! So happy to have found it while staying in Chiang Mai. It’s small but has all the equipment and machines you need. Super clean with AC and air filters. The staff is very nice too. I accidentally left my sunglasses on a treadmill and they found them and kept for me at front desk. Great daily (100 baht)and weekly rates that include their classes. Highly recommend Miss Fitness!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Many thanks for your kind review.

reviews.name: Anna-Marie Landsberg
reviews.text:
A warm and welcoming staff. Very friendly and engaging owners. Dropped in for a single workout - evening session. The gym closes at 10pm, super convenient if you have a busy schedule during the day.

THB120 for a single day workout, is an incredible bargain…if such a term can be used for the gym.

Well equipped with top of the range equipment,  arranged over 4 levels/floors. Good as new. We visited just after 8pm, so not busy at the time.

The ladies room was a pleasure to use. Clean and fresh.

We stored our belongings in lockers on the 2nd floor - where the ladies room is located. Secure with a personal code.

Would be nice if they had a water dispenser…that was the only thing lacking for me.

I highly recommend the gym to anyone who likes to get a workout in while travelling. I will definitely be visiting again.

reviews.name: Sandy Liang
reviews.text: Affordable and at a convenient location, it had machines, classes, and showers - perfect for what I needed for the week. Loved Kwan’s ballet classes and her awesome attitude. Slow but challenging, her classes were among the best. 100 baht a day; 400 for the week; personal training available. Schedule for the classes is on FB.

reviews.name: Jasoni Louise
reviews.text: small women’s only gym I came here one time.. they have a sticker on the door for Visa card, but they don’t actually take Visa. They take cash only which can be an inconvenience for someone who doesn’t travel with cash not a wide range of equipment for glutes which is shocking because it is a woman’s only gym so a woman would expect to have a wide range of gluten focus machinesI did like that you get a free class with your day pass, but yeah, probably won’t visit again

reviews.name: Sukritta Sukkasem
reviews.text: The equipments look new and clean. Gym has air-con, fan and air purifier. I came during week day at noon time no people.

reviews.name: Aria
reviews.text: I came in and asked them about the girls gym. They didn’t understand so i showed them this place on google maps. they told me the fitness for girls is at level 5. I didn’t even see a 5th floor level written anywhere. They also told me it’s just mainly for classes , they didn’t speak english very well so nothing was clear. I left.

reviews.name: Cristina Comunian
reviews.text:
The gym is clean, goood AC and fans, it has  top of the range machines and equipment and everything you need for a full workout. Drop in is 100 bath, staff is very helpful too.
It is women only, so it is more "civilized" than the usual gyms, where guys are loud and have to take more space  than needed :-). Totally reccomended. Thank you.

reviews.name: Emma Bell
reviews.text: Awesome little gym in Chiang Mai! Ladies only gym, super clean with all the equipment needed. A day pass gives you access to the gym AND the classes too. Day pass was 100bht. Really friendly and really welcoming 🙏

reviews.name: Denise Dolendo
reviews.text: Stayed in Chiang Mai for a month and was very glad to have found this gym. It’s not a very big gym but of the many times I went there it was never crowded so that was great. It was 100baht for day pass and you can attend any of their classes throughout the day or simply just use the gym. The staff are nice, aircon was good and shower facilities are decent. 1000/10 would come here again if I’m back in cnx.

reviews.name: Tara Pruett
reviews.text: Fantastic gym. Clean. Decent number of classes. Great pricing structure. Also, the staff is very kind. #kindnessmatters
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Appreciate your taking the time to give us the nice review.

reviews.name: Liiszu
reviews.text:
I don't quite understand the high score on this gym. If you don't want to do classes and if you like doing a variety of things with free movement and weights that go over 10 kg, this is not the place for you. The room is extremely small and relies heavily on the fact that it's empty. There were no dumbbells that went over 10 kg, no wall space to do wall balls, the floor had no grip and felt quite slippery. On top of it all they charge 100 baht for rental shoes because of some arbitary rule that you need to wear specific trainers for working out. I felt it was a bit to vet on the fact that a lot of tourists might not have brought their training shoes with them.
Everything was clean, but i didnt feel like i could work out the way i wanted.

reviews.name: Sarah Butler
reviews.text:
Great ladies gym, very clean with fans, air purifiers and strong AC. The staff are amazing and make exercise fun. It's a lovely community . Also a good range of suitable equipment .
Highly recommended!!

reviews.name: Chigozie
reviews.text: Excellent gym for ladies! The gym is small but has all the equipment you need for a good workout. Very reasonably priced, 100 baht for a day pass. Staff were welcoming and friendly which made me feel at ease. Definitely would recommend, if you are staying in Chaing Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the nice review. Happy that you liked our guym

reviews.name: Katherine
reviews.text:
Good amount of clean, new equipment. They also have an incline bench thing I love and feel compelled to use as a barometer of how good a gym actually is in terms of diversity of equipment (it makes me feel like Batman when I exercise, even though I know you’re not supposed to fully sit up if you want to target your core). The diverse array of classes are also insanely fun! I’ve never done a lot of these particular classes before and it’s hilarious to try some of them. It’s like being in a playground for adults! I went there with a friend and had lots of fun trying to do things we couldn’t.
I also love and feel so much safer in a female-orientated gym exercising alongside people of all different fitness levels. I don’t feel intimidated by being a newbie.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the thoughtful review.

reviews.name: נועה כהן
reviews.text:
The gym is well organised,  clean, and well kept. The team is super nice and welcoming.  Helped me with my posters. The classes were SO FUN !
I've been in Ballet Fit and Muay Thai
I'm highly recommend

reviews.name: Lauren Sedgley
reviews.text: This gym is wonderful!! I'm from the UK and currently travelling Thailand. Being a lover of the gym I've missed it dearly. I found this near my hostel and it's made my day! 200baht for the day, has lots of machines and great equipment for doing circuits. Also has nice clean showers and storage lockers. Plus the staff are lovely and friendly -  100% recommend!

reviews.name: Lara
reviews.text: Great place for a gym session, for only 100 baht/day! Perfect location, very modern and clean facilities. I loved that three are clean showers as well. It was great, I’m glad I found this place and will definitely return

reviews.name: Abby Harris
reviews.text: Fantastic gym, we dropped in during our stay in Chiang Mai and bought a day pass which was very reasonable. Great new equipment and friendly honest staff, I left my AirPod headphones there and went back the next day and the staff had kept them aside, was very relieved and grateful! Would really recommend this fab ladies gym.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the kind words

reviews.name: D S
reviews.text: I am traveling through Chiang Mai and was hoping to find a reasonably priced day pass for a gym to get a decent workout in. I stumbled upon Miss Fitness and am so glad that I did. It is a gym for female-identifying patrons only, and it was spotlessly clean and had a wonderful variety of equipment. From new treadmills, rowers, ellipticals and weight training, to bags and gloves for Muay Thai. Clean, well-stocked bathroom with showers and lockers as well. It is a small gym, but well-appointed and has everything that you might need. And with a 100THB price for a day pass, you can't go wrong.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the detailed review. Glad you liked our gym.

reviews.name: Monique Le Blanc
reviews.text: Joined missfitness gym today and I am already very happy! The gym is clean, friendly and quiet. I was previously at the 02gym and I prefer this already, much more comfortable and the equipment is more modern and up to date. I also had my first combat class today with Khun Bogie and really enjoyed it, Bogie was very friendly and great at coaching! Happy Customer :)

title: Maxfit Asoke แม็กฟิต
subTitle: Maxfit
ownerDescription: MaxFit คือฟิตเนสและโปรแกรมเทรนส่วนตัวสำหรับผู้หญิงในย่านอโศก สุขุมวิท และกรุงเทพฯ เหมาะสำหรับผู้หญิงวัยทำงานและผู้หญิง 40+ ที่ต้องการลดน้ำหนัก ลดไขมัน กระชับรูปร่าง สร้างกล้ามเนื้อ เพิ่มความแข็งแรง และกลับมามั่นใจในตัวเองอีกครั้ง โปรแกรมของเราออกแบบมาเพื่อผู้หญิงโดยเฉพาะ มีทั้งเทรนเนอร์ส่วนตัว เทรนแบบกึ่งส่วนตัว เทรนกลุ่มขนาดเล็ก และโค้ชโภชนาการ พร้อมการติดตามผลอย่างใกล้ชิด สำหรับผู้หญิงที่ต้องการฟิตหุ่นอย่างมีระบบในบรรยากาศที่เป็นกันเอง ใกล้ BTS อโศก MRT สุขุมวิท และย่านสุขุมวิท
address: 170/51 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
plusCode: PHJ6+43 Bangkok, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text: Wondering how to get the most out of your gym time, especially with a busy schedule? At Maxfit Asoke, we focus on precision and personalized plans. Our personal training sessions are designed to be efficient, targeting your specific goals whether it's weight loss or muscle gain. We ensure every minute counts in our fitness center near Asoke and Sukhumvit.

หลายคนตั้งเป้าหมายอยากหุ่นดี แต่ไม่รู้จะเริ่มยังไง "You’ll be getting Fit here. Highly Recommended! 💪🏻" คำบอกเล่าจากคุณ Chaiyaporn Aujanchai สะท้อนถึงความตั้งใจที่จะสร้างความแข็งแรงและรูปร่างที่ดีขึ้นที่ Maxfit Asoke

การมีเทรนเนอร์ส่วนตัว (personal training Bangkok) ช่วยให้แผนการออกกำลังกายชัดเจนขึ้น ไม่ว่าคุณจะต้องการลดไขมัน (weight loss service) หรือสร้างกล้ามเนื้อ (strength training) โค้ชของเราพร้อมวางแผนที่เหมาะกับคุณโดยเฉพาะที่ฟิตเนสอโศกแห่งนี้

มาเริ่มต้นเส้นทางฟิตหุ่นอย่างมีระบบกับเราที่ Maxfit Asoke ใกล้ BTS อโศก และ MRT สุขุมวิท

จองปรึกษาแผนการเทรนส่วนตัวที่ตอบโจทย์คุณวันนี้!

การลดไขมันอย่างยั่งยืนไม่ใช่เรื่องง่าย แต่ที่ Maxfit Asoke เรามีเทรนเนอร์ส่วนตัวคอยช่วยคุณวางแผนการออกกำลังกายและโภชนาการอย่างมีระบบ ไม่ว่าคุณจะเป็นมือใหม่หรือมีประสบการณ์ก็สามารถเริ่มได้ในบรรยากาศที่เป็นกันเอง ตั้งอยู่ใกล้ BTS อโศก MRT สุขุมวิท อย่ารอช้า ทัก Maxfit Asoke เพื่อจองปรึกษาเลย!

คุณกำลังมองหาวิธีลดไขมันอย่างยั่งยืนอยู่หรือไม่? ที่ Maxfit Asoke เรามีโปรแกรม personal training ที่ออกแบบมาเพื่อคุณโดยเฉพาะ โดยโค้ชที่เข้าใจในเป้าหมายของคุณ จะช่วยวางแผนเวทเทรนนิ่งรวมถึงการควบคุมโภชนาการ เพื่อสร้างกล้ามเนื้อและเพิ่มความแข็งแรงอย่างปลอดภัย พบกับฟิตเนสอโศก ได้ใกล้ BTS อโศกหรือ MRT สุขุมวิท ทัก Maxfit Asoke เพื่อจองปรึกษาเลย!

reviews.name: Yasser Ameur
reviews.text: I’ve tried many gyms before, but this is the first place where I actually stayed consistent and saw results. The coaches are supportive, knowledgeable, and genuinely care about helping you improve. The atmosphere is welcoming, not intimidating, and everyone makes you feel comfortable no matter your fitness level. Since joining, I’ve gained more confidence, more energy, and feel stronger than ever. Highly recommend for anyone looking to get fit in a supportive community!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Yasser, thank you for the fantastic review and for trusting us with your fitness journey. We’re thrilled our coaches and welcoming community helped you stay consistent and see real results. Hearing that you feel more confident, energetic, and stronger motivates the whole team. We look forward to supporting your continued progress and appreciate the recommendation.

reviews.name: Lily Merendet
reviews.text:
I highly recommend MaxFit!
The atmosphere is welcoming, supportive, and never intimidating. The coaches genuinely care and always motivate you to do your best.
Even as a beginner, I felt comfortable from day one. The workouts are suitable for all fitness levels, and the nutrition guidance really helps create long-term results. I recommend!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the glowing review, Lily. We’re thrilled you found our atmosphere welcoming and that our coaches and nutrition guidance helped you feel comfortable and make progress as a beginner. Your recommendation means a lot to the team. We’re here to support your fitness journey every step of the way.

reviews.name: Hathaipat Cheechern
reviews.text:
Easily accessible location with capable, creative, and caring trainers. The one-hour sessions go by so quickly, especially when you have others “suffering” alongside you!

The exercises are well customized and can be modified based on your fitness level. It has also been a great opportunity to try many types of workouts I had never done before. Personally, I have seen a clear improvement in my running performance since joining.

The members are also very friendly, with no judgment and lots of encouragement. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the wonderful review. We’re thrilled to hear our convenient location, creative trainers, and customized workouts have helped improve your running and let you try new exercises. It’s great to know the group atmosphere feels supportive and encouraging. We appreciate your recommendation and look forward to supporting your continued progress.

reviews.name: Gregory Enjalbert
reviews.text:
I have never been too much of a class person when it comes to exercising.

Last year I gave Maxfit a try as I wanted to up my game in terms of fitness, approaching 50 at the time.

Adam and the team are very welcoming, they know what they are doing, and it works. They also cover nutritional aspects which matters a lot for optimal health.

What brings me back is also the community, great people who encourage each other and are fun to exercise with.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your positive experience with Maxfit! We're thrilled to hear that you found our team welcoming and knowledgeable, and that the community aspect has made your fitness journey enjoyable. It's wonderful to see the impact of our holistic approach, including nutrition, on your overall health. We appreciate your commitment to improving your fitness and look forward to supporting you in continuing to reach your goals.

reviews.name: Elie Morlat
reviews.text: This gym is incredibly welcoming with friendly coaches who genuinely care about your progress. Great for beginners, with coaching on training, nutrition, and accountability. Highly recommend for anyone wanting sustainable results.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the fantastic 5-star review. We’re thrilled our coaches and supportive atmosphere helped you progress with training, nutrition, and accountability. It means a lot that you recommend us to others seeking sustainable results. We look forward to continuing to support your fitness journey.

reviews.name: Supaporn Thikhun
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at MaxFit since 2022, and it has truly been the best decision I’ve made for my health and fitness journey. Without the guidance, support, and environment MaxFit provides, I would never have achieved the same level of transformation on my own.

I’ve lost over 26 kg, starting weight was over 100 kg and I couldn’t be more thankful for the incredible results. The workout classes, fun activities, and supportive community have all contributed to my success. Not only have I transformed physically, but I’ve also made lasting friendships along the way. Everyone at MaxFit is friendly, welcoming, and motivated, which makes it an amazing place to train.

A big thank you to Adam, Ice, and all the trainers for creating engaging classes, offering great advice, encouraging me to stay consistent, tracking my progress, and providing helpful nutrition tips. Their support has been invaluable.

I highly recommend MaxFit to anyone looking for a gym that goes beyond just working out on your own. Group training here makes the process more enjoyable, effective, and sustainable. With the right guidance and a community of motivated people, you’ll see positive changes in your body, mind, and overall health.

I’ll continue to support MaxFit and recommend it to everyone I know. Thank you, MaxFit, for being such a big part of my fitness transformation!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Amazing thank you

reviews.name: Rema Ghaffar
reviews.text:
Working out at Maxfit Gym has been an awesome experience so far. There are so many different activities to try, which keeps things fun and helps the workouts feel fresh. One of the best part is meeting people from all kinds of backgrounds. Everyone superb friendly and we all share the same goal of getting healthier.

The vibes at gym is very welcoming and it’s easy to feel comfortable no matter what is your fitness level.

Highly recommend if you are looking for fun,supportive place to work out.🩷🩷🩷
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your fantastic review, Rema! We're thrilled to hear that you're enjoying the variety of activities at Maxfit Gym and appreciate the welcoming atmosphere. It's wonderful to know that you've connected with others in our community while working towards your fitness goals. Your recommendation means a lot to us, and we look forward to continuing to support you on your fitness journey!

reviews.name: Ba-wornpak Siripanich
reviews.text:
After trying one-on-one personal training at home and feeling bored and disconnected, I decided to give MaxFit Asoke’s group training a shot, and I’m so glad I did. The group classes here are not just workouts but they’re a community. The coaches are incredibly attentive, always monitoring and guiding each of us closely. Their focus and energy make every session engaging and motivating, and they’re great at recognizing and adapting to personal issues like my S-curve spine posture so I always feel supported and safe during workouts.

What I love most is the sense of connection. Working out with others who share similar goals has made the experience far more enjoyable and sustainable. It’s no longer just about exercise, it’s about showing up, pushing each other, and growing together.

After 6 months of consistent training, I’ve seen real progress by
2.5 kg muscle gain, 1.6 kg fat loss and weight increased by 1–1.5 kg (I was quite skinny before)

I feel stronger, more confident, and genuinely excited to keep going. If you’re someone who struggles with solo workouts or wants a more dynamic and supportive fitness environment, MaxFit Asoke might be exactly what you need.

reviews.name: Mary Jane Sanchez
reviews.text:
Hi! I’m Emjay, a 49-year-old with two grown-up kids. I want to tell you something about my experience at Maxfit Gym Asoke.

I recently stumbled upon Maxfit Gym, and I have to say, it’s a game-changer! The trainers and coaches there are not only incredibly knowledgeable but also radiate warmth and encouragement. It feels like a supportive community where everyone is motivated to help you succeed! From the moment you step in, you feel like part of a warm family. They are always approachable and quick to respond to messages, making you feel valued and cared for.

They provide expert guidance on effective training techniques and nutrition that are easy to follow and genuinely impactful. The trainers are not only exceptionally skilled but also quite handsome, a delightful bonus that has attracted many women to this gym!

I joined a 30-day challenge last December, and I'm thrilled to share that I lost 4-5 kg in just one month—an experience that exceeded my expectations! I wholeheartedly recommend Maxfit Gym to all moms looking to transform their fitness journey. Embrace the challenge; you won’t regret it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Emjay — we’re so happy you found Maxfit Gym Asoke and that our trainers, nutrition guidance, and community made such a positive difference for you. It’s wonderful to hear you lost 4–5 kg in the 30-day challenge and felt supported by our team’s responsiveness and encouragement. We’re honored by your recommendation to other moms and look forward to continuing to support your fitness journey.

reviews.text:

I feel more confident and strong now. I love the transformation my body has gone through these past 8 months.

reviews.text:
MaxFit Asoke is more than just a gym—it’s a supportive and inspiring community. The standout feature here is the exceptional coaching. The trainers are not only knowledgeable but also incredibly motivating, ensuring every member gets personalized guidance to achieve their fitness goals.

The environment is welcoming and uplifting, making workouts feel less like a chore and more like an energizing experience. Unlike commercial gyms, MaxFit fosters a close-knit community where members encourage and push each other to be their best.

The staff is friendly, professional, and always ready to help, creating an atmosphere that makes you want to come back every day. If you’re looking for a place that prioritizes coaching, community, and a positive workout environment, MaxFit Asoke is the perfect choice.

reviews.text:

ปล มีที่จอดรถ ค่า
reviews.textTranslated:
I've been taking yoga classes with Teacher Luknam since before I had my baby.

Teacher Luknam is a great teacher, kind, and most importantly, incredibly skilled! I feel like I've improved a lot since taking her classes, and it's painless too. She adjusts the poses for me, from beginner to advanced levels.

I'm still taking classes with Teacher Luknam even after I got pregnant.
I feel like I didn't have any back pain during my pregnancy!

The picture shows me at 26 weeks pregnant :)

The community here is also lovely. The girls and guys here are like chatting with their girlfriends during yoga classes.

I love Living Nest Yoga! 💗🤸🏻‍♀️

P.S. There's parking available.

reviews.name: Varanyu Prapawuttikul
reviews.text: มาเรียนโยคะที่นึ่ เล่นแบบกลัวๆกล้าๆ ตัวแข็ง ตึงไปทั้งร่าง ทำได้บ้าง ไม่ได้บ้าง แต่ที่นี่มีเสน่ห์บอกไม่ถูก ครูน่ารัก คุณป้าใจดี เพื่อนใน classs ที่เล่นก็ให้กำลังใจดี เราเล่นไม่เก่ง ปกติจะท้อละ ไม่เอาแล้ว แต่ก็แปลกใจตัวเอง ฉันยังคงมาเล่นอยู่เรื่อยๆ ถ้าไม่ติดงานก็จะมา ไม่ต้องกลัวเลย ครูน้ำจะให้คุณลองทุกท่า กลัวก็ต้องลอง เหมือนผลักตัวเองออกมาอีกโลกใบนึง ลองทำอะไรที่คุณคิดว่ามันยากดูสิ จากที่เคยบอกทำไม่ได้ หลังๆเปลี่ยนเสียงในหัว ต้องทำได้ สักวัน อย่างน้อยดีใจที่บังคับตัวเองให้มาออกกำลังกายแบบมีความสุขได้  ทีนี่มีเล่นหลายอย่าง โยคะFly โยคะบอล โฟลว์ Hatha หลากหลาย ราคาดีคุ้มมากๆๆๆ
reviews.textTranslated: I came to learn yoga here, feeling a bit nervous and stiff all over. I could do some poses, but not others. But this place has an indescribable charm. The teachers are lovely, the owner is kind, and my classmates are very encouraging. I'm not very good, and usually I'd give up, but surprisingly, I keep coming. If I don't have work, I'll come. Don't be afraid! Teacher Nam will let you try every pose. Even if you're scared, you have to try. It's like pushing yourself into another world, trying something you thought was difficult. From saying I couldn't do it, I've changed my mind; I know I can do it someday. At least I'm happy that I've forced myself to exercise and enjoy it. They offer many different styles here: Fly Yoga, Yoga Ball, Hatha Flow, and more. The prices are great and worth it!

reviews.name: fahsai aljira
reviews.text: โยคะแบบ private ที่นี่กับครูน้ำมานานแล้วค่ะ ตอนนี้ตั้งครรภ์อยู่ก็เลือกที่จะเรียนกับครูน้ำเหมือนเดิมเพราะว่าครูน้ำเป็นครูที่ใจเย็นเสียงเพราะมากเราที่สำคัญคือดูแลเราดีมากๆ คุณครูเก่งมากจริงค่ะ เป็นผู้เชี่ยวชาญจริงทำให้รู้สึกสบายใจมากที่เรียนกับครูน้ำโดยเฉพาะตอนตั้งครรภ์ที่ต้องดูแลตัวเองเป็นพิเศษ แฮปปี้มากค่ะ นอกจากนี้ครูน้ำยังถ่ายรูปสวยด้วยนะคะกล้องดีมากทำให้เรามีรูปลงหลังคลาสด้วย 🥰🤭
reviews.textTranslated: I've been having private yoga classes with Teacher Nam here for a long time. Now that I'm pregnant, I still choose to study with her because she's so patient, has a beautiful voice, and most importantly, she takes excellent care of me. She's a truly skilled expert, and learning with her makes me feel very comfortable, especially during pregnancy when I need to take extra care of myself. I'm so happy with her! Plus, Teacher Nam takes amazing photos too; her camera is fantastic, which gives me great pictures to post after class. 🥰🤭
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากนะคะสำหรับรีวิวที่ละเอียดและอบอุ่นมาก 😊 ทุกข้อความมีความหมายกับเราจริง ๆ และเป็นกำลังใจให้พัฒนาการสอนและบรรยากาศของสตูดิโอให้ดียิ่งขึ้น ขอบคุณที่ไว้วางใจ Living Nest Yoga Studio แล้วพบกันในคลาสนะคะ 💛🙏

reviews.text: เป็นสตูโยคะที่มีเป็นกันเองมากค่ะ น่ารัก ครู friendly สุดๆ มีหลายคลาส มือใหม่ก็เล่นได้ค่ะ คลาสเล็กทำให้ ครูเข้าถึงทุกคนสุดๆ เลิฟมากโดยเฉพาะการโฟกัสที่ถูกจุดทำให้การเล่นโยคะทั้งสนุกและโฟกัสถูกจุดมากๆเลยค่า
reviews.textTranslated: This is a very friendly yoga studio. It's lovely, and the instructors are super friendly. They have many classes, and even beginners can participate. The small class sizes allow the instructors to truly connect with everyone. I love it, especially the focus on the right points, which makes yoga both fun and effective!

reviews.name: Sasipin Distanont
reviews.text: ก่อนหน้านี้เคยไปลองที่อื่นมาแล้วรู้สึกว่าตัวเองคงจะไม่เหมาะกับโยคะ แต่พอได้มาลองที่นี่ก็รู้เลยว่าครูมีผลมากจริงๆ จากที่ไม่ชอบกลับมาชอบและเล่นได้ต่อเนื่อง 3 ปีแล้ว เพื่อนๆในคลาสก็ดีมาก มาเรียนแล้วสนุกทุกครั้ง ได้ทั้งสุขภาพดีได้ทั้งมิตรภาพดีๆ ขอบคุณครูลูกน้ำที่ทำให้กลับมาออกกำลังกายสม่ำเสมอได้อีกครั้งค่ะ 💓🤸🏻‍♀️
reviews.textTranslated: I've tried yoga elsewhere before and felt like it wasn't for me, but after trying it here, I realized how much the instructor matters. I went from disliking it to loving it and have been practicing consistently for 3 years now. My classmates are also great; every class is fun. I've gained both health benefits and wonderful friendships. Thank you, Teacher Luknam, for helping me get back into consistent exercise again! 💓🤸🏻‍♀️

During the session, I felt layers of emotional weight being lifted in a way I’ve never experienced before. I walked out feeling lighter, more balanced, and deeply at peace — but the effects didn’t end there. Even after returning home, I’ve noticed profound shifts in my life, mindset, and energy.

This was so much more than just a session; it was a transformative experience. I’m deeply grateful to Som for her genuine care and incredible healing ability. If you’re ever in Thailand, I can’t recommend her enough.

reviews.text:
I've been going to BASE Bangkok now for nearly two years since I return to Bangkok after living in Hong Kong for 10 years and the US before then. The classes and facilities are top notch.  I regularly go almost 5x a week (mainly the Sathorn location but also Thonglor on weekends) as well as have Personal Training sessions with Coach Ohm who is very skilled.  I like how I can track my progress using their BASEline technology, leaderboards, and apps.

I never considered myself an athletic person...just begrudgingly going to the gym to get tight T-shirt worthy biceps and chest muscles. After two years, I still look forward to going to BASE every time, being greeted by their wonderful staff and coaches, and getting my pump or sweat on.

The best part about BASE is the community it fosters. I did not think at my age, returning back to my home country, I would so easily be able to meet new people and make new friends.  I've made some of my best friends at BASE and we regular meet-up for sessions together, hang-out outside of the gym, and even train together to participate in competitions like Spartan--something else I thought I would never be able to do.

BASE is definitely worth checking out even if you are just visiting Bangkok.

I will come back here  some day - 10/10!

Super grateful for everyone at Sedthee for an amazing memory that I will cherish even when I am old and gray. They will not let you practice wrong technique, they will always welcome you with a smile, the pace is adjusted depending on your skill level and you will have fun even if you just try it out once for the experience. If you are a fighter you will have a corner you can be proud of - your training partners there to scream and support, your coaches to guide and help.

I have tried different gyms in many many countries and felt I learned the most from here. You will get a lot of attention from many experienced fighters of whom two are even world champions. The private lessons of course pack even more.

The community and vibes are also super. People work hard, are respectful, support each other and have fun. You will likely find new mates there as the place is on the smaller side. It is not a commercial gym and that is the beauty of it.

I heard countless people go through many gyms in Chiang Mai only to find their place at Sedthee. It is the perfect place to be.

To all my trainers and training partners I wish all the best always! 🙏

reviews.text:
If you think there is no such thing as a perfect Muay Thai gym suitable for everyone, let me tell you: there is! Sedthee Fight Club is that place.
If you are dreaming of pursuing a career as a fighter, this is the place for you. Teresa, Sedthee, and the other coaches will do their best to help you turn pro and can even arrange fights for you.
If you have no desire to fight but simply want to improve your fitness and technique, this is also the place for you. The coaching team will work tirelessly to take your skills to the next level.
If you are a beginner who has never practiced Muay Thai but has always dreamed of it, look no further. You will find meticulous instruction where the basics are clearly explained and demonstrated. They ensure you understand everything, all within a friendly and safe environment.
The people here are kind and understanding, yet they know how to push you to progress. I spent a month training here every day and could see significant improvement in my skills.
So, if you are looking for the perfect place to practice Muay Thai, you have found it. It’s Sedthee Fight Club."

reviews.text:
Had an absolutely wonderful time at Sedthee Fight Club. Haven't left Chiang Mai just yet but looking forward to my return just so I can head back to Sedthee!

The group classes are beautifully planned and executed with different trainers guiding you through the process, step by step. With the combination of trainers in any given session, it's a great opportunity for one to better understand Muay Thai and their own strengths and weaknesses too!

The one-on-one session with Kru Teresa was mind-blowing! Her patience, warm approach and dedicated love for Muay Thai inspired me so much!! This also made it so much easier to ask questions that aren't generally covered in regular Muay Thai sessions around the world. Highly recommended, especially for females who hope to join a competition some day.

Kru Daniel was an absolute pleasure to have as a trainer! His attention to detail, experience, and humour make the classes an absolute joy!

Collectively, all the trainers including Kru Soda deliver each of their sessions with utmost professionalism and dedication creating a sense of community making the gym feel like home.

reviews.name: Jenna Flogeras
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at Sedthee Fight Club for the past few years and fight regularly for the gym. I’ve trained at different gyms around the world and can confidently say that the quality of training and atmosphere here is top-notch. All trainers are invested in helping their students improve, whatever their goals. In each session, we do five pad rounds with a trainer, which is unheard of in most bigger gyms. All trainers are also experienced fighters themselves and each offer a unique perspective and style.

As for fighting for the first time in Chiang Mai, I want to clarify some misconceptions. Western expectations of how fights are arranged shouldn’t be applied here. At the local stadium level, matchups tend to be rough approximations. You may end up fighting someone heavier or lighter than you (I’ve been on both sides), as there are no weigh-ins (likely because there are multiple fights every night and it’s not practical, especially considering that it’s not uncommon for fighters to cancel at the last minute, and promoters have to quickly find a stand-in). Matchups are made by the stadium promoter, not the coaches at the gym, and promoters won’t be familiar with your skill or strength level if they’ve never seen you fight. While it’s normal for a Thai opponent to have had many more fights than a foreigner, especially a first-timer, foreigners usually come in with hard training and physical strength to back them up, which can offset the experience advantage and earn them the win. During a match, if you feel overwhelmed or overpowered, you’re always free to stop the fight, or the referee will intervene. All this being said, unless you’re okay with some level of unpredictability when it comes to your opponent, fighting a few amateur matches at home first is probably best. Personal accountability is important, and blame should not be placed on trainers, who have likely been “raised” in gyms with the Thai mentality of fighting, which is basically to fight whoever is put in front of you.

reviews.name: Amadeus Biernat
reviews.text: Great fight club in Chiang Mai that I can recommend with all my heart. They offer daily morning group classes as well as private training, and the coaches have an excellent, supportive approach. A perfect place to train and improve.

reviews.text:
This is my favorite Muay Thai gym in Thailand. It’s very female and beginner/intermediate friendly. The atmosphere is very nice.

It is well structured - warm up of 5 min running, shadow boxing, 3 rounds of bag work, followed by 5 rounds of pad work, techniques/sparring, stretching… Trainers also take efforts to explain technical details and help you improve. Thank you Kru Sedthee, Teresa, Soda, Boy, Benz, Lui, Daniel, Guitar. I learned a lot and hope to come back soon again.

What’s worthy to mention, if you are rather a beginner in sparring, you may do light sparring with the trainers. This helps a lot in building confidence and practicing techniques.

Thank you again and wish you all the best. We will be back for sure.

It was 400Baht for a 2 hour group session, what completely worth it. A mixed class of beginners and pros, but from my opinion, they catered to your level individually what was great. I was solo, but they are really welcoming.

reviews.text:
I can’t speak highly enough about this gym, the positive reviews really reflect the hard work that is going into this gym…

Firstly, this is a sincerely friendly no ego gym and everyone is extremely welcoming.

This is not a make it up as you go along gym. The classes are structured and a typical session is 3 rounds bag, 5 rounds pads with different trainers, speed kicks and sparring/clinch….sparring not mandatory if you don’t want to and trainers happy to do technique with you.

Really a diamond in the north of Thailand!

reviews.text: Price is quite alright, only 60 baht per person, it's even cheaper if you have a student card. The gym is spacious. The downside is these equipments are a bit outdated and rusty. Also be prepared, there's no aircon, and Thailand is hot as hell.

reviews.name: Stefan Loå
reviews.text:
The most affordable gym I've ever visited (and I've visited 50 gyms around the world and 30 in SE Asia). Very high quality of equipment, just one notch below expensive gyms like Fitness First and Virgin Active.

HUG gym could also be called HUGE gym, because the roof/ceiling is about 8 meters up, and the floor must be over 2000 sqm.

They got Muay Thai, table tennis, and personal training as well. But no group classes. Air feels clean and cool enough.

Good atmosphere, not too crowded during daytime. Almost only Thai, very few expats or tourists.

60 Baht for a day pass is extremely affordable for this level of quality. If this would have been located near the beach in Pattong or Pattaya the price would have been 300-600 a day, if not more.

reviews.name: Topher Judd
reviews.text:
So in the area I've been to about 3 gyms. Hug gym is nicest and most affordable of them all. It's an open air covered gym. It has an attached air-conditioned cafe, that has everything from coffee house pastries to full meals.
The actual gym has full free weights, universal machines, spin bikes, and modern treadmills. There is also large area dedicated to Muay Thai boxing. As well as some badminton and ping pong.
Facilities include full bathroom with actual lockers, showers and soap. I found them very clean. My only criticism, would be to have a free water cooler, and I found the open window to the next door houses living room, a bit weird. For more than an amazing view for them I'm sure into men's locker room.

But definitely recommended!

reviews.text: Very nice gym! Usually not too crowded. Chill vibe. Everything you need for a basic workout. Currently 60 THB for a day pass... very fair. Definitely recommended!

reviews.name: Riccardo Freda
reviews.text: I'm having so much fun training here. They really have the right space where to combine different kind of trainings, it's really satisfying. All of this for 60baht daily entrance

reviews.name: Matt Henry
reviews.text:
I feel bad for this gym. It has potential but the way it is being run is not very good. I feel like the owners have let it go, that has trickled down to the manager and the staff. The staff are sitting on their phones and doing nothing. The gym is not very clean, the same towels were being used all 2 weeks I went there and the bathroom didnt have soap or toilet paper. The gym mats are thrown in a pile and the gym has stuff everywhere. This gym should be so clean and airy and feeling great, as there is no one there and they are wanting more business. We left our membership early and have paid to go somewhere else.
If your not going offer great service and be wanting new business, at least let a youth or kids camp learn and do something amazing for your community.
I wish you all the best.

reviews.name: M H
reviews.text: I've tried five of these budget friendly gyms in Chiang Mai, and this is the best one. It has no AC but plenty of fans. Very spacious, well equipped, clean enough, and friendly staff. And the AC cafe next to it sells healthy food and drinks at good prices, and is a good spot to get some work done. All in all, highly recommended!

reviews.name: Liam Rudevics
reviews.text: Awesome open-air gym. Plenty of equipment - not everything but, everything you need. Not busy when I arrived 3:30pm. Perfect workout. Edit: students arrived around 4:30pm but not so bad

reviews.name: Andrew Schultz
reviews.text: All new equipment in a huge open warehouse. More geared towards boxing but still a great gym.  It's not really a great atmosphere like other gyms around but it's cheap and clean. I wish they had a few more monkey bars to do chin ups on but other than that there's heaps of treadmills and machines to work out on!

reviews.name: Peter Scratchley
reviews.text:
Great gym! Huge workout area. Friendly staff and a great little cafe with clean food. I love cats, and here I can combine a hardcore workout with a healthy meal, and then chill with their resident furry friends.

Modern equipment and loads of space.

reviews.name: Ian J
reviews.text:
*Updated review on 1 October 2022.
I've started training back at Hug Gym again because you have put the gym pretty much back to how it was when you first opened about 4 years ago.

Thank you so much. More space, good equipment, friendly staff and Top the personal trainer is a Top man, as always.

Just 40 baht per session.
Very few patrons. I hope more people come to Hug Gym and give this the business the support it deserves.

Thank you so much 😊🙏

Old review below)
(Not the gym it used to be.🙁
Back in 2018 I used for train at hug gym 5+ days a week. I loved to train there. The gym was airy and spacious, it had a very effective water cooled fan system, they had a stylish air conditioned cafe with spacious seating area to relax in and the reception staff were very friendly and helpful.
Now the gym area layout is strange. It's smaller than before, the machines close together which isn't good during covid, the equipment is laid out with the bikes in the boxing area with no fans/cool ventilation.
I give this constructive feedback in the hope that the owner will rethink the layout and size of the gym area. It's not just me, people I know who used to train at hug gym have moved to other gyms in the area.
Hug gym used to be popular, now very few people use it. It's not because of covid. Look at nearby Go Gym, it is very busy, lots of people go and if you have had 2 vaccines, the monthly cost is 600 baht per month.
Please make Hug gym good again. It used to be excellent.)

reviews.name: Mr. Hansy
reviews.text:
The best value for price so far in Chiang Mai. Very good and well equipped and maintained  gym. Equipment are diverse and new. Lot's of space. There's also boxing classes.

60 thb a day is an excellent price for what you get here. They also have a coffee/restaurant attached for reasonable prices.

It's a little bit away from the crowded areas but it's absolutely ok. Specially if you have means of transportation.  Highly recomend

EDIT: The gym lack some support equipment like  kettlebells, resistance bands and others. It's very difficult to have a complete  leg workout here.

[Dont forget to support local guides by liking the review]

reviews.name: D F
reviews.text: Very spacious, relatively new equipment. Almost everything you need for your regular workout except maybe some machines for the leg workout. Cons: They don’t really clean the racks and the machines properly as there were spiderwebs on some of them (!). No aircon, so it’s kinda hot there during the daytime.

reviews.name: Katie Marina
reviews.text: Very open space with lots of equipment including cardio machines and free weights. But it is HOT. There’s one giant fan blowing so if you’re near it it’s not as bad but most of the cardio machines are too far away from it. Still, for 60 baht it’s a decent place to get a workout if you’re in the area. And bonus, you can grab a healthy meal or shake afterwards. I had a strawberry shake (55 baht I believe?) and it was delicious and filling.

reviews.name: Ar Roy
reviews.text: Nice gym with new machines, but they do not play music so much there. There is a computer stand with You.tube, but there is sign forbidding the trainees to touch the computer, while the staff does not put any music most of the time. So you would better arrange your own music to listen through headphones...

title: Sit Thailand Muay Thai Gym
address: 128 Siri Phruek Alley, Pa Daet Sub-district, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
plusCode: QX6C+Q5 Pa Daet Sub-district, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Paul Chiu
reviews.text:
I trained at Sit Thailand for a week.  I've only trained in one another gym in Thailand and that was Sitjaopho.  So in comparison, the classes are very relaxed: it's all up to you.  If you want to run, you can.  If you don't want to run, that's ok too.  If you don't want to spar, that's ok, you can go on the bag and invariably Kru Thailand will come around to give you some instruction.  There were about 20 people in the class, more in the afternoon than in the mornings, and they were primarily at a beginner to intermediate level.

Kru Thailand isn't the chatty type but he's very hands on and is always watching and seeing where he can help his students.

There were 3 professional fighters training at the gym - Jigsaw (Muay Bouk) who was cutting weight for a fight on RWS, Captainteam (Muay Fimeu) who happens to be Kru Thailand's son  and Plaithongkhum (Muay Khao).  They typically kept to themselves and trained before the group classes.

I had PT sessions with Kru Tommy who some may remember from Manasak and Hongthong gym.  He was a fantastic and patient teacher: he really took the time out to explain everything to me and come up with ways to ingrain the proper technique along with distance and timing.

I would highly recommend this gym if you're serious about improving your Muay Thai technique.  You get what you put into it.  The krus won't push you unless you are proactive and want to be pushed.  If you want to fight and you're not running everyday and putting in the work, it's not going to happen.

reviews.name: Peter Le
reviews.text: The head trainer there, literally named Thailand, is an attentive coach that speaks pretty good English. I received more 1-1 attention here than anywhere else in Chiang Mai, and his experienced as a champion along with his discerning eye made for some a-ha moments. They've produced some stadium champs but the gym is also suited for intermediates or lower leel fighters.

reviews.name: Alessia Bertellotti
reviews.text: Great family owned Muay Thai gym in Chiang Mai. I went for the first time last year because it was recommended by a friend. We loved it there so much that we decided to come back again this year. Nice vibe, great trainers and opportunities for fighters

reviews.name: Richard Trovatten
reviews.text: Brilliant gym. Thailand is a legend and one of the best coaches I’ve trained with. Incredible techniques taught in a simple and accessible way. Incredibly generous with his time and attention. You make a mistake, he comes over and corrects you and helps you become better. Every single day.

reviews.name: Dr. Prateek
reviews.text: The best place to explore the Art of 8 limbs in Chiang mai state. Kru Thailand Pinsinchai will take of if you plan to train over there.

reviews.name: Chris Soda
reviews.text: Sit Thailand is an incredible gym. If what you’re seeking is an authentic Muay Thai gym, to improve your technique, and even fight, you’ll find that all here. I was struck by how close an eye Kru Thailand and his team of instructors have on your technique and how relentless they are to make sure your technique is proper. Kru Thailand would often come from across the gym to help correct my kick while I was hitting the bag. I also loved how closely involved he is in the day to day training. I had the absolute privilege to have two one-on-one hour long sessions with him and he helped me improve tremendously. He’s a friendly and playful guy who you can tell really wants you to improve. I loved all his instructors too. Such good guys. Lots of young Thai fighters there as well. Doesn’t take long to start to feel like family. I stayed for just under two weeks and it was honesty hard to leave. Everyone I met was so wonderful and serious about their training. Also, if you want convenience I’d recommend (especially if you just want to focus on Muay Thai during your stay) staying at the Vila Villa resort on the same property as the gym. It’s a bit secluded but you could rent a motorbike if you want or just use grab. Run by a very sweet lady. If you’re coming to Chiang Mai and weighing your options I’d highly recommend putting Sit Thailand on your short list. This was my first time training Muay Thai in Thailand and i couldn’t be happier.

reviews.name: Tony Chen
reviews.text:
The absolute best Muay Thai gym that I have been to. Was in Thailand for 3 weeks and went to 3 other gyms, but none had the patience and detail to the technicals as Sit Thailand had.

From the moment I walked in, I could feel that they really cared about every customer. The trainers repeatedly helped me work on the same things over and over again until my technique started to improve. They were never impatient or rude, but continued to be kind and professional.

This is a no frill gym, but an absolute gem. I hope to come back one day and train here again 🙏

reviews.name: gonzalo tebar
reviews.text: I was there a couple of times, trainer Thailand Pinsinchai is just amazing and his family and team the same. Beautifull place for training, lot of nature and not far from city. You can eat at many places nearby and cheap room close to also. Training is focus on technique and hard as always in Thailand , the teachers are very hard workers and their fighters, who fight in Bangkok most of them, awesome to learn from. Is a small family gym where you always feel welcome!

reviews.name: Ariel de Carvalho Santos
reviews.text: The best Muay Thai gym in Chiang Mai. Appropriate for all levels, the technical level, the coaches and the training partners are all great! Come here if you want to fight, get fit, make friends, and just have a great time overall. I'm very grateful for all my time here, thank you Thailand and family!

reviews.name: Adrian York
reviews.text: Easily the best muay thai gym in Thailand for both beginners and fighters. Trainers are very technical and care about your progress. I have trained here more than once and will be back. Also a lot of fun to train here with awesome people

reviews.name: Brian Chiong
reviews.text: Others have already mentioned the great things about this gym, but nobody prepared me for how good the playlist was 🔥✨️👌

reviews.name: Elena martin lopez
reviews.text: Best Muay Thai gym in Chiang Mai, and probably one of the best ones ever. Kru Thailand it's so helpful and you can learn tons from him and the rest of the fighters in the gym. Whether you are a professional fighter or want just to try Muay Thai, this is your place. 🙏💜

reviews.name: Callum Clothier
reviews.text: The gym is very traditional Thai style and if you are willing to put the work in, the coach will treat you like family. He is very focused on providing skills in technique, very strong clinch and femur style, this gym has a special place in my heart.

reviews.name: Chasing Geckos
reviews.text: I trained at this gym for some time. I ended up in better shape than I have ever been in. My wife also attended. The training staff is second to none. Your trainer is a prize fighter and know what he is doing. His son competes at a very high level. I was there a week ago and one of his students from Spain won his night against a Thai fighter!!! This trainer is good

reviews.name: reiner horjus
reviews.text:
I tried different gyms in Chiang Mai before I wanted to commit myself for a month. I can say that Sit thailand is definitely one of the best. A lot of gyms are only made for foreigners and just want to make them tired without really trying to learn them Muay Thai. Here in Sit Thailand they give you a lot of personal attention. Also you train next to a young group of Thai fighters, which is an awesome experience.
I want to thank Pinsinchai miss Kaskamon and Bewzaza for there hospitality and the lessons i learned in MuayThai.

reviews.name: Shaun
reviews.text:
First off I can’t comment personally on the gym as I have not seen it but I’ve heard from a good source it’s an amazing facility.

What I can comment on is thailand pinsinchai and his fighters and this is the reason it gets 5 stars without even seeing the facility.

I was fortunate to train with Thailand his trainers and his fighters at the gym he was using while he was waiting to open this location.

Thailand is not only an amazing trainer but such a great person that is so kind and patient no matter what level you are at . He loves the sport of Muay Thai and it really shows in his passion and the way he teaches.

His trainers and fighters were equally amazing and so helpful.

If you are looking for a authentic gym that you will get proper technique and training I would look no further than this gym.

reviews.name: mayure1985 Daby
reviews.text: I was left completely stunned. The attention to precise little details to help transform my technique was unbelievable. I received so many tiny technical cues to improve my technique. First time there and received a Private from Kru Thailand himself which shows the level of care provided in the training. I've trained in UK, UAE, Phuket, Bangkok, Koh Samui and Cambodia before but this is by far the best technique training I've received. I've been trying to cancel my flight to Phuket and extend my stay in Chiang Mai since.

reviews.name: duveen sturgeon
reviews.text: This gym was recommended by Sylvie Douglas Itu, who is fighter in Thailand and has trained with all the greats of the Golden Age.  Kru Pinsinchai Thailand (who was also a Golden Age fighter) is a wonderful teacher!  He is patient, kind, and technical, correcting your form as needed.  I also loved that in true Thai fashion he would make fun of what you were doing wrong to illustrate his point.  If you are seeking true Muay Thai instruction this is the place to go.

reviews.name: christof nolle
reviews.text:
This was my third time training on Thailand. I must say this gym really checks all the boxes for me: It is not too far from the old town, the neighborhood around the airport was surprisingly interesting and the level of attention you get from the trainers is outstanding. They really take their time to work with you. Even in group classes you will be receiving a lot of individual training.
I was even hesitant to write this review because it is such a hidden gem, but the place really deserves it. 5/5

reviews.name: Aden Lind
reviews.text: Awesome gym, head coach is amazing, has thai fighters including jigsaw who was awesome fun to spar, very boxing + clinch based style. Only wish was they had a tad bit more muay thai sparring. Hope to come back !

title: แก้วพิลาทิส สาขาพระราม 2 (RAMA2)
ownerDescription:
Kaew Pilates คือสตูดิโอพิลาทิสที่มุ่งเน้นการพัฒนาความแข็งแรงของร่างกาย การปรับบุคลิกภาพ และการสร้างสมดุลของร่างกายผ่านการฝึกพิลาทิสอย่างถูกต้องโดยผู้สอนที่มีประสบการณ์

คลาสของเราถูกออกแบบให้เหมาะกับทุกระดับ ตั้งแต่ผู้เริ่มต้นจนถึงผู้ที่มีประสบการณ์ โดยเน้นการเคลื่อนไหวอย่างปลอดภัย ช่วยเสริมสร้างกล้ามเนื้อแกนกลางลำตัว (Core Strength) เพิ่มความยืดหยุ่นของร่างกาย และปรับสมดุลของท่าทาง

ไม่ว่าคุณต้องการฟื้นฟูร่างกาย เสริมสร้างสุขภาพ หรือพัฒนารูปร่าง Kaew Pilates พร้อมดูแลและช่วยให้คุณบรรลุเป้าหมายด้านสุขภาพในระยะยาว
