reviews.text: Very professional trainer and good facilities.

reviews.name: Paveena Vessalert
reviews.text:
Very comfortable.
Near my house.

reviews.name: Rosarin Chen
reviews.text: Good location, Good trainer.

reviews.name: Duangsamorn Aroonsawasdee
reviews.text: Good

reviews.name: Monsinee Wongpattarapaiboon 167
reviews.text: Great services

reviews.name: Nuttiwut Buranasiriprawat
reviews.text: Good services

reviews.name: J. Ahrom
reviews.text: ครูดีมาก เทรนเนอดีมาก เล่น privateมา 20 กว่าครั้ง หมดไปเยอะมากๆ แต่บริการคือ… นี่คอร์สหมดอายุเพราะจำวันผิด จะขอต่อซื้อเวลาเพิ่ม แอดมินบอกว่าต่อไม่ได้ต้องต่อตอนที่คอร์สยังไม่หมดอายุ นี่ก็เลยบอกว่าอย่างน้อยน่าจะโทรมาเตือนกันหน่อย เพราะมันก็ไม่ใช่ถูกๆ เหลือ private 5 ครั้ง+ ถามเค้าว่างั้นทำอะไรไม่ได้เลยใช่มั้ย แอดมินบอกว่า ลูกค้าเช็คเองได้ผ่านเว็บ คือ ค่าเรียนไม่ถูกเลยค่ะ ที่อื่นเค้ายังมีบริการมีเตือนกว่านี้ ถ้าเสียเปนหมื่นๆแล้วได้แบบนี้ก็พอค่ะ เหมือนเอาเงินหมื่นไปทิ้ง ไม่คิดจะช่วยอะไรเลย ลาขาดแบรนด์นี้
reviews.textTranslated: The instructors and trainers are great. I've had over 20 private sessions and spent a lot of money, but the service is... terrible. My course expired because I got the date wrong, and I wanted to extend it, but the admin said I couldn't, I had to extend it while the course was still valid. I told them they should at least call to remind me, since it wasn't cheap. I have 5+ private sessions left. I asked if there was nothing I could do, and the admin said I could check it myself on the website. The tuition isn't cheap at all. Other places offer better service and reminders. If I'm spending tens of thousands of baht and getting this kind of service, then that's it. It's like throwing money away; they don't even try to help. I'm done with this brand.

reviews.name: Manida Koyra-ngub
reviews.text: ครูฝึกน่ารักใส่ใจผู้เรียนดีมากๆ สถานที่สาขาพระราม2ก็ไป-มาสะดวก สถานที่จอดรถสะดวกสบาย มีเลม่อนฟาร์มให้ช้อบของกินสุขภาพด้วย👍🏻
reviews.textTranslated: The instructors are lovely and very attentive to the students. The Rama 2 branch is conveniently located and has ample parking. There's also a Lemon Farm where you can buy healthy snacks. 👍🏻

reviews.name: Vk Grumpy
reviews.text: ไม่เคยเล่นพิลาทีสมาก่อน มาทดลองเรียนแล้วชอบมาก  ครูคิงส์ น่ารักมาก ช่วยเหลือจุดบกพร่อง เรื่องการปวดตึงกล้ามเนื้อ ช่วยให้ผ่อนคลายสบายตัวหลังเล่น สัญญาว่าจะเล่นไปตลอดยาวๆ ค่ะ  และ อุปกรณ์ สถานที่ต่างๆ คือ เหมาะสม ลงตัว พนงทุกคน ครูทุกท่าน น่ารัก ดีใจที่เปิดใจมาเล่นพิลาทีสค่ะ ♥️
reviews.textTranslated: I'd never tried Pilates before, but I tried a trial class and loved it! Instructor Kings is so lovely and helpful, addressing my weaknesses and muscle tension. She really helped me relax and feel comfortable after my session. I promise to stick with her for a long time! The equipment and facilities are perfect, and all the staff and instructors are wonderful. I'm so glad I gave Pilates a try! ♥️

reviews.name: Waranda Aroonsukrujee
reviews.text: ที่เรียนกว้างขวาง อุปกรณ์ทันสมัย สะอาดดีมาก ครูน่ารักทุกคนเลยค่า
reviews.textTranslated: The classroom is spacious, the equipment is modern, and it's very clean. All the teachers are lovely!

reviews.name: ตัวแทนอยากเล่า By Gamby
reviews.text: สตูดิโอพิลาทีส ชั้นนำ มีครูสอนที่มีความสามารถ สถานที่สะอาด และบรรยากาศเป็นกันเองมากค่า
reviews.textTranslated: This leading Pilates studio has highly qualified instructors, a clean facility, and a very friendly atmosphere.

reviews.name: Ni-on Taechataweewat
reviews.text: ดีมากค่า มีอาการบาดเจ็บหลายส่วน ทั้งหลังล่าง หัวไหล่ และข้อสะโพก คุณครูดูแลอย่างใกล้ชิดเข้าใจจุดบาดเจ็บและช่วยเสริมสร้างความแข็งแรงให้มาซัพพอร์ตจุดบาดเจ็บ และไม่ทำให้เกิดการบาดเจ็บซ้ำอีกค่า
reviews.textTranslated: Excellent! I had multiple injuries including to my lower back, shoulder, and hip. The instructor provided close supervision, understood the location of the injuries, and helped build strength to support those areas and prevent re-injury.

reviews.name: Nunthaporn Sitthiphonwanich
reviews.text: เริ่ดมากเลยค่ะ ครูทุกๆท่านให้ความใส่ใจในความต้องการและร่างกายที่แตกต่างกันของนักเรียนแต่ละคนเป็นอย่างดี พนักงานน้องแอดมินก็น่ารักซัพพอร์ตดีเสมอค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: It was fantastic! All the teachers paid great attention to the different needs and physical characteristics of each student. The admin staff were also lovely and always supportive.

reviews.name: Walairat Mongkonpornudom
reviews.text: เรียนกับครูป๊อปมา 5ปีแล้วค่ะ จัดโปรแกรมตอบโจทย์ให้ได้ทุกสภาพร่าง ทั้งตอนที่บาดเจ็บต้อง rehab หรือโปรแกรมสร้างความแข็งแรง ครูป๊อปตอบโจทย์ได้หมด ❤️
reviews.textTranslated: I've been studying with Teacher Pop for 5 years now. She creates programs that suit all physical conditions, whether it's rehabilitation after injury or strength training. Teacher Pop can handle it all! ❤️

reviews.name: Anchisa R.
reviews.text: ติดต่อขอจองลงเรียนกับเพื่อน แต่พอมาถึงพนักงานไม่ได้ลงคิวให้ เสียเวลา ทำงานไร้ระบบ บาย
reviews.textTranslated: I contacted them to book a class with a friend, but when we arrived, the staff hadn't scheduled us. It was a waste of time; the work is disorganized. Goodbye.

reviews.name: NexSizzz Z.
reviews.text: ห้องสตูดิโอใหญ่ Private มี4 ห้อง คุณครูสอนค่อนข้างดีเลยคับ ส่วน groups class คุณครูสอนสนุกและเหนื่อยมากกกก
reviews.textTranslated: There are 4 large private studio rooms, and the teachers are quite good. As for the group classes, the teachers are fun but extremely tiring!

reviews.name: Kanyawan Lertcharoenbundit
reviews.text: น้องๆที่สาขาน่ารักสอนดีเข้าใจง่ายเอาใจใส่ ทําให้สนุกกับการออกกําลังกายมากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The staff at this branch are lovely, teach well, are easy to understand, and are attentive, making exercising a lot fun.

reviews.name: Siriporn J
reviews.text: เล่นพิลาทิสไพรเวท ที่นี่มา 2 ปีกับครูป๊อป อาการโดยรวมดีขึ้นมาก ดูแลละเอียด คอยปรับท่าให้เหมาะกับเรา แนะนำค่า

There I  first time tried hammock and now continue to do in Ukraine. I miss all those teachers a lot and in my dreams I next year will have more time to do air ballet😍😍😍😍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Anna, thank you very much for your kind words! We are so happy to hear you've enjoyed our classes and that you continue practicing aerial yoga at home now. We are waiting for you next year in our studio! :)

reviews.name: Totoro
reviews.text:
Highly recommended!
Me and my husband both love to practice yoga here, the teachers are all very professional and English spoken, manager and staffs are friendly, yoga mat, class room, changing room, bathrooms everywhere are always clean.
For the classes they have many different types such like: aerial yoga, aerial silk, yoga on the mat,  stretch & flex classes for shoulders back, legs splits, and kids classes too.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your review! We are delighted to hear that you’ve loved our classes. We would be happy to see you again when you are back to Phuket 🙏

reviews.name: Nina Gorley
reviews.text: Super yoga studio! I’ve been looking for a place with good quality equipment for aerial classes for a long time, the hammocks are professional like they should be. They have different teachers, different amusing styles of aerial classes like aerial yoga, aerial fitness, aerial dance, air ballet. Each class is unique! Time flies so fast when I’m here! So happy that I’ve found this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi, Nina :)
Thank you very much for your review.
We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed your experience!
See you soon :)

reviews.name: Darren
reviews.text: I was holidaying in Laguna Phuket and took the opportunity to seek out some yoga sessions. Air Barre offer a one hour "stretch and flex" session 3 times a week and I thought I'd give this a go. Now I am far from a yoga aficionado and as such was looking for a class with more emphasis on 'stretch' than 'yoga' to help with my running recovery. I attended nine sessions in all with two different instructors. The sessions certainly tested me out and I usually finished in a lather of sweat, despite the room being air-conditioned. The facility offers a small Cafe as well as change rooms with toilets, lockers and showers. I got great value from the sessions and would definitely recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi, Darren! Thank you very much for your feedback! We hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Mu AdeL
reviews.text: 10/10 experience. Easily the best studio around BangTao!👍

reviews.name: Roni Lynette Jones
reviews.text: This studio is a real gem of a find in the heart of Cherngtalay. Bright clean professional venue with very friendly skillful teachers. A variety of Aerial Yoga and Hatha/Vinyasa and Yin classes to suit everyone. I was a total beginner at Aerial and within no time I was doing amazing things. Can't wait to return on my next visit!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi, Roni! Thank you so much for your review, we are more than happy that you've enjoyed your experience in our studio! We are looking forward to seeing you again soon!

reviews.name: Thomas Plha
reviews.text: I had the Hatha yoga session in the morning with Thea and it was a really nice experience. I'm a beginner and it was a bit challenging for me. But Thea had a good tempo and it was easy to follow! The facility is very clean and in a very good condition.

reviews.name: Anastasia G
reviews.text: It’s my favorite wellness club in Bang Tao 👯‍♀️ I love all: yoga, aerial, silks and health cafe 💪🏻

reviews.name: Mike Adams
reviews.text: The most exciting total body conditioning programme you can find. I am stronger and more flexible from Airbarre training for the last few months than ever before. The staff are very professional and encouraging. All in all, a great experience and I can feel the benefits!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your review, Mike.
We are happy to hear you are enjoying our classes!

reviews.name: маша злубко
reviews.text: Great modern and clean studio, the best I found in Phuket. They have membership that allows to visit different classes, that’s just perfect! I do yoga and aerial ballet, and I love it
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words, Maria! Glad to hear you are happy :)

reviews.name: Kara MacDonald
reviews.text: AIRBARRE provides a perfect safe haven filled with love and great energy. Their wonderful teachers and variety of classes make this space welcoming for any and all levels of practitioners. Defiantly not to be missed if you’re looking to unwind and destress while on Phuket.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi, Kara! Thank you very much for your rating and your kind words. We are delighted to know that you are enjoying your time at AIRbarre Yoga & Wellness Center! See you soon :)

reviews.name: bmw chan
reviews.text: Amazing teacher. Professional. I hope they could open more classes  kate and tea are the best of the best instructors.  If u stay long in phuket , Airbarre become your part of the routine
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your feedback about our studio and teachers! We are really proud of our team. We hope to see you soon in AIRbarre Yoga & Wellness Center.

reviews.name: Mikhail Milovanov
reviews.text:
The place is just awesome! The location is great as well as interior design, so it’s a pure satisfaction to workout there.
Also, I want to highlight the work of staff, everyone is very friendly and they are ready to resolve all your issues, even the minor ones!
So, I definitely reccommend this place to everyone, who is interested!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi, Mikhail!
Thank you very much for your rating and your kind words. We are delighted to know that you are enjoying your time in AIRbarre Yoga & Wellness Center! See you on the mat soon :)

reviews.name: thipwimon suwannasiri
reviews.text: Love to be here a lot with the nature and kru Dutchi is such good teacher and lot of knowledge. I’ve learned a lot from her. Definitely come back here again.

reviews.name: intothewoods cafe
reviews.text: Perfect place to experience extraordinary yoga practice among natural ambience. Definite a must if you love yoga

reviews.name: Robert Bell
reviews.text: I am new at yoga, but Dutchi made me feel so comfortable. The setting and energy at this beautiful location made the visit an experience I will cherish as a highlight of my vacation in this beautiful country. I fully recommend it to people at all levels. A perfect get away from the hustle and bustle of Chiang-mai.

reviews.name: Baby Jj
reviews.text: The first time I came here I was so happy ✨🥹 coz all the teachers were kind and i also love the food here 💗🫶🏻

reviews.name: Gidi Mevissen
reviews.text:
We enjoyed some very professional yoga classes by Dutch. The surrounding area is also so stunning, when we had class the rain did just stop and the scenery from that location was absolutely breathtaking.
Hope to visit again this year, if time will allow.
Thanks a lot.

reviews.name: irish rover
reviews.text:
Best yoga teacher in CM,  I have had lower back problems for years , doctors have given me all sorts of stretching  exercises ,which help a little, however private yoga classes with Dutchi , have almost cured my back problems .
Dutchi yoga Shala is only a 30 min drive from Chiangmai airport , in a stunning location , so much natural energy.
Dutchi teaches all over Asia , and has now been approved as a Yoga Alliance School ,and will begin teacher trainer 200 hour yoga courses.
She is an inspiration !!!!

reviews.name: Paolina
reviews.text: A yoga shala surrounded by nature and good,  energy. Taking class here is just like getting a new you. Easy to reach from the city. Highly recommended kaa.

reviews.name: Bo YogiLife
reviews.text:
Beautiful shala standing on the most stunning location in Hang Dong.

We always come back here to recharge and refill the energy. ❤️

reviews.name: Bird of Yoga
reviews.text: I thoroughly recommend this place for those who are looking for an intensive yoga course, or a teacher training course in Chiang Mai with different styles of yoga.

reviews.name: Akikojang Lee
reviews.text: The sala is absolutely lovely, clear and quiet. A lot of good energies on it.Dutchi is extremely sweet ,thoughtful and inspiring teacher😍😍😍🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻

reviews.name: Pinnarat Luangpathomaram

Good shala,best teacher.
Kru Dutchi is the best teacher ,especially her energy is so powerful.

reviews.name: Busayawan Sasirot
reviews.text: A most yoga practice in Chiang Mai. Look forward to practing with Dutchi!!!!

reviews.name: Gop Yo
reviews.text: So much organic energy here, best studio in Chiangmai to visit and practice

reviews.name: Sathaporn Pattanapongpaiboon
reviews.text: Best place to work

reviews.name: Supaporn Porkaew
reviews.text: Beautiful place and good energy

reviews.name: dutchanee panthatan
reviews.text: Welcome to shala pavana

reviews.name: Viyada P.
reviews.text:
ครูดัช ผู้เต็มเปี่ยมด้วยพลังงานและความเป็นครู  สนุกกับการเรียนตลอดคอร์ส สิ่งที่ได้จากการเรียนไม่ใช่อาสนะโยคะเท่านั้น ได้ทั้งแง่คิด มุมมองต่างๆ ในการดำเนินชีวิตและวิถีโยคะ บรรยากาศในการ
ฝึกดีมาก ที่สำคัญคืออาหารอร่อยมาก
reviews.textTranslated: Teacher Dutch, full of energy and a true educator, made the entire course enjoyable. What I gained wasn't just yoga postures; I also gained insights and perspectives on life and the yogic way of life. The atmosphere during the practice was excellent, and importantly, the food was delicious.

reviews.name: Nadine Teubel
reviews.text: Wir hatten eine wundervolle Zeit hier. Vielen lieben Dank, dass so spontan ein Kurs mit uns möglich war. Es wurde auf die verschiedenen Fähigkeiten (Anfänger und Erfahren) eingegangen. Es war ein sehr sympathisches, lustiges und spielerisches Yoga. Die Energie an diesem Ort war besonders. Danke 🙏✨
reviews.textTranslated: We had a wonderful time here. Thank you so much for making a class possible for us on such short notice. The instructor catered to different skill levels (beginners and experienced). It was a very friendly, fun, and playful yoga session. The energy in this place was special. Thank you 🙏✨

reviews.name: Dutchat Jitbanjong
reviews.text: Dutchi Yoga เป็นสถานที่ที่ทำให้เราได้ฝึกโยคะอย่างยั่งยืน คุณครูน่ารัก สถานที่ร่มรื่นสวยงาม บรรยากาศดี เต็มเปี่ยมไปด้วยพลังงานดี ๆ เหมาะแก่การเรียนรู้และพักผ่อนกายใจด้วยโยคะอย่างแท้จริง
reviews.textTranslated: Dutchi Yoga is a place where we can practice yoga sustainably. The teachers are lovely, the place is lush and beautiful, the atmosphere is great, and it's full of positive energy. It's truly a perfect place to learn and relax both body and mind through yoga.

reviews.name: Piya Thanoosa
reviews.text: ครั้งแรกกับการมาฝึกโยคะที่นี่  อากาศดี สถานที่ฝึกอากาศถ่ายเท อยู่กับธรรมชาติ ภูเขา สายลม และเสียงนก  เสียงกบ  สลับไปมา มันฮีลใจได้ดี รับกับพลังงานครูที่ถ่ายทอดออกมา positive กับ power ผสมกับพลังงานดีๆของนักเรียนที่มาฝึก มันกลมกลืนกันแบบกลมกล่อม จริงๆ ค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time practicing yoga here. The weather was great, the practice area was well-ventilated, and I was surrounded by nature – mountains, wind, and the sounds of birds and frogs. It was very healing. I could receive the positive and powerful energy that the instructor was conveying, mixed with the good energy of the students. It was a truly harmonious blend.

title: Ruamrudee Health Massage

plusCode: PGRX+2J Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Naomi Bortoloni
reviews.text:
Best massage in Bangkok!
The shop is very clean, there’s no noise inside, Privacy is respected, the massage was performed correctly, as I requested, helpful staff! They allowed me to take a shower after the massage to remove the massage oil

highly recommended

reviews.name: Aud Seah
reviews.text: Loved the foot, back and shoulder massage. 3 of us prefer hard pressure and our masseurs did a great job without us telling them what to do. We enjoyed the massage session very much.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ rating! We’re glad you had a relaxing experience with us. 😊

reviews.name: Charlotte Tsa
reviews.text:
Came here as it was very close to my hotel.
I didnt have a lot of time before going to the airport but they had a 30 min back shoulder massage, and it was great! really fixed my stiffness and neck pain.

Clean, comfortable, and professional.
I would definitely come back and get a longer massage. Price was very reasonable.

reviews.name: Ng Jen Ny
reviews.text: I’ve been here for massage for a few nights, and the first few sessions were really good. However, yesterday’s session was quite disappointing. The masseuse was mostly just rubbing my feet lightly, and even after I asked her to apply more pressure, there was no improvement. I’m quite disappointed with the experience and hope the service quality can be improved.

reviews.name: Winz Wins
reviews.text: Easy to park but the massage was very painful, a day after the session I experience headache that last a couple days and notice my back alignment was off a bit. Does the staff really certified for the massage? Can edit review when clarified.

reviews.name: Timothy TM
reviews.text: Went for the foot and shoulder massage (450thb) and it was v comfortable and good. Tried the Thai massage the next day upstairs and that was also fairly good (250thb). Night time can be quite crowded. Cheaper than most around and yet have clean and open space.

reviews.name: Roger Soh
reviews.text: Massage at Massgae is cheap and good, offering excellent value for a high-quality experience. The facility is quiet and clean, creating a peaceful and hygienic environment perfect for relaxation. I highly recommend Massgae for anyone seeking an affordable, effective massage in a serene setting.

reviews.name: Ben Cho
reviews.text: Our family, the four of us, came here for a 90-minute massage each. We all enjoyed the experience and felt recharged and rejuvenated. Will definitely return before our flight home

reviews.name: ED8
reviews.text:
Was pleasantly surprised that this massage center survived the covid pandemic.

I had a foot massage there just now and it was very relaxing and good. The place was well maintained and clean. Will go back there again tomorrow before my flight back to Malaysia.

reviews.name: Erle Villikka
reviews.text: Wow what an experience - took a combo deal for 90 minutes and received the best massage, i think it was combination of thai massage + oil massage with hot salt thingy The therapist was professional and knew what she was doing, I did not expect my legs to be that flexible🤭 definitely recommend, unfortunately left in a bit of an hurry and forgot to ask her name for recommendation

reviews.name: Hattaya K.
reviews.text:
Worst experience in massage shop ever!!!!
A small kid was screaming, shouting and crying out loud for hour without any action taken from the staff even manager. The parents between sofa talking all the time. No relaxing time but very annoying time while wasting my money. I went to many massage places but most of them keep the room silent . If any situation bothering other customers, there’d be someone trying to take action or find some way to stop that disaster
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for visiting our massage place. We are truly sorry to hear about what happened to your relaxing time. We did find out about what happened. It was a tourist family who brought along their kid which we normally love to welcome everyone to our place but will be careful about family with small kids in the future.  

Should there be any concerns, please do not hesitate to let us know on the spot.

reviews.name: Nina
reviews.text:
Best massage I had in a veeeery long time! Very friendly staff and super clean!
I would always come back. So glad I found this place. Definitely better than other massage places in Bangkok
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your amazing ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ review! We’re very happy to hear that you had one of the best massages in a long time and that you enjoyed our friendly staff and clean environment. Your kind words truly mean a lot to our team. We’re so glad you found us and we look forward to welcoming you back again on your next visit to Bangkok. 🙏

RHM Management Team

reviews.name: Takeshi Kiri
reviews.text:
If you read thru these reviews, most of the negative comments are accurate. We had a 60min foot massage here and there was a lot I didn't like. Some examples:

1. They shorted us  about 10min. They wash your feet, then sit you down in the chair and then disappear for 10min. Only at the end of the session did we realize they started their timer when they say us down, not when they started the massage. So it's missing 10 min and that really upset me.

2. The place has two giant ACs and they are blowing at max. The therapists put tiger balm on you so with the wind blowing, you're twice as cold. They are unwilling to reduce the AC because it is. for the comfort of the therapists - this seems to be more important to them than the comfort.of their customers.

3. It's expensive. We paid about THB 1000 for 2 people 60min foot and shoulder. Plus tip. Taking into account my points above, it was not worth it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We’re sorry to hear that aspects of your foot massage did not meet your expectations.

We apologize if the session timing caused any confusion or frustration. We will review our timing procedures to ensure the full treatment time is dedicated to massage, not waiting. Regarding the air conditioning, we understand how the strong AC combined with tiger balm can be uncomfortable, and we will discuss this with our team to find a better balance between guest comfort and staff needs.

As for pricing, we aim to provide quality service and will take your feedback into consideration as we strive to improve. We appreciate your honest comments and hope to have the chance to serve you better in the future.

FYI
The photos you attached are very out of date. We did the renovation years before you have posted this review.

reviews.name: Craig Towers
reviews.text: Came here yesterday. Love the fact that it’s off the main road and quiet. Very professional a step above the vast majority of places. Clean and tidy. Great chairs. I would highly recommend this place. Probably my 8th massage spot on this stay in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Jon Phelps
reviews.text:
The aromatherapy massage was very good and I have found them over several years to be usually good.
The receptionist is not particularly friendly but is efficient.
I do not like it that the therapists all seem to wear face masks … why? It is 5 years since Covid and Thailand wasn’t even badly affected. Where has the Land of Smiles gone? All smiles hidden behind masks!
Also, the massage experience would be so much better if you could put face down through a hole in the massage table. It is quite uncomfortable having to have a pillow with your head twisted sideways whilst lying face down for back massage. Two small changes could enhance the experience somewhat!

It would be good to get a response from the management?
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jon Phelps
,
Thank you for being a loyal guest and for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re delighted that you enjoy our aromatherapy massage.
We also appreciate your suggestions about the receptionist, face masks, and massage table setup, and your comments have been shared with our management team. We’re always looking for ways to make our guests’ experience even more comfortable and enjoyable.
We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

RHM Management Team

reviews.name: Wanderlust
reviews.text:
One of the best places I’ve been to for full body aroma massage. Always got the 2hr massage and well worth the price of THB1300.

Will keep coming here each time I come to Bangkok

reviews.name: Leena Chanvirach
reviews.text: Use to like this place a lot until they increased their price and then later on decided to shrink the massage package to just 3 packages after 8pm which is also ridiculously priced. The Touch Massage close by is much more flexible and allows u to get a reasonable price if u swap between the different parts of your body u want to massage e.g foot 60min shoulder 30min or foot 30min shoulder 60min...the good is they got more comfy chairs and a bigger place and better ambiance but that's just about it

reviews.name: Shie Shie
reviews.text:
I recently visited Ruamrudee Health Massage for a full-body aromatherapy massage after a long flight, expecting a soft and gentle experience. The place itself was quiet and clean, so I initially felt positive. However, the massage experience was honestly terrible.

The masseuse came in and aggressively spread my legs without any communication, which was very uncomfortable. The pillow provided was unusually large and chunky, making it hard to relax. I asked if they had a ponytail holder (since I forgot mine), and instead, they just put a shower cap on my head without much care.

As for the massage — it was supposed to be gentle, but the pressure was the hardest I have ever experienced (and I’ve had deep tissue and Thai massages regularly in other countries especially Vietnam). I asked several times for softer pressure, but the masseuse completely ignored my requests. It even got to the point where the pressure on my wrist was so strong and it made a sound and it felt like she could have broken it.

I came in hoping to relax and feel refreshed — instead, I left in pain. For three days I struggled to even walk up stairs, and almost a week later, my back is still sore,my neck is still in pain and my legs are aching. This was one of the worst massage experiences I’ve ever had.

Unless you want to risk being injured and end up spending your trip in a wheelchair, I do not recommend Ruamrudee Health Massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We are truly sorry to hear that your visit did not meet your expectations and that you left feeling in pain. Your comfort and safety are our top priorities, and we deeply regret that you felt ignored when you requested gentler pressure.

We sincerely apologize for the discomfort caused by the massage technique and any other aspects of your visit that made you feel uneasy. We take your feedback very seriously and will review this incident with our team immediately to ensure better communication and care moving forward.

Please feel free to contact us directly so we can discuss how to make this right for you. Your wellbeing matters to us, and we hope to have the opportunity to regain your trust.

reviews.name: Andy Weak
reviews.text: This is a complicated review. First and foremost I’ve been here four or five times and have had pleasant experiences all but the last time. They always say you either review very good or very bad service. The times before were good, clean, comfortable. The last time was bad to terrible. First the masseuse wasn’t dressed in the traditional uniform which should have been a sign. She really just rubbed oil on me not really doing anything related to a massage (rubbing my spine, front of my calf), she was not comforting at all, it was very cold and she did nothing about the AC even though I asked twice, she was rough literally hitting the back of my head, it got to a point where I just told her to stop, and to top it off she took the slippers (that she gave me) so I had to walk barefoot down the stairs to the entrance. Perhaps all the other proper masseuses were not available but still please do not let her massage people with little to no experience or training. Having said that I would return but to ensure I had a proper masseuse.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your honest and detailed feedback. We’re truly sorry to hear that your last visit did not meet the standards you’ve come to expect from us. We appreciate you highlighting both the positive experiences you’ve had previously and the issues during your recent visit.

We sincerely apologize for the discomfort you experienced, including the service quality, the room temperature, and the slippers incident. This is certainly not the experience we want for any of our customers. We take your comments seriously and will address this with our team to ensure all therapists meet our professional standards and provide a comfortable, respectful experience.

We’d love the chance to make things right and ensure your next visit is up to the high quality you expect. Please feel free to contact us directly so we can personally assist with your next appointment.

Thank you again for your feedback and for giving us another chance.

reviews.name: Pam Chicandard-Tan
reviews.text: I am a tourist in Bangkok and I love this place. Been here at least 12 times in the past 2 years. It’s so good sometimes i have 2 massages in a day ! The place is clean and peaceful. I usually go for the head shoulder and leg massage and the chairs are very comfortable . The best thing about this place is the consistent good standard of massage by different masseuse. They always do a good job and I leave the place feeling so relaxed and happy. Receptionist is not the most friendly but I don’t care as long as I get a good massage. The masseuse don’t chit chat with you which is what I prefer. Leave me alone! 😃 You can probably get much cheaper prices elsewhere but this place is not expensive. Highly recommend.

title: Ensen Onsen & Spa
subTitle: เอนเซ็น ออนเซ็น แอน สปา
ownerDescription:
Male only Onsen

Ensen Onsen, a hot spring center for meeting new friends, located in Silom, for those who love to relax and spend time together.

Ensen Onsen : The Best Male Onsen in Bangkok
address: 11, 15 Sap Rd, Si Phraya, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
plusCode: PGJG+PR Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Thee S
reviews.text:
As a foreigner, I had a great experience at Ensen Onsen! I booked therapist Kami for a 2 hr aroma massage on Monday night, Sept 7 and his skills were exceptional. I returned the next day and booked therapist Ray for another 2 hr, his massage was absolutely mind-blowing!

The steam room and onsen were clean, well maintained and pleasantly quiet during the weekday daytime. There’s also a discount for the onsen before 7pm. Good shower water pressure, a well maintained dark maze and even mouthwash provided in the washroom. Overall, a clean, relaxing  and safe experience. Definitely enjoyed my visits!

reviews.name: All Might
reviews.text:
This was my second time visiting Thailand, and this time I had a massage with a therapist named Leon.😍

Leon was very politee and friendly. He wasn’t very fluent in Eng, but he really tried his best to communicate with me. I really appreciated his effort hahaaaa lol

Unfortunately I had to rush back to my country that day😭😭

I hope to see you again someday, Leon and Ensen! Until next time! ❤️
“And don’t forget to give me a discount next time, Ensen! 😂”

reviews.name: Dean Paolo Mercado
reviews.text:
Review is for the food and facilities:

The locker room felt hectic. The space is a little tight when even two people need to access lockers in a single section, but this is probably more due to it being Songkran (and therefore busier than normal).

The lighting in the onsen / spa area is a darker, warmer color than depicted in the current photos. Maybe a step or two lighter than what you’d see at Orange Theory fitness. As a result, the space was more relaxing than expected.

It would have been nice to have the door between the steam room and showers operational; it would reduce foot traffic and keep the onsen area more tranquil.

We ordered two buta (pork) don bowls. Pretty tasty! There was also free ice cream and sticky rice available.

As mentioned on other reviews, there was only one massage chair. But it’s the kind that envelopes you completely and makes you feel safe and loved.

reviews.name: Brian Chu
reviews.text:
I came on a weekday and they were having an event from 8-9pm. Basically the place was empty until 7:30-8pm when suddenly everyone got there and it got quite busy but then most people left by 9pm. There were maybe thirty people, all locals, on the younger side, average to below average fitness.

The facilities are nice and spacious and the layout of the steam room and upstairs area is actually better than most other onsens, I have no idea why other reviews are complaining about this. However, the price has gone up unfortunately.

reviews.name: Philip1991 silver
reviews.text: The place is not bad (also not great, just regular) but the attitude of the people who were working there was just horrible. The guys at the reception were visibly making fun of me and then the workers inside gave me sensation of being an intruder more than a guest.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We sincerely apologize for the experience you had. We truly value every customer’s feedback, and we are currently reviewing the details of the incident. Your comments will be used to improve our service and ensure a better experience for all our guests. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again and provide you with a much better experience in the future.
Thank you 🙏🏻

reviews.name: mo blo
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience at this spa.

What is advertised as a spa is, in reality, a small pool and a small steam room. The overall atmosphere is uncomfortable: the showers are cold, and the air conditioning is blasting everywhere, making it hard to relax.

One positive aspect worth highlighting is that this spa clearly serves as a welcoming space for the Asian community, and I genuinely believe places like this are important and should exist. That said, as a non-Asian/foreigner, I personally felt quite disconnected, with very little engagement or interaction, which made the experience uncomfortable for me. This is not necessarily a flaw, but it would be helpful if this was communicated more clearly in advance so expectations are aligned.

I strongly do not recommend the massage. It is expensive and extremely poor in quality. The masseur’s touch felt unintentional and mechanical, with no sense of technique, or passion. It did not feel professional and was absolutely not worth the price.

Overall, the experience is far too expensive for what is offered, with no clear justification for the cost.

To be fair, the person at the front desk did try to handle the situation professionally and offered a discount. I appreciate the effort, but unfortunately the experience itself was so disappointing that I have no intention of returning.

I am sharing this review so others can make an informed decision before booking.

reviews.name: Robert Smith
reviews.text: Came on a weekday 6pm, less than 5 people and when I left at 730, there were probably 15-20 people. Mostly Thai, average to skinny fat body type and they look like middle age 30+ years old. The dressing area is blinding bright with the white overhead light that feels like in an office. The upper floor where the maze and the chase areas are also brightly lit that makes the place bizarre and uncomfortable for any action. And there’s only one massage chair which is sad and lonely. The management need to reconfigure the space to make it more cruisy and cozy, have more dim and warm lights and more areas to chill. The steam room good with strong steam and maze layout and that’s where most actions happen as the upper floor maze is dead cold. 250thb for entry is the cheapest in the area but just low price won’t keep the doors open, make this place fun not sterile.

reviews.text:
The place was very clean and of a very good standard!!! But no massage. The pool has mineral water at 41 degrees Celsius and a steam sauna. You get two towels, a kimono, and flip-flops: included in the price. The bar upstairs doesn't serve alcohol.

However, I was most dissatisfied with the massage. I chose the Thai massage, which was very poor, and they even charged me a 200 Baht tip upon leaving. Absolutely impertinent.

reviews.text: The vibe’s really chill, not too crowded. There are several zones to enjoy. The food’s great too — you can easily spend the whole day here.

reviews.name: WEI CHEONG LEE
reviews.text:
The bar was very slow in handling things. I waited around 15 minutes for the so-called free tea set (which was just cutting some bread), and that was still not done. I didn’t mind waiting if everything was done in order and everyone had to wait the same. However, two customers came after me, and their set was prepared in less than five minutes. When I asked, I only got a brief apology and was told to continue waiting.

I can wait, but not following the proper order and failing to take timely action when mistakes happen is quite disappointing.
(To be honest, there weren’t many customers at all—so why is it still so difficult to get things done properly?)
Two stars. One for the friendly counter staff, and one for the fairly clean environment. Nothing more.

reviews.name: JRR
reviews.text: I don't understand the positive reviews of this place. I will say that the reception is very kind (and cute) and helpful, and the locker area very clean. But the design of the place is ...well, there's nothing there. It's one pool with room temperature water and a steam room that's not hot either. That's it. No dry sauna, no hot pool, no cold pool, nowhere to sit. The showers have no water pressure, not even enough to get soap off of you. And why they put full- length stall partitions in a gang shower is confusing. There is a nice bar/cafe on the third floor if that's your kind of thing. I went late on a Thursday afternoon and was the only one there for an hour. (I was ready to leave after 20 minutes). When I left, there were three people there. Maybe the lack of facilities has something to do with that.

reviews.textTranslated:
This massage and spa may not have a luxurious atmosphere, but the service is excellent, clean, and meets high standards. The staff are very attentive and polite. The massage was complete and finished on time.

I used the scrub and aromatherapy massage service, totaling 90 minutes. There are three types of scrubs to choose from: salt, coffee, and rice cream. The massage oils come in three scents: lavender, jasmine rice, and relax.

The massage room has a bed, shower cubicle, mirror, and provides a shower cap and disposable underwear to change into. It's air-conditioned.

The staff will exfoliate your entire body, then you rinse off. After that, they apply oil and massage each part of your body. A head massage is included at the end, something other places I've been to don't offer. After the service, they also offer complimentary bael fruit juice.

My back and shoulder were really hurt so I informed her but got ignored. She moved to the neck and head parts in which she intentionally pressed really hard and pulled my hair (My hair was tied up and she was quite careful not to make it messy earlier). My hair was a mess that I looked like I just had a fight. Her manner is unsatisfactory, being dishonest is also unacceptable. I will proceed to prosecution if my back or shoulders have muscle strain later on.

I've been visiting Pam Thai Massage over the last 10 years.  My most recent and probably last visit was Dec 2024.

The quality and skills of the staff has gone downhill dramatically, especially in the last few years, to the extent that I now go elsewhere for a decent massage.

It started getting annoying hearing the staff flirt excessively and loudly with the older gentlemen entering the shop.  This is absolutely unnecessary and unprofessional.  The staff have loud conversations with each other while guests are trying to relax.

reviews.name: stuart knight
reviews.text: A warning to anyone who may have spinal issues or even unknown issues. My wife and I went for a foot massage and full body massage. That evening my wife lost all feeling in her legs and upper body on right side. We ended up going to 3 hospitals to get an MRI and it triggered some degenerative changes in her spine. So the issue was not caused by the massage but has triggered something we knew nothing about. Just a word of warning.

I wish i could give negative star. We came at 9pm, they said booking is full until 10pm asked us to come again an hour later. So we came back at 10pm since it was located near our hotel.

The girl told us they were full with reservation and requested us to come back 1 hr later again. We were like, what? Fine. We planned to make a booking for tomorrow night. Suddenly there was another woman came out from the shop talking chinese language with a super duper nasty face " we are not free!" and shut the door.

We said we wanna make booking for tomorrow, and she said they dont take reservations. But they just told us they were full with reservations.

Super duper racist when they treated us like tourist from china when we are not. So disappointed, and my husband that first time visiting Bangkok said that he felt disappointed with Bangkok and will never come back again.

reviews.text: 10 minutes into the massage, I was already thinking about the review I would give. Probably the best massage ever. Receptionist was very kind. It was private, relatively clean, and relaxing. The masseuse was so skilled, attentive, and intuitive. All of this in context that it’s a fraction of the price of the neighboring hotels.

reviews.name: Tom Elwood
reviews.text: Amazing massage, maybe the best ever. We were walk-ins, and were greeted with water and slippers, and taken right away for 2 massages. The therapist checked carefully about adequate pressure, and quickly found a sore spot on my shoulder and spent the majority of the time on that, from all angles.  Then she stretched the shoulder with a sitting maneuver pulling my arms back with her feet between my shoulder blades. On my legs and back she used her elbows and knees to achieve adequate pressure. The ambience is pretty minimal decor, with homemade tables for the massage. But fresh linens and a shower in the massage room completed the experience. We were served delicious ginger tea afterward. title: eforea Spa
ownerDescription: Unwind in the tranquil of eforea spa. Choose from range of treatments for the face and body, designed to leave you feeling relaxed and rejuvenated.
address: 59 Charoen Nakhon 5/1 Alley, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand
plusCode: PGH6+C7 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Ekkapob I.
reviews.text:
I recently returned to Eforea Spa at Millennium Hilton Bangkok after not visiting for quite some time, and I am happy to say it remains one of my top three favorite spas in Bangkok.

My therapists for this visit were Khun Lyla and Khun Tik, and both demonstrated excellent technique throughout the session. They were able to identify and work precisely on the areas where I was experiencing tension and discomfort, making the treatment both effective and relaxing.

The overall atmosphere of the spa was calm and peaceful. I arrived about 30 minutes before my appointment and the check in process was effortless. I simply presented my Gowabi voucher and was invited to relax while the reception team completed the registration process. Shortly afterward, we had a consultation covering the areas we wanted the therapists to focus on, areas to avoid, preferred massage pressure, and our choice of aromatherapy oil. Everything was handled smoothly and professionally.

The only thing missing from the arrival experience was a welcome drink, which is something I have come to expect from many hotel spas. However, this was only a minor observation and did not significantly affect the overall experience.

Once we were escorted to the treatment room, I changed into the provided attire and was pleasantly surprised that the bathrobe fit comfortably. As someone who often receives robes that feel slightly too small at other spas, this was a welcome detail.

The treatment began with a warm foot cleansing before the massage started. During the session, the therapists checked whether the pressure level was appropriate, although they did not ask about room temperature or music volume. This was not an issue for me, but it is a detail that some other spas pay attention to.

What truly stood out was the level of care at the end of the session. When Khun Lyla asked how I felt afterward, I honestly mentioned that my left side felt completely relieved while my right side had improved but was still slightly stiff. Without hesitation, she asked me to lie back down and spent additional time working on the remaining tension. The difference was remarkable. By the time I left, it genuinely felt as though I had a new back. My body felt lighter, more mobile, and significantly more comfortable than when I arrived.

The experience concluded with a warm herbal tea and a small snack while sitting with warm herbal compress bag overlooking a beautiful view of the large riverside trees outside. It was a peaceful and relaxing way to end the visit.

Overall, this was another excellent experience at Eforea Spa. The professionalism, attention to detail, and genuine care shown by Khun Lyla and Khun Tik reminded me why this spa continues to earn a place among my top three favorite spas in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Sunny Maz
reviews.text:
The reservation was easy to made. We called reception Hilton millennium and booked a 2 hour muscle relaxing massage.

The reception was very accommodating and gave me a complimentary tea.

The masseuse Nana and Amm were amazing.

The massage was so relaxing I fell asleep. Nana was so profesional and reassuring if the pressure was good. She was polite and really amazing in the massage.

The prices are reasonable. The service is worth the money.

The quality of service is top notch.
The room was cozy and relaxing
10/10 I’d highly recommended and definitely book again

reviews.name: Lisan Lie
reviews.text: This spa is part of the Millennium Hilton, so it's very luxurious and the service is warm and attentive. I enjoyed a hotel massage at a reasonable price, which was fantastic. The massage lady named NAM was nice and professional. I will definitely come back.

reviews.name: Genta
reviews.text:
After a long, adventure-filled day in Bangkok, I decided to treat myself to a little self-care at the spa in Millennium Hilton—and I’m so glad I did. Hidden away from the bustle of the city, eforea spa feels like a secret sanctuary in the sky.

The moment I stepped inside, I was greeted by a sense of calm—soft lighting, soothing scents, and warm smiles. I was led to my treatment room, and wow… it was absolutely stunning. Spacious, serene, and beautifully designed, with a private sauna and luxurious amenities that made it feel like my own personal retreat.

The massage itself? Incredible. My therapist had the kind of intuitive touch that makes you wonder if she could actually read my mind. Every knot and every ounce of tension melted away under her hands. It wasn’t just a massage—it felt like a reset for both body and soul.

After the treatment, I was offered a warm cup of herbal tea in a quiet relaxation lounge, with views of the river glistening below. Time slowed down for a moment, and I just sat there, deeply relaxed, completely content.

If you're staying at the Hilton—or even if you're not—I highly recommend carving out a few hours for this experience. It's one of those rare spa visits that feels indulgent, thoughtful, and genuinely healing all at once.

reviews.text: One of the best experiences I’ve ever had. I booked a three-hour massage and facial at a Thai spa, and it was pure relaxation from start to finish. Phen and Tikky were incredible—so skilled, gentle, and attentive. The massage was the perfect pressure, melting away all my tension, and the facial left my skin feeling so clean, hydrated, and glowing. They took their time with every step, making it feel really special and not rushed at all. The whole atmosphere was calm and peaceful. I left feeling completely refreshed, relaxed, and honestly like a new person. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Sojeong Park
reviews.text:
I visited the spa named Eforea in the Millennium Hilton while staying in the hotel.

I loved the massage from Mod, the best therapist I’ve experienced in Thailand!
Although I have received high-end massages in Chiangmai and Bangkok several times, her massage made me fall asleep. It was not too strong but not too soft—just perfect! I had waist pain, but it disappeared after her massage.

Definitely want to visit again. They provided high-quality service compared to other spas in a similar price range. You can get a foot & body massage in the single/couple room you choose. After the massage, they provided this amazing biscotti with a cup of tea.

Anyway, you should book the spa first! I wanted to walk in, but they were fully booked.

***** updated

I visited the spa again and received a massage from a different therapist. Unfortunately, it was very disappointing. However, they tried their best to provide the same quality of massage that I loved with the first therapist.

reviews.name: Dan Pieloch
reviews.text:
Visited around noon on 12 January. The lady at the desk was friendly and warm, and handed me the massage option list with prices clearly marked. I asked about the Thai Mixed Oil massage, and was our basically a combo of a firm Thái massage and a softer oil massage, and she said yes. So I requested a 1.5hr massage.

The lady handed me of to a different lady whose name I later learned is Pao Pao. She took me up one flight and into a two massage table room. She handed me those sexy disposable green undies (this is a lie, they are like paper). My table had a circular gave cushion, and Pao Pao took a small towel and wrapped it around this cushion, which was nice of her and also a good practice for cleanliness. The massage felt great, and I think every part got massaged except my scalp. I didn't mind because she paid a lot of attention to my left shoulder, which has been effed up for about 10 years due to a muscle tear or a muscle twist. Initially I almost cried, but as it continued I could tell she was working on trying to get it sorted, like a bit of physical therapy, which I tried long ago but it didn't take.

When we were finished, I smelled good from the oil, and I felt like my body had gotten in a relaxing workout, if that's a thing. I went downstairs to pay, and there was a cup of hot tea waiting for me. I spoke with the lady at the desk again, and her name is Nid, and she's the owner, and she has good English skills, and a kind heart. I paid with my American Express card, and Nid let me add the tip on my card, and gave me cash back to give to Pao Pao. I had a wonderful experience at Magic Hands Massage Si Phraya today. If you are in this area of Bangkok, you should stop in for this type of massage, and you will be well taken care of.

reviews.text:
I have been here three times, but this was definitely the last. I wanted to give this place a third chance, thinking I might have just had bad luck with my masseuses – but unfortunately, I was disappointed again.

During the full-body massage, the masseuse insisted on keeping the air conditioning on, even though we kindly asked them to turn it off. It was located directly above our heads, and the ceiling fan blew the cold air down onto us while we were exposed for the massage.

On top of that, the masseuses kept talking the entire time, making the whole experience far from relaxing. In fact, it was really uncomfortable, as they seemed more focused on their conversation than on the massage itself. When you're feeling cold, your body tenses up, and getting a massage while being tense is, in my opinion, completely ineffective.

I actually feel worse than before the massage, which is really disappointing and sad. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this place.

reviews.text:
Cherry Massage is hands-down one of Bangkok’s best-kept secrets—and Chomphu is the real MVP. From the second she started, I felt all my stress just melt away. Her technique is next-level: she finds every knot and works it out like a pro, but still gives off total girl-next-door vibes. Plus, she’s super cute—her smile legit made the whole hour feel like catching up with your BFF.

Booking? A breeze. The admin team replies in seconds, gives you clear BTS/EmSphere directions, and are genuinely chill and helpful. They had me feeling like a VIP before I even stepped in.

Location-wise, you’re right by the BTS and EmSphere mall, so it’s crazy easy to get to. Cherry Massage really feels like that hidden gem you stumble on and then can’t stop telling everyone about—except I’m kind of selfish, so shh 🤫. If you want the best massage in Bangkok, go see Chomphu at Cherry. Trust me, your body (and vibes) will thank you!

reviews.name: Kay Zee

She is legendary and did a wonderful job on all the knots in my back.

reviews.name: Kenshin N
reviews.text:
​I came to Bangkok truly looking forward to an authentic traditional Thai massage, but what I received here was severe sexual harassment.
​The male therapist in charge constantly performed unnecessary and persistent touching of my groin and anal area from the very beginning until the end of the session. This is clear sexual harassment and absolutely not professional therapy.
​When I showed my refusal, the therapist unilaterally cut the session short. I was left not with relaxation, but with profound emotional distress and anger.
​As a massage therapist myself, I can confidently state that this conduct is completely separate from traditional massage and is unacceptable behavior. I have to question your establishment's quality control and ethical standards. Is this kind of conduct permitted here?
​I have noted that the manager has contacted individuals regarding similar past reviews. To the manager: I demand a clear explanation and sincere response regarding this serious act of sexual harassment and the therapist's unfair conduct. Please contact me immediately upon seeing this post.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Customer,
​We are deeply shocked, appalled, and profoundly sorry to read about your distressing experience. What you have described is completely unacceptable, illegal, and goes against every ethical standard and value our establishment stands for. We offer our most sincere and deepest apologies for the profound emotional distress and anger this has caused you.
​Please be assured that Sabai Thai Massage Silom has a zero-tolerance policy towards any form of sexual harassment or misconduct. This behavior is absolutely not permitted here.
​We take your allegations with the utmost seriousness. In order to take immediate and severe disciplinary action, including instant termination and cooperation with legal authorities, we urgently need to identify the specific therapist and the exact date/time of your session.
​To the Management Team, your safety, dignity, and justice are our top priorities. We want to investigate this thoroughly and provide you with the clear explanation you rightfully demand. Please contact our manager directly and immediately at [ใส่เบอร์โทรศัพท์ร้าน] or email us at [ใส่ Email ร้าน].
​We are ready to cooperate fully and assist you in any way possible, including helping you file an official report with the local authorities if you wish to pursue legal action. We await your urgent contact.

title: Trichada The Cookery Home
ownerDescription: Discover the joy of authentic Thai cooking in a very friendly and welcoming home atmosphere at Trichada The Cookery Home, Chiang Mai. Led by local chef Trichada, our hands-on classes invite you to explore the flavors, techniques, and culture of traditional Thai cuisine. Whether you’re a beginner or a passionate foodie, you’ll learn to create delicious dishes step-by-step in small, friendly groups. Enjoy a unique, personal experience—rated 5 stars by happy travelers from around the world. Join us and bring the taste of Thailand to your own kitchen!
address: 62 9 Baanbaimai 2 San Pa Pao, San Sai District, Chang Wat Chiang Mai 50210, Thailand
plusCode: V37R+8G San Pa Pao, San Sai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
🍲 Creamy, fragrant, a little spicy… and full of Thai happiness! 🌶️💚

Some dishes feel like a warm hug in a bowl, and Tom Kha Gai, Thailand’s famous coconut chicken soup, is definitely one of them! 😋

Creamy coconut milk, fragrant galangal, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, fresh mushrooms and a little chilli… all coming together in a beautiful balance of flavours.

In my Thai cooking class in Chiang Mai, I'll show you how to make this delicious soup from scratch, understand the ingredients, and adjust the flavours just the way you like them.

And yes, we can make a wonderful vegetarian version too! 🌿
Come cook with me, discover the secrets of authentic Thai flavours, and bring a little taste of Thailand back to your own kitchen.

Cook with love, taste with a smile… and always come hungry! 😊💚
Oui

🌿 Who says Thai food needs meat to be delicious? 😋💚

Colourful vegetables, fresh herbs, fragrant spices and a little Thai magic… Sometimes the simplest ingredients create the most wonderful flavours!

At Trichada Cookery Home in Chiang Mai, I love showing my guests how delicious vegetarian and vegan Thai cooking can be.

Whether you eat meat, are vegetarian, or follow a vegan diet, we can adapt traditional Thai dishes to your preferences without losing those beautiful Thai flavours. 🌶️

And the best part? You’ll learn how to recreate them in your own kitchen, wherever home may be!

Cook with love, taste with a smile… and always come hungry! 😊💚
Oui

Cooking Thai food should be fun… and beautiful too! 🌺🌶️

For me, cooking is not only about following a recipe. It’s about tasting, experimenting, adding a little more of this or a little less of that — and finally creating something you’re proud to put on the table. 😊

That’s how we cook together in my Chiang Mai cooking class: relaxed, hands-on, and always adapted to the flavours you enjoy.

And then comes the best part… we eat everything we made! 😋💚

Cook with love, taste with a smile… and always come hungry!
Oui

Sometimes the sauce is the star of the show. 😋🥜🌶️

Rich, creamy, nutty, a little sweet, a little spicy… Thai cooking is all about finding that beautiful balance.

And of course, the best way to learn it is not from a jar! 😉 In my Chiang Mai cooking class, we make our sauces from scratch, taste as we go, and adjust them until they are just right for you.

Simple ingredients, big flavour, happy cooking. 💚

Cook with love, taste with a smile… and always come hungry! 😊

Oui

This is what I love about Thai food… every bite can surprise you. 😋🌶️

Fresh and crunchy, a little spicy, a little sour, herbs, roasted cashews - and something crispy on the side. So many flavours and textures on one plate. 💚

In my cooking class in Chiang Mai, you don’t just follow a recipe. We taste as we cook, adjust the flavours to your liking, and learn how to find that beautiful balance that makes Thai food so special.

Come hungry, cook with love, taste with a smile. 😊🌿

Oui

Khao Soi — one of the flavours of Chiang Mai you really shouldn’t miss. 🍜💛

Creamy, fragrant curry, noodles, fresh lime, herbs and those irresistible crispy noodles on top… there’s a reason Khao Soi becomes a favourite for so many people visiting Northern Thailand. 😋

And the best part? You can learn to make it your way. Chicken, or a delicious vegetarian version — in my cooking class, we adjust the dishes to what you enjoy eating.

Come cook Khao Soi with me in Chiang Mai, learn how those beautiful Northern Thai flavours come together, and take the recipe home with you. 🌿

Cook with love, taste with a smile… and always come hungry! 😊💚

- Oui

Thai cooking is not just about following a recipe. It’s about understanding the ingredients — smelling the spices, tasting them, and discovering how each one changes a dish.

In my cooking class in Chiang Mai, I want you to learn why Thai food tastes the way it does, so when you go home, you can cook with confidence instead of just following instructions. 😊

Come cook, taste and learn with me — and take a little Thai kitchen knowledge home with you. 💚

Oui

🌿 Wrap it, grill it, dip it… and enjoy! 😋

One of the joys of Thai cooking is discovering how simple ingredients can create so much flavor. Fresh herbs, leafy greens, rice noodles and a spicy-sour dipping sauce — all coming together in one delicious bite. 🌶️🌿

At Trichada Cookery Home, we cook from scratch and learn the little techniques that make Thai food taste truly Thai.

Come hungry, cook with me, and take a little taste of Thailand home with you. 💚

Fresh lemongrass, galangal, ginger, garlic, shallots, chillies, kaffir lime, coriander seeds, cumin, pepper… simple ingredients that build layers and layers of flavour. 🌶️

In my cooking class, it’s not only about following a recipe. You’ll get to know the ingredients, smell them, taste them and learn how they work together — so you can understand the flavours behind authentic Thai food.

Fresh ingredients, a little pounding and chopping, and plenty of fun along the way. 😊

— Oui | Trichada Home Cookery

This Thai lemongrass salad is all about fresh flavours — fragrant lemongrass, shallots, herbs, chilli, lime and plenty of crunch in every bite.

One of the joys of Thai cooking is learning how a few simple ingredients can create such a beautiful balance of spicy, sour, salty and fresh. And of course, in class we adjust everything to your taste. 💚

Come cook with me in Chiang Mai — chop, mix, taste, adjust… and then enjoy the best part: eating what you've made! 🥢✨

reviews.name: Jakob B-C
reviews.text:
We had a absolutely great time with Oui. She is such a warm, loving and inviting chef that you just must love the experience and the timr
You get to spend with here.

As we are traveling with two non English speaking daughters and two of us are vegetarian we had quite a dietary and communication mix to manage.

Nevertheless, Oui managed to let all of us cook at least one or even two dishes we just loved so much, we will be making them again.

If you want to experience real Thai cuisine while having fun in a private ambiance this cooking class is a must.

We have participated in a few cooking class while traveling on our travels and this was the most homely and fun experience we had so far.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your beautiful words! ❤️ It was such a joy having your family cook with me. I’m so happy we could find dishes that everyone enjoyed, especially with our little mix of languages and vegetarian choices 😊 That is part of the fun!

Knowing that you want to make some of the dishes again at home makes me very happy. This is exactly what I hope for when I welcome people into my home and kitchen.

Thank you for cooking, laughing and spending this lovely time with me. I hope you take a little piece of Thailand home with you. 🙏💚

Oui

reviews.name: Ben Johnson
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely incredible time with Oui at her beautiful home, learning to cook authentic Northern Thai cuisine. The experience began with a vibrant trip to the local market, where we handpicked fresh ingredients—an immersive and eye-opening start to the day.
Back at her home, Oui welcomed us with warmth, humor, and a genuine passion for cooking that made the entire experience feel personal and special. We prepared a wide variety of delicious dishes, each one more flavorful than the last, and we ate until we were blissfully full!
This was truly a highlight of our trip to Thailand. If you're looking for a meaningful, hands-on culinary adventure, we can't recommend Trichada Home Cookery highly enough. Thank you, Oui, for sharing your kitchen, your stories, and your heart with us!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind words! I’m really happy you enjoyed the day — from exploring the market together to cooking and eating at my home.

You two were such a pleasure to spend time with, and it made me very happy to see how much you enjoyed each dish. Hearing that this was a highlight of your trip truly means a lot to me.

Thank you for coming with such good energy, and for letting me share a little piece of my kitchen and my Northern Thai food with you.
Wishing you both a wonderful journey and many delicious meals ahead! 💛🌿

I’m really happy you enjoyed the whole experience. 
It was a pleasure sharing the ingredients, flavors, and little details of Thai cooking with you. I’m glad it felt authentic and special for you — that’s exactly what I hope for in every class.

Thank you for coming with such a lovely energy, and for your recommendation.
Wishing you many delicious Thai meals at home! 💛🌿

— Oui

We spent the rest of a relaxing day cooking, making spice paste, preparing ingredients and of course, eating!

What set this apart was Trichada’s warmth, knowledge, care and personality. I would highly recommend this course.

reviews.name: Viktoria L.
reviews.text:
The cooking class with Oui was an amazing experience during our stay in Thailand. She picked us up, took us to a local market (not comparable to the touristic markets at all!), where she knew everybody! She showed us all the fresh ingredients and shared her deep knowledge with us. After that we went to her home, a super lovely, green place, where our cooking place was already prepared in her beautiful garden. We prepared a 5 course menu, which meals we could choose as we preferred - meaning 10 meals for 2 people. Her friend helped us with the preparations and cleaned up, making it super comfortable for us. She gave us privacy for eating but also was super open minded, kind and incredibly funny! The food was amazing and she also sent us her recipes via Email after the class (more than the recipes we cooked, in english and german). She put so much love and afford in everything and truely made us feel home.
It was a great contrast to the super full, touristic classes which are usually offered in Chiang Mai - highly recommended!

reviews.name: Remi
reviews.text: This was such a magical day. Oui is so welcoming and energetic. She is an excellent teacher. We were able to be properly involved at all stages in each course. You make SO MUCH food and it was all the best food we had eaten after 6 weeks in Thailand. You get to take home all the food you don’t finish and so the course is breakfast, lunch and dinner for a day! It’s worth every penny and I wouldn’t change anything. It’s a wonderful day, don’t miss this chance!

reviews.name: O
reviews.text:
My experience at Trichada was nothing short of perfect. A morning and noontime of education, conversation and delicious food.

Oui came to pick me up at my hotel in the morning and drove me to a cool local market near her home. Along the way she gave me a selection of dishes to pick from, and I ended up picking outside the selection with a Satay dish.

We picked up fresh ingredients from the market and went to her beautiful home in the suburbs of Chiang Mai where she set up a lovely cooking station in her yard. From then I cooked the dishes, including and making curry paste, sticking the chicken on its skewers, with some help from the expert chef herself.

After the large, filling meal, Oui dropped me off next to the next location I had to go to, despite a lot of traffic issues in the area, such a lovely person!

I can't recommend Trichada enough, and I'm very happy I took the plunge and went here.

reviews.name: Andrew Christodoulou
reviews.text:
We had the most incredible experience with Trichada Home Cookery and our host, Oui. From the moment we were collected from our hotel, we knew we were in for something special. Oui warmly greeted us and immediately made us feel like part of the family.
One of the highlights of the day was our trip to the local markets. Oui took us on a fascinating tour, showing us the vibrant array of fresh produce available to the locals. It was truly eye-opening to see the quality and variety of ingredients that make Thai cuisine so extraordinary. We had the opportunity to select the ingredients we would be using throughout the day, ensuring that everything was as fresh as can be.
When we arrived at Oui’s beautiful home she guided us through the cooking process, sharing her secret techniques and ensuring that we understood the importance of balancing flavours. The cooking experience itself was nothing short of exceptional. Oui's knowledge and passion for traditional Thai dishes were evident in every step.
We had the pleasure of learning how to make a variety of dishes, ranging from the refreshing green papaya salad to the mouth-watering Khao Soi. The aromas and flavours that filled the air were simply intoxicating. The end result was a rich and fragrant dish. It was a true testament to Oui's expertise and her ability to bring out the best in Thai cuisine.
The sticky rice and mango dessert was the perfect sweet ending to an unforgettable culinary adventure. As we savoured each bite, we couldn't help but appreciate the care and attention that Oui had put into every aspect of our experience.
I wholeheartedly recommend the Trichada Home Cookery experience with Oui to anyone visiting Chiang Mai. Oui's warmth and hospitality will make you feel at home ensuring a memorable and immersive experience. Don't miss out on this extraordinary culinary journey.

reviews.name: April Toh
reviews.text:
Best cooking school experience - classes were small and a lot of hands on work, with close guidance provided. The cooking area is held outdoors in a traditional Thai home, everything was very clean, organised and you have your own work station.

The experience is very personalised, there was a lot of flexibility on the dishes we could learn to cook, which is great if you have attended other cooking schools before so you don’t have to learn the same dish again.

The market tour in the morning was also very enjoyable, learnt a lot about the ingredients going into our food.

A whole list of recipes will also be sent to you after class. Tremendous value and will highly recommend this to anyone!

reviews.name: Samuel S
reviews.text: The best experience we could make! We enjoyed two days of incredible Thai food, learning so many new nuances in cooking and combining flavours. Our teacher Oui was a wonderful host, you can tell she is passionate about what she's doing and eager to share her knowledge. Thanks for the great time. :)

reviews.name: Kieran G
reviews.text:
Trichada's cookery class was even better than we had anticipated and it was one of the highlights of our trip to Chiang Mai. From start to finish we were so impressed with the organization and friendliness of Trichada (Oui).

We really appreciated the effort that went into designing this course and it was so enjoyable to learn about, cook and eat the tasty meals!

We have already reccomended this to anyone we know visiting Chiang Mai 😋👍

reviews.text:
My cooking skills end at a good steak and occasional curry under supervision, but I know what differentiates good cook from a Chef — it’s the ability to move freely without boundaries of recipes and conventions, explore tastes and aromas at their base level and do magic of chemistry with temperature, time, elbow grease and passion — and Oui has it all.
I am grateful for the limited time we had together. All I could do is to be intensely attentive, to learn and be inspired. This person is overflowing with passion and knowledge, and it will be a crime not to open yourself to this experience!

Nikita and Sofi

reviews.text:
I visited three times in a week. If you find other massages too mild, this is the place to go. I prefer strong pressure, and they really pressed hard and deeply kneaded my muscles. The masseuses seem very experienced.
​There are no extra services like drinks or snacks, but the price is very reasonable. It’s great value for money. Even at this low price, they provide clothes to change into and have all the basics like aroma oils in a comfortable atmosphere.
​It’s a popular spot, so I recommend making a reservation. I booked in advance for all three of my visits. It was close to my accommodation, so it was very convenient.

reviews.name: Chris Gray
reviews.text:
An absolute gem, sitting like a flower at the roadside. If authentic Thai massage is your thing then RYU is a must-visit during your time in Chiang Mai. That such a nondescript, humble little room can host the most skilled practitioners of the arts of Thai pressure point massage is a never-ending source of fascination.
That you can get this first class treatment at only 150 baht/hr is hardly believable but it's true.
You can walk in off the street but probably better to phone or obtain their line contact.
I really cannot speak highly enough of all the staff who have given me massages, every one is highly trained and skilled.

reviews.name: C C
reviews.text:
⚠️ Warning to other travelers

I’m extremely disappointed with my experience today. As a frequent visitor to Thailand, I’ve always respected the local massage culture and supported many massage shops here. However, what happened today was completely unacceptable and unfair to foreign customers like us.

I booked a 90-minute massage for 750 THB and paid in full, genuinely looking forward to a relaxing experience. Unfortunately, the male therapist was very careless and unprofessional. The air conditioner was extremely cold, yet he didn’t bother to cover me with a towel or blanket. He checked his phone, went to the restroom twice, and ended the session about 30 minutes early.

Even worse, during the massage, he made some inappropriate suggestions, which I firmly declined. After that, his attitude completely changed — he lost all interest in working seriously and rushed through the rest of the massage, eventually asking me to leave after only about one hour. This behavior was highly unprofessional and unacceptable.

There was no head massage, no technique, and no sense of care  just a careless attitude throughout. When I reported this to the front desk, they simply said he was a “new staff,” but that doesn’t justify such behavior. No apology, no accountability, and no respect.

I came here because of the good reviews, but after this experience, I truly question how genuine those reviews are. This kind of dishonesty and lack of professionalism is not the Thai hospitality we know and love. I will definitely share my full story on my channel so that more travelers can be aware and avoid the same disappointment.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear customer,
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are truly sorry for your disappointing experience.
We take this matter very seriously and would like to investigate it properly. Could you please let us know the name of the therapist who provided your massage, as well as the date and approximate time of your visit?
Once we have this information, we will review the situation with our team and take appropriate action. We do not accept any unprofessional behavior or inappropriate conduct from our staff.
Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We appreciate your help in allowing us to improve our service.
