reviews.name: August Dine
reviews.text:
Heads up: Mixed Feelings About a Massage Therapist - Important Note for the Establishment
I recently had a really upsetting experience with a massage therapist named Nick. He touched me inappropriately without my agreement, and then asked for a 1000 baht tip.
To make things even less pleasant, the massage t-shirt he gave me smelled strongly of body odor and someone's perfume, so I immediately took it off and asked for a clean one.

Despite the good massage, his inappropriate actions and personal questions about my job, age, and private life made me feel really uneasy. Also, even while I was using the restroom after the massage, he stood outside the door and kept asking if I was finished to get the tip, which felt very rushed and uncomfortable. In the end, while I gave him less than the 1000 baht he asked for, I still felt pressured to give him a larger tip than I normally would.
Since the person who seemed to be the owner wasn't there when I left, I wanted to share this here as a warning to others and to urge the establishment to take notice.
What's concerning is that about four months ago, someone else left a review in Chinese with a picture, describing a similar uncomfortable encounter with someone who looks like Nick. It's worrying that this place seems to still be employing him.

Postscript;
I have read your response, but it seems you have completely misunderstood my complaint. I did not make an appointment. My issue concerns extremely inappropriate behavior by a massage therapist at your establishment (who introduced himself as Nick), followed by a demand for a 1,000 baht tip.

Are you suggesting that such conduct and pressuring clients for an unusually high tip is simply a "cultural difference"? That explanation is highly inappropriate and frankly offensive.

Even if, for the sake of argument, the person who served me was not actually named Nick, it does not change the fact that this incident happened at your business. The appropriate first response should have been an apology, not denial.

Regarding your claim that Nick was on vacation in Holland in April: the person who performed the massage clearly identified himself as Nick. I also took the extra step of checking Google Maps, where I found a photo of a massage therapist at your shop who matches both the appearance and a distinctive watch. It is clearly the same person. He also mentioned having studied massage at Wat Pho, and his technique was consistent with that style.

Despite this clear evidence, you insisted that Nick was absent, which makes it seem like your business is trying to avoid responsibility by providing false information. This is extremely disappointing and unprofessional. I will not be using your services again. Please remember that actions have consequences.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello! I received your complaint. According to my understanding, it is an obstacle to appointment communication, not what you said. Maybe it's cultural differences.In your April comment, Nick was on vacation with his boyfriend in Holland, and he was not at the store at that time.
When you took the photo, your work clothes were changed to green ones six months ago. Besides, Nick was in Holland with his boyfriend when you commented. We can provide you with visa documents.

This salon deserves 100 points in every respect - service, ambience, massage quality and entertainment. It is a hidden gem in Bangkok that offers a complete luxury experience. I can't wait to come back!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Munly, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback, and we're truly sorry your visit didn't live up to your expectations, especially for what you paid.

On pricing: our rates are set only by us. They're published on our website and confirmed by our team before every session, so there should never be surprises. We regret that an outside promotion gave you a different impression.

Each of our therapists works within her own comfort level, and we ask all guests to respect that. We also agree that every visit should feel warm and welcoming, never rushed or mechanical, and we've shared your comments with the team so we can keep improving.

If you're back in Bangkok, please message us before you visit so we can make sure everything is clear from the start. We'd really appreciate the chance to give you a better experience.

reviews.name: Nariokung

The music was soothing, and the room temperature was just right. The therapist kept checking in to make sure we were comfortable with the temperature and music level, which showed great attention to detail. Their technique was excellent, and the overall experience was really enjoyable. Loved the snacks both before and after the treatment. A perfect way to finish the session.

title: Loi Kroh Massage
ownerDescription:
Loi Kroh was established in 1998 as a massage salon. A year later, Loi Kroh began teaching private lessons; one-on-one courses taught by Tassanee Boonsom “Coocky” and her friend Keiji Yajima.
Loi Kroh works with a wide variety of students who come to us to perfect their skills, even if they have studied elsewhere.
After 28 years in Chiang Mai city, starting in September 2026, we look forward to welcoming you to a peaceful setting in the heart of the traditional Thai countryside in Mae Faek, San Sai District. It is a 45-minute drive north of Chiang Mai via Route 1001.
The school is still run by “Coocky” Tassanee Boonsom and Xavier Hlavacek, even though they both live in France most of the time.
address: Mae Faek Mai, San Sai District, Chiang Mai 50290, Thailand
plusCode: 2X3X+9J Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Hallie Kemp
reviews.text:
I would go back to Thailand just for this place. Kom was my teacher and he made sure that me and the other student always felt comfortable and confident with how we approached things and learned.

I feel like they really invested their time and energy into teaching us and I couldn’t be more grateful for the experience I had.

I cannot recommend this place enough!! It had small class sizes, fun little snack breaks, in depth instruction, and good energy all around <3

reviews.name: Nicolette Wong
reviews.text:
I did a 5-day Basic Thai Massage course and a Basic Tok Sen course with Teacher Kom in Sept 2025. Kom was patient & professional and gave detailed instructions that were easy to follow. The tiny class size was a big plus as I could learn slowly and practice with the teacher. The courses may be a tad more pricey than some other options in Chiang Mai, but I think they are worth it for beginners who want to learn thoroughly.

I also booked a massage with Teacher Kom. It is so different from (and superior to) the regular Thai massage you get in massage shops — try it if you are a massage enthusiast.

reviews.name: Nanci A.
reviews.text:
I studied as a student here with the beginner Thai massage and tok sen classes with the teacher named Tai.

I work in Utah, USA as a massage therapist and I joined a friend who came to Thailand for her work.

I learned SO MUCH. There is a book to study with pictures and words, we would study part together, then the teacher demonstrated the technique on me, then I practiced it on him. This was amazing to receive so much massage 🤤

I was concerned coming to Thailand about language. Many people speak at least some English. Tai and Napa were great to communicate with and did well with their English speaking.

Also, my second concern was will I be safe traveling alone in Chiang Mai. (My friend Katie was with me for one week, then she left and I stayed one more week to take this class.) I felt very safe here in the city. No problems at all.

The school had been closed from COVID. When I messaged inquiring to take a class, it was still closed so I first went to my teachers home. I was happy to have the experience to see the culture but it was very, very hot and humid with no A/C and I fell asleep several times in the day! We then did two days at my hotel to stay cooled off- much better! I then found out they just recently opened their new location and I took the Tok sen class at the school/massage office.

Everyone is friendly, Tai was a great instructor. Na pa offered me fruits and tea and water and created a warm welcome.

We began the day with a mantra and prayer ceremony.

I then asked to take a single Thai yoga class and it was one on one with Na pa. Not to learn it to teach to others, I just needed a good stretch before going back on the airplanes!

She is a wise guru powerful strong woman!!! I LOVED learning from her!  I learned to breathe more deeply, my shoulder and scapula regions are often so tight and my tailbone which leads to experiencing much pain in my body. She guided me in the Thai style yoga and my mobility was significantly better immediately after the yoga class. My shoulder was as able to stretch better! Amazing.

I signed up to receive a massage from her and I’m heading there now before going to the airport back to America. Maybe I’ll update here again after the massage. :)

I recommend Loi Kroh to learn and study massage 100%.

And I bought pants and shirt here to look “official.” :)

Only difference is maybe I would take a beginner thai class near my home, then come here for more advanced classes.

I thought I would come to Thailand once in my life. This was my dream come true! I am so grateful. AND I now feel I need to come again and have more training and see my friends and teachers again in the future.

Thank you Tai and Na pa and everyone who makes this Loi Kroh possible.

reviews.name: Lucy Curno
reviews.text:
I just completed the 5 day ‘Basic Traditional Thai Yoga’ and it was an incredible experience. Tai and Pare made me feel right at home from the moment I walked in the door.

Each morning we prayed and danced before starting massage practise for the day - it was the best!

Tai was my massage teacher and he is the most supportive and patient teacher. He’s also incredibly funny! I was lucky enough to have a private training with him, as I was the only student to book and it was amazing. We practised on each other 50% of the time, and he would let me find my way and then jump in to help when I asked.

Pare is such a delight too! She was teaching another student the oil massage course, and she is a huge ball of energy and smiles. I felt like family with them both.

I would absolutely recommend, it’s a very special and intimate school with teachers who are truly knowledgeable, passionate and kind. I’ll definitely be back next time I’m in Thailand 🙏 Khop khun ka!!

reviews.name: William Crombie
reviews.text: Currently finishing up my last day of my course. Paie, my instructor, was wonderfully patient and knowledgeable, and provided me with an excellent introduction to the art. If I had more time in Chiang Mai, I’d definitely come back for more!

reviews.name: Maya Scarlett
reviews.text: I asked them if I could join their level 2 chi nei tsang. They said there was still spots open. I said I’d like to call them to ask a few questions, made plans around being able to attend, and found out on the phone four days later when they had time to talk to me that they only allow students that took their level 1 to join….. why didn’t you tell me that four days ago? When they say on the website, you have to take level one to take level two, they mean THEIRS, even though many people and places in Chiang Mai offer a level 1. Cost me a week of time and thus hotels for their failing to state you need to take THEIR level one, even though every other person I have spoken with lets you switch between schools. It’s not imperative to anywhere else. I think it’s a marketing money thing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Maya,
We are sincerely sorry for this misunderstanding. But as it is clearly indicated on our website, we ask students to have followed the first level in Abdominal Detox Massage be able to follow the second training.
For several years, there have been more and more massage schools offering Chi Nei Tsang training in Chiang Mai. Each of them offers a very specific training courses. The different levels offered are therefore absolutely not equivalent from one structure to another.
For any information or request for registration in massage trainings, please use the email school@loikrohmassage.com. Phone calls are mainly reserved for massage appointments.
Best regards,
The Loi Kroh team

Loi Kroh is based remotely in France while charging  exorbitant amount to local teachers for the use of their “brand.” Also bear in mind that the certificate they offer is not even approved by the thai government. I recommend avoiding them completely.

I’m not someone who usually leaves bad reviews, but after bearing witness to this type of inexcusable malpractice, I felt I had to say something.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are sorry to read your negative feedback about us. And let's assume that this is due to a misunderstanding of the situation with regard to our recent termination of the partnership that linked us to "Napa" Kaewnapa Sripodok until recently.
We would therefore like to clarify the situation in the following points.

Firstly, we had to separate from teachers Napa and Beam due to serious and repeated professional misconduct over several months. This separation has resulted in the school moving on February 2, 2024. As this misconduct is professional and therefore confidential, it does not need to be made public.

Secondly, we assure you and certify that Loi Kroh is and has always been based in Chiang Mai, Thailand, from its creation in 1998 to the present day. Your confusion probably stems from the fact that the owner of Loi Kroh has lived in France for several years, and that certain administrative tasks are managed from France. But the school is indeed based in Chiang Mai, currently at 150/6 Ragang road, T. Chang Khlan, A. Mueang.

Thirdly, we have nothing to do with a Mafia organization! And we kindly ask you to withdraw these offensive remarks.
We are first and foremost a private school where many people from the same Thai family work, accompanied by other Thai professionals. A Frenchman has been working with us free of charge since 2008, offering his skills and know-how for certain administrative tasks. 

As for our certificates, yes, they are not approved by the Thai government. For you should know, dear Nico COMOTTI, that in Thailand only schools that pay the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Education annually are accredited. Accreditation does not give any value to the teaching provided. Quite the contrary! Ajahn Pichest could tell you all about it if he were alive today...

The Loi Kroh team

We used to be frequent guests at Chi Spa Chiang Mai and were always impressed by the experience. Sadly, the quality has declined significantly over time. While the materials and ambiance remain top-notch, the professionalism and skill of the masseuses have deteriorated.

Yesterday’s visit was the pinnacle of disappointment. You pay ten times the price expecting a premium treatment, but what you get feels like a tenth of the quality of a basic street massage. My masseuse was clearly untrained and unmotivated—she even checked her phone during the massage. I had to remove the towel from my eyes just to see what she was doing. She looked sleepy or disinterested... hard to tell

I voiced my concerns at checkout, but all I received was a casual “I will tell her.” No apology, no acknowledgment of the poor experience.

This place used to be exceptional, but it’s become a shadow of its former self. Very sad to see such a reputable venue fall so far.

reviews.name: Maevis Meadows
reviews.text:
I’ve only been training Muay Thai for about one month, but I’ve spent the past week at KHC Muay Thai in Bangkok — and I already feel at home here. From the moment I walked in, everyone was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and ready to help. The gym is clean, organized, and has such a positive energy that makes you actually look forward to training every day.

Even as a beginner, I never once felt out of place. The coaches are patient, knowledgeable, and genuinely invested in helping you improve. They take the time to correct technique, motivate you, and push you in the best way. At the same time, the gym has plenty of seasoned fighters, which creates an inspiring environment and amazing training partners who challenge you but also support you.

In just a week, I’ve learned so much and gained confidence I didn’t expect this quickly. KHC is truly beginner-friendly while still having that authentic fighter atmosphere. Whether you’re new like me or already experienced, this is a gym where you’ll feel welcomed, respected, and pushed to grow. Highly recommend to anyone training in Bangkok!

reviews.text:
แวะคลายความตึงของร่างกาย​ สัมผัสความผ่อนคลายย่านถนนนครไชย​ศรี​ กทม.

สวัสดีค่าทุกคน! วันนี้เราจะพาทุกคนมาสัมผัสประสบการณ์นวดผ่อนคลายสบายตัวกับร้านนี้มีชื่อร้านว่า ชบาแก้วนวดเพื่อสุขภาพ

เปิดให้บริการทุกวันตั้งแต่ 9:00 - 20:30 น.

บรรยากาศร้าน:
ก้าวแรกที่เดินเข้าไปในร้านก็สัมผัสได้ถึงบรรยากาศของแอร์เย็นฉ่ำและความเป็นกันเอง พนักงานต้อนรับด้วยรอยยิ้มและให้คำแนะนำอย่างใส่ใจ ร้านตกแต่งอย่างเรียบง่ายแต่สะอาดสะอ้าน ทำให้รู้สึกผ่อนคลายตั้งแต่ยังไม่ได้เริ่มนวดเลยค่ะ

เราเลือกนวดแผนไทยซึ่งเป็นซิกเนเจอร์ของทางร้านค่ะ ก่อนเริ่มนวด หมอนวดจะสอบถามความต้องการของเราก่อนว่าต้องการเน้นส่วนไหนเป็นพิเศษ เลยบอกไปว่าขอเน้นขาเพราะเดินเยอะ แล้วปวดเมื่อยขา หมอนวดก็จัดให้แบบเน้นๆ เลยค่ะ

ความชำนาญของหมอนวด:
ต้องบอกเลยว่าหมอนวดที่นี่ชำนาญมากๆค่ะ นวดคลายเส้นได้ตรงจุด รู้เลยว่าตรงไหนที่เรามีปัญหา นวดแต่ละจุดคือลงน้ำหนักได้พอดี ไม่เบาไปไม่หนักไป จนเรานี่เคลิ้มจนเกือบหลับไปเลยค่ะ

ราคา:
ราคานวดแผนไทยเริ่มต้นที่ 230 บาทต่อชั่วโมง ถือว่าคุ้มค่ามากๆ กับคุณภาพการนวดและบริการที่ได้รับค่ะ

ความประทับใจ:
หมอนวดมีความชำนาญ นวดคลายเส้นได้ตรงจุด บริการเป็นกันเอง ใส่ใจลูกค้า
บรรยากาศร้านสะอาดสะอ้าน ผ่อนคลาย
ราคาสมเหตุสมผล

โดยรวม:
ถ้าใครกำลังมองหาร้านนวดแผนไทยดีๆ ในกรุงเทพฯ ย่านถนนนครไชยศรี ขอแนะนำ "ชบาแก้ว นวดเพื่อสุขภาพ" เลยค่ะ รับรองว่าทุกคนจะได้รับการนวดที่ผ่อนคลายและสบายตัวอย่างแน่นอนค่ะ

คำแนะนำเพิ่มเติม :
แนะนำให้โทรจองล่วงหน้าเพื่อความสะดวก
ทางร้านมีบริการนวดอื่นๆ อีกมากมาย เช่น นวดน้ำมัน นวดเท้า สามารถสอบถามรายละเอียดเพิ่มเติมได้ที่ร้าน
reviews.textTranslated:
Relax and unwind in the Nakhon Chai Si area of ​​Bangkok.

Hello everyone! Today, we're taking you to experience a relaxing massage at a shop called Chaba Kaew Health Massage.

Open daily from 9:00 AM to 8:30 PM.

Atmosphere:
The moment you step inside, you're greeted with a cool, refreshing air-conditioned atmosphere and a friendly welcome. The staff greet you with smiles and offer attentive advice. The shop is simply decorated but clean, making you feel relaxed even before the massage begins.

We opted for the Thai massage, their signature treatment. Before the massage, the masseuse asked about our needs and preferred areas for focus. I mentioned focusing on my legs because I walk a lot and they're sore. The masseuse delivered exactly that!

Masseur Skill:
I must say, the masseuses here are incredibly skilled. They massage precisely where my muscles were aching, knowing exactly where the problems were. The pressure was just right – not too light, not too heavy – I was so relaxed I almost fell asleep!

Price:
Thai massage starts at 230 baht per hour. It was definitely worth it for the quality of the massage and service received.

Impressions:
The masseuse was skilled and massaged the right spots. The service was friendly and attentive.
The shop atmosphere was clean and relaxing.
The price was reasonable.

Overall:
If you're looking for a good Thai massage shop in Bangkok, in the Nakhon Chai Si area, I highly recommend "Chaba Kaew Health Massage." You're guaranteed a relaxing and comfortable massage.

Additional advice:
It's recommended to call and book in advance for your convenience.
The shop also offers many other massage services, such as oil massage and foot massage. You can inquire about details at the shop.

reviews.name: Aratchaporn J

reviews.name: Korada Vapinanont
reviews.text: คุณหมอกับเจ้าหน้าที่ให้คำแนะนำดีมากค่ะ พิลาทิสดี ครูเป็นนักกายภาพบำบัดโดยตรง เล่นได้ไม่หนักจนเกินไปค่ะ ความไพรเวทเต็ม10 ค่าา
reviews.textTranslated: The doctor and staff gave excellent advice. The Pilates class was great; the instructor was a certified physical therapist, so the exercises weren't too strenuous. The privacy was a perfect 10!

reviews.name: Kanyarat Sudkrob
reviews.text: มาเล่นพิลาทิสครั้งแรกดีมากๆ เลยค่ะ คุณหมอและพนักงานแนะนำดีมากๆๆ น่ารักมากๆค่ะ

reviews.name: Vorrawee Tethanyawarakool
reviews.text: เป็นคลินิกที่ vibes ดีมาก ผ่อนคลาย มีนักกายภาพมาตรวจให้ก่อนแล้วไป Pilates เพื่อแก้ไข คอบ่าไหล่ สำหรับชาว office syndrome เลย

reviews.name: Tanchanok Sorasesakun
reviews.text: Highly recommend!!! คลินิกครบจบในที่เดียว แนะนำมากๆเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: Highly recommend!!! A clinic that offers all services in one place. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Maneerat Thangthongsree
reviews.text:
เป็นการเล่นพิลาทิส ครั้งแรกที่ ประทับใจมาก ของเราเป็น Privet Pilates กับครูมิ้น ครูใจเย็นมากห้องพิลาทิส ที่ วีวารา พิลาทิส คือสะอาดหอม บรรยาศผ่อนคลายสุดๆ

reviews.textTranslated:
This was my first time trying Pilates, and I was very impressed. Mine was a Private Pilates session with Instructor Mint, who was very patient. The Pilates room at Vivara Pilates is clean, smells nice, and has a very relaxing atmosphere.
They also have Duo Pilates options for couples. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.name: Kantkanit Watanakun

reviews.textTranslated: It was excellent! Very private. The physiotherapist was very good and focused on the right areas.

reviews.name: J-ae Siripatcharotorn
reviews.text: เพิ่งเจอว่ามี rehab pilates ใกล้ๆเลยลองมาเล่นดู สอนโดยนักกายภาพ สอนดีมากค่ะ ใส่ใจรายละเอียด คอยจัดท่าให้ตลอด
reviews.textTranslated: I recently found out there's a rehab Pilates class nearby, so I decided to try it. It's taught by a physical therapist, and they're excellent. They pay attention to detail and constantly adjust your posture.

reviews.name: Palaoy Ponpan
reviews.text: สตูดิโอสวยงาม สะอาด เดินทางสะดวกค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The studio is beautiful, clean, and conveniently located.

reviews.name: Phaniya
reviews.text: คลีนิคสะอาด กว้างขวางมากค่ะ นักกายภาพให้ความรู้ดีมาก คุณคุณพิลาทิสก็ใจสอนดีค่ะ โฟกัสได้ถูกจุดรู้สึกสบายตัวหลังทำกายภาพและเล่นคลาสมากเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The clinic is very clean and spacious. The physiotherapist is very knowledgeable, and the Pilates instructor is also very kind and helpful. I felt much more comfortable and focused after the physiotherapy and classes.

reviews.name: may may

reviews.textTranslated: The doctors and professors gave excellent advice and were very friendly.

reviews.name: Porntira Chaokijka

reviews.textTranslated: I tried Pilates today. The focus was on the right areas, and the instructor was excellent.

reviews.textTranslated: The atmosphere is great and the instructor is excellent. It's not difficult at all for beginners.

A great place for strength training focusing on balanced movement.

reviews.text: มีปัญหา ปวดเอว เข่า และหลัง บ่าไหล่ มาฝึกพิลาทิส และ DNS กับครูอ้อม อาการปวดดีขึ้นมากแทบไม่มีอาการเลย ไม่ได้ดึงหลังเลยตั้งแต่ฝึก ได้ฝึกสติกับการเคลิ่อนไหวร่างกาย ถ้าเราทำถูกต้อง ร่างกายจะบอกเราเอง
reviews.textTranslated: I had problems with lower back, knee, and shoulder pain. I started practicing Pilates and DNS with Instructor Aom, and my pain has improved significantly – almost completely gone. I haven't had to stretch my back at all since I started. I've also learned to be mindful of my body movements. If we do it correctly, our body will tell us.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณรีวิว ดีดีนะคะพี่อ้อม ขอบคุณมาดค่ะ

reviews.text: Pilates studio สอนการออกกำลังกาย แนว DNS เข้าใจ ร่างกาย ในมุมและองศาที่ถูกต้อง ไม่ยืดเกินองศาของร่างกาย แก้ไขอาการปวดหลัง บาดเจ็บ แนะนำ เลยคะ

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากค่ะ 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Natthaya Thepphanao
reviews.text:

แนะนำมากๆสำหรับคนที่อยากเรียน pilates & yoga และกิจกรรมออกกำลังกายอื่นๆ
reviews.textTranslated:
Instructor: I learned Pilates and Yoga here. Teacher Aom is an excellent teacher ❤️ and she helped me with my movement problems effectively. She ensured I exercised with correct posture and is very knowledgeable and skilled. She helped relieve my muscle pain and corrected my incorrect body posture. She constantly updates her knowledge and incorporates new techniques to improve her teaching.

Location: The Pilates and Yoga equipment is complete and standard, and the teacher continuously purchases more. The place is clean, and the teacher cleans it regularly.

Highly recommend this place for anyone who wants to learn Pilates, Yoga, and other fitness activities.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากค่ะ ที่ให้โอกาสได้ดูแลนะคะ จะพัฒนาเพื่อ ผู้ฝึกไปเรื่อย เรื่อย 🙏🙏

reviews.textTranslated:
I'd like to review my return as a student at this studio after a long break.

This time, I came back with a work-related injury (severe neck, shoulder, and right scapula pain). I've been attending group training twice a week for one hour each time, using the DNS (Dynamic Stroke) technique. My pain has significantly decreased.
The DNS technique can be applied to daily life 24/7, whether sitting, walking, standing, or sleeping. One hour of class is incredibly worthwhile! The instructor explains things clearly, and is attentive to each student. My classmates are lovely. I highly recommend trying DNS. Come experience it for yourself; this studio offers more than just exercise. ❤️❤️❤️

reviews.text:
During our recent 5-night stay at Centara Watergate Pavillion Hotel Bangkok, we had the pleasure of experiencing the 1+ aromatherapy massage at Cense by SPA Cenvaree.

From the moment we walked in, the luxury of the spa was evident. We enjoyed an hour-long massage where the therapist skillfully adjusted the pressure to accommodate my preferences, switching between soft and firm as needed.

The spa manager, Kunyanut, was exceptionally well-spoken and made communication easy. After our massage, we were treated to a fantastic hot shower with Balmain products provided. The attention to detail was impressive, with everything we needed thoughtfully taken care of, including delicious snacks and tea!

Cense by SPA Cenvaree offered a clean, hygienic, and thoroughly relaxing experience—exactly what we needed during our stay in Bangkok. Highly recommended!

As I entered Pilates Space, Michael Gerber principle came to mind: success comes from working not only in the business, but on the business. That mindset is evident everywhere here — from the teaching quality to the thoughtful details that make this studio exceptional.

I came to The Pilates Space Studio with long-standing movement compensations . What I experienced here was something entirely different.
When I learned that the owner, Kru Amp, had changed careers, another old saying came to mind: the way you do one thing is the way you do everything. From the first session, it was clear that this is someone who approaches her work with total commitment and depth. That level of excellence shows up directly in her one-on-one Pilates practice.

If you’re someone who has tried Pilates, physio, or movement work before and felt like you plateaued, this studio offers a genuinely different experience.
And yes — this is also the kind of place where you might be asked to arrive an hour later because Santa dropped in for his yearly Buriram revision lesson 😱.
That alone tells you the level of trust and reputation here.

reviews.name: Brooke Bates
reviews.text:
I can’t recommend Indra Massage highly enough! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and cared for. The atmosphere was clean, relaxing, and professional, making it easy to switch off and unwind.

The therapists are incredibly skilled and took the time to understand exactly what I needed. The massage was the perfect balance of relaxing and therapeutic, helping to relieve tension while still feeling like a luxury experience. I left feeling refreshed, lighter, and so much better than when I arrived.

The level of care, attention to detail, and genuine customer service really sets Indra Massage apart. You can tell they truly care about their clients and want everyone to have the best possible experience.

If you’re looking for a place to relax, recover, or simply treat yourself, I highly recommend Indra Massage. I’ll definitely be coming back next time I’m in Bangkok 🤍

reviews.name: Jonathan
reviews.text:
Regular customer here. I visited again at the end of the year, and starting the New Year with a massage was a perfect way to relax. The atmosphere is calm, warm, and very relaxing — a great way to begin the new year.

All therapists are professional, and you really can’t go wrong with anyone. Each has a different style depending on whether you choose Thai massage, oil massage, or foot massage, and whether you prefer it gentle or strong.

If you’re unsure who to choose, I can personally recommend Aek, Chanon, Lotto, Phon, and PP.

Highly recommended — I always enjoy coming back.

reviews.text: I went for a 2 hour Thai oil massage. It was good, strong and also very relaxing. The masseur knew what he was doing. The massage lasted just a bit over the 2 hours so was perfect. Staff and owner very friendly.

There is so much talking and laughing between staff members during the massage from room to room it is not relaxing. I asked for a 2 hour Thai massage with balm, extra strong. I had to ask the massager several times over 2 hours if he was tired, as his pressure kept getting softer and softer. He would increase pressure for 5 minutes and then go back to an irritating light push or pinch. I had requested a Thai massage with tiger balm. The balm was never applied or used during the entire massage, but the therapist had it on the tray.
I assumed he would eventually get to use it but as he got closer to the end of 2 hours, I asked about the balm and he just laughed and said times up.
I later told the owner that the massage I ordered was a Thai massage with balm, I pointed to it on the selection board when I entered. All he did was smile and pointed to the regular Thai massage price. No apology, discount, bowing, or care for the customer's concern. Another issue of poor training that the staff knows routine for the massage, but they lack the consistency and attention to the muscle tension so that they would vary the pressure and touch.
Prime, SalaaThai, Urban, Relax Sathorn, Sense Sathorn, Sook Sabai are much better choices.

그리고 외진 곳에 있고 위생적인 곳은 절대 아님 오일 묻은 손 손님용 담요에 닦고 내 얼굴도 만짐

왜 두번이냐 갔냐면 첫번째 갔을땐 압도 시원한 편에 베테랑처럼 잘하는 분이 해주셨음. 물론 그때도 좀 시끄럽긴 했으나 그만큼 skillful한 면이 더 컸음

다른거 안보고 가성비 좋으면서 강한 압 좋아하면 가시고 이왕이면 다른 샵 추천합니다
reviews.textTranslated:
It seems like a shop with stark pros and cons (though the downsides outweigh them).

I went twice, but the reason I gave it 2 points is that they lifted my clothes three times while I was changing, even though the male owner was there...;

They kept checking their phones to see if it was time or not. They seemed to be texting in between; I must have heard the clicking sound of their phones dozens of times.

The middle-aged women chatted a lot amongst themselves; it wasn't quiet at all.

The most serious thing is that they don't know "Don't touch." I have a deep wound from a second-degree burn, and when I said "Don't touch," they pressed hard on it more than three times... lol. If they don't know "Don't touch," they should at least have some common sense. They only stopped touching me after I made an X sign and another woman came over. I was so pissed off...

Also, it is located in a secluded area and is definitely not hygienic. They wiped their oil-covered hands on a customer blanket and even touched my face.

The reason I went twice is that the first time I went, the pressure was quite strong, and the person who performed it was skilled, like a veteran. Of course, it was a bit noisy back then, but the skillfulness outweighed that.

If you don't care about anything else and just want good value for money with strong pressure, go there, but if you're going to do it anyway, I recommend a different shop.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I apologize for every mistake and thank you for your complaint. Hope to use it to fix it next time. Thank you.

reviews.name: Masna Rai
reviews.text: I had a Thai traditional postpartum care package  with Dr. Peach. Very professional and friendly. Nice session.

reviews.name: Nichadapha Saelim
reviews.text:
Highly recommended!

I spent my Sunday enjoying "Serene Slumber day package" at Anantara Wellness Riverside Bangkok. There are 4 parts
1. Sleep Enrich Assessment
2. Antioxident ECGC IV Drip
3. Sweet Herbal Dream Massage
4. Revive Foot Massage

First I got both massages, I fell asleep so fast and that surprised me because I barely slept during massage sessions somewhere else.

Then I had the IV drip and the sleep assessment which I totally loved it. Never know that they have epigenetic test on that session also.

Didi (The consultant) is an expert in this field and she gave me a very valuable advice.

Also there was an afternoon tea from Mocha and Muffins in this package. The tea was so relaxing, scone was yummy and sorbet was amazing.

All in all, love it and I would highly recommend anyone who want to find a great way to spend on weekend!

reviews.name: Jess Pratomthong
reviews.text:
I would like to thank a lovely team and Dr. Art at Anantara Wellness Center. After speaking with him, I gained so much valuable knowledge about nutritions and a much better understanding of how the body’s systems work. Before, I had very little understanding of metabolism, but now I understand it much more clearly and can apply this knowledge to my daily life.

Thank you so much, Dr. Art, for your guidance and support. I truly appreciate it.

reviews.text: “The staff here are lovely, and the service is excellent. The overall space is perfect for relaxation. I’ll definitely be coming back again soon!”

reviews.text: I did an acupuncture with Dr. Cash and she was just brilliant. Thank you for your consultation and wonderful accupuncture. Service and Spa was very good. Price is bit expensive but worth every penny.

reviews.name: Global Expolorer
reviews.text: On Par with vitality clinics in USA. Professional staff, upscale amenities and tranquil environment. They have a MD on staff who's patient in explaining the whole process. The message therapist on staff is a gift. She's got 10years of experience at the Bangkok hospital. She's a healer; using Reiki and neurology to get into the muscle and help release the knots and blockage. I m grateful to go for professional wellness center in a city saturated with spas and wellness centers. It's not cheap because they have qualified MD, Nurse and certified therapists on staff.

reviews.name: karthik Krishnamurthi
reviews.text: Taken the Consultation and treatment from Dr.Cash for my back pain. Excellent treatment and she has explained the problem and addressed the issue correctly. Highly recommend her for your treatment.

reviews.name: Elisabeth Cochrane
reviews.text: I have had this consultation every time I’ve stayed at this hotel and I have received some very helpful information to know what changes I need to make to improve my health. The doctor gave me do much the me and great information.

reviews.name: Romi Haughton Gray
reviews.text: Had an acupuncture treatment with Cash. Life changing and explained so much. Cash is so knowledgable, and helpful, emailing me all we discussed after the appointment. Thoroughly recommend. Thank you Dr Cash.

reviews.name: P Mac
reviews.text: Luxurious Spa upon beautiful grounds with very pleasant and welcoming staff. Sought out Dr. Cash specifically her experience with regards to Chi Nei Tsang and Acupuncture. The experience was second to none. Am returning for a 2nd session without hesitation.

reviews.name: Claus Nielsen
reviews.text: Amazing new Wellness centre.  And good for a quick Vitamin IV drip after a Mai Thai or too many at Traders Vic :)

reviews.name: Eileen Robinson
reviews.text: My husband and I called into the Power of Ancient Wellness workshop. Karen and Ballon were wonderful hosts. We tried some very tasty Thai food for health and made our own herbal inhaler. We had a wonderful experience. Thank you kindly for your hospitality

reviews.name: Ma. Cecile Cam
reviews.text: I am very happy with the services given. The staffs were very cheerful and accomodating especially Pak who tour me around the center. The rajasamnak therapeutic massage by Peach was very relaxing, highly recommended. Ms Didi with health consultation was very interesting and an eye opener, she did a fantastic job. I had also a skin consultation and it was an excellent one. He taught me the proper skin care that i need to look better. The experience was perfect.

reviews.name: icepnth
reviews.text: Good service and treatment quality. I really recommend the traditional chinese therapy call Gua sha.

reviews.name: Alexandre Masuda
reviews.text:
Amazing how the Chinese acupuncture doctor could find my weak point only checking the pulse. The price worth because the doctor spend one hour to listen your problem, diagnose and give advice.
After acupuncture I feel so relaxed and sleepy. Like piece of mind. 😎😎

reviews.name: Henry
reviews.text: This hotel was so welcoming when we got here but as we got ready to take off for our flight early morning the arrangements we made with the hotel didn’t go as planned. I gave the three star rating because of the hotel being considered a five star I was expecting that same five star hotel feel. I would still advise you to try them out for yourself. The breakfast you pay for here was good every day they changed up some of the food in the breakfast buffet. This hotel doesn’t just cater to westerner’s so if your coming from anywhere other then the USA you’ll be ok. They have a little of everything to do there as well from early morning activities which some are free and others you’ll have to pay for. They also had a free boat service to the you over to iconsiam mall which if you are here in the month of June can fell sticky. It takes about 20mins or so by boat to get to the mall if you are looking for a more cooler and fast way get a Grab.

reviews.name: Khalil Rountree
reviews.text: Beautifully designed, Kind staff, abundance of treatments, thorough consultation. The staff are passionate about wellness and healing. Very professional. I really enjoyed the visit, 10/10 thank you  Anantara wellness 🙏🏿

reviews.name: Kuba Stanosz
reviews.text: That was a great experience! The therapist was highly skilled, I could easily relax and enjoy it!

reviews.name: Hayan .H
reviews.text: I recently visited Lalynn for a 1-hour massage, and I have to say, it was one of the best experiences I've had in Bangkok. The staff were incredibly friendly and professional, and I felt very welcomed from the moment I walked in the door. The massage itself was absolutely fantastic - I couldn't believe how quickly the time flew by! The therapist was skilled and attentive, and really seemed to know how to work out all of my knots and tension points. Overall, I would highly recommend Lalynn to anyone looking for a top-quality massage experience in Bangkok. Thank you so much for a wonderful visit!

reviews.name: Leroy Saunders
reviews.text:
One of the good real massage shops in the area, an amazing experience from when you walk in.

Greeted with kindness and a smile, clean rooms that smell great and the massage has always been really really good here.

Only thing Iv experienced that might be a great addition is a glute massage in the process, I do a lot of training, squats deadlifts etc and the glute is a big link in the posterior chain, they seem to skip this muscle here (though I have never asked directly for them to massage my glutes)

Other than that it’s an amazing massage parlor with professional staff.

Always good going back

reviews.text:
ไปครั้งแรกประทับใจมากค่ะ เพราะเจอหมอนวดไม่รีดเส้นแรงเกิน เขานวดเท่าที่ร่างกายเรารับไหว นวดเสร็จตัวเบา ไม่ระบม ปลื้มมาก เลยตั้งใจมาซ้ำรอบสองค่ะ

รอบสองได้หมอนวดอีกคนนึง มือหนัก ลงแรงเยอะ แต่เราไว้ใจคิดว่าเขาน่าจะกะน้ำหนักได้แบบหมอที่เจอครั้งแรก มีบอกตอนรู้สึกเจ็บบ้าง และร้องบ้างบางทีค่ะ ภาพรวมโอเค เข้าใจว่าน่าจะนวดคนละสไตล์เลยไม่ได้อะไรมาก

หลังนวดเสร็จระบมนิดหน่อย รู้สึกล้าร่างกายประมาณนึง แต่ที่พีคคือ มันเริ่มระบมเจ็บ และมีจุดที่ขึ้นรอยช้ำตามภาพค่ะ

ส่วนตัวไม่คิดว่าจะออกมารุนแรงขนาดนี้ และอาจเพราะเราไม่ได้แสดงออกถึงความเจ็บขณะนวดมากพอ แต่ถ้าเป็นไปได้อยากให้ร้าน Keep ให้สไตล์การนวดเป็นแบบหมอคนแรกที่เราเจอ คือไม่เน้นลงหนัก เอาพอคลายได้เท่าที่ร่างกายจะไม่บอบช้ำ ไม่อยากให้หมอมี Mindset ว่ามาที่ต้องขยี้ให้คลายมากที่สุดค่ะ เพราะถ้าคิดแบบนั้น ยังไงก็ระบมแน่ และมันจะไม่กล้ามานวดอีก 🥲

(ภาพรวมโอเคนะคะ บรรยากาศดี มีที่จอดรถ น้ำมะตูมอร่อย สถานที่สะอาด โทรจองง่าย แค่เจอเรื่องนี้ไปเลยไม่ค่อยโอเคค่ะ)
reviews.textTranslated:
My first visit was amazing! The masseuse wasn't too rough; she massaged at a level my body could handle. I felt light and not sore afterward. I was so pleased that I decided to come back for a second time.

The second time, I had a different masseuse. She was heavier and applied more pressure, but I trusted her and thought she'd be able to gauge the pressure like the first time. I did point out when I felt pain and even cried out a little. Overall, it was okay. I understand it was a different style of massage, so it wasn't a big deal.

After the massage, I was slightly sore and felt somewhat tired. But the worst part was that it started to get sore and painful, and there were bruises as shown in the picture.

I didn't expect it to be this intense, and maybe it's because I didn't express the pain enough during the massage. However, I'd like the salon to maintain the massage style of the first masseuse – not focusing on excessive pressure, but on releasing tension without causing further injury. I don't want masseuses to have a mindset of wanting to squeeze in as much as possible to relieve tension. If they do that, soreness is inevitable, and I wouldn't dare come back again. 🥲

(Overall, it was okay. The atmosphere was good, there was parking, the bael fruit juice was delicious, the place was clean, and booking was easy. It was just this one incident that made it less enjoyable.)

reviews.text:
วันนี้มาทำ Promotion ขัดผิว + นวดอโรม่าเทียนหอม 1,200 THB ในส่วนของการขัดผิวกับการนวดอโรม่าดีนะคะ
แต่อยากให้ช่วยอบรมพนักงานค่ะ
1. การพูดคุยขอให้มีหางเสียงทุกครั้งนะคะ
2. เนื่องจากมีการนวดแล้วมือโดนหน้าหลายครั้ง ห้องค่อนข้างมืด ไม่แน่ใจเห็นหรือเปล่า แต่รอบสุดท้ายตอนนวดอโรม่า น้ำมันโดนหน้า ขอทิชชู่มาเช็ด อย่างแรกต้องขอโทษลูกค้านะคะ ไม่ใช่ทำเฉย นวดต่อ มันทำให้ลูกค้ารู้สึกแย่ค่ะ
3. ความรู้ในการตอบคำถามลูกค้า ไม่ค่อยมีเลย ถ้าอยากขายคอร์ส ต้องบอกประโยชน์ในการเลือกตัวสินค้านั้นๆ ด้วยค่ะ
4. อย่าพูดถึงลูกค้าคนอื่นในแง่ลบ ต่อให้คุณจะผิดหรือไม่ผิดไม่ควรพูด และช่วยให้เกียรติลูกค้าทุกคนอย่างใจจริง ลูกค้าไม่ได้มาใฟ้ทำฟรีๆ เราจ่ายเงินค่ะ
5. อยากให้ช่วยปรับทัศนคติ ความคิด การบริการ ของพนักงานให้มากๆนะคะ ไม่งั้นอาจจะเสียทั้งลูกค้าใหม่ขาจร และลูกค้าเก่าๆนะคะ

บอกตามตรงนะคะ ตอนแรกเข้ามาก็รู้สึกดีค่ะ จนกระทั่งเจอคำพูดพนักงานแล้ว เข้าใจลูกค้าคนเก่าๆที่มาแล้วมีการคอมเม้นติ ไม่แปลกใจเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
Today I came for a promotion: body scrub + aromatherapy candle massage for 1,200 THB. The body scrub and aromatherapy massage were good.
However, I would like to suggest that you train your staff better.
1. Please use polite language when speaking to customers.
2. During the massage, there were several instances of hands touching the face. The room was quite dark, and I'm not sure if they saw, but during the final aromatherapy massage, oil got on my face. When I asked for a tissue to wipe it off, I should have apologized to the customer first, not just ignored it and continued the massage. It made the customer feel bad.
3. They lacked knowledge in answering customer questions. If you want to sell a package, you should explain the benefits of choosing that particular product.
4. Do not speak negatively about other customers. Whether you are right or wrong, you should not say such things. Please show genuine respect to all customers. Customers are not here for free; we are paying.
5. I would like to see improvements in the attitude, mindset, and service of your staff. Otherwise, you may lose both new and returning customers.

Honestly, I had a good experience at first, until I heard the staff's comments. Now I understand why some returning customers have left negative comments. It's not surprising.

reviews.text: I highly recommend the Ari branch! I’ve been taking classes with Instructor Khe, and he is great. He pays close attention to every technical detail and challenges you to be mindful of every movement. Whether you’re a beginner or advanced, it will be a great experience training with him.

reviews.name: Anna Huynh
reviews.text: I completed my one week trial! It is a great discount and it includes hand wraps.  I chose this gym not only for its affordability, but it was closer and has AC. This actually plays a big factor for me as it’s really hard to train in high humidity/heat. I’m a complete beginner and I think this gym is suitable for me. On the first day, I didn’t have my own gloves but they lent me a pair. After my first class, I liked it and bought my own pair at Chatuchak market. They also sell them there too. The group classes consist of warm up, pad work, then conditioning exercises. The krus and staff are all good, each with their own style and fun personalities. If I could stay longer, I would continue training here and try out the private lessons to perfect technique. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Degen Hill
reviews.text:
This gym has everything. Muay Thai ring, free weights, incline / decline / regular bench press, leg press, squat rack, free weights, cable machine, 2 smith machines, cardio machines, spin bikes, and much more. It’s 1,500 baht for 1 month and 100 baht for 1 day. Cheaper if you buy more than 1 month.

The gym itself is huge, super clean, and machines are efficiently organized. Plus all the bright colors are a nice touch compared to the usual black at many gyms.

Staff were super helpful and spoke good English. Highly recommend this gym.

reviews.name: Tetyana Mytrofanova
reviews.text: Very good gym, so far the best I've visited in Chiang mai ( for that price). Very big, have all the nessecery equipment for a proper workout. The change room clean also ( but you need your own lock for the locker). A/C works well. The price for 1 day visit -100 baht.

reviews.name: Kyle Watanabe (ខែល)
reviews.text: Favorite gym in Chiang Mai so far. 90 baht for entry use. Nice bathrooms with lockers (you need your own key if you want to lock it) and showers. Very clean, and so many options! Very happy to see proper bumper plates, however they don't let you drop the bar from clean or snatch height. That would be the only extra thing they could have. A nice sled pull area, lots of bikes and treadmills, and crazy rig set ups. You gotta check it out! They even have a truck you can lift! I think it is around 110 kg.

reviews.name: Daniel Atkinson
reviews.text:
Nice big gym with a car park. The staff are very friendly and there are healthy food options for when you've finished your workout.

A couple of the machines are not at 100% (seated arm clip chest, X trainers etc). The male toilets smell a bit...but there's lots of machine variety and it's never too busy.

reviews.name: Julie Qi
reviews.text: Price is good for aircon. However, it lacks the necessary equipment to build any decent size. If you need to build your back, glutes or legs, there won’t be enough plate loaded machines for you. The king could definitely use a boost.

reviews.name: Matthias Z
reviews.text:
Mixed package between 5* and 1*
Average of 4* is being kind. We went twice within a week. First time everything was 5* professional foot massage focusing on the feet, good pressure and quiet and relaxing atmosphere. So we went back yesterday and it was a horrible experience. My wife was lucky and got a nice, professional therapist. I got the first seat at the door, which opened every 2 minutes. It was very chaotic and my therapist, was busy talking to various colleagues trying to manage the reception area. She wasn't focused on me at all and was basically rubbing my leg. Customers were chatting, employes were chatting and the door was opened (as mentioned) every 2 minutes. The A/C was blowing full blast right into my face. It was more a bus stop feeling than a professional massage place. It got a bit better towards the 2nd half hour and it felt I had two very different massages for each feet. I would not recommend a Saturday evening and don't accept the first chair. Again my experience yesterday was a 1*

reviews.name: Anish Thakkar (Doc Thakkar)
reviews.text:
I was waiting for the tennis pro shop to complete restringing of my racquet, so came here for a 1-hour Thai massage for 350 baht. When I had asked for a strong massage, the masseuse replied that ‘deep tissue’ costs more, so I declined.

The massage was decent, but I felt that some of the high-pressure situations were applied in the wrong areas, and didn’t actually clear knots. As a result, I tipped the masseuse 20 baht (a low tip). I overheard her talking to another masseuse ‘yisip baht,’ which means ‘20 baht.’ I thus left not feeling so great. Water at the end was a nice touch though, so 4 stars!

reviews.text: From the beginning to end this was the most unfriendly, unprofessional and untrained massage place I’ve ever been to. The energy was just rancid from the women who worked there. I had to ask multiple times for the worker to go softer or stop hurting me to which she would ignore me and make faces at the other women in a cruel and unkind way behind our backs (or so she seemed to think). We have left with more pain than when we arrived, it was rushed, harsh and truly unprofessional. If I could give it zero stars I would. Shame on these women. Also my partner (male) was made very uncomfortable by his masseuse almost touching him inappropriately. Overall just the worst massage we’ve ever ever had.

reviews.name: Nyia Lampkin
reviews.text:
This place is interesting, but I personally prefer a different location. I wanted to book a scrub and a 45-minute oil massage. First, I had to book through a third-party website, which was fine. However, the scrub was not what I’m used to in the states. It consisted of Himalayan sea salt (or something similar). I’m used to scrubs being done with a mitt and hot water, and my masseuse would scrub my body while I could see all the dead skin coming off.

My skin is soft from the scrub they did, but it’s definitely softer when I have the mitt. After the scrub, you have to walk to the shower room, which was filthy! Please be sure to wear the shower shoes they provide upon entering—which are also not the cleanest (and too big), but it will have to do.

The room where all the treatments are done is creepy. It doesn’t have the traditional massage beds, but a wooden bed with no face hole, just a pillow and a sheet. My masseuse was very sweet and did a great job, but I would definitely second-guess coming here.

Ambience: 6.5/10
Cleanliness: 5.5/10
Friendliness: 8/10

reviews.name: LU LU
reviews.text: Love this place. In the salt room. The smell and decor and the service. Top notch. Best massage I had in Chiangmai. The tea set after massage definitely so  therapeutic. First time I received tea pot style in massage place. Will come back many time.

reviews.name: Katie Gray
reviews.text:
There are more reasons to come here than I can list! I promise you won't regret it! I've been to many float spas around the world. This is a family owned business with 5 star customer service vibes. They took such good care of me. I had a 90 min float followed by a 60 min hot oil massage.

I was served tea before and after, along with snacks. Water was provided. Very detailed and easy to understand instructions for how to float if you're new. Extremely clean facility with fresh towels and robes. You can tell they are genuinely kind and care about their clients well-being and enjoyment. I'm so happy I found this place and plan to visit again before I leave the area. Well worth the price!

reviews.name: YT W
reviews.text:
I’ve been here three times during my stay in Chiang Mai. The masseuse — Air — is the best I’ve encountered out of my ten visits to Thailand. Unlike other masseuses who may follow a basic routine, Air is attentive and customizes the massage to suit individual needs. For example, she immediately recognized my office syndrome and treated it with great care.

There may be many places around Chiang Mai that are cheaper, but if the massage isn’t deep enough, you might find yourself needing it more often. In contrast, Air’s massage is so thorough and relaxing that it lasts — you won’t need another session anytime soon.

By the way, the salt cave is refreshing, and the floating is worth a try.

In conclusion, I really love this place and would absolutely recommend it. I’ve only had massages with Air, so I can’t speak for the others, but the owners are super friendly. I’ll definitely come back here on my next trip. Hope to see you all again soon!

reviews.name: Whistle Blower
reviews.text:
I had every intention of trying this spa after walking past it earlier in the day. It looked inviting, so I decided to come back that evening.

Before going in, I was finishing a cigarette well away from the entrance. The group the owner was upset with wasn't directly in front of the spa either. They were further down the road outside a nearby bar. That's what made the whole situation seem so strange to me.

The foreign owner suddenly came outside and began loudly confronting the group while what appeared to be recording them with a body-worn camera or similar device. Unfortunately, he also seemed to assume I was with them and directed comments toward me, even though I wasn't part of the group.

What really put me off wasn't that he objected to people smoking. It was the way he handled it. From my perspective, it came across like someone having a temper tantrum rather than handling the situation calmly or professionally. If he genuinely believed there was a problem, there are more appropriate ways to deal with it than yelling at people who weren't even standing in front of his business.

The entire interaction felt awkward, confrontational, and honestly a bit unsettling. It's not the kind of first impression you'd expect from a place that's supposed to promote relaxation and wellness.

Because of that experience, I decided not to go inside. I can't comment on the quality of the massages or the spa itself because I never became a customer. My decision was based entirely on that interaction, which unfortunately was enough for me to take my business elsewhere.

reviews.name: Charles Raney
reviews.text: The 60min salt float was very unique and relaxing. The hot oil massage was excellent. I was served tea, cold facial towel, and water before going up. Tea and fruit served afterward. The owner gave very detailed instructions on using the salt floating room, shower and tub. Salt rooms are all unique and beautiful. Enjoyed talking with Renato and staff relaxing afterward. I have already booked another visit  for this week. For me prices are higher than some places but I feel it was worth it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Charles, too kind. We still need to improve something in our Spa.

reviews.name: P
reviews.text:
Very impressive!! Recommended!!💯

Very nice and clean spa. Staffs are very polite and professional. Drinks, snacks and all related stuffs such as towels and slippers are well prepared.

It is my first time for sensory deprivation so I was quite nervous but turned out that I had such a great experience. My muscles feel so relaxed. Foot massage is also great as well.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you !!!!

reviews.name: Richard
reviews.text:
I saw the Relaxing Emotions Spa sign advertising the salt caves, so I googled the place to find out more. It was then that I discovered they offered float sessions. I floated once in the States, so I was eager to do it again. I paid Relaxing Emotions Spa a visit to inquire about floating and ended up getting an hour-long foot massage then and there. The massage therapist was rhythmic with her moves almost as if what she was doing was an art. When she finished my feet and legs, I was surprised to find out the price also included my neck and shoulders. Afterward, I was given tea and fresh fruit. The owner and I chatted a bit as well, and I made reservations for a floating session the next day. He also showed me the salt rooms, which I’d definitely like to use someday.

I went back and did an 80-minute float session. Although the room was never pitch black, I was able to relax deeply. It seemed like I was in the tub for 30 minutes when 80 had actually elapsed. It was a great experience, and the owner plans to make some improvements to make it better. Same fruit and tea afterward. I’m looking forward to my next visit(s).
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much Richard, you are too kind to us. I just got the new switches for the tub, the old ones are malfunctioning now. After installed you can open and close the music again and turn off the lights of the stars on the ceiling and the lights inside the tub. I will also improve the quality of the music inside the VSC with two new speakers and a new amplifier. Music doesn't transmit the same way in air or in our Magnesium salt saturated water. There will also be another improvement: a music only or music option with a short but effective spoken lesson that teaches you how to breathe well to relax. Then follows another lesson that continues to teach how to relax body and mind. Usually you can't listen to it all and you sink into a very relaxing deep sleep phase. This option will help beginners, floating expert lovers usually do not need it.

reviews.name: Jason Moriarty
reviews.text: Most people come here for the salt room and bath, but we stumbled in for a foot massage and were blown away. As of Jan 2026, it’s 280 THB for an hour, and you get the experience of a 5 star spa. Quiet air conditioned environment and comfortable chairs. Also the sign on the outside says they close at midnight but if you arrive at 11:59 pm they will still take you - most places around don’t do this. We came back 5 times in 3 days 😂 trust me - check out this hidden gem!!!💎 we get a lot of massages and went to a lot of spas, we know quality!

reviews.text: Fantastic experience. An oasis of well-being. From the welcome to the end you enjoy every second. A great experience on a trip to Chiang Mai that you won't forget and will happily come back to. see you next time. Thanks 😊

reviews.name: Ohm Rooms
reviews.text: Relaxing Emotions Spa is just a short walk from Tha Phae Gate, close to food, cafés, temples, and cultural spots, which makes it very easy to plan a visit during the day. The space feels calm and open, and the staff are genuinely attentive. The salt float is a special experience and can help release a lot of tension, both mentally and physically. It is one of those sessions where you come out feeling lighter and more centered. The massage was also deeply relaxing and helped the body recover. It is a great place to reset and take a real break from the busier side of Chiang Mai.

Local Health Dept. that gave us the Spa Licence, was very happy that we have  Floatation in Chiang Mai, something new and something that go well together with Thai massages.

title: Sit Thaharnaek
ownerDescription:
The Sit Thaharnaek Muay Thai Gym is run by Kru Hua and his family. Kru Hua has over 500 fights and was at one point ranked number two at the Rajadamern stadium in Bangkok. Together with his trainers, he will be happy to teach you both basics as well as advanced skills in muay thai.

Sit Thaharnaek is a great gym to train in while you are on holidays in Chiang Mai or if you would like to stay longer to focus on your training and/or fighting. Kru Hua trains fighters from all over the world and if you would like to fight in Chiang Mai this can be arranged from the gym.
facebook: Sit Thaharnaek Muaythai
Instagram: sitthaharnaekmuaythai
address: 53 moo 3 Moo Baan benjarong Han Kaeo 50230, Hang Dong District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
street: 53 moo 3 Moo Baan benjarong Han Kaeo 50230

reviews.name: Tawan Saetang
reviews.text: Friendly training environment. Even though professional fighters are training here and you have zero experience, all level fighters are welcomed here. A little bit far from the city but the price for training compensates your travel cost or even more affordable than some of those in the city. Trainers and gym owner are spectacular. Nice, full of laughter, and ready to take care of every bit of your training.

reviews.name: Shelley Chang
reviews.text: I've never done muay thai, or any boxing, so I was a bit nervous about coming here, but everyone was really welcoming. The instructions were more clear and easy to follow than the other gym we tried. There are 6~7 trainers every day, and different trainers will notice and make you focus on different aspects of your form. There a serious fighters training here, but as a non-fighter, I had some really, really good workouts. They were also great with my seven year old kid. They got him to work (not a simple task) but made him feel like he was having a good time.

reviews.name: alexis cappadoro
reviews.text: Excellent gym for both beginners and experienced athletes. The coaches correct mistakes and are very professional. I highly recommend this gym.

reviews.name: Rob H
reviews.text: Only spent a morning training here with my family on a short stay in Chiang Mai. They worked us hard and it was great for all our different levels. The kids were well catered for - they are 6 and 8 and the guys here were brilliant with them. They pushed me hard enough to make me feel like puking too - just what I needed after too much sitting on my butt drinking beer. Loved it. I’m sure you will too. 5 stars all the way.

reviews.name: Kagan Fulford
reviews.text:
This place was SO much fun!!! I was looking for somewhere to take a group of friends for my husband's birthday & after reading reviews, we decided to give it a try.

They treated us with so much respect, even though we most likely looked ridiculous!! We had 3 girls and 3 guys and had a blast! I will definitely be back! Also, the prices are hard to beat for what you get!

Amazing service!!!

reviews.name: Francisco FrancoAfonso
reviews.text:
In Chiang Mai after searching in detail I chose Sit Thaharnaek for one week intensive, 4 hours a day and it could not be better.

Very honest, professional and one to one only depending on your drive and body to improve.

The location, ambiance, equipment, the attention, the price and the team are all very good. I will be back!

reviews.name: Tajudin65
reviews.text:
An hour group training is 400baht or you may train with personal trainer 700baht and hour or 900baht and hour with the master.
Which ever training you choose is worth the money coz the experience is overwhelming. No appointments needed, just walk in and bring your sports attire. Gloves provided foc

reviews.name: David George
reviews.text: If youre looking for an authentic muay thai gym with world class trainers then this is your place. Its a little bit of a drive, but it is a true muay thai training facility with roosters roaming and gorgeous vegetation in the background.  Highly recommend

reviews.name: Benjamin
reviews.text: We stumbled across this Muay Thai Gym by accident, decided to try it for one session. As a result we got hooked to it and decided to do it 3 times a week, for 4 weeks ! The coach is very nice and the atmosphere is very friendly there, even though people do train hard. We were complete beginners and came for fun, but we did our best and put a lot of efforts into it. Their teaching method is adapted to anyone and very cheerful and motivating. Sometimes they also arrange trips to see real matchs, and can also get you to fight if you are willing to (and if you are ready of course !). We will miss those guys and wish them only the best for the rest !

reviews.name: Alice Becklake
reviews.text:
I have trained at this gym twice already and I cannot wait to do double sessions for the rest of the 7 days I am here. I'm a little bit of an experience fighter and I've gained so much more knowledge from what they have taught me, they are also very very good with begginnera,I'd probably say this is one of the best gyms with a good price in Chiang Mai!
The Trainers are lovely and speak quite good English. Definitely will come back!

reviews.name: Alec McKenzie
reviews.text: I spent a week training at Sit Thaharnaek Muay Thai Gym and I have no hesitation recommending them. The staff were friendly, spoke good English and pushed me hard while making sure I enjoyed my time there. They gave me an excellent introduction to Muay Thai as it was my first time. They also cater to the long-term professional fighters as the trainers are past champions in their own right. You are sure to get a great workout at Sit Thaharnaek Muay Thai Gym and I thank all the great people there for my great experience.

reviews.name: Spencer Pooghkay
reviews.text: Absolutely top tier gym. I came into this gym having about a year of experience and realized that I still have so much more to learn. The instructors give lots of 1 on 1 time. Very friendly environment, would recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.name: Marc Tassilly
reviews.text: One of the best in town. We booked a family training for 5 days, 1 hr every day (private lessons). We train at intermediate level and children once in a while when in holidays. Very central location in Chiang Mai. Could walk from our hotel (Anantara). Great instructors, all very experienced (professional fighters at top level) and teaching seriously all ages and levels. Had a great time. Learned a lot. Very nice atmosphere. Instructors really caring and nice to children. Kids loved it too. Will definitively come back!

reviews.name: Joel
reviews.text: Great trainers and hard training if your a fighter. Recommend, I've been to many boxing camps all over Thailand

reviews.name: Sebastien Bourret
reviews.text:
I was lucky enough to train there 3 days in a row there.
Classic but serious training: running or jumping rope / warm up / shadow boxing / pad (the number of rounds depends of how many people are here, at least 3, up to 5. Each one was 4 min. The Kru is holding the pad) / bag work. You train with the guys who are fighting for the gym.
Trainers are motivated, involved and help you to improve your skills. I got what I paid for, I definitely recommend this place to train.

reviews.name: Glyn Evans
reviews.text: I came here and found this gym by chance , I am 56 years and have been doing Muay Thai on and off since 1988 . Kru Hua is a absolutely fantastic coach and I had 1-1 lessons off him every day during my 1 week stay there . He had over 500 fights and the knowledge that he knows has to be seen to be believed.  This is a camp for beginners and also advanced of this wonderful sport . Fantastic coach and fantastic warm family camp  Glyn UK

reviews.name: Michel Davit
reviews.text: I went there to learn the basics of Muay Thai during a short stay in Chiang Mai. I only could do 2 sessions and it was amazing. The coaches are super nice and they teach you a maximum of techniques with fun exercises. Prepare to sweat!

reviews.name: Brandon R
reviews.text: I trained her once as a drop in way back in 2019. They accommodated me, made me feel welcome, and gave a great workout.

reviews.name: Kelly Pereira
reviews.text: Excellent trainer Kru Hua!!! He has over 500 fights in 15 years. His son is 12 and has had 85 fights already. But what made me stay longer was the way he teaches and how he explains things. I had done private sessions with other people in other gyms but nobody bothered to correct me on my absolute basics. Hua broke it down to all the real basics and corrected my form. In 1 session with him I progressed more than I did in 2/3 sessions with other people. He uses different techniques and does not allow you to move on if you're not on point. A part from a great trainer he welcomes all his students as family. Often e offered us food, fruit shakes and we even got to celebrate his birthday with him and his family. Honestly the best school I have trained at so far. A lot of the guys I met at the school come and stay for months, and come to Sit Thaharnaek year after year! I enjoyed my time here and will definitely come back.

reviews.name: M Y
reviews.text:
Pros:
-very tourist friendly and about half the adult class is European/american born
-very one on one, and they were good at giving tips to tweek technique
-good mix of conditioning, drills, and sparring

Cons
-batbrooms were dirty and a bit secluded. Also the facility itself was a bit dirty, but it's the only Thailand place I tried, so maybe this level of cleanliness is the standard
-I'm used to 1 hour classes in North America so after the 1.5 hour mark, I was mentally checked out

reviews.text:

Apparently there was a small happy hour promo of lesser thb 50 as we arrived before 8pm (promotion will vary of  course), so my massage cost thb 300 and they also provided tea. They also were not greedy about the amount of tips we gave (at least not in front of us).

Not bad to go if you are shopping in the area, such as at platinum mall or at December's.

reviews.name: PRIYA DUBEY
reviews.text: I tried few places in past one week, but this is really hidden jam. Had a really relaxing foot massage here. The place was clean, calm, and well maintained. The therapist was professional and knew exactly where to focus. I felt so much lighter and relaxed after the session. Definitely coming back again. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are happy and pleased to have served you and hope to serve you again in the future. Thank you.

reviews.name: Putri Eky

reviews.name: Mickey T
reviews.text:
Siam Massage at Grand Diamond Hotel: A Runner's Paradise

Seven years ago, I experienced my first traditional Thai massage in Phuket, and recently, while staying at the Grand Diamond Hotel in Bangkok, I decided to treat myself to another one at their in-house Siam Massage. I was not disappointed!

Taking advantage of their happy hour discount, I indulged in a full-body Thai massage for only 300 THB. As an avid runner, I especially appreciated the attention given to my calves, thighs, hamstrings, and forearms – areas that often bear the brunt of my training. The therapist skillfully worked on these specific muscle groups, easing tension and leaving me feeling rejuvenated.

Beyond the targeted muscle work, the overall experience was fantastic. The air-conditioned room provided a welcome respite from the Bangkok heat, allowing for complete relaxation. The therapist was professional and knowledgeable, ensuring a comfortable and therapeutic session.

If you're seeking a quality Thai massage in Bangkok, especially if you're a runner in need of some muscle TLC, I highly recommend Siam Massage at the Grand Diamond Hotel. Don't forget to check for their happy hour discounts for an even more rewarding experience!

reviews.name: Bn JN
reviews.text: The place is very nice and well designed and clean. The menu a little confusing. The massage was ok, not that special but a little pricy. They have oil massage and aroma massage i asked for coconut oil massage they charged me for aroma massage which is 1000 baht for 90 minutes. Could be also my mistake but surely i will not go back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Official Statement from Hatthasinvech
Thank you to our customer for sharing their feedback. We respect that each customer may have a different experience and perspective.

As the review refers to the massage type, oil used, pricing and sequence of events, we believe it is important to provide clarification for the benefit of other readers.
Before responding, we carefully reviewed the available information from multiple sources, including payment and service records, security footage, discussions with the staff involved, relevant communications and information exchanged following the service. Our response is therefore based on a comparison of available records rather than on the account of either party alone. We confirm that the information below concerns the same incident described in the review.
 1. Massage Type, Oil and Pricing
On August 28 at 3:30 PM, two walk-in customers initially selected our 90-minute Aroma Massage and requested separate rooms.
During the service, after returning from the restroom, there was a request concerning the use of coconut oil. Our review found a misunderstanding regarding the type of oil and the applicable massage program.
For clarity, our prices at that time were:
Coconut Oil Massage, 90 minutes: THB 859
Aroma Massage, 90 minutes: THB 1,099
Our team understood that the customer wished to use our specially selected cold-pressed coconut oil, normally reserved for specific treatments such as facial and head massage and for customers requiring particularly gentle care, including children and pregnant women. This oil differs from the coconut oil used in our standard Coconut Oil Massage program.
We acknowledge that when the oil or massage program is changed, our staff should clearly reconfirm the oil, program, duration and price before proceeding. This was a communication error on our part, and we sincerely apologize.
There was no intention to overcharge the customer or deliberately change the service. We have reviewed and improved our procedures to prevent similar misunderstandings.
 2. Therapist Selection
The initial therapist was assigned according to the queue and circumstances at the time. When the customer requested a change of therapist, we respected the request and arranged a female therapist as requested.
 3. Professional Boundaries
During the service, a request was made that was outside the scope of health massage services provided by Hatthasinvech. The therapist politely declined and continued with the selected health massage program.
Hatthasinvech provides health massage services only. Every therapist has the right to maintain appropriate professional boundaries and to respectfully decline requests that are outside professional standards. Such a refusal should not be interpreted as poor service or a lack of professionalism. Maintaining these boundaries is part of ensuring safety, professional ethics and respect within the profession.
 4. Our Commitment
We take responsibility for the areas where our communication fell short, particularly regarding the oil, program and pricing, and we have taken steps to improve our procedures.
At the same time, we have a responsibility to protect the professional standards and dignity of our therapists. A therapist is not required to accept a request when it falls outside the scope of professional health massage services.
Our intention is not to argue with or blame the customer. We simply wish to provide the facts based on the information available to us, so readers can consider the situation fairly from both perspectives.
At Hatthasinvech, we remain committed to:
Professional Health Massage
Respect for Professional Boundaries
Respect for Both Customers and Service Providers
Thank you for taking the time to read our statement and for all feedback that helps us continuously improve our standards of service. 🙏🏻🤍         
Health Massage • Professional Care • Respect for the Profession

reviews.name: Mi Mi
reviews.text:
Such a lovely little gem! ✨ The salon is new, super clean, and nicely decorated — feels fresh and cozy. It’s only about a 10-minute walk from The One Chiang Mai condo, and booking was quick and easy.

The staff were all very friendly and welcoming. But what stood out most to me was the atmosphere — soft music, warm lighting, subtle scents… everything felt peaceful and relaxing. For the Thai massage, they give you a comfy outfit to wear, and after the session, they serve a cup of tea, which was such a nice touch.

It honestly felt like stepping into a little bubble of calm😌 Highly recommend if you’re looking to unwind.

reviews.name: Sofia Wakabayashi
reviews.text:
I had an amazing 60-min foot massage here and absolutely loved the experience. The space was calm and welcoming, with thoughtful touches like ginger tea, small snacks, and a relaxing foot scrub to start.

What really stood out was the skill of the masseuse. She intuitively found knots in my feet and ankles I didn’t even realize I had and worked different pressure points on each side based on where the tension actually was. I’ve had many foot massages, and you can truly tell when someone is experienced.

She even managed to pop every one of my toes (which has never happened before!) and I left feeling incredibly relaxed and relieved. A bit of a hidden gem with genuinely skilled therapists.

It’s also a bit of a hidden gem in a great little area just around the corner from Central Festival Mall, with restaurants and places to sit nearby, making it easy to grab food before or after your massage.
