reviews.name: M H
reviews.text:
Beware - the pricing display is NOT accurate. Found out after the service was already provided that the aroma massage is NOT 399 per hour as advertised. Instead it is 799 (400 baht difference?!) it is unacceptable. We even have a generous tips to the therapists. Shouldn’t the price you displayed, advertised would be honored?!

The receptionist just apologize and said the pricing sheet is incorrect. 🤔
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Esteemed Guest 🙏🏻

Please allow us to extend our most sincere apologies for the discrepancy in the displayed price of the aroma massage service. This matter arose from an inadvertent error in our printed program menu, which has since been thoroughly reviewed and corrected to ensured that there was no intention to mislead or cause any inconvenience. 

📌For the sake of transparency, we wish to clarify that the aroma massage program has never been offered at the price of 399 THB. The figure displayed was solely a typographical error, which we fully acknowledge and deeply regret. For your reference, all official communication, social media platforms, and  previous customer reviews reflect the correct and consistent pricing. 

As a  gesture of our goodwill and sincere regret, we would be honored to extend a special privilege or compensation for your next visit. We earnestly hope to have the opportunity to serve you  again and to restore your confidence in our services

With our highest regard and deepest appreciation,
The Hatthasinvech Team

reviews.name: David W
reviews.text: Very clean and modern. All the massage persons had great pressure power, however it lacked the precise location of where it should be applied to. Also no stretching in the thai massage package. Most people who haven't been to a really really good place, you will most likely not know the difference.  We've been to literally hundreds of places and even more massages in different countries. Overall a pretty good place. $399/hr for standard thai style.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Costumer,

On behalf of Hatthasinvech Health Massage, we sincerely thank you for taking the time to share your review and thoughtful feedback. We are delighted to know that you appreciated the cleanliness, modern atmosphere, and the massage pressure delivered by our therapists. 

At the same time, we truly value your constructive comments regarding the precision of pressure points and the absence of stretching in our traditional Thai massage package. Your insights are extremely helpful, and we will take them into account as we continue to train our staff and improve the overall quality of our services.

📌Further Explanation for Better Understanding
Potential Effects of Stretching and Twisting Techniques in Traditional Thai Massage 

While stretching and twisting are part of traditional Thai massage techniques,in some case, these practices may have adverse effects on health-especially when performed inappropriately or without proper assessment of the recipient's physical condition. Such actions may result in the following issues: 
• Risk to the spine: Forceful twisting or bending may cause intervertebral displacement or accelerate disc degeneration. 
• Impact on the nervous system: Movements that affect the spine may compress nerves, leading to numbness or radiating pain in the arms, legs, or back.
• Muscle or tendon injuries: Overstretching can cause muscle or tendon tears without immediate awareness.
• Unsuitable for the elderly or individuals with chronic
conditions: For example, those with osteoporosis, joint degeneration, or individuals recovering from surgery.

For these reasons, our establishment has chosen to offer massage techniques that prioritize safety by avoiding forceful stretching or twisting. 
This ensures a relaxing 
experience with effective results,while minimizing the risk of injury in both the short and long term.

We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back in the near future, with an even more satisfying experience.

Should you have any further feedback or inquiries,please feel free to contact us at tel:0979474998

Warm regards, 
Hatthasinvech Health Massage Team 🙏🏻💖

reviews.name: Pakawat Jeansuwan
reviews.text:
มีโอกาสมาทำงานที่เชียงใหม่ หลังจากทำงานเสร็จก่อนกลับเข้ากทม. ญาติๆแนะนำปากต่อปากว่าให้มานวดผ่อนคลายร้านนี้ก่อนหลังจากเหนื่อยล้ามานาน ความรู้สึกที่ได้มาสัมผัสที่ร้านครั้งแรก ร้านบรรยากาศดีมากๆ ให้ความรู้สึกผ่อนคลายตั้งแต่เดินเข้ามา ร้านสะอาดดูปอดโปร่ง มี welcome drink เป็นจอกน้ำชาร้อนๆมาคอยต้อนรับ พนักงานพูดคุยให้คำแนะนำแก่ลูกค้าดีมากๆ หลังจากได้ปรึกษากับเพื่อนๆในทีม จึงเลือกคอร์สนวดออฟฟิศซินโดรมไปคนละ 60 min

หลังจากเข้ารับบริการเสร็จ ทางพนักงานนวดได้อย่างมืออาชีพและมีความละเอียดสูงมากๆ โดนทุกจุดที่ปวดล้าจากการทำงานได้อย่างแม่นยำ อีกทั้งทางร้านยังแถมเวลาให้พวกเราที่ดันมาเลทเลยเวลาที่จองไปด้วย ขอบคุณทางร้านที่มอบประสบการณ์ดีๆ ในการมานวดผ่อนคลายในครั้งนี้มากๆครับ ไว้โอกาสหน้าจะมาใช้บริการใหม่อย่างแน่นอนครับ
reviews.textTranslated:
I had the opportunity to work in Chiang Mai. After finishing work and before returning to Bangkok, relatives recommended this massage shop for relaxation after a long period of exhaustion. My first impression was that the atmosphere was wonderful; it felt relaxing from the moment I walked in. The shop was clean and airy, and they offered a welcome drink of hot tea. The staff were very friendly and helpful. After discussing with my team, we opted for a 60-minute office syndrome massage each.

After the service, the masseuse was incredibly professional and meticulous, accurately targeting every sore and tired point from work. They even added extra time for us because we arrived late. Thank you so much to the shop for providing such a wonderful and relaxing massage experience. I will definitely use their services again in the future.

I had never trained Muay Thai before and found this gym through Google Maps. I ended up training here for three months straight and had a great experience.

The members are also great. I met a lot of experienced people who were always happy to give me advice or explain techniques when I needed help. The atmosphere feels welcoming and relaxed.

The price is definitely fair, especially since you can stay and train for as long as you want until closing time. As a student, price matters a lot to me, and I think you get good value for your money.

There is a really nice ring available for sparring, as well as gloves, hand wraps, and shin guards if needed. The bags and equipment are also good.

This is not a commercial fitness-style gym. It feels much more like a local neighborhood Muay Thai gym with a chill atmosphere and a strong sense of community.

I would 110% recommend it to any beginner who wants to try Muay Thai and learn in a friendly environment.

reviews.name: Angelic Kreations
reviews.text:
Thai Massage Conservation Club  A Review from the Heart

This massage stayed with me.

The work was done by a blind practitioner who was absolutely amazing. I regret that I cannot recall his name, but the care, skill, and intention in his hands spoke clearly for him. There was a depth to the massage that went beyond technique. It felt grounded, present, and respectful of the body as a whole.

I want to share something thoughtfully and with care. When traveling, especially for those of us whose immune systems can be sensitive at times, cleanliness matters deeply. I was mindful of that going in. The linens and coverings were clean, and you could even smell that fresh laundry scent, which immediately put me at ease.

If I had one gentle suggestion, offered as a training observation and not a complaint, it would be about sound. I personally prefer massages to be quiet so the body can fully soften. During my session, there was a lively conversation happening nearby between another practitioner and a returning guest. The energy was joyful and friendly, which is beautiful, but it did slightly pull from the stillness of the moment. Some guests, like me, come seeking silence as part of the healing.

One thing I truly loved was what followed. The fruit and tea afterward were such a warm, welcoming touch. It is a simple gesture, but it says a lot about how guests are cared for beyond the table.

What stood out most was the spirit of the place. People here love what they do, and it shows. Chiang Mai carries the reputation it does for a reason. There is an understanding of peace here. No one is concerned with who you are or what you do. They are focused on their craft, welcoming you in, and treating you with genuine respect. For many people in the world, that kind of experience is rare, and it matters.

I would absolutely return.

One important note for visitors, shared so others do not experience confusion. There are two locations with the same name, and they do not offer the same services. Blind massage is available here. Vitamin C shots are not. I initially thought I was going to a location that offered both. That part is simply something to be mindful of when planning your visit.

Everything is in divine order, and I look forward to returning, receiving another massage, and getting that vitamin C shot next time at the correct location.

Grateful for the care, the craft, and the humanity.

There were 8 blind masters , service is good, they let us take shower. But no music. Atmosphere is good. Dark room. All is clean , they give you clothe if you need and also there is a small coffee place. You can see this on my photo.

reviews.name: chiangmaicharlies
reviews.text:
Located in Ratchamanka Road, opposite the large city block with Wat Chedi Luang in the middle.  Not the easiest place to find and get to, due to the one way systems, but well worth finding, and easy with Google Maps.

Very clean and tidy rooms with a number of blind and sighted masseurs and masseuses.  Much more worth going to for a 'blind massage' - which is quite different to a relaxing massage.  A blind masseur or masseuse will find pressure points on your body and use them to release pain there.

After your massage you are presented with a tea and plate of fruit, which you can consume at the front of the building whilst people watching.  I'm sure you can order a drink and snack here, in the most comfortable surroundings, without having a massage - but it's much better combining with a massage.

Highly recommended.

reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience. I have had a couple of massages in Chiang Mai and this was by far the worst. I found myself constantly having to explain what to do, which completely defeats the purpose of going for a relaxing massage.

There was no flow at all, the lady kept randomly and repeatedly working on the same areas. I had to repeatedly ask her to move to other parts.

Unfortunately it was my last day in Chiang Mai and this experience really dampened my mood after an otherwise amazing week in the city. What made it worse was the response from the owner/front desk staff. When I shared my feedback she seemed to not care at all.

Chiang Mai has a massage or spa at almost every corner so I would definitely recommend choosing another place.

reviews.name: Philip Chan
reviews.text:
I recently visited the Thai Massage Conservation Club and tried a blind massage for the first time — honestly, it was incredible. I’ve been to massage places all over the world, many of them 10 times more expensive, and nothing compares to this.

The blind therapists can’t see, but they make up for it with an incredible sensitivity to muscle tension. It felt like they could scan my body like a human X-ray, finding every knot and tight spot without me saying anything. Most massages feel good during the session but the pain comes back afterward — this is the first time I actually felt healed.

The price is extremely reasonable at 400 baht per hour, and I highly recommend booking 2 hours to get the full benefit.

One of the best massage experiences I’ve ever had. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Happy

reviews.name: Naomi Boxall
reviews.text:
I've discovered that I'm actually just a bundle of knots held together in skin.

So just as well I popped in here as I was walking past: I was massaged by a blind man named Somjit and he started by asking me what pressure I wanted. I chose medium and then after the confusion about starting on my side, we began.

Somjit managed to find every single bit of tension i knew about, and many more besides. He was very respectful, often apologising before delivering a push into a pressure point that he knew would cause a moment of distress. Or, after he knew I wasn't so fond of the clicking. Yet, we worked through all the kinks, and I'm sat having fruit and tea afterwards wondering where all this space in my body came from.

The room was very clean and though the music was tinkly and on a loop, it was good background for the middle space between paying attention and zoning out. Even now, the woman at the reception is wiping down the areas that might have become dusty in the last few hours.

I can honestly recommend this massage venue.

reviews.text:

The atmosphere is friendly for beginners but will allow more experienced fighters to have good training too.
A great place with good training!

reviews.name: Paige O'Connor
reviews.text:
Note for English speakers using Grab: the gym didn't come up when I typed "Phetsiam", but if you copy the address directly from Google it will take you to the right place.

Everyone is so kind and welcoming here! I came to the gym at the recommendation of a friend who lives in Bangkok and had a great private lesson with Miw. The owners and many of the trainers came over to chat and welcome me right away.

For the training, the structure was: stretching warm up, shadowboxing, pad rounds, and sparring rounds; the trainer also helped me stretch after. One of the owners recorded a few rounds for me, which I thought was really thoughtful. I have a few years of a experience, but no fights--they helped point out a few things I should improve if I want to fight, like lateral movement. I liked that we were able to spar in the ring.

The gym is super clean and nice. I brought my own gear, but it looked like they had plenty of clean gear to borrow if you need.

Miw gave more specific pointers than the other trainers I've worked with in Thailand, rather than just doing a fast paced pad round. This was good, especially because I wasn't feeling well the day of my lesson and couldn't go too hard. I saw some beginners being trained, so it seems like the gym is good for all levels.

The training was great, but what really stood out was how kind everyone was. I wish I were staying longer so I take the group class and more private sessions. Check out their instagram if you want to see the vibe, they post a lot. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: A N
reviews.text:
Where do I even begin... I thought I had experienced all the Muay Thai gyms until I found Krugot Muay Thai Gym. I initially bought 4 private lessons without thinking much of it, other than the fact that they were conveniently located near where I was staying. But wow – every single session has been fantastic!

A few things that make them stand out from other gyms:
✨ The owners are incredibly enthusiastic and passionate about Muay Thai. Their love for the art is contagious, and they genuinely care about their clients' growth, health, and wellness. Even if they aren't the ones directly training you, they’re engaged and present, cheering you on and supporting the coaches throughout your development.

✨ The coaches are top-notch, and the quality control in teaching is evident. I primarily trained with Kru Petchsiri, one of their active fighters, and he was amazing. He could quickly read how I move, offering progressive challenges that helped me adapt and grow. He not only refined my technique but also helped me find a flow that worked naturally for me. Watching him in action during demonstrations added another layer to my learning process.

✨ The welcoming atmosphere makes you feel like you’ve been part of the gym forever. They treat you like an old friend, not just a client. I found it thoughtful and kind that they record your training and take photos for you – a fantastic way to track progress or share on social media.

I genuinely enjoyed every moment here and will definitely be coming back when I return to Bangkok. The pricing is great, the environment is supportive, and the training is top-tier. I highly recommend Krugot Muay Thai Gym to anyone looking for an exceptional Muay Thai experience. I will continue to practice and use what I've learned from them. I’ll miss this place and the incredible people until my next visit!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I checked the CCTV footage at the massage parlor and found no record of you actually coming to Kanya's shop. It must be a misunderstanding; you probably went to another shop. If it were my shop, I would listen and be willing to improve, but this is not the truth.

reviews.name: Alexis Ng

This place is a joke. The first masseuse I got did not know massage at all and kept putting her weight on my spinal cord while massaging my back.

She did know know any proper massage technique and was very haphazard in the way she did it. Also kept moving up and down the bed several times as if she couldn't decide what she wanted to do.

I made a fuss and asked to change my full body oil massage duration from 2 hours to 1 hour as it was not enjoyable at all. They then asked a different masseuse to massage me. She at least was better but still not so good. Just used a lot of oil, way more than needed and it was very basic massage with no knowledge of how to control the pressure in the right places.

In the end I left feeling even more sore and uncomfortable than before I did the massage there.

There are many many massage places in Chiang Mai so do yourself a favour and avoid this one even if the prices are quite low. That may explain the lack of standards here. Very disappointing!

reviews.text:
visited this place with a friend at around 10 PM.
My friend was massaged by a young lady who was strong and clearly skilled in proper foot massage techniques.
But the lady who massaged me (I believe she’s the oldest in the shop) did the complete opposite. For the entire hour, she just rubbed oil on my legs without applying any real pressure. I couldn’t feel any massage at all – it was all just for show. Even when I looked at her with obvious discomfort, she kept pretending to focus, but in reality, she wasn’t doing anything meaningful.
The price is very cheap, but I was truly disappointed with the service. I didn’t complain to the owner only because she is quite old, almost like my mother’s age.
I’m writing this review to warn future customers to be extremely careful if you get this particular lady.

reviews.name: Lawrence Goh
reviews.text:
We stayed at the hotel upstairs for 5 nights and somehow ended up getting massages 4 nights 😂 Three of those were here.

Every massage was great. The therapists were really skilled, knew exactly where the tight spots were, and we always walked out feeling so much better. They stayed focused the whole time, no chatting with each other, no rushing, and never once asked or hinted for tips. We actually had to stop them to give them one. 🤣🤣

We liked it so much that we told our family to come too. All 5 of us walked in without a booking and somehow they got us all in straight away. The place was actually pretty busy every time we went, so we thought that was impressive.

Prices are super reasonable for what you get. The cashier (I think she’s the owner) was always really friendly and polite.

They also have a sweet meow hanging around. 😸You can tell they genuinely care about it instead of using it as an attraction, which was nice to see.

This isn’t one of those fancy luxury spas, but that’s honestly part of the charm. It’s simple, authentic, traditional, comfortable, and just a really solid Thai massage. We’d definitely come back next time we’re in town.

I trained at Thiakla Muay Thai for 3 months. I had an amazing experience. The family orientated environment makes you feel like you’re part of the team right from the get go. The coaches are experienced, light hearted, competitive, happy, dedicated people. They take pride in teaching you proper technique, but also in making sure you enjoyed your time with them. Sparring on the top floor at sunset never gets old!! If you’re looking to dial in your skills & have a fight or two, or get in the best shape of your life; I highly recommend Thiakla Muay Thai Gym!

To my coaches Parichat, Raeng & Paithong. Thank you for everything. I cannot wait to see you guys in the fall!

Me as just a starter with 3 lessons experience:

instead of doing the standard moves and following up with basic padwork. He helped me to actually increase my fight IQ and find/create openings, light sparring, and everything reflecting real situations.

title: The Yoga Shala Phuket
ownerDescription: Traditional Ashtanga Yoga Shala Phuket (TAYSP) is a unique center of wellness where the ancient yoga techniques meet modern researches on health and well being. Weather you wish to attend daily Ashtanga yoga classes or take a weight loss course you find here the right environment where professional specialists take care of you with personal support and training.

reviews.name: ERINI DIMA
reviews.text:
I've been practicing Ashtanga yoga for 10 years. Any Ashtanga practitioner knows that after years of practice, there comes a moment when determination and joy in practicing significantly decrease. I went to Phuket on vacation and happened to visit this studio. It was the most wonderful thing I've done in recent years. In the first class, I felt the joy I used to feel in my first years of practice. In this studio you can practices the real Ashtanga as teached by Patabijois (the first thing I noticed when I got in the studio was the sound of the breath). There is a strong focus on breathing and the correct execution of the asanas. The adjustments are amazing, and your body thanks you for it immediately. I felt I was entering the postures much deeper, and I didn't feel in danger at all with the adjustments. I haven't felt this much awareness in my practice for years. I was so thrilled that I extended my stay in Phuket and plan to attend the intensive Ashtanga course this year.

I wholeheartedly recommend this studio and Rich and Sofya, who certainly know what they are doing and do it wonderfully. ❤️

reviews.name: Cecilia Colella
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience! I joined the Ashtanga Intensive Course and absolutely loved it. Sofya and Rich are incredible teachers, so attentive, passionate, and deeply knowledgeable. They offer constant support,  the best adjustments and create such a warm and inspiring atmosphere in the shala. The program was well-structured, challenging, and full of learning. I’m leaving with a happy heart, deeply grateful for this beautiful and transformative experience. 🙏
and I’m sure I’ll be back! ♥️♥️♥️♥️ With much love and gratitude.

reviews.name: Martina Pacovská
reviews.text:
One of the most inspiring places to practice Ashtanga yoga in the world.

The teachers here are truly exceptional. Their knowledge of the body, anatomy and traditional Ashtanga practice is incredible, and they guide each student with great care, attention and respect for the individual body.

But what makes this place truly special is the atmosphere. There is something very authentic and conscious about the way yoga is taught and lived here. You can feel that yoga is not just something they teach — it is something they truly embody.

It is also beautiful to see how they raise their young son in this environment, sharing yoga and an active, mindful life with him. They are not only amazing teachers, but also wonderful human beings.

People travel from all over the world to practice here — and once you experience it, you understand why.

If you love Ashtanga yoga, this is a place you should absolutely visit at least once in your life.

reviews.name: kanjana dawongsa
reviews.text: I love this Shala,The teachers Rich and Sofia are amazing. Take care of everyone in the class. Teachers will focus on alignment. I've been doing yoga for 10 years and I never knew what the right thing was until I came to study here. I feel like every day of my yoga class here is like I'm here to workshop. !😘 I really love this place so much also love my teachers Rich and Sofia number 1 in my heart for yoga teacher 😘❤️👍👍👍👍AWESOME !!! 👍❤️

reviews.name: Региша Кулакова
reviews.text:
Great family of yoga teachers !!!
The class has an atmosphere of active work on oneself.  I easily concentrate on my breath.
After practice, I feel very easy.
Many go for many years.  I asked one student, she said that she tried yoga in different places but here is the best and she comea here from another area.  I also get great pleasure.
Thank you, teachers!

reviews.name: Sandra Dwyer
reviews.text:
Sofya & Rich are literally the best of the best in their field & have an incredibly professional & unique aptitude to yoga & its disciplines.
I hadn't practiced yoga for quite sometime before attending the yoga retreat but Rich & Sofya really build that self trust & commitment to oneself that is required to step into listening to your body & your mind more intuitively.
It was honestly one of the best experiences of my life. Committing every morning to an intense Ashtanga practice with daily breathwork, meditation and lectures on yoga related topics.

The yoga retreat was so profoundly impactful that I have decided to return & do the 200hr teacher training course.
I can't imagine attempting this with any other yoga shala .
Overall, highly highly recommend Sofya & Rich as the best mentors for guiding you through your yoga journey, Two incredible passionate people who love what they do & so driven to help others. They live and breath what they practice & are wonderful examples of what life can look like when you commit to helping others and yourself in a very pure, selfless way. Love & light is what sums them up in its totality.
Feel lucky to have met them. They have left a lasting impression on me forever more & I look so forward to attending their yoga teacher training course this year.
Thank you Sofya & Rich for the amazing experience.

reviews.name: Chiara Cerboncini
reviews.text:
My 3-week Ashtanga Yoga intensive in Phuket was truly transformative.
Thanks to my wonderful teachers, Rich and Sofya, I learned the power of slowing down the breath to bring energy to both body and mind, and the importance of giving time and space to Pranayama in daily life.
I discovered that “it has to be difficult to find the benefit”, and how Drishti and Bandhas are essential parts of the practice.
Through Sofya’s gentle way of sharing yoga philosophy, I connected deeply with my true Self — through the physical, energetic, and subconscious layers.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart, Rich and Sofya, for coming into my life. I’m sure our paths will cross again soon.

reviews.name: Amornrat Khuephat
reviews.text:
I have known their work for a long time and they are one of the most dedicated yoga teachers I have seen. Every class is well prepared and taught with great care for her students.

Maintaining high standards for certification is important for the integrity of the practice. I truly admire their professionalism and commitment.

reviews.name: Russell Kotoff
reviews.text:
I have been practicing Ashtanga Vinyasa for over 10 years. I had several different teachers. I was lucky with my teachers.

I can say with confidence that Rich and Sofia (I have been with them for more than 6 years) are really professionals.

For many years I have seen how they give knowledge and meaning to yoga itself.

There are a lot of students who come to them from different parts of the planet for many years in a row. Each of them is already a teacher himself.

And  every time, all over again, under the sensitive and competent guidance of Rich and Sophia, each of us gets to know ourselves deeper and deeper.

Thanks Rich and Sophia 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Anton Veldin
reviews.text:
I really enjoy practicing at this shala.
The classes are just the right level of intensity for me, and I appreciate the Mysore-style and led sessions.

Rich and Sofya are attentive and always take time to adjust and guide each student. Even without fully memorizing the Ashtanga sequence, I feel comfortable practicing here — especially during Mysore classes where I can follow the book and move at my own pace.

It’s a great place for anyone who wants to see steady progress in their practice.

reviews.name: Lie Franssen
reviews.text: Both Rich and Sofya are great Ashtanga teachers, fantastic adjustments, beautifull people! I was verry happy to be in TAYSP a 2nd time for the intensive Ashtanga course and I hope to repeat again. I recommend to join them and have this incredible experience!

reviews.name: Balsam o
reviews.text:
I came from Saudi Arabia on unpaid leave to learn Ashtanga Yoga, looking forward to this experience after more than ten years of practice. Unfortunately, I was very disappointed by the unprofessional behavior, negative attitude, and poor treatment I received, which made the experience frustrating and discouraging.

I later completed my training at another school in India, which was a much better experience, thank God.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Balsam,
​Thank you for sharing your perspective. However, we must clarify the facts regarding your experience at our school. At  TAYSP, we uphold the traditional standards of Ashtanga Yoga, which require a high level of physical and mental preparation, especially for a TTC 200.
​Our records and internal documentation show a different picture: you arrived without completing the required pre-course preparations and consistently declined to follow the teachers' technical instructions. Our faculty spent extra time trying to assist you, but unfortunately, you were unable to manage the intensity of the process and chose to leave mid-way.
​Regarding your claims of 'unprofessionalism' — we have documented evidence of our interactions, which clearly shows our instructors' patience and professional conduct even in challenging situations. We take the reputation of our teachers very seriously and do not accept unfounded accusations as a reaction to academic difficulties.
​We are glad you found a school that better fits your expectations, and we wish you success in your future practice

reviews.name: Sylvie Deloge
reviews.text: I completed the 3 weeks Intensive Program and really enjoyed it. All the classes were interesting and fit perfectly in the program. Sofya and Rich have a very gentle and caring approach in their teachings. I definitely learned a lot from them! In addition, the food was delicious and the accommodation was great. I loved it all soooo much that I stayed another 4 weeks so I could keep practicing with these guys a bit longer!

reviews.name: Ting Ting Qiu
reviews.text:
I had the incredible opportunity to attend a 4-week Ashtanga Yoga Intensive at The Yoga Shala Phuket last year, and I couldn't be more grateful for the experience. The course provided me with a solid foundation for my own practice, and I feel more confident in my abilities moving forward.

Sofya and Rich are exceptional teachers who truly embody the essence of Ashtanga Yoga. Their guidance was deeply inspiring. They created a supportive and authentic atmosphere, where I could focus on developing my practice while feeling cared for and encouraged.

What really stood out to me was their warmth and helpful nature. They both left a lasting impression on me with their genuine, down-to-earth approach. I’m thankful for the time spent at The Yoga Shala and highly recommend it to anyone seeking to deepen their yoga journey.

reviews.name: Jenny Schulze Hagen
reviews.text:
Authentic Ashtanga Yoga in Phuket
Deep, Aligned & Truly Healing 😍🫶🏽

I had the privilege of practicing with Rich and Sophie in Phuket, and I can say from the bottom of my heart: these two embody Yoga in its purest, most honest, and yet modernly integrated form.
Their training is not only rooted in traditional Ashtanga lineage, they studied with highly respected teachers and pass on the series with dedication and precision
but also enriched with therapeutic and anatomical expertise. Every class reflects a deep understanding of the breath, alignment, and conscious adjustments.
What touched me most is the balance between discipline and compassion:
They guide with clarity, correct with respect, and create a space where your personal limits are honored and gently expanded.
The energy they hold is both powerful and serene grounded in years of practice, true humility, and a deep connection to the essence of Yoga.
Whether you’re a complete beginner or a longtime practitioner:
Rich and Sophie meet you exactly where you are physically, energetically, and soulfully.
🙏🏽🙏🏽 Thank you both for your dedication, your presence, and your wisdom.
Your teaching resonates far beyond the mat.🤍

reviews.name: Nantakarn Sangwarn -
reviews.text: “A peaceful yoga retreat that offers traditional teaching methods, led by knowledgeable and kind instructors who are approachable and compassionate.”

reviews.name: 5X6 Веник
reviews.text:
Taking a 4-week intensive Ashtanga yoga course at a school in Phuket under the guidance of Rich and Sofia was an unforgettable experience. This course not only significantly improved my teaching skills, but also allowed me to better understand the philosophy and practice of yoga.

Rich and Sofia are true masters of their craft. Their knowledge and passion for yoga are inspiring. They have a unique ability to see and develop the potential of each student, supporting and motivating on the way to personal and professional growth.

The school provides an ideal environment for immersion in practice: the calm and beautiful nature of Phuket, cozy classrooms and an attentive approach to each student. This course is a real treasure for those who want not only to learn asanas, but also to live yoga with every breath.

Thanks to Rich and Sofia for this wonderful course. I am sure that everyone who passes it will feel significant changes in their practice and teaching.

reviews.name: adriana cruceanu
reviews.text: I have known Sofia and Rich for 5 years now and have been practicing Ashtanga with them every time I come to Phuket. They are strong and knowledgeable teachers, with personal and profesional integrity. I feel fortunate to have them as guides for my advanced practice, since Ashtanga is a practice that requires a lot of subtlety and finesse, not to say strength, the more you advance into it. Sofia ad Rich also give us the gifts of yoga therapy, fasting, arts of adjustments and probably the most comprehensive 200h Teacher Trainings in the area. Like I said, a privilege to have access to their expertise.

reviews.name: Anna García
reviews.text:
I recently completed Rich's Ashtanga Yoga Adjustment Course and I must say, it exceeded my expectations. Rich's expertise and professionalism were evident from the start. The course provided a comprehensive overview of adjustment techniques in a concise and practical manner. He created a supportive environment conducive to growth and learning.

I highly recommend Rich's Ashtanga Yoga Adjustment Course to anyone looking to enhance their teaching skills. It's an excellent investment in your professional development.

Thanks you so much for your guidance!

With lots of love,
Anna

reviews.name: Eugene Gilad
reviews.text: I have never tried yoga before.  Today, I train for six months about 4-5 times a week.  From conversations with the trainees by my side and those who train at other yoga institutes, I came to understand that this place is a global focus of many yoga students and teachers from all over the world who come to learn to practice and learn how to teach Ashtanga yoga in a professional and unique way.  The teachers Rich and Sophia are exceptionally professional both in Ashtanga yoga and in the content worlds related to it, they invest their whole hearts in the trainees, with sensitivity and determination and give space for development and growth to every student and teacher who comes to learn and practice.  The place is always neat and clean, contains a lot of quality and diverse equipment that allows many trainees to perform many trainings and adjustments during practice and study.

reviews.name: Julz Perry
reviews.text: I asked for a hard massage so they gave me a male. I thought ok, off to a good start. He asked at the beginning if I was ok, which it was, 2 minutes later though, Nope. He massaged my toes, which is not something I have ever experienced in 100’s of other foot massages (both home and abroad) this was completely pointless and just felt weird. Absolutely hammered the arch of my foot with ridiculous amounts of pressure, despite me moving multiple times, basically ignored the rest of my feet, then lightly rubbed my legs (despite me telling the lady at the front no legs, half of my massage was leg focused) moved on to shoulders, neck and head. The pressure was great at the start however there was no technique. He was just pinching the tops of my shoulders. I the got asked to move to the stool when her proceeded to put his hands on top of my shoulders and just press down with all of his body weight. Then more pinching. I actually feel really bad for the poor bloke. He really tried, he did it hard as requested however zero technique. Did not focus on muscles at all. Pushed hard in places you aren’t supposed to push on at all. Glazed over all the regular release points. It was evident he had no idea what he was doing. These guys need to be trained properly because this poor man is going to end up seriously injuring someone due to the way he was taught to massage and the fact that he is the one that is providing the “hard” massages. Please please retrain the staff before someone is seriously injured. 2x friends who came with me both said their massages were also below average. One was constantly looking out the window, not focused on what he was doing at all, massaging bone and again with toes and the other was just not foot focused enough and again, toes. A fourth friend got a full body oil massage and said his was sensational so maybe it’s just the foot massages. Who knows. 2 of us walked out with pain we didn’t have when walking in. Do not recommend. Would not go again. Please, retrain the staff. Completely disappointed because there’s so many good reviews for this joint.

reviews.name: Micah Shelton
reviews.text:
I am a wilderness firefighter who lives and works in the U.S.  This profession is hard on one's body.  In Chiang Mai on a brief holiday, I decided to see if I might find some pain relief at Kul Massage.  I was not disappointed.  I have been to chiropractors in the U.S. over the years, but found here in one hour more reief than all those visits put together.
The masseuse has strong hands and a true practioner's sense of an individual's body.  It almost seemed like he was reading my mind as he worked.  I am no expert on the art and science of authentic Thai massage but could feel the pain fleeing my body (at least temporarily) from years of swinging a pulaski and climbing mountains on fire.  Was the experience gentle?  No....but it seemed to me throughout the session that the practitioner was reading my muscles and bones with his deft hands and was attentive to how my body responded.  I entered the premises to find pain relief and to learn more about my body.  I left feeling better and with increased knowledge.
I suppose others come to Thailand too for relief and revelation.  It is such a warm and welcoming place to visit.

title: Bangkok Shambhala Meditation Center
ownerDescription: The Bangkok Shambhala Meditation Group is part of an international community of over 200 urban meditation and rural retreat centers. We offer weekly public meditation, a core curriculum of Buddhist and Shambhala teachings, as well as training in advanced contemplative practices. We invite you to explore our diverse programs designed to help people of all traditions discover their inherent sanity, compassion, wisdom, and humor.
address: 118, 3rd Floor, 79 Soi Sukhumvit 23, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand
plusCode: PHR8+46 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: David Miller
reviews.text:
My wife and I were in Bangkok and started going to the Sunday 2pm meditations at the Shambhala Center. We were really impressed by the space and the people at the center. The space was conducive to meditation, the practice was welcoming but not watered down; the instructors compassionate and kind.

We enjoyed it so much that we did the meditation retreat they offered in late 2024 (I did all 5 days, my wife 3 days). There we had a fantastic experience. It wasn’t easy doing extended hours of meditation but the way they structured it with breaks between the seated meditation for walking meditation and yoga practice made it all much more doable. It was my first meditation retreat and by the end the moments of struggle were well worth it for the additional benefits it’s offered my daily meditation practice and general peace of mind. It also really connected us to a community of like-minded individuals living in and passing through Bangkok - a great community!

Thanks to Jamie, Martina, Chin and George for everything! We look forward to coming back when we’re in Bangkok again!

reviews.name: C L
reviews.text: First of all I wanna thank you my friend Eva for the invitation to go there. I had a wonderful time and met some mindfulness people . James the meditation instructor from US is great and we had a awesome group discussion. The one and only  Thai lady at the meditation center is very kind and polite. I enjoy a lot thank you 🥰🥰🥰
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for your review Candice! Glad you enjoyed the class...  See you next time.

reviews.name: lorne philpot
reviews.text: Great place to connect with one's inner self and to mediate. Various courses are also offered here throughout the year.

reviews.name: Sára Filipcová
reviews.text:
The place is not marked from the outside, you enter Young Place and then take the elevator to the 3rd floor.

I have little experience with meditation, I have tried it a few times at home and not very successfully. I thought of visiting this meditation center during my visit to Bangkok. At a time that suited me, a 3-hour meditation was taking place. There were 6 of us, all very nice. The instructor took into account that there were also beginners participating and guided us through the entire meditation. After 2 hours it was really difficult for me to keep my mind calm, so I took the opportunity to leave early.

Thank you for this pleasant experience and I recommend others to try it.

reviews.name: Krista de Guzman
reviews.text: I spent a month in Bangkok and had the priviledge to attend the Sunday and Wednesday meditation sessions that were freely offered (donation based) by the center.  The sessions are beginner friendly, welcoming and inspiring. Thanks again all, looking forward to being back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Krista!  Glad you enjoyed the sessions while you were here!

reviews.name: Larissa Bishop
reviews.text:
Jamie -

Thanks for facilitating such a great organization. I’ll always remember the utter depth of conversations, as well as all of the fun laugh sessions I’ve had at Shambhala Meditation Center. I looked forward to coming every week. To be in a space where we can talk about life and the universe with people from all different ages, ethnicities, countries, and religions was hands-down the most profound experience I’ve had in my life.

I’ll definitely continue with meditation when I get home & try to find a nearby center to go to 🙂

reviews.name: Eng-Khim Lim
reviews.text: We were coming from Indonesia and wanted to learn and experience Meditation 101. Bangkok Shambala Meditation Center was able to provide us with a customized lesson for beginners. Great experience overall. Thanks Jamie!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: You're welcome!  Glad you enjoyed the class!

reviews.name: Seb John
reviews.text: Small but great space with good people. Please visit an event listed on their website calendar and support with a donation!

reviews.name: Chris Abraham
reviews.text: As a longtime meditation practitioner, I was so delighted to find this center in Bangkok. In a city that feels very different and foreign at times, the center immediately felt like a piece of "home". The leader, Jamie, and the other members are serious practitioners and very welcoming to people of all traditions. Attending their study sessions on Wed nights is now a highlight of my week.

reviews.name: George Lamburn
reviews.text: I highly recommend Bangkok Shambhala. I've been going weekly for the last 2 years or so and it is absolutely one of the highlights of my week. Jamie, the meditation teacher, is fantastic and is a perfect teacher for those either beginner or advanced. The community is fantastic, and I am so, soooo grateful that this meditation group exists. I highly recommend if you are in Bangkok!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks George 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Jia Moon
reviews.text:
Very nice, peaceful space.

Dropped in Sunday 2-3pm
Mix of sitting and walking meditation with focus on the breath

Suggested donation 100B

Reminded me of vipassana.
Meditation room is on the smaller side. Has nice seating cushions for comfort.

I would recommend.
I would return.

Thank you
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Jia, glad to hear that you enjoyed the class!

reviews.name: Jas Lee
reviews.text:
I went for the Sunday 2pm drop in meditation.
Kind people, quiet space. Minimal decorations and furnishings. Good to escape the hustle and bustle of the city. Very little guidance though so beginners may find it challenging.

reviews.name: Asano76
reviews.text:
This is a great meditation center for people who want to have peace of mind.
The head teacher Jamie is a knowledgeable person who has a fantastic understanding of Buddhism.
If you are in Bangkok, do come here!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for your nice review!  Glad to know that you enjoyed the class!

reviews.name: Richard Dawson
reviews.text:
Shambala is a little ocean of meditative calm in the city. I attend the Wednesday evening Shambala Cafe sessions which are a great way to meet fellow meditators and share experiences.
It's a really open group to people from all meditation traditions and none, so a great space to learn, discuss the dharma and feel inspired.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Richard!  🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Thomas Papazov
reviews.text:
We will always be very grateful for the teachings Jamie offered us at the Shambala center. A spark was lit, that is now pleasantly pushing us every day to become better persons.

Life has actually been a bit difficult for us this last year. I honestly think that we would not have navigated these obstacles the way we did without some of the enlightenments learned through meditation practice. Of course, we are not warriors all the time .. but I cannot imagine how it would have worked out without all the personal development we've achieved through meditation and the teachings received at the center.

Thank you very much for this gift !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much for your kind words and wonderful review!  Very happy to know that you have benefitted from the classes and teaching's you received at the Shambhala center 🌞

reviews.name: Sachin
reviews.text: I was looking for a meditation center in Bangkok and I’m glad that I ended up at Shambhala. James gave us instructions in meditation that was followed by a group discussion which was super nice. I had an interesting talk with James on Tibetan Buddhism later on. I would highly recommend Shambhala Meditation center.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Sachin!  Glad you enjoyed the class.

reviews.name: Aung Hein
reviews.text:
This place has quite place for medidation.
I have really good mood when i was there.
But i think meditation dont need you to go far place. We can meditate everywhere.
If our room is not quiet, plug earphone, play forest sound and close our eye.

reviews.name: Xander
reviews.text: I really enjoy Jamie’s meditation leadership and his openness, inclusiveness, and the weekly readings / discussion.

reviews.name: A. R. (Hanry)
reviews.text: Love this place. A genuine Buddhist Sangha with a great lineage.

reviews.name: Georgi Djalev
reviews.text: Great place to get a deep first insight. Jamie was really helpful and open wide a big door for my future!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much for your review!  Glad to hear that you found it helpful!

title: Pechbura Thai Massage
subTitle: นวดแผนไทยเพชบุระ
address: 7/9 Soi Chulalongkorn 12, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand
plusCode: PGVF+HH Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Chia Lim (Chia)
reviews.text:
A underrated massage place at Chulalongkorn Area!

This is the best massage we’ve had in Bangkok! We tried a few massage shops around this area, but this one truly stood out. The two experienced ladies really know authentic Thai massage. The pressure was perfect, and they could even identify our body problems and focus on the areas that needed attention.

We walked out feeling so impressed and comfortable, especially my shoulder and back pain which felt much better after the session. Honestly, if we had discovered this place earlier, we would have come every day.

And the best part? The price is super reasonable for such an amazing service. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Luis Calado
reviews.text:
My wife and I had a fantastic experience at this Thai massage place yesterday. We were both warmly welcomed.
The place was clean but don’t expect views and relaxing music. We prefer it that way – we come for the massages, not the scenery.
The therapist was incredible, expertly delivering an authentic Thai massage. My wife, however, was expecting a bit more pressure, so her feedback was slightly different.
Since we stumbled upon this place while passing by, I think it’s a great choice. We paid 300 baht each for an hour, which is a very fair price.

reviews.name: Katrina
reviews.text:
Great service, clean and tidy. Also very well priced! My friend and I can here every day during our stay. DEFINITELY RECOMMEND.

We got massages from Pati and Dada 🥰

reviews.name: Yi Ling
reviews.text:
Came here after walking a whole lot today and decided to go for a 1.5h thai massage experience to treat myself! I asked for a masseuse that could help me press HARD, and boy, did they give me a very skilled masseuse! 👍👍👍

I got Padhi, who, despite her small frame, had really strong fingers, and she worked on parts of my body, which she felt the knots at and pressed until they went away. Which is mainly at the area around my shoulder blades and back of my knees. I was folded around like an origami paper, and I felt all my knots being combed out.

Padhi was also very attentive when she noticed my sinus acting up, so she turned the fan a notch down. When I told her that some parts of my shoulders were achy when pressed, she took out a minty balm and asked if she could help me with that area. It probably wasn't part of the service, but I was very thankful for that because I was instantly relieved. Needless to say, I gave her a big tip upon leaving.

This place is relatively new, clean, and slightly more ghetto than the prim and posh massage parlours. There isn't much privacy here, and noise travels from the streets, and you can hear the other customers talking as well. I didn't mind at all, as I enjoy the community spirit here 😊

I'm definitely saving this place and will be coming back here again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you ka 😊🥰

reviews.name: MAI
reviews.text: Feeling so relax after the massage. Reasonable price. I recommend to book online before because not many massage persons at the shop.

reviews.name: catherine Gunnewicht
reviews.text: We just walked into this place and we both had a thai massage with oils. It was one of the best massages I've ever had. Really recommend this place. And good  price too. Definitely recommend 👌

reviews.name: Bee Elle Dinh
reviews.text: We were in the area and wanted to get a massage.  We made the right choice by coming here. Got a two hour full body and my gosh, my husband and I both agree that this was a really great massage by two expert masseuse. They knew exactly how much pressure needed and focused on parts that we didn’t even know needed massaging. We definitely recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณ​ค่ะ❤️

reviews.name: Chum de silva
reviews.text: I came to this place twice in 2 days! One of the best massages I’ve had during my time in Thailand. Highly recommended, especially if K.Nham massage you she is really professional and friendly!

reviews.name: Anushke de silva
reviews.text: This massage place is one of the best ones I have ever been in Thailand! GO See K,NHAM, she has an unbelievable skill set to fixing and spotting out blockages and problems areas on your body, Highly recommended A++++

reviews.name: Olivia Janku
reviews.text: I had a very pleasant experience here. Great service, friendly and professional staff, reasonably priced. They gave me a cup of tea at the end which was a very nice touch. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Tharika Gimhani
reviews.text: Had a Thai massage today. It was so good. Place is clean too. Probably l will go again.

reviews.name: SONNY V
reviews.text:
Amazing massage place and cheaper rates. And very clean and tidy shop.

They did so good massage and staff is friendly and welcoming.

Thanks you so much. (Australian couple)

reviews.name: Eric Swendsen
reviews.text: Did not appreciate the fact that the masseuses were chatting loudly during the whole massage and laughing. Massage was okay but I've had better. Not very professional.

reviews.name: Jasmine Tan
reviews.text: sucks don’t come don’t even know how to massage

reviews.name: Adrian Wan
reviews.text: Great prices, great service. We stopped in for a quick foot massage while waiting for dinner, we will come back for longer massages.

reviews.name: Corrine Tan
reviews.text: The place is clean and the masseuses are experienced. The charges are also very reasonable. Highly recommend. We will visit again

reviews.name: James Kennedy
reviews.text: Very good massage, professional and clean. Worth the visit.

reviews.name: Victoria Vela Abad
reviews.text: It was very pacefull place and the workers and massage are very nice

reviews.name: Mel C
reviews.text: The best massage I’ve ever had with Dada. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: tsz ching cheng
reviews.text: Poor service. Very rude to the guest

title: Baipai Thai Cooking School
ownerDescription: Thai Traditional Hands on Cooking class in Bangkok
address: 8, 91 Ngam Wong Wan 54 Alley, Lane 5, Lat Yao, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand
plusCode: RHP9+X8 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Roger
reviews.text:
A highly recommended cooking class if you want to actually learn something, with a very friendly team throughout.

The location is a bit outside the city, but we were picked up from the nearest BTS station, which made things easy. The setting itself is beautiful, surrounded by greenery, and everything was very clean. It was under construction with some noise but wasnt big distraction.

Luckily, there were only five participants that day. Our chef first demonstrated and prepared the basics, after which each of us cooked four different dishes individually, which was one of the reasons we chose this class. Everything was very well organized and continuously cleaned up, allowing us to fully focus on the cooking experience.

Would happily do another class here next time in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind review! 

We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed the hands-on cooking experience, our beautiful setting, and the support from our team.

We also appreciate your understanding regarding the construction work during your visit. It means a lot to know that you'd like to join another class when you're back in Bangkok.

We look forward to welcoming you again soon!

reviews.name: Jan Philipp
reviews.text:
Located in a zen-like garden, we reached the school by skytrain and a short walk. From the first moment onwards, we felt welcomed and enjoyed a lovely morning there.
Our local chef was very charming and guided us to prepare 4 different dishes within 3 hours. Everybody had to do all steps and cooked his/her own meal with fresh ingredients. It was so easy, our 14 year old boy could follow without any problem.
At the end, we got a lot of pictures and a booklet with all recipes.
It was more than just cooking - it was an unforgettable experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 🌿

We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed the peaceful garden setting and felt welcomed from the very beginning.

It’s lovely to know that our chef made the experience enjoyable and easy to follow for everyone—including your 14-year-old! We believe cooking should be hands-on, fun, and accessible, and we’re happy that preparing all four dishes felt both engaging and rewarding.

We’re also glad you appreciated the photos and recipe booklet—so you can bring a little taste of Baipai back home with you.

Your words mean a lot to us, and we’re honored to have been part of such a memorable experience for your family.

Warm regards,
Baipai Thai Cooking School 💚

reviews.name: DivingDancer
reviews.text:
Wonderful personalized instruction. The instructor was warm and welcoming, and did a great job of walking through each of the recipes. I was given my own personal cooking station, as well as a seat at the dining table.

She started in a small herb garden area, where she pointed out each of the common herbs used in Thai cooking. Then, returning to the instruction area, she then went through each of four different recipes, first cooking them herself and discussing technique and ingredients. Then I prepared each of the dishes myself. After each dish there was a pause in the class to taste and comment.

The atmosphere is absolutely beautiful. It is an outdoor classroom in a covered setting, with koi pond and gardens.

Very highly recommended! The cost of the class was very affordable. The quality of the instruction, and the quality of the dishes prepared, was more than worth the cost of the class itself.  The next time I make my way back to Bangkok, I will absolutely sign up for another class.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your wonderful and detailed review! We're so happy you enjoyed the personalized instruction, hands-on cooking, and our garden setting.

It’s great to hear you appreciated the step-by-step learning and tasting experience. We truly value your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back to BaiPai on your next visit to Bangkok!

reviews.name: Jason Moloney
reviews.text: What a fantastic experience learning the ease of Thai cooking from scratch and the wonderful flavoursome meals that can be made easily at home.  The teaching was wonderful the setting was beautiful and was truly a cherished experience from my journey.  I was disappointed I was unable to get back for a second time on my trip.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind review! We're so happy you enjoyed learning Thai cooking with us and that it became a memorable part of your trip.

We hope to welcome you back again next time you're in Bangkok!

reviews.name: William Lau
reviews.text:
We had been to this Thai Cooking School many times since their previous location.  They were always good and we loved it.

The teacher was good in communication and demonstration skills, and the assistants were helper and they all provided excellent experience to us.

They had different menu and we picked the day that Tung Yum Kung was available and we could able to cook it nice and yum.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your continued support and kind review! We're so happy to hear you've enjoyed coming back to BaiPai over the years.

It's wonderful that you enjoyed the class, our team’s guidance, and cooking Tom Yum Goong. We truly appreciate your loyalty and look forward to welcoming you again soon!

reviews.name: Alban DB
reviews.text: Great time, lovely staff and fun to learn how to cook Thai meal. No need to eat before as you will taste your own preparation. Very convenient to have bus shuttle from Bangkok center included in the price.

reviews.name: Hing Eli
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience communicating with Baipai Thai Cooking School! Even though I couldn't move forward this time because of personal reasons, their customer service is fantastic. Recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. We hope you could make it next time. Looking forward to see you then. ❤️🥰😊

reviews.name: Curtis CC
reviews.text: Joined this tour with my friend during my stay in Bangkok. We were very pleased with their cooking and service. It was extremely impressive. Instructor and the guide were very joyful and helpful. Took us to see the local market and got to learn about local fresh ingredients for cooking. For any tourists who visit Bangkok must join this tour. It for sure will give you a memorable trip. There is nothing for me to complain with :-) also they offer free hotel pick up and drop off! Thank you for Baipai cooking school!

reviews.name: Christopher Sgro
reviews.text: We revisited Baipai on our current SEAsia trip, after having been here 10 years ago on our very first trip to Bangkok. It was a highlight then and it certainly was now. The setting is beautiful, with a serene landscaped outdoor space that takes you away from the hustle of BKK. Our instructor was so informative and interesting — we really got a feel for the flavors, techniques, and ingredients used. The food was delicious, and the pace of the course was so nice. If you’re in Bangkok and have any interest in Thai food, I highly recommend you do a session at Baipai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for returning to BaiPai after 10 years! 

We're delighted that you enjoyed the peaceful setting, the cooking experience, and learning more about Thai flavors and techniques. Your recommendation means a lot to us.

We hope to welcome you back again on your next trip to Thailand!

reviews.name: Benjamin Cheng
reviews.text: Great place for group cooking class. Friendly staff, nice and clean surroundings.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. We hope you and your family enjoy cooking Thai cuisine at home. We hope to welcome all of you again next time in Bangkok ❤️

reviews.name: Maddy Martin
reviews.text: Unforgettable experience, not to mention the picturesque setting! Yui, our instructor, was incredible as well.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your lovely review! We're delighted that you enjoyed the experience, our garden setting, and Chef Yui's guidance.

We hope to welcome you back to BaiPai again soon!

reviews.name: Pamela Cheong
reviews.text:
I have the best experience here with a small group of fellow students. A organic toque farm of the herbs and fruits grown for our cooking ingredients . Love the  teaching styole and method .learn and cook a dish and the. Enjoy . Move to next dish.
There is repeated students who came back.
I am definitely coming back next time or even consider a corporate event of cocktail foot some customers.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind review! We're delighted you enjoyed the hands-on cooking experience and our organic garden.

We truly appreciate your interest in returning and even hosting a corporate event. We look forward to welcoming you again!

reviews.name: Frederic Delaunay
reviews.text: Fantastic experience. We learnt to cook 4 dishes. Satay chicken skewer, shrimp salad, stir fried beef and chicken panang curry. Once passed the fence, we feel in a little oasis, super location, great cook, very clear in explaining all the process. Nice assistant helping out and making it all a memorable experience. I can only advise to go there if you want to cook great Thai food after vacations.. Thank you!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your wonderful review! We're delighted you enjoyed learning all four dishes..

It’s great to hear our chef and assistant made the experience clear, fun, and memorable. We truly appreciate your recommendation and hope to welcome you back to BaiPai again!

reviews.name: Lorraine Conn
reviews.text: My husband and I attended a Bai Pai Thai cooking class today in Bangkok, from the shopping at the exotic, open air food market  to the moment we stepped from our van on to the beautiful grounds until we left, very full. The staff was fabulous. We watched our Chef prepare and cook a dish and then we each got to prepare and cook the same dish by ourselves.  This made for a quality learning experience and a delightful lunch. I would highly recommend attending this cooking school.

reviews.name: Ammarin Daranpob
reviews.text: Nice ecosystem for learning how to cook Thai food, romantic, surrounded by nature, peaceful for a retreat

reviews.name: Andrew Anders
reviews.text:
Each time I visit Bangkok I make sure I swing for 4 hours of fun and cooking Thai food. Small classes in morning and the afternoon, you can choose menu on website and book it for that day.
Driver pick you up at hotel and bring to school, after small introduction to each other and ingredients time to start cooking delicious food. Stuff is very nice, full of Thai hospitality also you can meet people from all the world. Don't miss this opportunity. I'm ready for next trip....

reviews.name: Josiah Eadie
reviews.text: I loved every second of this cooking class. The venue was stunning, the food delicious and most importantly the staff were both entertaining and great teachers. I highly recommend anyone with an inclining of interest in cooking to take part. Well done to all the team at Baipai Thai Cooking School.

reviews.name: Daniel
reviews.text:
I booked this event on Tripadvisor. Had an eventful day with June and Chef Noi and the rest of the staff. The class is held in a very nice location, where you will arrive after being picked up from your hotel in Bangkok.

We made 4 dishes, including 1 dessert. The chef will first prepare the dish and explain all the steps. Then everyone will get to taste the chefs food, so you know what taste you will be aiming for. You will then go to your station and cook the food for yourself, with guidance from the staff if you need.

Another positive is that you get to take the recipes back home, so you can try it out in your own home! I will return for another class next time I'm in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Kate Stringer
reviews.text: This was the best part of our visit to Bangkok. The cooking class was enjoyable, easy to learn, and located on beautiful grounds. I highly recommend this class to anyone looking for a fun culinary adventure.

reviews.name: Brent
reviews.text: This is a ‘must do’ when traveling to Bangkok. Class was informative and very hands on.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind review! We're delighted you enjoyed the hands-on and informative cooking class.

We truly appreciate your recommendation and hope to welcome you back to BaiPai again soon!

reviews.name: Malika Nurmatova
reviews.text:
We stayed here for almost two months and truly fell in love with the place. Vasucha and Joshua are warm, kind-hearted hosts who make you feel right at home. Their beautiful space is filled with soul - every detail, every corner is thoughtfully designed, and the many sweet cats add so much warmth and joy 🐾

Here, our days followed a peaceful rhythm. Mornings began with breakfast on the rooftop, enjoying the breathtaking view of the Big Buddha 🌄 The kitchen upstairs has everything you need - comfortable, clean, and cozy. Then we’d head to the gym, and come back to find our room freshly cleaned thanks to the wonderful: Soraya, Snow White, and their little helper Si - who made our stay even more amazing 💛

In the afternoons, we worked downstairs in the quiet, welcoming coworking space. Cats would curl up next to us or play nearby - the perfect companions. Evenings were our favorite: dinner with sunset views from the rooftop, followed by relaxing Yin Yoga and sound healing sessions on the ground floor. I was deeply moved by the practices - led by gentle, kind instructors. The space and energy here invite deep peace and connection.

We also met amazing long-term residents and felt a real sense of community. This place is not just a stay - it’s a feeling. A retreat. A home full of care and quiet magic ✨

We can't wait to return.

reviews.name: Pattrapan Samranjit
reviews.text: What an amazing experience with Touchwood! Hands down the best yoga in Phuket. The Thai business owner/teacher provides excellent English-speaking classes that are easy to follow and well-structured. I attended the 10AM Vinyasa class, which was exactly what I was looking for- a gradual increase in intensity followed by a relaxing finish. The sound bath at the end was a truly enlightening experience. I highly recommend Touchwood and can't wait to go back!

reviews.text: I recently started practicing yoga at this amazing studio, and I couldn't be happier with my experience. The atmosphere is so peaceful and welcoming, it truly feels like a sanctuary. reviews.name: Rebecca Mildon
reviews.text: Absolutely love Touchwood! I stayed here with my husband and the experience was lovely. Our room was spacious with all of the amenities you would need for your stay, including a private bathroom. We enjoyed our coffee in the hammocks on the rooftop. We took a yoga class with Vee, who is a fantastic and patient teacher. Vee and Josh have been wonderful hosts as well, providing us with information and recommendations for the area to make the most of our time in Phuket. The space is nicely renovated with beautiful touches that enhance the mood. I also enjoyed meeting the house cat, Popcorn, who has been incredibly inviting! Our experience has been exceptional and I would recommend Touchwood to folks looking for a great stay or yoga class.

reviews.name: Pear Nuntakarat
reviews.text:
My new favourite place in Phuket and will definitely return! I stayed at Touchwood for a week and had the best time reconnecting body and soul. Absolutely love the vibe. My room was super comfortable, clean, and spacious with all the amenities one would need.

The communal spaces are also very nice and well maintained. Vee and Josh are such a lovely host, very friendly, and know all the good spots in town!

Doing yoga here is also a must whether you are new or experienced. Vee is very knowledgeable and passionate about what she does.

They do a really good coffee here too. I find it's hard to find a good coffee in Thailand in general. So it's such a blessing I found it here.

Overall, a really good experience, and would love to come back again! Thank you for your hospitality. Oh, and I will miss Popcorn and Sabrina dearly.

reviews.textTranslated:
This is a new and clean shop. They focus on seated and reclining massages on chairs; they don't yet offer full-body reclining massages. The masseuses are very polite. I recommend sitting inside the shop because the outside area near the entrance/exit can be noisy, which can be disruptive, especially when you're trying to doze off.
Highly recommend! The masseuse is excellent at neck massage, like a spa massage. They offer hot compresses, acupressure on the face, and a great neck, shoulder, and back massage. They focus on relaxing spa-style massages. If you're looking for a deep tissue massage for pain relief like a Thai massage, this might not be for you. The foot massage is also good; it focuses on acupressure, not too heavy or forceful.
They focus on acupressure in the spaces between the toes, the soles of the feet, foot scrubbing, and ankle kneading. Overall, it's excellent. Next time, I'll just go for a neck, shoulder, and back massage. The shop has only been open for about a month.

title: Yoga Republic
ownerDescription: We are Phuket's BEST yoga studio.
address: 4, 2 Srisoonthorn Rd, Cherngtalay, Thalang District, Phuket 83110, Thailand
plusCode: X8P9+MC Si Sunthon, Thalang District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Eileen Neo (Sgsohotleh)
reviews.text:
The studio is absolutely immaculate, clean, well-maintained, and has a very calming atmosphere the moment you walk in. I guess that’s why they re called yoga studio. My first time doing yoga, felt that the class flow was well-paced, making it quite engaged.

The instructors were friendly, which made the lesson fun too. One area for improvement would be good is that they can clearer instructions for some poses.

Oh ya, one thing I found a little unusual was that the fan wasn’t turned on throughout the class. It got a bit warm at times, idk i perspire because it was hot or I exercised!!

Overall, it was a pleasant experience!

reviews.name: YY
reviews.text:
We were looking for a group activity and decided to sign up for the Gentle Flow class here, absolutely no regrets! 🧘‍♀️

The session was well paced, relaxing, and exactly what we needed. Somehow, all the aches and stiffness l had been feeling over the past few days disappeared after the class. It was such a refreshing and much needed reset/exercise. I would definitely recommend it if you're looking to stretch and exercise! 🧘

reviews.name: GlobeTrotter Lens
reviews.text:
In A Nutshell:

-If you are traveling through Bang Tao & need to find a nice yoga studio to practice at, then Yoga Republic is the place!
-I was lucky enough to fit in a couple of classes (Gentle & Fusion Yoga).
-Both classes offer a great practice.
-The Fusion class offers more powerful & challenging poses, which I love.
-The facilities here are very clean such as the big lobby, bathrooms w/ showers & lockers to keep your personal items secured.

Overall, Jack, the owner/instructor is a really friendly & welcoming guy.  I appreciated the warm vibes & flows!

reviews.name: Tereza B.
reviews.text: I took my very first hot yoga class here and got completely hooked—I’ve already been back a few times! Jack is an excellent teacher, always positive and encouraging. The studio itself is also beautiful and has a great atmosphere. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Cloé FAIRÉ
reviews.text: The studio is beautiful and the teachers are truly exceptional. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a meaningful and inspiring yoga experience. Special thanks to Jack for his kindness, attentiveness and those little golden mantras that stay with you long after class✨

reviews.name: Savvas Michael
reviews.text:
Yoga Republic has been a big part of my fight camp. The hot classes help me recover, stay mobile, and keep my mind sharp.

Jack is a great teacher , calm, focused, and always on point.

Grateful for this place.

reviews.name: Pacific Media LLC
reviews.text: At 34, I was stiff as a board and skeptical that anything could change that—until I found Yoga Republic. Hot yoga with Jack and hot Pilates with Sage have been total game-changers. Both instructors are incredibly knowledgeable and take the time to focus on each student’s individual practice. I’ve gained flexibility, strength, and confidence in ways I didn’t think were possible. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Dominic Christofi
reviews.text: The space is immaculate - very appropriate vibes and sensational ambience; Jack is a phenomenal instructor and personality - he takes his classes seriously and passionately, assuring everyone's safety and proper conduct, immersion and engagement. A truly authentic yoga experience 🙏🏼 thank you

reviews.name: sage farras
reviews.text:
Best studio in the world I could say
Love the vibe beautiful studio amazing teachers

reviews.name: Mike Doering
reviews.text: Must-visit for yoga fans holidaying in Phuket. Amazing studio, well kitted out. The instructors are so friendly and welcoming, but also very experienced and committed to a traditional hot Bikram style practice with excellent verbal cues and suggestions for adjustments to make yogis of all levels of experience feel welcome in every class. They also do Pilates, yin and other classes I didn’t get the chance to try. Can’t wait to visit again on my next Phuket trip.

reviews.name: Melissa Lee
reviews.text: Gorgeous new studio and lovely instructor! Always made to feel welcome and comfortable here. Good vibes only! Highly recommended for anyone who wants to practice yoga and leave happy !

reviews.name: Milica Vlahovic
reviews.text: The best yoga studio in Phuket! After a busy day at work, Yoga Republic is the place to be! I love the crew, I joined them as a very beginner (haven't done much of yoga in my life) and have noticed the progress with my body and mind just after couple of months. I would suggest Yoga Republic to everyone, expats living here, visitors, tourists, even if you haven't tried yoga before, don't be scared! It is so much fun and, how Jack would say, sweat is the new black :)

reviews.name: leonie murphy
reviews.text: Great modern and clean studio. The energy of this place makes it head and shoulders above any other hot studio I've visited. The teachers Jack and Puck are both outstanding, patient teachers that have very different styles of teaching so you never get bored in any class. The other students that visit this studio are all very friendly and relaxed too so it's also a great place to socialise over a healthy juice or two. Yoga republic is one of the things that keeps me in Phuket. I can't get enough.

reviews.name: mutikoa100
reviews.text: Best Yoga studio in Phuket! jack and his team are fantastic and so dedicated!! Passionate people will look after you like never before! Go and try it, they even convinced me :)

reviews.name: Vicki Stapleton
reviews.text: Most inspiring yoga studio!!! Studio set up has such a gret vibe and overall the atmosphere is relaxed and you get so much out of one class!! Love the blog, just started following "with an open heart and mind".

reviews.name: Mimi Uchiyama
reviews.text: amazing studio with the friendliest instructors. Jack will certainly brighten your day. studio is very clean with state of art infra red heating. A must visit when you are in Phuket.

reviews.name: Sarah Wheeler
reviews.text: Having never enjoyed yoga in the past, Yoga Republic has given me a new love for yoga. Jack and his staff make you feel welcome and help you push yourself beyond what you believe are your limits. Its a class I look forward to every week.

reviews.name: A C
reviews.text: Did a family private class with Jack. The yoga studio is clean, nicely decorated and well maintained. We truly enjoyed his class. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Tamara Berry
reviews.text: Good place to do yoga with various types of classes. All the staffs can speak English. They’re very friendly and helpful. The price is a little bit high especially in this pandemic situation. They could decrease a bit to get more of people. One more thing, the place very clean!

reviews.text: Amazing place, facilities,  teacher and atmosphere. Absolutely fantastic spot to upgrade your Thai trip package for your body enjoyment. Wish I could have this in my home city as I didn't manage to have enough!
