reviews.text:
I bought a day pass to try their pilates class & used their Thermal service.

I love it! The facilities are very nice, clean, premium. They have sauna, steam, ice room, & more! I wish I have more time to enjoy the whole day.

The instructor for the class is also professional, for a day pass u can also access to the gym! Overall it is worth it for me. Drop in Pilates class at some studio is already half a price so…

Definitely will come back :)

reviews.name: Viva Waratah
reviews.text:
An all-round excellent Spa Facility! Booked a 60-minutes Aromatherapy Massage and the receptionist suggested to come an hour earlier to enjoy their thermal experience. Couldn’t be more grateful for the suggestion as the thermal journey is not to be missed! There are seven types of experiences including hot and cold therapy, ice-bucket bath, different types of steam, sauna and etc. which are all perfect to help relax the muscles and the body, making it ready for massage.

The massage itself is also very good. Strong and firm.

The design and the setting are absolutely beautiful. Personally, I think this is probably one of the most stylish-looking urban spa I’ve ever been to in Bangkok. It’s a pleasure just to be hanging out in such a beautiful place.

Shower facility is top-notch. There’s also a lounge you can relax after the treatment.

Prices are steep, but reasonable and worth the experience.

reviews.name: Songwit Ngamsinpasthien
reviews.text:
If luxury had a heartbeat, it would pulse quietly through Sindhorn Wellness by Resense. Tucked inside the ultra-refined Sindhorn Kempinski, this isn’t a spa it’s an orchestrated experience designed for those who truly understand what the word “retreat” means.

The Thermal Journey here is not just a sequence of rooms it’s a narrative. Each transition, from the crystal steam chamber to the Himalayan salt room, feels like moving through chapters of calm written specifically for you. The temperature, the light, even the acoustics all calibrated with surgical precision to silence the outside world.

There’s a kind of old-money elegance to everything: discreet attendants who anticipate without intruding, textures and materials that whisper sophistication, and that signature Resense scent subtle, grounding, unmistakably premium.

What sets this place apart isn’t the marble or the amenities (which are flawless), but the intellect behind its design. It’s a wellness concept built not for show, but for transformation a sanctuary for the kind of people who prefer quiet power over flashy luxury.

Verdict: Sindhorn Wellness by Resense isn’t where you come to escape the city; it’s where you come to remember what equilibrium feels like. Flawless, composed, and unapologetically world-class.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Songwit Ngamsinpasthien,

Thank you for sharing such an evocative and beautifully written reflection. Your words capture the very essence of Sindhorn Wellness by Resense not merely as a spa, but as a sanctuary of quiet transformation. We are truly honoured that each detail, from the Thermal Journey to the discreet elegance of our service, resonated so deeply with you.

Your description is a testament to the philosophy behind our design: a place where luxury is felt, not flaunted, and where equilibrium is gently restored. On behalf of the entire team at Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok, thank you for seeing us so clearly. 

We look forward to welcoming you back whenever you seek calm, clarity, and quiet power.

Kind regards,

Jee Hoong Tan
Hotel Manager

reviews.name: King
reviews.text:
I recently attended a two-day sunset yoga course, and it was truly an amazing experience. Den is an outstanding instructor — not only highly professional and knowledgeable, but also incredibly supportive and encouraging.

Throughout the course, Den created such a positive and uplifting atmosphere. He provided so much emotional support and genuine encouragement that I felt completely comfortable and confident. His guidance gave me a huge boost in confidence, both in my practice and in myself.

I’m very grateful for this experience and would highly recommend this course to anyone looking to grow in their yoga journey. Thank you, Den, for such an inspiring two days!

reviews.name: Sarah Nels
reviews.text:
Wonderful sunrise yoga session with Tanny - I was the only participant!

Tanny is an absolute delight- and how wonderful to practice on the beach!  I agree with all the other 5 star reviews- this is a must do while in Krabi!!! Your body and mind will thank you!

reviews.name: Evelyn Oh
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the beach yoga during my trip in Krabi. Two days yoga with Tanny is really fun and she’s very kind and helpful, always correcting my pose as I stopped practicing yoga for a few years. I would definitely come again and recommend to friends.

reviews.name: Carson Greco
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible you must go if you’re into yoga and in Krabi!! Even a beginner could take and enjoy class - the instructor Tanny has wonderful energy and gives excellent guidance. She is a light and the beautiful setting helps too! I would do this every day if I could. And best flying pigeon I’ve ever done, with her guidance!

reviews.name: genevieve anne
reviews.text: A must in Ao Nang! Practicing on the beach in front of the pink sunset is an unforgettable experience. The teachers are lovely, fun, and adapt the poses to your needs. Nice energy in class with everyone having a good time together.

reviews.name: Egle Vaitieke
reviews.text: I loved the morning yoga class on the beach. The yoga teacher was very professional and inspiring. Thank you!

reviews.text: It's risky to big up an experience in your head..but amazing when they exceed that image. This class was professional, organised, challenging but also relaxing. We were also so lucky with the sunset view. Definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Kelsey Landen
reviews.text: I loved the sunrise beach yoga class! The class was challenging enough where I felt accomplished, but also relaxing and meditative. I even learned some new breathing techniques! Tanny is a wonderful instructor, and helped me out with a pose I couldn't quite get right. She had modifications for those who needed them. The location had a beautiful view of the ocean, and we were in the shade. I would absolutely recommend this class to anyone, and I wish I had more time to do another class.

reviews.name: I S
reviews.text: Attended a beach yoga session at Ao Nang Beach led by instructor Tanny. It was fantastic! She tailored the session well for all levels, and the stretches were varied and effective. Practicing yoga at sunset on the beach was magical, inducing a meditative state easily. Tanny was attentive and skilled. Highly recommend for a rejuvenating experience connecting body and mind in nature.

reviews.name: Mia Whitlock

I felt amazing after my yoga session and am already planning to squeeze in another class with Tanny before I leave Ao Nang. Definitely recommend yoga with Tanny

my first yoga in here.

reviews.name: danny mac
reviews.text: I had an absolutely amazing experience at Kokoro Massage Bangkok! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was calming and inviting. I had Yaya as my masseuse, and she was incredible—professional, attentive, and truly skilled. She knew exactly how to ease my tension and make me feel completely relaxed. The massage was tailored perfectly to my needs, and I left feeling rejuvenated and refreshed. Highly recommend Kokoro Massage, and if you can, ask for Yaya—she’s phenomenal!

reviews.name: Wilson Liu
reviews.text:
I am high now.
I asked for Lemon, my friend went with Eva. They only showed us on ipad, but now I'm done, I didn't finish in 1 sec. I wrote this far then she asked me go to the room. Then after exactly 59 mins, we finished and I continued writing this. I didn't finish in 1 sec. Don't believe that lie. It is AI. It is fake new. I am not a liar. But the place is good. Dear Sanjay,
We’re sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations. At Kokoro, we take service time and pricing seriously, and additional charges should only apply to service agreed upon by the customer. 

We would like to investigate what happened during your visit, including the session time and any additional chanrges mentioned. Please contact our management directly with the date and approximate time of your visit so we can review the details and address this properly

Kokoro Management

reviews.name: Christian G
reviews.text: Ava provided exceptional service. I opted for the 90 minute service and it was a thrilling ride from start to finish. She is an expert in satisfaction and left me craving more. I returned for a second session and it exceeded the first visit. I will find her again when I return to Thailand. She’s worth the visit.

reviews.name: Garrett Lee (Shiny)
reviews.text: Im a firm believer that chemistry has everything to do with the experience you get at a place like this. You could go 5 times and have 5 wildly different experiences. My experience here was fantastic. I was well recieved and the girl I chose was young, beautiful, and also knew how to actually give a great massage. I had the VIP Nuru massage for 90 minutes, and it was glorious. It came with a full bubble bath and full body oil massage with a special toe-curling ending. I won't say which girl I chose because I am here for another week and want her to be available for me. 😅

reviews.name: Chin Chinapat
reviews.text: Kokoro roll and Shimahokke fish are recommended. The Umeshu is also very good teste.

reviews.name: JUNMIN KIM
reviews.text: Moji. She's the worst. She's expressionless, and when you speak to her, she just replies as if she's annoyed. Her service is also sloppy compared to other employees. The boss needs to train her to do her job properly.

reviews.name: Shaft Afro
reviews.text:
Worst experience ever. As mentioned by previous reviewers, these girls have attitude issues. For me, the girl (who claimed her name was Paris to hide herself from blame, when it was really Cookie) has an extremely bad attitude problem. Near the end of the session, she got incredibly angry just because I asked a few questions on the process (they don't explain anything to you), it completely ruined the experience. She kept saying "I'm working, I'm working!! Don't disturb!" amongst other things. Even in a mainstream industry, you would never show such an attitude to your customer, especially when they have been friendly and attentive the whole time.
Afterwards, I told the receptionist who said they cannot do anything about it, let alone offer a refund. So I asked for an apology from the girl (what I thought was a small enough ask) but she came out with an extremely fake, sarcastic apology. Even the receptionist noticed and agreed it was rude. So she proceeded to phone the boss to get Cookie to apologize again "for real", not that its worth anything now anyway. Apparently she's new to the place, but for me that's no excuse. This is a personality problem and it will likely happen again to the next customer.

Overall, terrible experience and please avoid this place (also save your money as its more much more expensive than others). Don't risk it for extremely low reward. You can get much better experiences elsewhere (literally anywhere else).

reviews.name: Sarah McQuarrie
reviews.text:
The best massage in Bangkok. I am a frequent traveller to Thailand and am accustomed to the variety of massages from high end hotels to platforms on beaches.

Location: a 2 minute walk to the right of Sheraton Riverside in Bang Rak. Across the river (take a river taxi/shuttle) from IconSiam and the Peninsula hotel, on the same side as the Mandarin Oriental and Shangri-la.

Price: More than the typical high street. Converted into other currencies it is very reasonable for the quality of the environment and the service. 1 hour foot massage: approx 100dirhams, $38 Canadian.
I also had a 2 hour massage with Gua Sha facial which cost approx 300dirhams, $115 Canadian. It was the best experience I’ve had in a spa.

Quality: The attention to detail is superb. The welcoming staff, calm atmosphere, beautiful decor, welcome tea and foot wash, provide the perfect introduction to the service you are about to experience. Private rooms with private bathrooms, silk robes, slippers and a bell to let the masseuse know you are ready.
My masseuse was knowledgeable and skilled with understanding when and where pressure was needed. I have scar tissue on my knees from surgeries and I can honestly say I had more mobility after she was done. It hurt and was somewhat uncomfortable at times but 100% worth the gained movement afterwards. I was more mobile after my first foot massage than I was after several sessions of physio.

I had a total of 3 massages over 4 days, I enjoyed it that much.

My masseuse was Nancy, my friend had Annie. We both highly recommended.

reviews.name: Alice Bevan
reviews.text: It’s a nice place, drinks provided before and after and a foot massage and scrub, but I booked a 75 minute back, shoulder and neck massage for 1,799 baht and received a full body and head massage, without focusing on my neck at all. A bit disappointing, as I was hoping that the massage would focus on the tension and soreness in these areas but instead she was pressing on and stretching my legs and arms, which wasn’t what I expected. The masseuse didn’t talk during the massage either, to ask what kind of pressure I would like etc.

reviews.name: Ariane V
reviews.text: VERY good went here with my family after walking all day in Bangkok. REALLY SWEET owner and really good masseuses. I STRONGLY RECOMMEND WHEN IN BANGKOK!

reviews.name: Piyawan C. van Driel
reviews.text: Best massage we ever had! Good product and staff are very friendly and helpful.

reviews.name: Tim Askew
reviews.text:

I visited with my wife and had a medium pressure massage focussing on my very sore back.

Erb is superbly professional and the surroundings very relaxing. It was heartening to see so many locals here.

This is a very good high class spa.

reviews.text: Very nice place for massage. The place was so clean and smells amazing. So many type of massage that you can choose.

reviews.name: Christopher White
reviews.text: My wife and I went to several highly rated true Thai priced spas that where good. On our way back to our hotel we saw the buy one treatment get one free special and stopped in. It’s slightly more than the other local spas but was many times better than the rest and worth every cent with the BOGO offer. Treat yourself as this place is the real deal!!

It seems they changed the staff, and you feel not very pampered anymore..They dont cover one leg while massaging the other leg (this is standard in every massage salon) and they dont ask if its too cold or too hot. Back and neck massage was very good, but when my therapist went to the legs it was no longer aroma therapy but deep tissue combined with elongation of the toes with deep pressure....  and the massage for my husband was only line pressuring up and down.....
All together only 1 stars - for the welcome and ambiente...

title: House of Taste Thai Cooking School, Phuket
ownerDescription:
House of Taste Thai Cooking School provides the best hands-on experiences of cooking authentic Thai food. We are a group of people with keen interests in food and culinary arts.

We provide various cooking classes including Half-day Group Classes (4 dishes in 3.5 hours), Private/Advanced/Team Building courses, and DTV courses.

Half-day class starts with a local market tour to buy daily fresh ingredients. You’ll get to experience Thai culture and local lifestyle in Kata (Karon), Phuket. Cook and dine 4 authentic Thai menus made from scratch. This exciting course is the perfect way to explore the traditions of Thai food and prepare you for all skills and knowledge needed to prepare the mouth-watering dishes at home.
address: 43 16 Patak Soi 14, Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83100, Thailand
plusCode: R8M3+6W Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Soe Sahebzad

A huge shoutout to Ms. April for her fantastic guidance. She gave detailed, step-by-step explanations for every dish, making everything easy and fun to learn. She is super professional, highly skilled, and has a brilliant sense of humor that kept everyone laughing and engaged throughout the entire class.
The whole experience was smooth, educational, and delicious. I genuinely cannot recommend this enough—it is an absolute must-do!

Would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting! <3

reviews.name: Michelle Chatfield
reviews.text: Spent a wonderful three and a half hours with April, Kay and their team today,  starting with a visit to the local markets and clear explanations of the ingredients and how they impact the dishes, as well as tips on selecting the fruit and vegetables for the planned dishes. The cooking school has been recently renovated and features having a wonderful modern set up and views. The day was informative, organised and most importantly fun 🤩 we cooked 4 dishes that were all delicious and received lots of great tips and tricks for cooking Thai food, thanks for a wonderful day 😁

reviews.name: Katrina Guthrie
reviews.text: The food was phenomenal and was overall an incredible experience. There was four courses all equally as delicious! I went with my family and we all had such a great time. This is also very beginner friendly with the staff being very helpful. I would recommend this to anyone!!!

reviews.name: ANJ Phage

I highly recommend this cooking class to anyone visiting Phuket!

reviews.name: Angela Nguyen
reviews.text:
I walked in without an appointment and had no trouble getting in. Located on the 5th floor. I chose the 90-minute neck and shoulder massage for 1,700 THB. It’s on the pricier side compared to other massage shops, but it was absolutely worth it.

I specifically wanted a massage that focused almost entirely on my neck and shoulders, and that’s exactly what I got. The therapist really worked through my knots and tension. I walked out feeling noticeably lighter, and my neck and shoulders felt so much better afterward.

The facility was spotless, the atmosphere was peaceful, and the calming music made it incredibly relaxing.

I would definitely come back. If you’re looking for a true neck and shoulder massage rather than a full-body massage with a little attention to those areas, I highly recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 😊 We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed your neck and shoulder massage and that it helped relieve your tension. It's great to know you appreciated our peaceful atmosphere, clean facilities, and the care provided by our therapist.

Thank you for recommending us to others. We truly look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit to ICONSIAM!

— The BHU MHAI Team

reviews.name: Tina Tong
reviews.text:
My husband and i were visiting the massive Icon Siam recently. It was our first visit there and was looking for a massage place. As google said its an upscale spa.. we decided to try 2 hours of thai massage. The reception looks impressive and when we were shown into the massage area, it was just cubicles with curtains drawn. I do not wish to give it 5 stars for a few reasons. 1) the masseu lady i had was massaging me too soft in the first 10 minutes so i was trying to tell her to be stronger. however, she did not have a courteous look at all. She decided to swap with her partner masseu who was massaging my husband. luckily the other masseu was what i preferred and seemed to understand english, 2) another customer was on his speaker phone ! no one stopped him!

3) another thai customer came in ( i presumed it was their regular ) and was carrying on with a nice chat with her masseu!

therefore , i cannot give this place 5 stars it is a shame as it is clean and convenient on the 5th floor of Icon Siam.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Guest,

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback and for choosing BHU MHAI during your visit to ICONSIAM.

We're pleased to hear that you found our spa clean and conveniently located. At the same time, we sincerely apologize that your experience did not fully meet your expectations.

We appreciate your comments regarding the communication with our therapist and the atmosphere in the treatment area. A relaxing and peaceful environment is very important to us, and we will review these matters with our team to ensure a more comfortable experience for all of our guests.

Your feedback is truly valuable and helps us improve our service. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again and provide you with the five-star experience you expected.

— The BHU MHAI Team

reviews.text: This is a great middle of the road spa / massage business. Traditional Tantric sensual and erotic massage available.

reviews.name: Bowen Huang
reviews.text:
I took a chance and walked into this studio last week, and it turned out to be one of the best decisions I’ve made.

As someone who doesn’t speak Thai, I was nervous at first, especially since most of the students have been practicing for decades. But everyone welcomed me with such kindness. The teachers switched between Thai and English so I could follow along.

The community here is incredibly warm and supportive. People genuinely encourage each other, celebrate every bit of progress, and make everyone feel like they belong.

Thank you for creating such a beautiful space, Kamphu. I feel very lucky to practice here.🙏🏼
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words! 💖 We are so happy to hear that walking into our studio was such a great decision for you. It was a true pleasure having you in class! Creating a welcoming, inclusive, and supportive community for everyone—regardless of language or experience—means the world to us. We’re so glad you felt the warmth and positive energy here. Hope to practice with you again soon! 🙏🏼✨

reviews.name: Daungyewa Utarasint
reviews.text:
I thoroughly enjoyed my experience with Teacher Kamphu. Taking private lessons with her has greatly enhanced my yoga practice. I had put off practicing for almost two years because of chronic pain in my left shoulder.
Teacher Kamphu is very attentive and caring. She helps correct and adjust your base poses so you don't risk injury later on. When I told her about my shoulder problem, she took it seriously and kept it in mind throughout the session: for any pose that involved the left shoulder, she made sure to guide me through an alternative posture.
By the end of my private lessons with her, I had regained both my confidence and my love of yoga. Thank you, Teacher Kamphu — khob khun mak mak ka. 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Hong, for trusting me with your yoga journey! I’m absolutely thrilled to help you find joy in your practice again. It’s always a pleasure to guide such a wonderful student like you. See you again soon!

Applying pinpoint acupressure to "Point 1 on the Lower Back" (next to the 5th lumbar vertebra / at the bottom of energy line 1 on the back) has a particularly outstanding effect among the three points, specifically "resetting the body's foundation," as follows:
1. Reducing the burden on the lumbar spine (preventing acute lower back pain)
The joint between the 5th lumbar vertebra (L5) and the sacrum (the bone in the middle of the pelvis) is the place in the human spine where the weight of the body is concentrated and stress is most intense.
Restoring cushioning:
By applying pressure to Point 1 and loosening the surrounding multifidus muscles, the blockage between the lumbar vertebrae is relieved, and the compressive stress on the intervertebral discs is released. This significantly prevents acute lower back pain caused by sudden movements.

Point 1 is very close to the "origin" where the tendons of the erector spinae muscles attach to the pelvis (sacrum). This is a very dynamic and powerful technique called "Double Foot Press" in Chiang Mai-style Thai massage.

The therapist sits with their legs extended and uses both feet to press the back of the thighs in a "sideways walking" motion, delivering a more stable, deeper, and stronger pressure than when using only one foot.

Key Points of the Treatment
"Sideways Walking" Rhythm: Just like striking a keyboard, shift your weight alternately between your right and left feet, moving from "above the back of the knee → middle → in front of the ischium." This rhythm is key to releasing the client's tension.

Therapist's Weight Shift: In the seated position, instead of pushing with arm strength, the trick is to slightly lean your upper body forward, as if "bringing your navel closer to the client," and shift your weight onto both feet.

The Role of the Hands (Anchor for Stability):
Hands holding the ankle: These act as support to prevent the bent leg from falling outwards.

Hands holding the knee: By fixing the straight leg to the floor, the pressure from both feet is not released and reaches deep into the hamstrings.
Expected effects:
Maximum surface pressure: Because both feet are used, the client feels a comfortable pressure as if being "pushed by a big wave."
Thorough muscle fiber massage: The alternating foot movements move the hamstring muscle fibers in multiple directions, powerfully increasing flexibility.

This is a highly technical and dynamic technique using traditional foot pressure from Chiang Mai-style Thai massage. In particular, it incorporates a technique to deliver stable and strong pressure to the client's hamstrings by creating a "leg lock."

This document summarizes the key points of this technique and precautions for safe and effective execution.

1. Positioning and Locking
The process of crossing the client's legs over the therapist's legs to "lock" them is crucial for the therapist's own body stability and protection of the client's hip and knee joints.

Securing a fulcrum: By placing the client's foot under the therapist's knee and holding the heel, a "lever fulcrum" is created to prevent the client's leg from slipping.

Supporting the back of the knee: By grasping the back of the knee with the other hand, hyperextension (over-bending) of the knee joint is prevented, allowing for safe and concentrated pressure on the hamstrings.

2. Pressure Application and Rhythm
The "12321" rhythm is fundamental to the approach to "Sen" (energy lines) in Thai massage.
Differentiation of Foot Sole and Side (Temporal) Use:
Entire Sole: Apply gentle, sustained pressure using a broad surface area.
Temporal (Outer Side of Foot): Target deeper layers and the edges of specific muscles.

reviews.text:
CCAスクールの卒業生です。

タイマッサージLevel①〜⑤、お腹ダイレクソロジー、トークセンなど、受講できるものを　ほぼ学ばせて頂き、どれもインストラクター資格まで取得させて頂きました。

＊
インストラクター資格のイメージは、日本でスクールを開業して、生徒様に対してレッスンをし、CCAスクールのディプロマ(資格証明書)を発行できる　というような感じがわかりやすいかと。

CCAスクールで学んだことを、日本で活かして。ある企業様のフィットネス事業部において、売上げ日本一位になることができました。それは、トレーニング＋タイ古式マッサージ(CCAスタイル)を組み込み、お客様のダイエットで必ず「結果」を出すことが出来たからです。

タイ古式と言っても、たくさんのスクールがある中で、、、

なんで？
CCAスクールが、おすすめなのか。それは、レッスンにおける細かい指導が行き渡っているからです。

他のスクールだと、テクニックにおいては　アバウトな形で指導する所も多いのがタイのマッサージスクールでは見受けられます。

しかし、各先生方が生徒に対して　テクニックが「もの」になるように　細かな点まで指導してくださります。時には、優しく、時には厳しく。たくさんの「愛情」を持ってレクチャーしてくださります。

例えば、指圧のポイントが少しでも違ったら　直ぐに教えてくれたり。難易度が高いストレッチの場合は、体重のかけ方から　細かく教えてくれたり。

だから、タイ古式マッサージを学んで、日本でお客様に喜んで頂くために、キャッシュフローを良くしていきたい方は！！

CCAスクールがダントツでおすすめです。僕は、このスクールで学んだおかげ様で、日本で結果を「数字」という形で残すことができたので。もちろん、1番はお客様の笑顔を見ることができたのが最大のおすすめする理由です♪

【先生方の魅力】

(タノム先生)

タノム先生は、いつも優しく元気で、時にはジョークを通じて、場を和ませてくださります。タイ古式の技術もすごく、漢字のイメージで表すと「剛」の中に、すごく温かさがある感じで、施術中のまとったオーラを、個人的には学ぶべきポイントです♪

(キム先生)

自分は、1番キム先生の指導を受けました。全てのものをハイクオリティーで表現するのがキム先生です。タイ古式マッサージもすごいし、お腹ダイレクソロジーの表現レベルは、世界一と思ってます。

漢字のイメージで表すと「柔」と「美」です。柔らかいタッチで、美しいタッチのリズムを奏でる様は「芸術」です♪

(ヌム先生)

彼は「天才」です。He's a genius.
ヌム先生の視点は、特別で、生徒様がなかなか技術的な面で困っていると

ちょっとした立ち位置のアドバイスをして、直ぐに改善されたりと。

タイ古式マッサージは、体格の関係上でテキスト通りに出来ないことも多々あります。だけど、ヌム先生は生徒1人1人に対して、しっかりと向き合ってレクチャーしてくださります。

余談ですが、ヌム先生とは同じ年だけど、凄すぎてまだまだ書きたいことがありますが、この辺で（笑）

【最後に】

もしスクール選びで迷っている方がいたら、是非CCAスクールを！！

人生を変える出会いが待っていると思います！！
reviews.textTranslated:
I am a graduate of the CCA School.

I have taken almost all the courses available, including Thai Massage Levels 1-5, Abdominal Directional Reflexology, and Tok Sen, and have obtained instructor certifications in all of them.

*To give you an idea of ​​what instructor certification means, it's like being able to open a school in Japan, teach students, and issue CCA School diplomas (certificates of qualification).

I have put what I learned at CCA School to good use in Japan. I was able to achieve the top sales in Japan for a company's fitness division. This was because I combined training with Thai massage (CCA style), consistently delivering "results" in clients' weight loss.

Even among the many Thai massage schools...

Why?

Why do I recommend CCA School? Because of the detailed and thorough instruction in their lessons.

In other schools, the instruction of techniques is often rather vague, which is something I've observed in Thai massage schools.

However, each instructor provides meticulous guidance to ensure that the techniques become truly ingrained in the students. Sometimes gentle, sometimes strict, they teach with immense care and affection.

For example, if the pressure points are even slightly off, they'll immediately correct you. For more difficult stretches, they'll explain everything in detail, starting with how to apply weight.

Therefore, if you want to learn Thai massage and improve your cash flow to make your clients happy in Japan,

CCA School is by far the best recommendation! Thanks to what I learned at this school, I was able to achieve tangible results in Japan. Of course, the biggest reason I recommend it is seeing the smiles on my clients' faces!

【Instructor's Appeal】

(Tanom Sensei)

Tanom Sensei is always kind and energetic, and sometimes lightens the mood with jokes. Thai massage techniques are incredible. If I were to describe them using kanji characters, it would be "strong," but with a great deal of warmth. The aura he exudes during treatment is something I personally believe is worth learning from.

(Kim Sensei)

I received the most instruction from Kim Sensei. Kim Sensei expresses everything with high quality. His Thai massage is amazing, and I believe his abdominal directional massage technique is the best in the world.

If I were to describe him using kanji characters, it would be "soft" and "beautiful." His soft touch and the beautiful rhythm he creates are truly "art."

(Num Sensei)

He is a "genius."
Num Sensei's perspective is unique. When students are struggling with technical aspects,

he'll give a little advice on positioning, and they improve immediately.

Thai massage often can't be performed exactly as written in the text due to differences in physique. However, Num Sensei carefully attends to each student and provides thorough instruction.

As a side note, although Professor Num and I are the same age, he's so amazing that I still have so much more I want to write, but I'll stop here for now (lol).

[Finally]

If you're struggling to choose a school, I highly recommend CCA School!!

I believe a life-changing encounter awaits you!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
この度は、ここまで丁寧で心のこもったレビューをお寄せいただき、本当にありがとうございます。

CCAでの学びを通じて、日本で具体的な「結果」として成果を出されたこと、そしてお客様の笑顔につながっていることを大変嬉しく思います。

Level①〜⑤から各種講座、さらにインストラクター資格まで深く学んでいただいた中で、私たちの指導やカリキュラムに信頼を寄せていただけたことは、何よりの励みです。

CCAでは、単にテクニックを学ぶだけでなく、実際の現場で「使える技術」として身につけていただくことを大切にしています。
そのため、細かな手の使い方や体重の乗せ方まで、一人ひとりに合わせて指導しております。

また、タノム先生・キム先生・ヌム先生それぞれの個性や魅力についても、ここまで深く感じ取っていただき、心より感謝いたします。

これからも、受講生の皆さまがそれぞれの現場で価値を発揮できるよう、より質の高い教育を提供してまいります。

これからタイマッサージを本質から学びたい方、そして現場で結果を出したい方にとって、CCAが一つの選択肢になれば幸いです。

改めて、素晴らしいご縁とご活躍に心より感謝いたします。今後ともどうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

reviews.name: Baan Dee Dee
reviews.text:
いつもお世話になっています。
今まで、サロン研修やタイの他のスクールも行きましたが、このスクールに通ってからタイマッサージの悩みがなくなったので、カリキュラムも先生方も信頼しています。
reviews.textTranslated:
Thank you for your continued support.

I've attended salon training and other schools in Thailand before, but since attending this school, all my concerns about Thai massage have disappeared. Therefore, I trust the curriculum and the instructors.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
この度は温かいレビューをいただき、誠にありがとうございます。

これまで様々な研修やスクールを経験された中で、当校の学びがタイマッサージの悩みの解消につながったとのこと、大変嬉しく思います。

カリキュラムや講師陣に信頼を寄せていただけたことは、私たちにとって何よりの励みです。

今後も、現場で実践しやすく、本質的に理解できる学びを提供できるよう努めてまいります。
引き続きどうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

reviews.name: miyuki
reviews.text:
チェンマイでタイマッサージを3校から習い、感じたCCAの特徴をシェアします。

①予約・質問などをやりとりする日本人スタッフの方が、とても親切・丁寧・迅速な対応でした。

② 学校の空気感も優しく穏やか。
チェンマイのおばあちゃんのおうちで過ごすような居心地の良さ。緊張せず、リラックスして学べました。
生徒のペースを見て講習ペースを合わせてくれます。
(私の覚えが悪くても ゆっくり教えて下さいました)

③講習テキストに手技毎の復習動画QRコード付き！
事後分からなくなっても動画で大枠確認できます。
(全体的にフォローが手厚いと思いました。)

④どの先生も日本語が お上手なので(女性のキム先生から習いました。マッサージ店勤務歴あり)、他校より 詳しく手技を教えていただきました。

その他は写真・動画にコメント追加しているので、参考にして下さい＊
reviews.textTranslated:
I learned Thai massage at three schools in Chiang Mai, and I'd like to share my impressions of what makes CCA unique.

① The Japanese staff who handled reservations and questions were very kind, polite, and prompt.

② The school atmosphere was gentle and calm.
It felt like spending time at grandma's house in Chiang Mai. I was able to learn without tension and in a relaxed atmosphere.
They adjusted the pace of the class to suit the student's pace.
(Even though I had a bad memory, they taught me slowly.)

③ The course textbook came with QR codes for review videos for each technique!
If you forget something after the class, you can check the general outline by watching the videos.
(I felt the support was excellent overall.)

④ All the teachers spoke fluent Japanese (I learned from Ms. Kim, a woman with experience working at a massage parlor), so I was able to learn the techniques in more detail than at other schools.

I've added comments to the photos and videos, so please refer to them.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: こんにちわ。雨季のチェンマイは果物がおいしくて緑の自然がきれいになります。またCCAに来てください。ありがとう。

reviews.name: 2 m
reviews.text:
ここに来て10日が経ちました。
毎日楽しいです♬
スクールは、朝9時から6時迄お休憩を取りながら行います。
先生達は皆んな明るく、楽しみながらも、丁寧に教えてくれます。日本人専門なので言葉の壁も気になりません。それがとっても魅力です。
寮も清潔で快適に過ごせます。
美味しいランチを皆んなで食べます。
洗濯物もしてもらえ助かります。
ここの周りには色々なお店も有るので、荷物も少なくして現地調達で問題無いです。
サポートしてくれる日本の方も、居ますので心強いです。
スクールの後の、外での食事も美味しいです。
何よりチェンマイの人達は皆んな笑顔で、元気です。
タイで本番のマッサージを習いたい人、本番の空気感を体験するには最高な場所でお勧めです。
reviews.textTranslated:
It's been 10 days since I arrived here.
Every day is fun!
The school runs from 9 am to 6 pm with breaks in between.
The teachers are all cheerful and teach carefully while making it fun. Since it's exclusively for Japanese students, there's no language barrier, which is a huge plus.
The dormitory is clean and comfortable.
We all enjoy delicious lunches together.
Laundry is also done, which is a great help.
There are many shops around, so you can pack light and easily buy things locally.
There are also Japanese people who provide support, which is very reassuring.
The food we eat out after school is also delicious.
Above all, the people of Chiang Mai are all smiling and energetic.
For anyone who wants to learn authentic Thai massage or experience the real atmosphere, this is the perfect place and highly recommended.

reviews.name: T N
reviews.text: 日本語で学べる貴重なタイマッサージスクールです。タイ人の先生が解剖用語も日本語で説明してくださいます。また、技術的な注意点に関しても本当に細かく教えてくださいます。たくさんの学びがありました。タイマッサージ初心者の方はもちろんですが、経験者の方も是非学びに訪れて欲しい場所です。
reviews.textTranslated: This is a rare Thai massage school where you can learn in Japanese. The Thai instructors explain anatomical terms in Japanese, and they also provide very detailed instructions on technical points. I learned so much. It's a place I would recommend not only to beginners in Thai massage, but also to experienced practitioners.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
日本人の生徒は詳しく学びたい人が多いです。私たちは20年間日本人にタイマッサージを教えました。
順番だけ覚えて終わる学校じゃないです。筋肉の事、力のこと、考え方のこと。あなたの知りたいことを日本語で何でも質問してください。

reviews.name: NEHAN SPA & School
reviews.text:
タイマッサージレベル1と2のインストラクターを日本で取得して、その上のテクニックを勉強するためにCCAに来ました。

初めてのことで不安でしたが、心配無用でした！CCAの授業を教えてくれるのはタイ人のベテラン講師達ですが、日本人向けスクールなので100%日本語のレッスンで安心です。
先生はみんな優しくてハッピーで楽しくて、マッサージに関してはプロフェッショナルで真面目。
細かいニュアンスをもっと深く聞きたいときは英語が通じますし、みんなお互いスマホの翻訳を駆使しながらコミュニケーションを取ってました。

現在敷地内にある4人部屋の女子寮はめちゃくちゃ快適でした。
寝具は床にマットレスで寝心地は良いです。立ちシャワーとトイレが一体型のバスルームが２つあるから他の人と被りません。
シャンプー、コンディショナー、ボディソープ、1800wと2100wのハイパワードライヤー2台（すぐ乾く！）、フェイスタオルとバスタオルのセットが用意してあります。あと、身支度用の女優ミラーが２つあってびっくり。
寮の外のキッチンと冷蔵庫も使えます。
洗濯はお手伝いさんが毎日してくれて、下着も気にせず洗ってもらってました。これは地味に助かりすぎる。持ってくる服は少して大丈夫ですよ。
何よりも、現地の日本人スタッフの山本さんが、細やかに対応してくれて、現地の情報も即座にくれるし、お出かけをアレンジして同行してくれて良い感じの若者で、安心感がありました。
海外に慣れていないけど、本格的なタイマッサージを勉強したい人におすすめです。

追記
その後ピン川の洪水があり、学校も浸水になって避難しました。山本さんのサポートで全員無事にホテルに移動でき、レッスンもどうにかリスケしていただけそうです。
reviews.textTranslated:
I obtained my Thai Massage Level 1 and 2 instructor certifications in Japan and came to CCA to study more advanced techniques.

I was anxious because it was my first time, but there was no need to worry! The instructors at CCA are veteran Thai teachers, but since it's a school for Japanese students, the lessons are 100% in Japanese, which is reassuring.

The teachers are all kind, happy, and fun, and are professional and serious about massage.

If you want to ask about subtle nuances in more detail, you can communicate in English, and everyone uses smartphone translation apps to communicate.

The four-person women's dormitory on campus is incredibly comfortable.

The bedding consists of mattresses on the floor, which is very comfortable. There are two bathrooms with combined showers and toilets, so you won't overlap with other people.

Shampoo, conditioner, body soap, two high-powered hair dryers (1800w and 2100w – dries hair quickly!), and sets of face towels and bath towels are provided. I was also surprised to find two vanity mirrors for getting ready.

You can also use the kitchen and refrigerator outside the dormitory.

The laundry was done daily by a maid, and I didn't have to worry about washing my underwear. This was incredibly helpful. You don't need to bring many clothes.

Above all, Mr. Yamamoto, the Japanese staff member on site, was very attentive, provided immediate local information, arranged outings, and accompanied us. He was a nice young man, and I felt very secure.

I recommend this place to anyone who isn't used to traveling abroad but wants to learn authentic Thai massage.


Postscript:
Later, the Ping River flooded, and the school was submerged, so we had to evacuate. Thanks to Mr. Yamamoto's support, everyone was able to move safely to the hotel, and it looks like the lessons will be rescheduled.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 学校ひっこししました。チェンマイでまたタイマッサージの勉強にきてくださいね。ありがとう。

reviews.name: Sae
reviews.text:
トークセン1day(6時間)のコースを受講しました!私たちは3名で予約しましたが、先生2人がついてくれて非常に丁寧、熱心に指導してくださいました!
教科書もわかりやすく、全てのページにQRコードからとべる動画もあり復習もできます。

基本的にマンツーマンですが、2名以上で受講すると少し割引になるのと、個人的に1人モデルで先生がやるところを見ながらメモとれたり、左右に分かれて先生と同時に見よう見まねで実践できたのでわかりやすかったです!

他にも色々なコースがあります!
問い合わせのレスポンスも早く、当日の案内などのメールも丁寧に対応してくださりとてもオススメしたいスクールです!

先生方は日本語でレッスンしてくれますので語学が不安な方も安心です!

かわいい飼い犬がいるので、アレルギーの方はご注意ください🐕
reviews.textTranslated:
We took a 1-day (6-hour) Tok Sen course! We booked for three people, and two instructors were assigned to us, providing very thorough and enthusiastic instruction!
The textbook was easy to understand, and every page had a QR code that linked to a video, making review easy.

While it's basically one-on-one instruction, there's a small discount for groups of two or more. Personally, I found it very helpful that I could take notes while watching the instructor demonstrate, or practice simultaneously with the instructor by watching and imitating them, with one person acting as the model.

They offer various other courses!
The response to inquiries was quick, and the emails regarding the day's information were very polite and helpful. I highly recommend this school!

The instructors teach in Japanese, so even those worried about language barriers can feel at ease!

There's a cute pet dog, so please be aware if you have allergies 🐕
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
この度はトークセン1dayコースをご受講いただき、また丁寧なご感想をありがとうございます。

3名様でのご参加により、実技を見て・実践して・確認するという学び方がしやすかったとのこと、大変嬉しく思います。少人数制のため、できるだけ一人ひとりに目が届く指導を心がけております。

また、テキストとQRコード動画による復習システムについてもご評価いただきありがとうございます。帰国後や日常の中でも繰り返し学べる環境は、技術の定着において重要だと考えております。

日本語でのレッスンや事前のご案内についても安心していただけたとのことで何よりです。

トークセン以外にも多くのコースをご用意しておりますので、ぜひ次回は別の技術も学びにいらしてください。再度お会いできることを楽しみにしております。

reviews.name: SAYURI
reviews.text:
以前からお世話になっています。
ニマンヘミンからこちらに移動して来たスクールです。それに伴いスクールの形態もグループからプライベートに変わり、その分みっちり＆まったりとしたレッスンになりました。
先生方はとても親切で一生懸命教えて下さります。(そして時にとても面白く…笑いが絶えません)
学校選びで悩んでいる方は是非一度足を運んで下さい。

また、スクールだけでなく施術を受ける事も可能です。プロフェッショナルな先生方の施術を是非体験してみて下さい。街中のマッサージ店のように当たり外れはありません。もちろん『当たり』のみです✨
色々なコースがありますので毎日通っても飽きません😉✨
reviews.textTranslated:
I've been using their services for a long time.
This school moved from Nimmanhaemin to here. As a result, the school format changed from group to private, resulting in more intensive and relaxed lessons.
The teachers are very kind and teach with great enthusiasm. (And sometimes they're really funny...the laughs never stop.)
If you're having trouble choosing a school, be sure to give them a try.

You can also receive treatments here, not just classes. Be sure to experience the treatments of our professional teachers. Unlike regular massage parlors in town, there are no hits or misses. Of course, there are only "hits." ✨
There are so many different courses available that you won't get bored even if you go every day. 😉✨

reviews.name: 眞船依子
reviews.text:
チェンマイで色々な学校に行きました。それぞれの良さはありますが、私はCCAがとても気に入っています。タイ人の先生がとても日本語が上手なので詳しくしっかり教えてくれること。テキストにQRコードが付いていて、いつでも動画で復習できること。こんなに充実しているのにリーズナブルなこと。1dayなど短期間で習える講座もあり、短い滞在期間でもたくさん学べること。お昼ごはんはタノム校長先生手作りの美味しいタイ料理ランチつき(学費に含む)。そして何より、メソッドが素晴らしい。実践的ですぐ現場で使えるものばかりです。郊外に移転後も、オールドシティまで校長先生が車で迎えに来てくださいます。

…CCAを選ばない理由があるとすれば、何だろう？頭をひねっても思いつきません。

そのぐらい全てにおいて素晴らしい学校です。
reviews.textTranslated:
I visited several schools in Chiang Mai. Each had its merits, but I really liked CCA. The Thai teachers are excellent at Japanese, so they teach thoroughly and in detail. The textbooks have QR codes, allowing for video review anytime. Despite being so comprehensive, it's very affordable. They offer short-term courses, such as one-day programs, so you can learn a lot even with a short stay. Lunch is included (in tuition), featuring delicious Thai food homemade by Principal Thanom. And above all, the method is fantastic. Everything is practical and immediately applicable in the field. Even after moving to the suburbs, the principal still picks you up from Old City by car.

...If there's a reason not to choose CCA, what could it be? I can't think of one, no matter how hard I try.

It's that good in every way.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
日本でもタイマッサージを楽しんでください。そして喜ぶ人を増やしてください。それがあなたの人生を良くします。
再びチェンマイで会えますように。

reviews.name: ゆりか
reviews.text:
先生達の日本語が想像以上に上手で、分からないところはすぐに聞けて教えてもらえる環境がとてもありがたかったです。
優しく、ユーモアのある先生達のおかげで最後まで楽しく学ぶことができました。

タイ人の先生に直接指導してもらえる充実感や、チェンマイならではの安らぐ雰囲気は日本ではまず味わえなかったと思います。貴重な経験になりました。

タノム先生には、エレファントキャンプ、タイガーキングダム、ドーイステープをまわるツアーも行っていただき、本当に来て良かったと思える日々を過ごせました。

またチェンマイに行きます。
reviews.textTranslated:
The teachers' Japanese was much better than I expected, and I was very grateful for the environment where I could immediately ask questions and get explanations whenever I didn't understand something.

Thanks to the kind and humorous teachers, I was able to enjoy learning until the very end.

The sense of fulfillment from being directly taught by Thai teachers and the relaxing atmosphere unique to Chiang Mai are things I probably wouldn't have experienced in Japan. It was a valuable experience.

Teacher Thanom also took me on a tour of the elephant camp, Tiger Kingdom, and Doi Suthep, and I truly felt that I was glad I came.

I will definitely go back to Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: yuj komala
reviews.text:
トークセン習おかなーとぼんやり考えてたところ、
以前から知り合いの方とバッタリチェンマイで会い、

CCAもよかったよー！と勧められたので、

早速、タイ式のレベル4とトークセンを予約！

続けざまに、

ホームタイ古式マッサージと

お腹ダイレクソロジーを受講しました！

ホームタイ古式マッサージとお腹ダイレクソロジーは、インストラクターとして、学ばさせてもらいました！

こちらの学校は、少数で学べて、とてもアットホーム！

先生方はベテランの方ばかりです

お昼ご飯も注文しといたら、校長先生が50バーツで作ってくれます！

それがめちゃ美味しい😋

私のお客さんも、チェンマイに来られて、CCAでホームタイ古式マッサージを習われました！笑

ナイトバザールにも近いロイクロ通りにある、CCAで皆さんも習ってみてください！
reviews.textTranslated:
I was vaguely thinking about learning Tok Sen when,
I unexpectedly ran into someone I knew in Chiang Mai,
and they recommended CCA, saying, "CCA is great!"
So, I immediately booked Level 4 Thai Massage and Tok Sen!

I then took
Home Thai Traditional Massage and
Abdominal Directional Reflexology courses!

I was even taught Home Thai Traditional Massage and Abdominal Directional Reflexology as an instructor!

This school has small class sizes and is very homey!

All the instructors are veterans.

If you order lunch, the principal will make it for you for 50 baht!

It's incredibly delicious! 😋

One of my clients also came to Chiang Mai and learned Home Thai Traditional Massage at CCA! Lol

I recommend everyone try learning at CCA, located on Loi Kroh Road, close to the Night Bazaar!

reviews.name: A. S.
reviews.text: 楽しかった〜！！！素晴らしく、親密な勉強のできる環境が整っています。お優しい人柄の先生方、皆さんそれぞれから丁寧なご指導をいただきました。１週間をこえる寮生活は現地に着くまで不安でしたが、とても清潔で快適でした。寝心地ばっちりのマットレス、美味しいお昼ごはんまで校長先生自らご提供下さり、感激しました。同時期の生徒さんとも仲良く過ごせ、出会いに感謝です。途中、体調を崩しましたが、病院のご紹介など日本人スタッフさんの手厚いサポートのおかげで無事にディプロマを取得。また「帰って来たい。」と思える、心の故郷💓になりました。
reviews.textTranslated: It was so much fun!!! It's a wonderful, intimate learning environment. The teachers were all very kind, and each of them gave me careful guidance. I was a bit worried about living in the dormitory for over a week before I arrived, but it was very clean and comfortable. The principal even provided a comfortable mattress and a delicious lunch, which I was very touched by. I also got along well with the other students in my class, and I'm grateful for the encounters I had. I did get sick midway through, but thanks to the generous support of the Japanese staff, including referrals to hospitals, I was able to successfully complete my diploma. It has become a spiritual home💓 that I want to return to again.

reviews.name: yatabe maria
reviews.text:
今回知り合いの方から、こちらのタイマッサージスクールがとても丁寧で施術内容も良いと聞き、今回通うことにしました♪

評判通り、先生方はとても丁寧にまた時にふざけたり楽しく学ばさせて頂きました(^^)
他のスクールにも通ったことがありますが、テキストがとても分かりやすくとくにマッサージ初心者の方にもオススメです♪

私はベビーマッサージも学びましたが内容が丁寧でびっくりしました！！

また次回もCCAさんにお世話になります(^^)ノ
reviews.textTranslated:
I heard from an acquaintance that this Thai massage school is very thorough and the treatments are excellent, so I decided to attend. ♪

Just as the reviews said, the teachers were very thorough and sometimes even joking around, making the learning experience fun. (^^)

I've attended other schools, but the materials are very easy to understand, so I recommend them, especially for massage beginners. ♪

I also studied baby massage, and I was surprised at how thorough the content was! !!

I'll definitely be back to CCA again next time. (^^)ノ

reviews.name: kinopi
reviews.text: 初めてタイ古式マッサージの授業を受けたところがCCAで本当によかったです！日本語の上手な先生方に細かいところまで教えていただき、充実した時間を過ごせました☺️送迎ありで、お昼ご飯もあって…大満足でした！またお伺いさせていただきます✨！
reviews.textTranslated: I'm so glad I chose CCA for my first Thai massage class! The instructors, who spoke excellent Japanese, taught me every detail, and I had a very fulfilling time. They even provided transportation and lunch... I was completely satisfied! I'll definitely come again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
日本人は丁寧です。真面目に学びたい人多いです。辛いご飯苦手です。
マッサージが上手になったら、またC CAに来てください。

reviews.name: mo ka
reviews.text:
1dayレッスンを受講しました。
移転したスクールは市街地から離れますが、送迎があるため行き帰りの心配はありません。

先生方は優しくも、できていないことはきちんと指摘して、どうすればできるようになるかを伝えながら指導してくれます。
細かく教えてくれるのがCCAの好きなところです。
終了時刻より早くレッスンが終了し、その後苦手なところの復習を先生と一緒にすることができありがたかったです。

私が受講した日は日本人のサポートスタッフさんもいたので色んなお話ができました。
日本人向けのスクールということで、タイ国らしいおおらかさだけでなく、時間通りの送迎や進行もありがたかったです。

先生手作りのお昼ご飯や、3時のおやつタイムも幸せで、居心地良く学ぶことができました。

また、スクールだけでなく施術も受けることができます。

また帰ってきます。
reviews.textTranslated:
I took a one-day lesson.
The new school is away from the city center, but there is transportation so I don't have to worry about getting there and back.

The teachers are kind, but they also point out what I'm not doing well and teach me how to improve.

What I like about CCA is that they teach in such detail.
The lesson ended earlier than scheduled, so I was able to review my weak points with the teacher afterwards, which I appreciated.

There was a Japanese support staff member on the day I took the class, so we were able to talk about a variety of things.
As a school for Japanese people, I appreciated not only the laid-back atmosphere that is typical of Thailand, but also the punctual pick-up and drop-off and the class schedule.

I also enjoyed the homemade lunch prepared by the teacher and the 3 o'clock snack time, which made for a comfortable learning environment.

In addition to the class, you can also receive treatments.

I'll definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Mao Yukiue
reviews.text:
他の学校にもともと通っていて、手順しか教えてくれなかったり、質問に対して明確な答えが得られないことが多くモヤモヤしていたところ、こちらの学校を紹介していただきました。

試しに1日だけ通ってみたところ、内容の充実と、先生の細部に至る指導に感動しました。その勢いのまま、まだ最初の学校で予約していた残り2週間ほどのスケジュールを全てキャンセルして、CCAに全振りしました。

レベル1・2は基礎、3・4は親指をセーブするために肘・膝・足を使う、1・2の代わりとなるような手技がもりだくさんです。5はツボの位置を知ることがメインとなりますが、今まで曖昧だった位置が明確になって、筋肉について改めて勉強する機会となりました。

ただ手順を覚えることが目的ではなく、正しい身体の使い方、長くセラピストを続けられるような手技を学ぶことができる学校です。
1日の密度がかなり濃い授業なので、YouTubeに公開されている動画で予習したり、授業後は当日中にテキストを見て復習することがおすすめです。独特なテキストもおもしろくて好きです😂

本当にこの学校に出会えてよかったです。また来たいです☺️ありがとうございました！
reviews.textTranslated:
I was originally attending another school, but I was frustrated because they only taught procedures and didn't give clear answers to my questions. Then I was introduced to this school.

I tried attending for just one day, and I was impressed by the richness of the content and the instructor's detailed guidance. I was so impressed that I canceled all my remaining two weeks of scheduled classes at my first school and dedicated myself entirely to CCA.

Levels 1 and 2 cover the basics, while levels 3 and 4 are packed with techniques that use the elbows, knees, and feet to protect the thumb, essentially serving as an alternative to levels 1 and 2. Level 5 mainly focuses on knowing the location of acupressure points, and it clarified previously ambiguous locations, giving me a chance to relearn about muscles.

This school isn't just about memorizing procedures; it teaches correct body usage and techniques that will allow you to continue as a therapist for a long time.

The classes are quite dense, so I recommend preparing by watching the videos on YouTube and reviewing the textbook immediately after class. I also like the unique and interesting textbook! 😂

I'm truly glad I found this school. I'd love to come again! Thank you so much!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
CCAは20年日本人にタイマッサージを教えました。CC Aは順番だけ教える学校じゃないです。
詳しいことたくさん教えます。私たちは日本語をもっと上手にします。
ありがとう。私の友達

reviews.name: yusu
reviews.text: 受付や質問担当の日本人の方がLINEで丁寧に対応してくれるので現地に着くまで安心でした。アットホームな雰囲気で、リピーターの方々も先生も仲良く親戚が集まったかのような雰囲気。担当いただいたキム先生に親切丁寧に教えてもらい、細かく理解できました。どうしても行きたい市場があり、途中で抜けてバイクで送っていただくなどこちらの都合も大切に扱ってくださいます。とてもおすすめのスクールです。
reviews.textTranslated: The Japanese staff at the reception and in charge of questions were very helpful via LINE, so I felt at ease until I arrived at the destination. The atmosphere was homey, with repeat students and teachers all getting along well, like a gathering of relatives. Teacher Kim, who was in charge of my case, taught me kindly and carefully, and I was able to understand every detail. There was a market I really wanted to go to, so he took a break along the way and drove me there by motorbike, so he was very considerate of my schedule. I highly recommend this school.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: こんにちわ。雨季のチェンマイは果物がおいしくて緑の自然がきれいになります。またCCAに来てください。ありがとう。

reviews.name: sachika t
reviews.text:
安心して受講できると思います。

授業は日本語ですが、先生によってどの程度日本語が話せるかは違います。英語を交えたりシンプルな日本語に言い換えたり、お互いに気遣いつつコミュニケーションを取る感じです。
もちろんそれができなくても丁寧に教えてもらえるので心配はいらないと思います！気さくで素敵な先生方です。

女性用の寮を利用させて頂きましたがとても過ごしやすいです。
設備の心配はあまりいらないです。日本人スタッフの方が細やかに対応して下さるのでとても助かります。

グループ授業が復活したタイミングでしたので、今のところ少人数ですが他の受講生の方達と楽しく過ごしています。

想像よりもずっと環境がよく、授業に集中できています。
施術にしっかり活かせる技術を学ぶにはとても良いと思います。
reviews.textTranslated:
I feel comfortable taking the classes.

Classes are in Japanese, but the level of Japanese each teacher can speak varies. They mix in English or rephrase what is being said in simple Japanese, and communicate with each other while being considerate of each other.
Of course, even if you can't do that, they will still teach you carefully, so there's no need to worry! The teachers are all friendly and wonderful.

I stayed in the women's dormitory, which was very comfortable.
I didn't have to worry too much about the facilities. The Japanese staff were very attentive and helpful.

Group classes have just resumed, so although the class size is small for now, I'm having a great time with the other students.

The environment is much better than I expected, and I'm able to concentrate in class.

I think it's a great way to learn techniques that you can put to good use in your treatments.

title: Pian Massage & Thai Massage School
address: 108/15 Khaosan Rd, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand
plusCode: QF5X+G6 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Emilia
reviews.text: I’ve gotten two foot massages and a Thai back massage here and the massages were amazing (especially the Thai one from a lady named Yuda or Yody?). The ladies did such a good job and I felt really good afterwards. The only think that I didn’t really like is that you can’t choose if you want to sit in the back salon where it’s quiet or in the front where you have loud music from Khao San Road. I feel like if you can choose where to sit it would be even better and more relaxing!

reviews.name: 孫悟空
reviews.text: I am the Japanese student who came back to give a tip. I'm sorry if I caused any trouble because I didn't understand English well. But your kindness and great massage made me very happy. I will never forget you. Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Maya Bar Ilan
reviews.text:
A nice massage place, but probably not one of the best ones I had during my 4 weeks vacation to Thailand.
This was kind of disappointing, especially as the place is considered a Thai massage school, but it could also be that we just got unexperienced masseurs (all 3 were male masseurs).

reviews.name: Nav Amole
reviews.text: Reluctantly walked in this joint with my lady. She went for her feet and I got the thai version. Wow. What an experience. Say hi to An and ask for Aunwat.

reviews.name: Shaun D
reviews.text: The place is separated into two parts, one for foot massages and another for facials. The place is clean, well priced and the service is generally friendly. There is also working Wi-Fi. It loses a star because my 30 minute foot massage was 5 minutes on the "foot" and 25 minutes on the "leg". But that could vary with different therapists. Tea and cookies provided afterwards.

reviews.name: Monkey LaLa
reviews.text: I've been to many massage places in Bangkok and this is the best. Every time i come to Bangkok i come here. very peaceful people, nice cool room for massage. very skilled masseuses.

reviews.name: Kubilay Ertürk
reviews.text: Staff is incredibly kind, massagers were professional. Smells good, highly recommend it! 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Rahul Ajmera
reviews.text:
This is a nice place for a massage, located in the lanes at Khao San Road.  They charge standard prices of 150THB for a 30min massage.

The body massages take place in a common hall on the first floor and foot massages take place on ground floor.

reviews.name: Maui Jayson Tours
reviews.text:
Great prices!

Great Staff.

We will be back!

reviews.name: Anubhav Gupta
reviews.text: Very experienced massagers. Authentic thai massage.

reviews.name: Stephen Davis
reviews.text: Have been using this place for 20 years and it never fails me. Had an incredible 1hr massage and pedicure, visit here 😍🇹🇭😉

reviews.name: Tobias Graf
reviews.text: Great experience, the lady who did my massage was doing an excellent job.

reviews.name: Cassy Myers
reviews.text: Best place to go for massage on Khaosan road. Went here twice and it was better than any i got in Thailand.

reviews.name: Layla Yang
reviews.text: Excellent massage, only 300. Pretty comfortable

reviews.name: Miranda Nadeau

reviews.text: Best massage in this area. Very professional.

reviews.text: Great massage and super relaxing for a good price

reviews.name: Justin Brown
reviews.text: Always great ,my preferred place on the khao san

reviews.name: Sergi O
reviews.text: Awesome, that girl had magic in her hands ✨

title: Baan Hongnual Cookery school
address: 116หมู่ที่ 3 ซอย 6 Chai Sathan, Saraphi District, Chiang Mai 50140, Thailand
street: 116หมู่ที่ 3 ซอย 6
plusCode: P2RR+7W Chai Sathan, Saraphi District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Mike Eggenschwiler
reviews.text: Amazing experience! We booked the private cooking class and it started with a visit to the market to get some ingredients. We were able to freely choose any 4 dishes we'd like to cook. The cooking itself was great as we were told all little tricks to make great dishes. At the end you get a little recipe book with many classical thai dishes (but only if you pass the class😉)

reviews.name: William Blackley
reviews.text:
Amazing experience, such a beautiful location in a courtyard with greenery surrounding.
The facilities were great super clean polished tile floor.
Market trip first, explaining ingredients of what you cook.
Precise instructions with lots of patience and some funny moments.
I strongly recommended.
Thank-you.
Our garden in Australia with have more ingredients after this.

reviews.name: B K
reviews.text: What an experience! First get your fresh ingredients on the local market based on your chosen menu. Then prepare, cook and finally consume your own meal in a great athmosphere and with a great teacher. Receiving a cookbook at the end to try preparing Thai food also at home. Well appreciated!

reviews.name: Amber Sharma
reviews.text: Absolutely INCREDIBLE experience. 11/10. We notified our instructor of our dietary restrictions and she had no problem with improvising. We made spring rolls, stir fried veggies & tofu with rice noodles, tom kha kai soup, green curry, and mango sticky rice. Everything tasted delicious. The instructor went out of her way to explain everything thoroughly. She was loveable and had a great sense of humor. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this class to anyone and everyone, and I would undoubtedly partake in another one of these classes again.

reviews.name: Anna Penner
reviews.text: We did a cooking class with Baan Hongnual as a family and had such a fun time! They organized the ride from the hotel, took us to a market to see how locals shop for their ingredients, then brought us back to the cooking school. It’s a really pretty location! We got to help set the menu, and all the dishes we made were delicious! It was very easy to follow along, even if you’re not a very good cook. And luckily we got booklets with the recipes!

reviews.name: Elizabeth
reviews.text: We had an AMAZING time at the Baan Hongnual Cookery School! We did a private class with Ms. Amporn, and she was fantastic. She took us to the market and showed us how to pick out what we needed and even helped us pick out some things to bring home. We then drove to her house, where she has a very impressive set up. We set our own menu and she helped us cook each course. There was such an emphasis on hygiene, process, and customizing flavor to our own tastes. She even gave us a cookbook so we can recreate the recipes at home. Amporn is professional, skilled, funny, and helped us create some really tasty dishes! A must do in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Madison Stewart
reviews.text: We did a private morning cooking class and had a blast! Our teacher was kind, fun and went out of her way to educate us on how to adapt recipes when shopping and cooking at home. I had dietary requirements that they were happy to accommodate. The facility is in a peaceful area with fresh air that we enjoyed. The four hours flew by. Would highly recommend and can’t wait to use our cookbook at home!

reviews.name: Franzi Weiland
reviews.text:
It was such a great experience ! The teacher was awesome and the selfmade food tasted delicious. I highly recommend doing it! You'll get a cooking book for doing your own Thai food at home. Me and my friends had an amazing time :)

Thank you for the food adventure :)

reviews.name: Wojtek Konczalik
reviews.text: Our teacher Nai was amazing - she was really patient, had great English and taught us very well. The food turned out delicious and the whole experience was very fun!

reviews.name: Kathryn Heywood
reviews.text:
My daughter & I really enjoyed our experience learning to cook Thai food!
Thank you Amporn & your fantastic team 😊

reviews.name: MrPixiesrip
reviews.text: Beautiful garden, our teacher was excellent calm and caring. A peaceful and delightful day.

reviews.name: Julien “Err0r404” Schmitt
reviews.text:
Peoples here are so nice and give excellent cooking lessons!
Would recommend ++

reviews.name: Tim Walker
reviews.text: Fantastic morning cooking class. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: 林莉丹
reviews.text: The teacher is very interesting and the classmates are really fun!

reviews.name: Alice
reviews.text: Amazing experience!!!

reviews.name: Lars-Martin Bøe
reviews.text: Excellent!

reviews.name: Lester Cohen
reviews.text: Great experience

reviews.name: isabelle cordonnier
reviews.text:
Nous avons acheté les ingrédients au marché puis nous avons cuisiné 4 plats traditionnels : une soupe, une entrée, un pad thaïe et le fameux et délicieux dessert mango sticky rice. Tour était parfaitement organisé du transport au succulent et copieux repas de dégustation.
Bravo pour cette prestation sans faute!
reviews.textTranslated: We bought the ingredients at the market and then cooked four traditional dishes: a soup, an appetizer, pad thai, and the famous and delicious mango sticky rice dessert. Everything was perfectly organized, from transportation to the succulent and generous tasting meal. Congratulations on a flawless service!

reviews.name: balanu hutsakaas
reviews.text: Wij gingen met een groep de kookles volgen en dat was een super leuke en smaakvolle ervaring! Ze nemen je mee in het hele proces. Van het kopen van de groente op de lokale markt, naar het rollen van spring rolls en het bakken van Pad Thai in een wok. De omgeving was gezellig en schoon. Een absolute aanrader als je in Chiang Mai verblijft!
reviews.textTranslated: We took a cooking class with a group and it was a super fun and flavorful experience! They guide you through the entire process, from buying vegetables at the local market to rolling spring rolls and stir-frying Pad Thai in a wok. The setting was cozy and clean. Highly recommended if you are staying in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: 邱阿昭
reviews.text: 2026/02/18 參加kkday 訂購的烹飪學校行程，Ae老師很風趣又有耐心，除了教會如何做泰式料理，更教我們把握原則靈活變化。一開始先帶我們去傳統市場挑選採買食材，再來到烹飪學校，我們兩人共學做五道泰式料理。場地寬敞通風舒適，設備齊全，環境優美，下次有機會要再來。
reviews.textTranslated: On February 18, 2026, I participated in a cooking school trip booked through KKDay. Teacher Ae was very funny and patient. Besides teaching us how to cook Thai food, she also taught us to grasp the principles and be flexible. First, she took us to a traditional market to select and buy ingredients, and then we came to the cooking school where the two of us learned to cook five Thai dishes together. The venue was spacious, well-ventilated, comfortable, and well-equipped, with a beautiful environment. I would definitely come again next time.

title: Thai Isaan Cooking School
ownerDescription:
Best Thai Cooking School in Chiang Mai, provides 10 Thai recipes + 1 Thai drink includes 2 Isaan tribe’s recipes in addition to local market tour.
You will learn about Isaan tribe as well which is one of the Thai tribes and they have different cuisine than Thai cuisine, also they have different language than Thai language and different traditions.

#Cookingclasschiangmai
#Cookingclassinchiangmai
#Cooking_class_chiang_mai
#cooking_class_in_chiang_mai
address: 112, 6 Faham Rd Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50300, Thailand
plusCode: R2F2+H6 San Phi Suea, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Zeena Al-Obaidi
reviews.text:
Had the pleasure of doing this on my birthday and absolutely loved it! So many dishes, so much food, and the teacher is very knowledgeable and a really great guy.

The market tour at the start was fantastic in demystifying unknown foods you would normally pass by (including grilled brain!).
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for that great review, hope you enjoyed our class, and enjoy your trip😉

reviews.name: Yiwen Fan
reviews.text: Very nice experience with Thanya. I learnt the names of thai spices and we made 9 dishes and 1 drink, even cheaper than taking them in a restaurant! recommend you all to have a nice day here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Yiwen, we were happy to have you here:)

reviews.name: Timo Wijnhoud
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I did a morning cooking class at Thai Isaan Cooking School, and we had an amazing time. We got picked up from our hotel and went to a local market first. Our instructor showed us around and explained a lot about the market and all of the different ingredients to us. Then we had a little break and started cooking. We prepared a total of 10 dishes, and they all tasted great. The instructor is a really funny and kind woman who really knows what she's doing. Overall, a really fun day and I recommend this course to everyone who is staying in or near Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: manoa sageman
reviews.text: If you’re looking for cooking classes in Chiang mai this is the place to go. We had a lovely time learning to cook Thai dishes and Tanya was really helpful and even made pictures for us. Overall we had a great time so check this place out!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for this great review

reviews.name: Kamila Górecka
reviews.text: Great school, delicious food with variety of different cuisines. Super sweet teacher, great atmosphere, pick up from hostel. We loved it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It was nice to have you in our class Kamila and waiting for the photos of what you gonna cook when you get back home:)

reviews.name: Antoine Durand
reviews.text: Very nice experience! The teacher was really great, patient and the atmosphere was nice. Both fun and serious 😀 we made many dishes and we tasted it one by one. Be prepared to eat a lot even though it is small portion.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for this great review, waiting for the food that you will cook at home😄

reviews.name: Nube
reviews.text:
I looked at all the cooking class brochures I found and selected this one and it was the right decision. I learned a lot and had a great time cooking. The visit to the market was a perfect introduction, learning about the ingredients and other things we found there that otherwise I could never have guessed. The teacher has a good knowledge of the Thai and Isaan culture and kitchen, she was very kind answering all my many questions :)
I totally recommend it to anyone who is curious and a lover of the food and Thai culture who also wants take something extra from this experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Claudia❤️

reviews.name: Jana Suter
reviews.text:
Very lovely day!
The stop at the market was very interesting! All the fresh food looked and smelled amazing! Very nice atmosphere too!

The cooking class was great! Many many dishes to prepare and lots to learn!
The small explainations were very nice!
Everything tasted amazing!
Nice to have some small pauses between the dishes to eat and get ready for the next dish 🥰
We really enjoyed our time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your great review, hope you a safe trip😉😊

reviews.name: Johanna Duncansby
reviews.text:
We had a great time at one of the evening classes. Lovely teacher who speaks good English and seems genuinely passionate about cooking and giving guests a good experience. You also get an online cooking book included so it's easy to try out the recipes at home.

The food was really good too, but it's honestly the good company and memories of a good time that's going to stick with me :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank your great review Johanna, and waiting for the photos of your Thai food:)

reviews.name: Rosie Rowell
reviews.text:
I love cooking Thai food and have taken 2 cookery classes before - but this was the BEST!  Yes, it was fun.  Yes, the many courses we made were absolutely delicious (don't eat before you arrive!).  But our chef Thanya made sure we understood why we prepared things a certain way, or in a certain order.  She was always happy to pause and explain, and this is what transforms a very good teaching class into a really informative cooking session.  I learned so much.  Thank you!   My husband was there just to enjoy himself and the food - he had a great time too!
And the on-line recipe book is beautifully produced, and - again - has all the important options and ideas for changing ingredients.
Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Catalina Dumitrascu
reviews.text: Amazing cooking class in Chiang Mai! We were very lucky to have it all by ourselves, she explained everything very nicely, with a lot of tips and also, she was open to questions. There were a lot of meals and different recipes but the transition was very smooth. Definitely recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We were happy to have you in our school Catalina, don’t forget to send us the photos of what you cooked of the Thai food in your home;)

reviews.name: Juliane
reviews.text:
Absolute recommendation!
Super nice people, with a lot of knowledge and fun to teach you the art of cooking. I found it particularly interesting to get to know Isaan cuisine, as I had hardly heard of it before.  The value for money is excellent, as well as a perfect balance between taking the time to explain and quickly achieving the incredibly tasty dishes.

reviews.name: francoise pierrot
reviews.text: Simply amazing! The class was everything I was waiting for: being able to cook all the dishes I learned at the class back home.  The morning market was a very good thing to do because we learned all the necessary ingredients to make the dishes, we also had some time to buy the things we wanted .Tania was very helpful and explained in details all the ingredients. reviews.name: Sally Cinello
reviews.text:
Save your money & time and go with another school.
We chose here as we wanted to experience learning not only Thai recipes of food we know & love but also learn to cook some lesser known Isaan ones.
The website boasts that it is local Thai people running the course which appealed to us as who better than a local to tell you about their food/culture etc however it was a guy from Egypt called Midu ? spelling as he didn't even introduce himself to us.
I thought he was just completing the market tour & the Thai chef would be prepping back at the class but it was Midu that taught us.
I thought I'd still be able to learn something but sadly when trying to engage in conversation about Isaan people & their culture etc got no more information than I had already read on the pamphlet. It was only hubby & I that were in attendance both of whom have done a lot of cooking classes when travelling & cook a lot at home but know that there are always things that we can learn but it felt so awkward & uncomfortable as when we were asking questions it felt like Midu was on the defensive & not answering any of our questions.
We were supposed to have got coffee/tea/fruit none of this was on offer.
The cleavers that we had to cut with were really blunt - dangerously so.
The portion sizes were tiny which was just as well as the recipes we were taught were either tasteless or practically inedible - too salty, which couldn't be our fault as Midhu poured in the fish sauce etc.
When we had the curry dish to eat I was surprised there was no rice on the table to eat it with, thinking they had forgotten it I asked & was met with surprise that I would want rice as we were "cooking a lot of food & would be too full with rice" - I have never not had rice or some kind of bread to accompany a curry that had sauce so was very bemused at this - I partly wanted to see if the taste of the curry would be better with rice sadly not, massive amounts of fibrous material from the ginger etc - Midhu explained it was because the curry paste we made had not been ground enough however he was the one that checked & told us it was ready.
Another of the reasons I picked this one was as it had some traditional Isaan recipes such as larb - this was made with tofu, which when I questioned that my understanding was it was made with pork mince was told that they do it with tofu as they have vegetarian people that do the course - when I stated that we obviously weren't vegetarian as we had made dishes with meat in already.
The only dish that would have probably tasted ok was the spring rolls & papaya salad however rather than getting to sit & eat it whilst it was warm & crispy we were instructed to put it on the table & come back to cook some more - so by the time we got to it the spring roll was cold & soggy from the papaya salad dressing.
It felt like we were rushed through & the class was 2 hours shorter than advertised which when I asked was told it was as there was only 2 of us, when we are cooking our own food not sure how this affects the time so greatly.
We were supposed to be taught how to make a thai tea but instead were taught this lemongrass water when I asked about being shown the tea I was informed that he showed us the lemongrass but he could show us the packet that the thai tea comes in which we can buy at the market.
We were supposed to get a cookbook & some ingredients to make the recipes at home but in my husbands words " I'd be too embarrassed to serve any of this to people"
We spent the remainder of our time in Thailand seeking out the dishes that we were taught to see what they actually taste like - cooked by people that know what they are doing they tasted delicious!!

Experience the heart of Thailand at Bukit Thai Cooking Class Phuket. An exclusive opportunity to immerse yourself in the essence Thai culture, where food and tradition intertwine. Discover the secrets of authentic Thai cuisine in a hands-on cooking class, while also sharing a special moment with Thailand's cutest elephants.
Bukit Thai Cooking Class is an immersive experience where you can discover the deep-rooted connections between Thai cuisine and the local way of life. Learn to prepare traditional dishes and feel the spirit of the people, all while supporting a future for local Thai communities and Thai elephants.
Join us to truly feel the culture and passion that makes Thailand so special!

reviews.name: Justin Seputra
reviews.text:
We had such an incredible day at Bukit Elephant Park, truly one of the highlights of our trip. Feeding the elephants was an unforgettable experience. Being able to get so close, hand them food, and see their personalities up close was both fun and surprisingly peaceful. The staff clearly care deeply about the elephants, and the whole experience felt respectful and well-run.

But the real standout of the day was the Thai cooking class. Chef Jimmy was absolutely fantastic, friendly, funny, and incredibly knowledgeable. He explained everything in a way that made it easy to follow, even for beginners, and you could tell he was genuinely passionate about sharing authentic Thai food. What made it even more special was that the recipes he taught had elements from his hometown, which gave the class a really personal and authentic touch.

We cooked Thai green curry, Tom yum goong, and Pad thai, and every dish turned out amazing. Chef Jimmy walked us through each step, explained the ingredients, and shared little tips you’d never get from a cookbook. The green curry had incredible depth of flavour, the tom yum goong was fresh and perfectly balanced, and the Pad thai tasted better than many restaurants we’ve tried.

It didn’t feel rushed at all, it was relaxed, interactive, and a lot of fun. By the end, we not only had a delicious meal but also felt confident we could recreate everything at home. If you’re visiting Bukit Elephant Park, the cooking class is an absolute must-do. A perfect mix of culture, fun, and seriously good food. Highly recommended!

title: The Work Loft Silom
subTitle: เดอะ เวิร์ค ลอฟท์ สีลม
ownerDescription:
Looking for a great place to work or organise meetings? Our airy workspaces, funky private offices, cool meeting rooms, lovely cafe-bar & terrace are made for you!

Amazing working spaces • Great location in Silom • Open every day including Sat-Sun

Our members can truly have a 24/7 access with aircon service.
address: 281, 19-23 Silom 1 Alley, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
plusCode: PGHM+6H Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Sukawan R.
reviews.text:
Great location right next to BTS Sala Daeng. We booked Meeting Room M501 for a half-day session at 1,800 baht. The room is designed to accommodate up to 12 people, but there were only four of us, so it felt very spacious.

The room was equipped with a 49-inch screen, a whiteboard, and free Wi-Fi. Overall, the facilities were satisfactory, although the airflow could have been better.

They also provide complimentary snacks and beverages, including coffee, tea, and drinking water.

There is no free parking though.  They say we can park at Park Silom for 50 baht per hour.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Khun Sukawan,

Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed review. We’re glad you found our location convenient, enjoyed the meeting room facilities, and appreciated the complimentary snacks and beverages.

We also appreciate your feedback regarding the airflow and will continue looking for ways to improve the comfort of our meeting spaces.

We apologize that we don’t have on-site parking available. As we’re located in the heart of Silom, next to BTS Sala Daeng, space is limited and parking costs in the area are quite high. By not maintaining dedicated parking facilities, we’re able to keep our meeting room rates affordable and continue offering great value, including high-speed Wi-Fi, complimentary refreshments, and fully equipped meeting spaces.

Thank you again for choosing us, and we hope to welcome you back for your next meeting.

Best regards,
The Work Loft Team

The Work Loft team
