reviews.name: Harvey Poppington
reviews.text:
It's a nice space with all the right equipment. However this one in particular has an issue with sound traveling up and down the stairs and permeating throughout the entire building.

The staff are very sensitive to it, to the point they told me to stop coughing (I had a cold but was trying my best) and later interrupted me during an important team meeting complaining it was too noisy.

So, great for travellers who work alone with headphones on, but if you need to interact with colleagues, find somewhere with more appropriate facilities and sound-proofing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Harvey,

Thank you for your feedback, and we’re sorry that your experience didn’t meet your expectations.

As a relatively small coworking space, we do have to enforce strict noise policies to ensure all guests can work comfortably. Due to the layout of the building, sound can travel between floors more easily than we’d like, so our team occasionally needs to address noise issues when they affect other members.

We certainly didn’t intend to make you feel uncomfortable, and we appreciate that you were doing your best while unwell.

For phone calls, meetings, or conversations with colleagues, we provide phone booths and meeting rooms specifically designed for those situations, helping everyone balance collaboration with the quiet environment many of our members rely on.

Thank you again for visiting and for sharing your thoughts. Your feedback helps us continue improving the experience for all our guests.

reviews.name: Franklin Porter
reviews.text:
Easily one of the best co-working spaces in Bangkok.  Plenty of comfortable spaces to work, hi-speed Wifi (tested at 430 Mbps down and 480 Mbps up), and the cleaning staff is so nice and constantly keeping the place spotless.  The front staff is also super nice and can speak English with you.  Both floors have a sitting and kitchen area, with free mix coffee and tea.  Bathrooms are spotless and spacious and very private.  Both floors are decorated well and there are lamps at each table so you can have as much or as little light as you like.  They have a couple phone-call booths on both floors.  Location-wise, it's right in the middle of the action.  Super short walking distance from the BTS station and only a short walk (either through the BTS station or street-level) from the MRT station.  BTS has an escalator up about a 1 minute walk away, so at the end of long work session, it's an easy ride up to the BTS.  In the area there is more food options within walking distance than you can imagine.  Silom Park opened next door and there is a 24-hour Foodland and nice little park out front to get some fresh air, also a Starbucks downstairs.
Lastly, and most important, you can easily get a 1-month member that gives you 24-hour access to the workspace.  They don't try to push you into a longer membership like most places do.  All they ask is that if you're last to leave your floor, turn off of the lights and AC.
If I was staying longer than 1 month, I would definitely consider making this my permanent workspace.  Can't say enough good things.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Franklin,

Thank you so much for your positive feedback.  This encourages us to make our space for you and everyone better every day.

The Work Loft Team.

After 9 months of attending I can give a full review on this gym.
The gym is well equipped, staff and people there are very friendly and I had a lot of great time. Also the visa process was easy and clear.
But I am not sure you can become good in boxing here. Maybe problem is me or it’s because I don’t speak Thai. At first I had a 1-on-1 Muay Thai classes. I asked in advance what is better to join as a newbie and admin said better to go to private class first than to group class, which I did. So I was with the Kru who doesn’t speak English at all, it was hard to understand what to do, I just repeated what he showed me. Then I joined the group class and I get a good Kru who speak English a bit and it was better, but the first thing he asked me was “Are you first time? You don’t know the basics?” and by that time I’ve been attending 1-on-1 classes for more than a month already.
After that i thought I’ve been improving until a lot of month later another Kru asked me how long am I attending and I answered something like “6 months already” and he looked surprised from my technique. So sad, maybe I am just not born to do boxing lol.
Group classes are actually fun and good. Look like PE lesson + boxing, so if you interested in fun activities it’s a good thing to join. From all the Kru I highly recommend to stick to Kru Nhan. And if you wanna have more fun lesson - Kru Wan.

Also I joined the strength training classes with PT Sun and enjoyed it a lot. I achieved my goals with weight loss and improved a lot with form and weights. PT Sun is a real professional, I can see as I had experience in gym before. He helped me to see that I am really strong and I can always do more than I think. I get a lot of support from him and I am gonna miss this classes

Overall everything was good.
Gym 4 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
PT Sun 5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.name: William Lee
reviews.text:
As someone with pretty good experience in Muay Thai, I joined this gym due to it being my secondary fitness protocol and the prices were pretty good compared to other MT gyms. I did the group classes.

First off, this is more a group fitness Muay Thai gym. I say this because almost all the students that I had encountered here (and at the Ploen Chit location) are either beginners or barely intermediate.

The structure is warmup, pad work and HIIT/Calisthenics/stretching

15-20 minutes of warm up and stretching which sometimes is like light cardio.

25 minutes of pad work. You sign up on arrival who you wish to hold pads for you. Max 3 ppl per trainer. 1-2 people means you get 4 rounds. 3 people means you get 3 rounds. All rounds are 3 minutes each.  I like my 4 rounds.  While the rounds are good, I don’t get as tired as other MT gyms where those trainers push me harder. It’s good cardio regardless but I prefer to be pushed more and one of the trainers here does it.

20-25 minutes of HIIT/calisthenics and quick stretching after. They often have you use dumbbells and/or a kettlebell.

The Ekkamai location is probably their best compared to Ploen Chit which is the closest other location. This gym has tall ceilings so noise isn’t a problem. It’s well ventilated. It’s on the 2nd floor of the mall so you have access to food courts and restaurants and is right off the BTS. If it rains, you’re dry.  Excellent combo.

Free parking (you’ll need a ticket and a trip to the mall counter to validate).

Comparing to other MT gyms, there’s no sparring here and there is little training to help you improve in group classes. I would get a tip here and there so it’s not entirely absent on pad work. Private training will give you tips to improve technique, etc.

Note that the weight lifting area here is not an open gym. It’s only for personal trainers for your private sessions if you had signed up.

They have showers. Toilets are in the mall outside the gym, same floor. I love that I can keep my gloves there.

title: Sunshine Massage School
ownerDescription:
Sunshine Massage School is an authentic gateway to learning Thai Traditional Massage in Chiang Mai, Thailand.

We welcome serious students seeking an enriching cultural experience, up to working therapists looking to deepen their skills.

Our signature 10-day beginner's course, starting every Monday year-round, provides a strong foundation in this ancient healing art, following the holistic approach of Asokananda.

Join us to explore Thai massage therapy principles and traditional medicine in a welcoming, professional environment. Whether you're a novice or experienced practitioner, Sunshine Massage School is your destination to learn the art of Thai Yoga massage in Thailand.
address: 159/2 4 Kaeonawarat Rd, Wat Ket, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50000, Thailand
plusCode: R226+59 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
Two 5-day courses (30 hours each), in Chiang Mai, Thailand. Anatomy & Osteopathy for Thai Massage.

Week 1, 8 to 12 February: The Central Axis, spine and pelvis. 
Week 2, 15 to 19 February: The Extremities, lower and upper limbs. 

Each week can be taken alone, but most students take both.
Open to all levels and styles of Thai massage experience.

Thierry Bienfaisant bridges the foundations of osteopathy with applied anatomy to refine your Thai massage technique. You localize and palpate the key structures of the musculoskeletal system, understand the biomechanics, innervation and vascularization behind them, and then apply that knowledge through Thai massage stretching, slow deep pressure, acupressure and dynamic techniques to release tension and restore mobility. By the end, anatomy becomes a clear 3D picture of the body that gives your practice orientation and precision, and you learn to structure a session around preparation, action and integration.

Baht 11,500 ( approx EUR 317) per week

5-day workshop (30 hours), Chiang Mai, Thailand

25 to 29 January 2027

For Thai massage practitioners; prior knowledge of Ayurveda is helpful but not required.

Traditional Thai massage works along the Sip Sen, the ten energy lines through which vital life force is believed to flow. In this workshop with Sukha you study the location and function of each of the ten lines and their associated Marma points, learn to palpate and assess them for blockages, and practice working the points by hand.

The aim is practical: by the end you can assess a client's needs and design a customized 60-minute session that targets specific imbalances, using the Lotus Palm Advanced Manual as reference. The course also introduces assessment through the Five Kosha bodies and works on developing intuition and sensitivity in Sen line work.

5 days / 30 hours, Baht 12,500 ( approx. EUR 335 )

5-day workshop (30 hours), Chiang Mai.
For intermediate and advanced Thai massage practitioners.

18 to 22 January 2027

Dynamic Thai Massage is a style of continuous movement in which giver and receiver fall into the same rhythm. Developed in Europe by David Lutt and Takis Oikonomou and inspired by the late Ajahn Chaiyuth Priyasith, it combines techniques from Thai massage with rocking, shaking and harmonic techniques borrowed from osteopathy.

With Flora you work on fluidity, continuity and changes of rhythm in a treatment, with the main focus on restoring movement of the spine, opening the ribcage and freeing the breath, working the sen lines with rocking techniques, and bringing mobility back to the main joints. The class is intensive, playful, and meant to be enjoyed by both sides of the mat.

5-day workshop, Baht 13,500 ( approx. EUR 371 )

4-day workshop, in Chiang Mai, Thailand.

18 to 21 January 2027

For massage therapists with Thai massage experience.

Most of us start with thumbs and hands, then move on to elbows and knees. Your feet and body weight can do much of that work instead, saving your wrists, thumbs and knees for a long career. In this workshop with Sukha you learn one-foot and two-foot techniques for kneading, rocking and acupressure, how to judge the right amount of pressure, and how to integrate foot work into a full-body Thai session.

The course puts strong emphasis on body mechanics, positioning and weight distribution so you work safely, plus sen line stimulation, adapting techniques to each client, and communicating with clients so they stay comfortable.

4-day workshop (24 hours in total), 
THB 10,500.  (approx. 274 €)

5-day workshop (30 hours), in Chiang Mai, Thailand. 
Open to anyone with a background in Thai massage.

23 to 27 November 2026

Roni Gilboa has spent more than 20 years working with cancer patients and their caregivers, and teaching massage therapists how to work safely in that setting. This course covers what cancer treatment does to the body, what palliative massage asks of the practitioner, how to adapt pressure, position and intention, and how to hold your own ground while doing it.

Roni's Touch Therapies method blends traditional Thai massage, Shiatsu and fascia work.

Baht 11,500 ( approx. EUR 314 )

Advanced Thai Massage Course in Chiang Mai – 3 Weeks with Itzhak Helman

16 November – 4 December 2026

Join Itzhak Helman for a special 3-week Advanced Thai Massage Training 

This 15-day / 90-hour program covers:
	•	Week 1: Thai Massage for Lower Back Conditions
	•	Week 2: Whole Massage in Side Position
	•	Week 3: Focus on the Spine
Explore advanced Thai Massage techniques and approaches, including work with the feet, lumbar area, pelvis, sacroiliac joint, energy lines, side position, spine, neck, shoulders and related structures.

Price: 34,500 THB for the complete 3-week program

This course is designed specifically for Active Practitioners and Advanced students.

📍 Sunshine Massage School, Chiang Mai, Thailand

I took the 8 week combo course blending the beginner Thai massage course with bridging into being a practitioner, advanced stretches and side lying position, herbal compress making and use, and field work with overseeing. As a yoga teacher and a Thai massage practitioner already and complete enthusiast, I'd recommend any friend or student of mine to attend this school without hesitation!!! For the price I paid, I feel I got much more than what I expected. I chose this place over others as multiple people I've talked to knew about this place and recommended it. They were right. I too recommend this place if you're interested in learning Thai Yoga Massage. Enjoy! 🙏🏽🤙🏽🪷

reviews.name: Sergey Semenchinskiy
reviews.text:
We, my wife and I took the beginners course at Sunshine Thai Yoga Massage School for two weeks from 2 July 2016. Of course, we were a bit worried before the trip there, but it was absolutely vain. On arriving (it was Friday) we went to look for this school to make registration and learn the way to be not late for class on Monday. Our trip from hotel took about two hours. A good part of Chiang May had be already seen, when we found the school at least. The cozy two-story house of massage school was located next to local hospital between two big streets, in 15 minutes of walk from our hotel.

As I said, the school building is really cozy. There are a large open veranda and administration room on the ground floor, as well as a large dining room with kitchen. There are also one classroom. There are three large tables in the dining room, fridge, oven, spoons, forks, plates and every your needs. Everyone is allowed also to store his own food into the fridge, but until next Friday only. Do not afraid to leave your food there. It will be safe for sure. Everybody, if he doesn't want to go out for a lunch, can make his lunch himself here.  During the break, you take your own food and locate comfortably at beautiful tables. After such intense training you will be a huge appetite for sure. But do not load heavy food before the second half of the day. Best of all to have a good dinner after classes end, after 16: 00.

On the first floor there are four more classrooms. All classrooms are spacious, air-conditioned, with large windows. They have for two doors each, and there are pots with water and cut lime fruit near class doors in hallway. Classes have full equipment for practice with massage mats and pillows (two per student). Mats and pillows are covered with clean covers and pillow cases. There are also blackboards, fans and air-conditions. Everywhere in the School was extremely clean. Maidens permanently are washing and cleaning something. But in a such environment there are one more reason - nobody would dare to leave a mess.

There is also the next school’s building. It was just finished and not opens still.

Now about our instructors. Many thanks to them for the knowledge that we have received. We have passed the introductory course on the 1st and 2nd stage of Thai yoga massage. This is very significant. After such a course, you can give very good sessions. Only need to practice more.

Our group of 8 people had been leaded by instructor Jip. Jip is obviously a nickname. Jip  of course, has also a beautiful and complicated Thai name. He is a very friendly and  cheerful man. But at the same time, he is very knowledgeable, spiritual person. His lectures, usually on morning 3 hours sessions, were always interesting and useful. It was a theory. Practice started later, after a lunch break.

While practice, Jip watched us carefully.  If necessary, he showed us the moving several times, explained most suitable approaches to the client body, permanently reminded about safety rules.
While practice, Jip watched us carefully.

Very useful for us also were two Thai massage books, which we got at registration. One was a workbook in English, with pictures, instructions and space for our own notes. The second book was the book for reading in the native language of student.

We can say, as conclusion, that in the school, we everywhere felt us very welcoming, friendly attitude on the part of the administration, instructors  and other staff, all was clearly, efficiently, without unnecessary emotions.

reviews.name: Travelling Darryl
reviews.text:
Sexual Harassment Concern and Lack of Support from Max

I want to share my personal experience with Max, in his role at Sunshine Massage School. This review is not about the quality of the school or its programs, but specifically about how sensitive concerns were handled by him.

When I brought forward information related to inappropriate behavior and sexual harassment during the last day of my Advanced Stretching course, I did not feel heard, supported, or treated with the care such a situation requires. The lack of empathy I experienced from Max was deeply disappointing and left me feeling dismissed rather than supported by someone in a position of authority.

I chose to speak up not only because of my own experience, but because I was aware that the same individual had also impacted other students in a previous course. Two people chose not to continue into the advanced level as a result. My intention was simply to make the school aware so appropriate changes or safety measures could be considered. Instead, I felt shut down in even trying to share this information.

During that same conversation, I was informed by Max that I was being removed from another course I had hoped to take, due to a deposit requirement that had not been clearly communicated to me.

Given the timing, this felt punitive and left me feeling unwelcome rather than supported.

One of our final exchanges ended with Max asking, “What do you want me to do about it?” In the context of someone raising concerns about sexual harassment, this felt deeply dismissive and effectively closed the conversation.

From my professional background as a former social worker, this is a well-known way of silencing someone who is coming forward.

After speaking with other students, I learned that my experience with Max was not isolated, and that similar interactions had led some to cancel classes or leave the school.

To be clear, I am not seeking a response from Max. That opportunity has passed.

I’m sharing this so others — especially those needing to raise sensitive concerns — can make informed decisions about where to seek support.

I also want to emphasize that the courses themselves were excellent. Advanced Stretching with Lay and the three-week course with Itzhak were outstanding, and staff at the school were professional and supportive.

ownerDescription: With over 20 years of combined experience in various healing modalities, we Roshni and Namvir, at Bangkok Healing Haven have created a nurturing space for growth and transformation for every single person that comes through our space. We have both dedicated our lives to our spiritual journey and united in our passions as husband and wife for a spiritual life together and helping other people achieve more.

reviews.name: H Sylvia
reviews.text:
The session with Roshni was magical and enlightening,
It was my first time visiting , Roshni made me feel like she had known me for some time. Roshni is very experienced and patient, We had communicated briefly prior so when I got to the studio I felt completely at ease.The session was more powerful and helpful than I expected. I just want to say thank you to Roshni again, your energy is so kind and lovely.

For anyone that has any doubt about therapy or reiki but wanting/curious to seek therapy or healing and has no idea where to start, I strongly recommend bangkok healing haven. You will find what you are looking via this magical visit.

reviews.name: Rahil Mundkur
reviews.text:
Reiki with Manika proves to be much more than just energy work. She is skillfully intuitive and has identified underlying issues with astounding accuracy, bringing insight to lived challenges and counter-productive beliefs I was previously only sub-consciously cognisant of. During a session, I could feel the intense heat of the energy she was channelling so powerfully through her hands.

She has a very gentle and soothing energy. Her warm way of being and caring presence offer a healing experience in themselves.

Although a session is expensive, it is certainly well-earned. Manika is very intensely attentive throughout the reiki healing (about one hour), and is generous with her time before and after the therapy too. She fosters a relaxed space before the reiki to ascertain motivations for the consultation, and debriefs after the session to relay findings and make recommendations.

I consider it a worthy investment in well-being that brings holistic benefits far beyond the session. I feel gratified that I had the courage and good sense to follow through on my intuition to pursue reiki as a healing modality. I am also grateful for the good fortune of meeting Manika, because she has brought understanding to key changes I can make for personal growth and ease with life. I am still developing my sensitivity and awareness of  energy, and am keen to pursue further with Tai Chi.

I am appreciative of Manika’s conscious professionalism and insightful wisdom, and intend to return regularly to make the most of the opportunities for physical and psychological healing that she offers with such sincerity and dedication.

Highly recommended, and I hope you try a session to find out for yourself.

reviews.name: Lucilda Bouton
reviews.text:
Both the shamanic and ancestral healing sessions I experienced with Namvir were nothing short of incredible ✨🙏🏼

Each session provided a safe, powerful space that allowed me to release deep-rooted patterns and connect with profound inner peace.

The shifts in my energy and perspective have been life-changing.  Namvir has this innate ability to make one feel comfortable, safe, seen and heard.

If you are looking for true, deep-level healing, this is it!

Grateful and thankful for this Soulful Experience ✨🙏🏼

reviews.name: L HM
reviews.text:
I came in not knowing what to expect from a first session, but left feeling like a big weight had been lifted at exactly the right time. Nam’s approach is warm, friendly, and relaxed, creating a safe and soothing space to allow the nervous system to gently readjust.
What surprised me most was how subtle the work felt, yet how powerful the impact was. Even in a calm, unassuming apartment setting, the session brought a deep and surprisingly intensive release.
I left feeling lighter, more grounded, and genuinely better. I’ll definitely be returning.

reviews.name: Annabelle
reviews.text:
Back in 2021, I felt a calling to learn Reiki and began searching for the right mentor. I found Roshni through positive reviews and was immediately drawn to her clear, thoughtful teaching style and the content she planned to cover across all three levels.

Through her classes, Roshni opened my eyes to the unseen world of energy—a realm that uncovers old wounds, ancestral traumas, and hidden patterns. It has truly been a transformative journey.

Beyond the classes, I’ve benefited from several private Reiki sessions with her, which have greatly supported me. Her guidance is invaluable for emotional rebalancing and self-alignment, and I have often recommended her to friends and family.

Roshni is deeply empathetic, non-judgmental, and easy to connect with. Her intuitive abilities are remarkable, so much so that I view her as psychic.

She has been fundamental to my spiritual growth. I am deeply grateful—not only for Roshni’s healing, but for the tools and guidance she has given me to support and heal others, allowing her wisdom and light to ripple through the lives of many.

reviews.name: Tejale Bellani
reviews.text: I have seeing Roshni for multiple years now and every session with her is magical. I truly love how she takes the time to heck I with you and makes sure you feel safe and comfortable, while she provides you with a beautiful healing space. Her approach to her sessions are very warm and loving, making me feel very relaxed and always wanting to come back. I can't thank her enough for all the amazing things she has helped me uncover and support me in being the best version of myself. Thank you Roshni! <3

reviews.name: Chayawaree Rojdenduang
reviews.text:
After meeting Roshni, my life has never been the same. I had practiced Reiki with others before, but something within me was guided to experience Reiki with her. From that moment on, I never returned to where I once was, I chose to continue this journey with Roshni.

During the uncertain times of COVID, when I felt lost and unsure of my path, I joined her intuition course and other workshops. Three years later, I went on to complete Reiki Level 2, and now I am continuing my journey with her toward the Master level.

I never imagined that the struggles and wounds within me could be truly healed through Reiki. Yet with Roshni, I found spiritual growth and discovered my true self from within. Everything I once felt stuck with, everything I wished to transform, and even the hidden gifts and deepest desires of my soul, all were revealed and nurtured through her guidance.

Every time I practice Reiki with Roshni, I silently give thanks for her, for the universe, and for every path that led me to meet her.

reviews.name: ADITI ROONGTA
reviews.text:
I feel incredibly lucky to have come across Roshni’s Instagram account—definitely not by coincidence! I’ve known her since 2020, and in since then, I’ve not only grown as an individual but have also discovered so much about myself while healing on multiple levels. Roshni has guided me through some of my deepest challenges, and as we all know, healing is an ongoing journey.

Her words of wisdom stay with you long after each session, offering clarity and reassurance. With Roshni, I always feel that I’m on the right path, supported by the best healer. I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone embarking on their own healing journey. Roshni, I truly can’t imagine what I would have done without you—our connection has become so much more than just a client-healer relationship for me; it’s an emotional bond. With her I am my most vulnerable and in a safe space.

Learning Reiki with Roshni has been one of the greatest gifts I’ve given myself. Her workshops and personal sessions are unmatched. If you’re reading this, take it as a sign—go ahead and book a session without hesitation. You won’t regret it.

Lots of love always!

Highly recommend!!!

She was highly recommended by a close friend and I felt intuitively that I needed to have a session with her. I had never experienced reiki before and was hopeful but unsure about doing it remotely. Amazingly, so much has shifted for me with individual work, group sessions, and just recently completing reiki level 1 training. I feel in a way like all of my prior inner work, including many years of Buddhist practice and psychotherapy, has prepared me to receive such profound healing and it has amplified my own abilities as a healer significantly.

Even this past week after completing reiki level 1 training, old friends and new have remarked that I feel different, have an impactful voice, and have a magnetizing presence. Personally, I feel more and more certain in my own intuition, self, and purpose in life.

I cannot thank Roshni enough for all of her help, gentle support and sweet encouragement! She is a real source of magic in this world ✨

reviews.name: Emma Dufresne
reviews.text: Rhoshni helped guide me when I was going through a transformational period in my new life. If you are feeling stuck- please reach out to Roshni! I cannot recommend her enough. She was a big influencing guiding me through my awakening and reaching inner peace. I now live everyday at peace and full of love. Reiki does wonders and I firmly believe has the power to heal everyone. It has more power than what a therapist can do for you!!  That’s the power of energy. ❤️🙏🏻

reviews.name: Kristine Ki McGinn
reviews.text:
I've been working with Roshni for almost two years now, and when I say she changed my life, it is not an exaggeration. My first session brought powerful + immediate changes. It kicked off my healing journey, & gave me insight into things that had stumped me my whole life. This experience led me to do Reiki Level I & II with her, which have also both been life changing. I recommend my friends to her all the time and even after seeing many mediums, energy workers, etc. one friend said she never experienced such immediate changes working with anyone. She is also now pursuing Level I.

Roshni is the real deal, she is extremely gifted, and taps on your own inner strength + innate ability to heal. I finally know that I am on the right path, living more in accordance with my life's purpose, and I attribute much of this to her. Do not hesitate to work with her, you will not regret it!

reviews.name: Priyanka Basnet
reviews.text:
Ive been doing Zoom sessions with Roshni for a few years. Can not recommend it enough! I leave every session feeling closer to myself. She knows exactly what I need in the moment and gently guides me through my difficulties..

I would highly recommend anyone seeking guidance, clarity, feeling of being stuck to book a few session and be transformed. I love Roshni with all my heart.

reviews.name: Florence Turcq
reviews.text:
Some call it magic, some dismiss it as mysticism, and others take the leap to experience it for themselves. In places like the U.S., energy healing is increasingly recognized and even integrated into medical treatment. But beyond science and skepticism, its true power is something you can only understand by feeling it.

I have been working with Roshni for over five years now, and the journey has been nothing short of transformative. Both receiving and learning Reiki with her have deepened my understanding of energy healing and profoundly changed my life. Healing energy is just as vital as healing the mind, and Reiki is a powerful complement to practices like coaching or traditional therapy.

You don’t have to be a yogi or a spiritual seeker to benefit from Reiki. Energy flows through all of us—it’s part of who we are. I work in a fast-paced corporate environment, and like anyone else, I need balance and grounding to navigate life’s ever-increasing demands. Roshni’s work helps me realign, find clarity, and move forward with greater purpose.

Her presence—whether in person or online—radiates kindness, wisdom, and an unwavering sense of safety. She holds space with profound compassion, allowing healing to unfold in its own time. I am deeply grateful to have found Roshni on my journey.

If you’ve ever been curious about energy healing, Bangkok Healing Haven is the perfect place to begin. I cannot recommend it enough.

หลังจากได้มาเรียนทำขนมกับ chefchop อาจารย์สอนทุกๆอย่างจริงๆค่ะ ตั้งแต่ความรู้ขั้นเบสิค เรื่องวัตถุดิบต่างๆ ข้อดีข้อเสียของแต่ละวัตถุดิบ และชอบมากๆคืออาจารย์ทดลองชิมรสชาติ และส่วนผสมมาหมดแล้ว จึงทำให้สูตรขนมของอาจารย์มีความอร่อยและกลมกล่อมมากๆค่ะ
อาจารย์สอนทุกอย่างจริงๆ แบบไม่มีกั๊กกันเลยค่า ก่อนหน้าที่มาเรียน กลัวการทำขนมและคิดว่าเป็นเรื่องยากค่ะ แต่ตอนนี้ รู้สึกมีความสุขและเข้าใจการทำขนมมากขึ้นค่ะ
สำหรับใครที่กำลังหาคอร์สเรียนทำขนม เรียนกับอาจารย์ บอกเลยว่า ดีมากค่า ได้ความรู้ทุกๆเรื่อง และที่สำคัญที่สุดเลยคือ อาจารย์สอนให้เราเอาไปใช้ได้จริงๆค่ะ ไม่ใช่เพียงแค่ทฤษฎีค่ะ แนะนำคอร์สนี้มากๆเลยค่า
reviews.textTranslated:
After taking a baking class with Chef Chop, the instructor truly taught everything. From basic knowledge about various ingredients, the advantages and disadvantages of each ingredient, and what I really appreciated was that the instructor had tasted and tested all the ingredients beforehand, resulting in incredibly delicious and well-balanced recipes.
The instructor taught everything without holding anything back. Before taking the class, I was afraid of baking and thought it was difficult. But now, I feel happy and understand baking much better.
For anyone looking for a baking course, I highly recommend learning with this instructor. You'll gain knowledge on every topic, and most importantly, the instructor teaches you how to apply what you learn in real life, not just theory. I highly recommend this course!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากเลยครับ🥰🥰

reviews.textTranslated: I flew all the way from Malaysia to take a shokupan bread-making class with the chef. The chef was incredibly detailed, patient, and friendly. They explained every step in detail and shared many secret techniques! Even someone with no prior experience could understand the class. After the bread-making class, I was so impressed with the chef's skills that I continued with a cake-making class – burnt cheesecake, young coconut cake, and tiramisu – all in one day! Most importantly, everything turned out delicious! I barely needed to adjust the recipes; they were ready to sell immediately based on the chef's precise calculations. I'll definitely look forward to more classes when I return to Thailand at the end of the month, Chef! 🥰

reviews.textTranslated:
A beautifully decorated dessert shop located on the G floor of Esplanade Mall on Rattanathibet Road.

The desserts are visually appealing and delicious. I recommend the strawberry cheesecake bingsu, which is incredibly tasty.
The Thai tea cheesy lava cake has a strong Thai tea aroma but lacks the cheesy flavor. Fortunately, the taste is delicious and the dessert is beautifully and uniquely decorated.
The chocolate toast was a little chewy, but the flavor was perfectly balanced.
All the desserts are beautifully and thoughtfully decorated, closely resembling the menu photos.
There's a free water refill station at the back of the shop.
The staff provides good service, and the prices are reasonable compared to other bingsu shops.

title: Patom Thai Food Cookery School
ownerDescription:
A Thai Cooking School is a cultural and experiential tourism business that focuses on sharing authentic Thai cuisine with international visitors and food enthusiasts.

The instructors act as both professional cooking teachers and English-speaking guides, providing clear explanations of Thai ingredients, cooking techniques, and the cultural background behind each dish. Classes are conducted entirely in English and are suitable for beginners as well as experienced cooks.

⸻

Teaching Style
• Hands-on cooking experience
• Small group classes for personal attention
• Step-by-step instruction in English
• Safe, friendly, and interactive learning environment
address: 103 ท่าศาลา 6 Tonkam Alley, Tambon Tha Sala, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50000, Thailand
street: 103 ท่าศาลา 6 Tonkam Alley
plusCode: Q2GC+3Q Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Emma O'Neill
reviews.text: My friend and I throughly enjoyed this cooking class. We got picked up from our hotel then brought to a Thai food market and got to pick out our ingredients. The ingredients were sooo fresh and tasted so good. All the meals were so delicious and Patom is such a good teacher! She is so funny you will laugh the whole way through. Definitely recommend, it was a great day with such lovely food
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Was amazing for teaching cooking school, by chef PaTom Thaifoood, khob khun ka

reviews.name: Aitor Chicharro
reviews.text: We had a great experience, Patom guided us throughout all the process. It felt very authentic and the dishes were easy to cook for everyone. We definitely recommend it!

reviews.name: Alessio Ianni
reviews.text:
5 stars for Chef Patom because I loved her energy! I'll share the same feedback which I shared with her in person: the food came out incredible, some of the best food I've tasted in Thailand, and I definitely learned a bit about the ingredients used. The experience starts with going to the local market to pick out ingredients, chef then takes you to her home with an outdoor kitchen which is very well equipped. Before buying the ingredients, mention if you have any requests for specific dishes as she can teach you anything you want.

Where theres room for improvement: Chef Patom is a professional chef and still has many traits of one. We found the experience a bit rushed and as if we're working in her kitchen to push many dishes out in a short amount of time, it would have been nice to learn a bit more about each ingredient and how it impacts the final flavour of the dish, how you can correct these impacts and what the final result of the dish is.

In saying that, Chef Patom is very approachable and you can definitely ask all questions you want and get more information where wanted if you just ask. All in all, definitely a recommendable experience and the cheapest we've found.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Was fun with your group, big thanks for contact us, Aroi mak mak ka

reviews.name: Ingeborg Stueland
reviews.text:
I highly recommend this cooking school! I randomly stumbled across it in Chiang Mai, and it was so easy to book it (and very cheap compared to other). The chef picked me up from the hostel and I got to join her to a local Thai market. Then she took me to her houses where we together cooked delicious Thai food, while being able to ask questions and learn about the cuisine and ingredients.

The chef is an amazing personality, which makes this experience soo much more than just cooking. She even made us a mojito to enjoy while cooking.
Again, I cannot say enough about Thai cookery school, you should definitely check it out! I’ll be taking home with me fun memories and so many new delicious recipies.

I had a cooking class today with my 9-year-old son. It was very fun and educational. We made 5 dishes: Pad Thai, green curry, Tom Yum, spring lollies, sticky rice, and mango.
It was all delicious and easy to make. In the morning, you go to the market to get ingredients, and then you make the dishes with Tammy. My son loved it, and I definitely recommend it. Don't hesitate, just do it. 😉

reviews.textTranslated:
We met with Tami in the morning, agreed on the dishes we wanted to make and went straight to the market to buy the freshest ingredients!!
Unfortunately, our little son doesn't like markets, but Tami was quick and to the point, and so the experience went by quickly.
We went to cook the dishes we agreed on with her, in her kitchen.
Tami is very cute and funny!! Explains and helps, and each dish comes out tastier than the last!!
Tami is very patient with children - this is noticeable even when there is a language barrier, with a little mediation, they understood everything!
We took the course in the morning, but I recommend that those who are not big eaters in the morning take it in the evening because we no longer have room in our stomachs for more food...
Tami is charming, funny, light, and simply wonderful.
We really enjoyed ourselves and learned a lot!!!
I suggest bringing a small notebook and a pen to write down the recipes!!!
I highly recommend it, thank you very much Tami!!

I bought a three-day pass through GoWabi and overall had a really good experience at this gym. The staff at the front desk were friendly, helpful and patient even though my sign-up process was a bit complicated.

reviews.text:
the manager (~40yo woman with glasses) is very arrogant. I wanted to subscribe, I ran away instead. Therefore I can’t give more details about the gym itself 😂

reviews.name: Ruth RH
reviews.text:
I cannot express how disappointed I was with this gym, although I actually never had an opportunity to try its equipment. I went there a couple days ago to ask about a sign I saw that advertised a body scan and personal trainer. I had a lot of trouble with the front desk not even wanting to get me someone who could answer my questions, but they finally got someone. She didn't understand my question about the sign, but that's ok. My Thai is very limited. Nonetheless, I made an appointment for a "trial". She insisted on a phone number. I offered her Line contact info instead and explained that I really didn't want a phone call to "remind me" of the appointment as I didn't want to be interrupted in meetings. However, she called me anyway.

When I arrived for my appointment, they wanted me to sign-up through their bar code. No problem BUUUUTTT the first question on the screen had a check box allowing them to send marketing materials to my phone. I didn't not want that, but the woman clicked through on MY phone, before I had a chance to uncheck the box. I picked up my phone and explained that I didn't like other people touching my phone and answering questions on my behalf. I put it down to complete the form and she did the exact same thing on the next screen. I grabbed my phone and left.

I have disabilities that I had already explained to her. If they cannot follow the simple instruction, "Don't touch my phone", I certainly could not trust them to follow instructions regarding how they could or could not move my body.

reviews.text: 700 Baht is Crazy Price for a day pass. Equipment is bad and the gym is full. Atleast it is big and the view is nice but for training the worst gym i vistited so far.

reviews.name: Camila Lee
reviews.text:
I tried this gym with a 3-day trial coupon.
My current gym has become overcrowded since they started selling memberships carelessly, so I’ve been testing different gyms with daily or trial passes.

This location is very convenient since it’s connected to the BTS. On my first day, I met a staff member named “Bow,” who was helpful and gave me clear information about membership pricing. If I decide to join, I’d definitely recommend her.

However, there are a few downsides:
•	No powerlifting allowed.
•	Uneven flooring, especially on the 2nd floor weight area, which can be uncomfortable.
•	My last visit felt quite unpleasant compared to the first day — maybe because it was Friday and the gym was more crowded.

One more thing — the staff seemed overly sensitive about money matters.
I simply asked if the 3-day pass meant “3 entries” or “3 calendar days,” but one of the female staff members (the one with the nice hairstyle) responded quite coldly.
I think they don’t realize how that kind of attitude affects customer experience.

Overall, 700 THB for a day pass is pricey by Bangkok standards, but I don’t mind paying if the service feels worth it.
I just hope they can be a bit more open and professional when explaining trial details.

reviews.name: Matthew Raab
reviews.text:
Where to begin with this gym?  When you first walk in you'll be greeted by some robots.  Then you'll encounter a bunch of trainers standing around awkwardly trying to intimidate you into purchasing personal training.  It becomes clear that it's the business model to over hire personal trainers as they make the most money this way to a point where there are so many trainers they can outnumber customers at the gym.

Bottom line is that many people are leaving this gym because this gym doesn't care about you but instead only trying to squeeze more money from you.  Think carefully before engaging in a contract.

reviews.name: pexme
reviews.text:
Good value for money I would say. It is clean and has most equipment you could ask for.
Additionally, the staff are all really nice and in general offer great service.

The only reason I don’t give it 5 stars is that it is crowded. You will have to wait for equipment, especially the reclining benches. I would advice them to make the free weight space larger because they have the space; they are just not using it properly. Half of the upper floor is always empty, and the other half is always packed with people.

A major improvement would be if WE Fitness Ekkamai would make the free weights area larger, perhaps just make it the whole top floor. Add more reclining benches, add more squat racks (they only have 1 squat rack!) and remove the equipment that is to the far end of the top floor. Seriously, rarely if ever do people us that area. There used to be a boxing ring there which they removed. That was a good idea, but they still can do better.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for review

reviews.name: p don j
reviews.text:
I got this membership free so I'd probably give it 4 or 5 starts on that basis, but in the interests of fairness I'll rate it as though I'd paid the normal price which I think is about 2800-3500 a month (plus a potential joining fee?).

First I don't know why anybody would pay that when you could go  to most other gyms and pay half or less.  You'd miss out on free coffee and key card lockers, but not much else.  We Fitness is trying to be a Fitness First / Virgin gym at this pricepoint but Virgin has pools, and Fitness First has many more locations, better equipped gyms, and they aren't as crowded.

Early evening is crazy busy, hard to find free machines to use.

They have some weird weight machines with a screen that you have to play games on to activate the machine and use it.  They're annoying and nobody uses them.  There are a few of them and they waste space.  They seem to go quite hard on HIIT type of fitness.  And there are so many personal trainers.  If you just want to go in and get a normal workout, it seems like you'd be paying for all these extras that you wouldn't ever use.

The clientele is skewed towards the poser personalities.  Think women in tight leggings and men looking in the mirror all the time.

The staff all seem friendly, and everywhere is pretty clean.  But it's not good value for money for ~3000 baht on a long-term contract, I'm surprised it's so busy/popular.

Great for back pain, stiff shoulders, sore legs, and muscle recovery. Popular with athletes and active people. Foreigners welcome.

In this area I think the best massage! First time I've been there and already love it. I recommend Dew, she has very good hands and absolutely will cure any muscle pain you may have it. Not too strong, not too light, just perfect! Also the staff is very kind and smiley. Sure I will come back because working on a computer and sitted everyday, I really enjoyed the massage on my inner thighs, buttocks, and abdomen. She did a great job and make me feel like new! Prices are reasonable. The shop is small but clean. I went early in the morning and I got my massage instantly. It's easy to find on Google maps. There is a shower for the oil massage. In the end the ginger tea was delicious!

Thank you so much for the very good experience Dew.

reviews.name: Sophie Dielissen
reviews.text: I saw the many good reviews on google maps and wanted to try this place. I did not care that she answered the phone during my massage, that her phone was constantly giving notifications or that she was sometimes distracted. But i genuinely had an unpleasant experience here for the first time ever in Thailand. I don’t know if it was a bad day for her or just a different masseuse or because I was a foreigner. I asked her to apply pressure and she did, but she also applied pressure on joints and bones. It hurt a lot. The technique was just something I never had before. It was an oil massage so you are not dressed and it feels more vulnerable. But she was on her phone while massaging me. One hand massage one hand on her phone. She could not read my body and how I was reacting because she was distracted ofcourse. She was massaging all the wrong places and even gave my arms a dry massage which instead of pressure she dragged my skin so badly it made me cry. I have absolutely no idea why this has happened but I left feeling incredibly sad and rather humiliated and disrespected. You come to someone, undress and hope to have your body taken care of. Please be kinder with your clients. Or at least pay attention to them.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I must apologize on behalf of my staff for the poor service you received. 🙏🙏..I will have the opportunity to serve you myself.

reviews.name: M M (Mm)
reviews.text:
I had a strange experience here.

I had two massages at this place. The first one was good, so I came back a second time and chose an oil massage.

I was asked whether I preferred a male or female therapist. I said either was fine, and my therapist was a man.

The massage itself felt very good, but at one point he pointed to the front of my body and asked, “Do you want me to massage here too?” I said yes because I assumed he meant my stomach or collarbone area. However, he then started massaging my breasts.

I felt uncomfortable, but since it was my first oil massage, I wondered if this was somehow normal in Thailand, so I let it pass.
Later, he asked me, “Do you want a special massage?” I asked what that meant, and he replied, “B2B.” I didn’t know what that was, so I declined. I looked it up afterward and found out that it referred to a sexual massage.

I was surprised that something like this could happen even at a regular massage shop, and I later realized that massaging my breasts was not a normal part of the treatment either.

For women visiting this place, I would recommend requesting a female therapist if you have any concerns.

Thank you for visiting our restaurant and for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re glad to hear you enjoyed the taste of the food, the warm hospitality from our team, and the convenience of our parking. We also noticed you spent almost 2 hours dining with us, which shows that you felt comfortable and were able to enjoy the overall atmosphere — something we strive to offer all of our guests.

We were, however, surprised by the 2-star rating, especially since your review highlights several positive aspects of your experience. We understand that expectations around portion sizes and pricing can vary, but we pride ourselves on using only the highest quality, fresh ingredients, and preparing each dish with great care. We believe this attention to detail is reflected in both the taste and the overall dining experience we provide.

We truly appreciate your perspective and will certainly take your feedback into account as we continue to improve. We’d love the opportunity to welcome you back and exceed your expectations next time.

Warm regards,
— Sriwangying Team 🍽️🌿

The Earl Grey tea is fragrant, light, and superb.

The savory dishes are exquisite, befitting a culinary school that studied at the royal palace.

The restaurant has a warm atmosphere. I recommend calling to reserve a table or order in advance. The staff are friendly and attentive in recommending dishes.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบพระคุณสำหรับรีวิวที่น่ารักและคำชมที่อบอุ่นใจมากๆ เลยนะคะ 😊
ทางร้านรู้สึกดีใจที่คุณลูกค้าประทับใจในความสดของวัตถุดิบ รสชาติอาหาร และบรรยากาศของร้าน รวมถึงการบริการจากพี่ๆ ทีมงานของเราค่ะ

คำแนะนำเรื่องการโทรจองหรือสั่งล่วงหน้าก็เป็นประโยชน์มาก ทางร้านขอขอบคุณที่ช่วยบอกต่อ และหวังว่าจะได้มีโอกาสต้อนรับคุณลูกค้าอีกบ่อยๆ นะคะ

ด้วยความยินดีและขอบคุณจากใจ
— ทีมงานศรีวังหญิง 🐚🍽️

reviews.name: Sinepatdaraja Subin
reviews.text: มาเรียนร้อยพวงมาลัยแบบชาววังที่ศรีวังหญิงกับคุณแม่ในช่วงวันหยุดที่ผ่านมา รู้สึกประทับใจมากๆ ค่ะ ได้ทั้งความรู้และได้เพิ่มสกิลร้อยพวงมาลัยจากคุณครูที่มีความสามารถในการร้อยพวกมาลัยจากโรงเรียนในวัง และยังรู้สึกภูมิใจมากๆ เวลาได้เห็นผลงานตัวเองตอนร้อยเสร็จ เป็นช่วงเวลาที่คุ้มค่ามากๆ เลยค่ะ ได้ใช้เวลาและทำกิจกรรมร่วมกับคุณแม่ เป็นกิจกรรมที่ใจฟู ที่อยากจะแนะนำหลายๆ คนมากค่ะ 🩵 ขอบคุณทางโรงเรียนมากๆ เลยนะคะ ปล. อาหารอร่อยมากๆ ค่ะ โดยเฉพาะกั้งทอดกระเทียม
reviews.textTranslated: During the recent holidays, I learned how to make traditional Thai garlands at Sri Wang Ying School with my mother. It was a truly impressive experience! I gained knowledge and improved my garland-making skills under the guidance of highly skilled instructors from a royal school. I also felt incredibly proud seeing my finished work. It was a very worthwhile time, spending quality time and doing an activity with my mother. It was a heartwarming experience that I would highly recommend to others. 🩵 Thank you so much to the school! P.S. The food was delicious, especially the garlic fried mantis shrimp!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบพระคุณสำหรับรีวิวที่มีค่ากับทางร้านมากๆค่ะ

reviews.name: Vissarut P
reviews.text:
นอกจากสอนอาหาร ก็มีเค้ก ขนมชาววัง พร้อม Afternoon tea set ให้ทานด้วย

เค้ก และมากาลอง อร่อยมาก กกกกๆๆๆ

บรรยากาศน่ารักๆ เจ้าของดูแลเอง เยี่ยมเลยครับ
reviews.textTranslated:
Besides cooking classes, they also offer cakes, royal Thai desserts, and an afternoon tea set.

The cakes and macarons are incredibly delicious!

The atmosphere is lovely, and the owner takes care of everything personally. Excellent!

reviews.name: Thammasak Charoenfhung
reviews.text: วันนี้ได้ไปจิบชาพร้อมเครื่องเคียง ขนมหลากหลายชนิด ที่อร่อย และมีความเป็นเอกลักษ์ ขนมแบ่งเป็น แบบ English Afternoon Tea ครับและเป็นขนมหน้าตาสวยแบบไทยหน้าตาน่ารักทำให้แทบไม่อยากทานครับเพราะสวยอยากมองนานๆ55 ก็เป็นความสุขของคนรักการดื่มชา อย่างคำแรกเปิดต่อมรับรสด้วย สโคน กรอบนอกนุ่มร่วนหอมเนยมากครับและรสชาดก็แทบจะไม่ต้องปาดเนยและแยมเลย อร่อยจนต้องสั่งกลับบ้านครับ จิบชาแล้วต่อด้วยปั้บสิบมาในรูปแบบนกน้อยอยู่ในสวนผักชีและพริกขี้หนูสวนแป้งนุ่มหยุ่นพร้อมใส้กลมกล่อมอวลอยู่ในปาก แก้เลี่ยนด้วยแตงโมปลาแห้งชุ่มฉ่ำในปากทันทีตัดด้วยเค็มหวานเบาๆเพลินเลยครับ จากนั้นเซทขนมอบ ทาร์ตผลไม้และมาการองรสอ่อนแป้งกรอบผิวสวย แต่ของเด็ดอยู่ตรงนี้ล่ะครับ เค็กฟองน้ำหน้ามะพร้าวอ่อนน้ำหอมโอยยยย เบาเหมือนกินก้อนเมฆ..รสชาดกลมกล่อมมากอันนี้แนะนำเลยครับ เสียดายว่าจะสั่งกลับบ้านดันหมดซะก่อนครับ สถานที่สะอาดสวยแต่งแบบอิงริชวินเทจ จานชามช้อนซ่อมสวยตามการตบแต่งร้านเลยครับ อ้อใครชอบน้ำส้มคั้น แนะนำเช่นกันครับ เสริฟมาในแก้วเจียรใน วันนี้อิ่มท้อง อิ่มตา อิ่มใจครับ.
reviews.textTranslated: Today, I enjoyed afternoon tea with a variety of delicious and unique pastries. The selection included English Afternoon Tea and beautifully presented Thai desserts that were so pretty I almost didn't want to eat them! It was pure bliss for tea lovers. The first bite was a scone – crispy on the outside, soft and crumbly on the inside, with a wonderful buttery aroma. It was so delicious I barely needed butter or jam; I even ordered some to take home. Next came a "Pab Sip" (a type of Thai pastry) shaped like a little bird in a garden of coriander and chili peppers – soft and chewy with a flavorful filling that lingered in my mouth. The watermelon with dried fish was refreshingly juicy, offering a light balance of salty and sweet – very enjoyable. Then came the baked goods set: fruit tarts and macarons with delicate flavors and beautiful crispy shells. But the highlight was the coconut sponge cake – so light and fluffy, like eating a cloud! The flavor was incredibly well-balanced; I highly recommend it. Unfortunately, they were sold out, so I wanted to order some to take home. The place was clean, beautiful, and decorated in an English vintage style. The plates, bowls, spoons, and forks were all lovely, matching the decor. Oh, and for those who like freshly squeezed orange juice, I highly recommend it too! Served in a cut glass, today was a feast for the stomach, the eyes, and the heart.

reviews.name: Pornprom Suthatorn
reviews.text: อร่อยทุกเมนูที่ทานเลยครับ ห้องนั่งทานขนมตกแต่งสไตล์อังกฤษ คุมโทน ดูดีมาก แก้งถ้วยชาม มีดตักเนยยังแบรนด์อังกฤษเลย พี่เจ้าของร้านบอกว่ากำลังจะมีขายข้าวช่วงกลางวันด้วยครับ เป็นข้าวไข่ข้นปู ฯลฯ
reviews.textTranslated: Everything we tried was delicious. The dining area is decorated in an English style, with a consistent color scheme that looks great. Even the tableware and butter knives are British brands. The owner mentioned that they will soon be serving lunch as well, including dishes like crab omelet rice, etc.

reviews.name: Tidaporn Mawin
reviews.text:
อาหารอร่อยมากค่ะ(แนะนำกั้งกระเทียม ฟินมาก😋)
ร้านสวยมากๆๆ  มีมุมถ่ายรูปเยอะเลย  เจ้าของร้านใจดีสุดๆๆ  แนะนำเลยจร้า♥️♥️♥️
reviews.textTranslated:
The food is delicious (I recommend the garlic mantis shrimp, it's so good 😋).
The restaurant is so beautiful, with lots of photo spots. The owner is super friendly. I highly recommend it! ♥️♥️♥️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบพระคุณสำหรับรีวิวที่มีค่ากับทางร้านมากๆค่ะ

reviews.name: pimphat sitivichaporn
reviews.text:
เป็นร้านลับ ที่อยากให้แมส
เพราะอาหารอร่อยมากกกก

บรรยากาศร้านน่ารัก พี่ๆเจ้าของร้านใจดีสุดๆ

อาหารอร่อยทุกอย่าง ไม่ผิดหวังเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
This is a hidden gem that I wish was more popular.

The food is incredibly delicious!

The atmosphere is lovely, and the owners are super kind.

Every dish was delicious; I wasn't disappointed at all.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบพระคุณสำหรับรีวิวที่ดีมากๆ และคำชมจากใจนะคะ 😊
เรารู้สึกดีใจที่คุณลูกค้าประทับใจในอาหาร บรรยากาศ และการบริการจากพี่ๆ เจ้าของร้านค่ะ การที่คุณลูกค้าอยากให้ร้านเราเป็นที่รู้จักมากขึ้นก็ทำให้เรามีกำลังใจในการพัฒนาคุณภาพต่อไปค่ะ

ขอบคุณอีกครั้งที่มาเยี่ยมชม และหวังว่าจะได้ต้อนรับคุณลูกค้าอีกในเร็วๆ นี้นะคะ
— ทีมงานศรีวังหญิง 💐🍽️

reviews.name: Supensri Sakulsim
reviews.text: คลาสร้อยมาลัย ดีมากๆ คุณครูหนึ่งใจเย็น สอนดี ได้เทคนิกใหม่ๆเยอะมากเลยค่ะ มีอาหารเที่ยง ขนม เครื่องดื่มอร่อยๆให้ด้วยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The flower garland making class was excellent! Teacher Nueng was very patient and taught well. I learned many new techniques. Lunch, snacks, and delicious drinks were also provided.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบพระคุณสำหรับรีวิวที่มีค่ากับทางร้านมากๆค่ะ

reviews.name: Grace C.
reviews.text: ชอบบรรยากาศที่สุด ร้านสวย ตกแต่งน่าร้าก เป็น afternoon tea ที่น่าประทับใจมาก อาหารอร่อย ขนมอร่อยมากเลย
reviews.textTranslated: I loved the atmosphere the most. The shop is beautiful and the decor is lovely. It was a very impressive afternoon tea. The food was delicious and the pastries were amazing.

reviews.name: Niramon Rearngwit
reviews.text:
ขนมชาววังที่อร่อยแถมปราณีตหายากมากใกล้ทะเลสาบ ให้ขนมเยอะมากๆ สำหรับ 3ที่ มีขนมให้มากกว่า 11 ชนิด มากกว่า 50 ชิ้น เลยนะ
อร่อยน่ารักคุ้มค่ามาก เชฟจบอาหารคาวหวานจากในวัง ขนมอร่อยสุดๆ
สโคนคือดีกลมกล่อมมากๆ ไม่หวาน นุ่มพอดีมาก
เค้กมะพร้าวฟูฟ่องนุ่มลิ้น มะพร้าวอ่อนสดมาก
Sacher torte ครีมช้อคโกแลตพรีเมี่ยมนะ
Diplomat cake ครีมนำเข้าจากอังกฤษ คือดีสุดๆ

ส่วน ช่อม่วง ขนมจีบนก แป้งสิบ อร่อยแบบอหารคาว ใส่มีกลิ่นพริกไทกำลังดีมาก
ล่าเตียง หายากมาก อร่อยดีค่า

มาลองเลย
reviews.textTranslated:
This royal Thai dessert shop near the lake offers incredibly delicious and exquisite treats. They give you a huge variety of desserts; for three people, there are over 11 different kinds, more than 50 pieces!
Delicious, lovely, and great value. The chef graduated from the palace with degrees in both savory and sweet cuisine, and the desserts are absolutely amazing.
The scones are excellent, perfectly balanced, not too sweet, and incredibly soft.
The coconut cake is fluffy, soft, and melts in your mouth, with very fresh young coconut.
The Sacher torte has premium chocolate cream.
The Diplomat cake has cream imported from England – it's simply superb.

The Chormuang, Khanom Jeeb Nok, and Pang Sip are savory dishes with just the right amount of pepper.
The La Tiang is very rare and delicious.

Come try it!

reviews.name: Kavalim.2011 Kavalim.2011
reviews.text: บรรยากาศร้านสวยงาม ร่มรื่น อาหาร และเบเกอรี่อร่อยทุกเมนู เจ้าของร้านน่ารักมากๆค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The restaurant has a beautiful and relaxing atmosphere. The food and bakery items are all delicious. The owner is very lovely.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบพระคุณสำหรับรีวิวและคำชมที่อบอุ่นนะคะ 😊
เรายินดีมากที่คุณลูกค้าชื่นชอบบรรยากาศร้าน อาหาร และเบเกอรี่ทุกเมนู และรู้สึกดีใจที่เจ้าของร้านสามารถสร้างความประทับใจให้กับคุณลูกค้าได้ค่ะ

หวังว่าจะได้ต้อนรับคุณลูกค้าอีกครั้งในเร็วๆ นี้นะคะ
ขอบคุณอีกครั้งที่แวะมาชิมและรีวิวให้ค่ะ 🙏💐

— ทีมงานศรีวังหญิง

reviews.name: traveller
reviews.text: บรรยากาศร้านสวย ละมุนใจ อาหารอร่อยมากกกกกกกก วันนี้ลองข้าวคลุกพริกเกลือปูและไข่ปู  & กั้งทอดกระเทียม เด็ด ดีต่อใจ
reviews.textTranslated: The restaurant has a beautiful and relaxing atmosphere, and the food is incredibly delicious! Today I tried the rice mixed with chili, salt, crab, and crab roe, and the fried mantis shrimp with garlic. Absolutely amazing!

reviews.name: Naratip Naratip
reviews.text: บรรยากาศน่ารัก อบอุ่น ขนมอร่อย โดยเฉพาะ มาการอง ครีมชีส good vibe good taste
reviews.textTranslated: The atmosphere is lovely and cozy, and the desserts are delicious, especially the cream cheese macarons. Good vibe, good taste.

title: Thai massage by blind (맹인 마사지)
address: 104 Sanamkila Rd, Tambon Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXWQ+FX Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Travelling Darryl
reviews.text: As a massage therapist for 14 years, I can be picky on technique.  I asked for medium pressure and the man gave me what I needed to release the knots and pains in my body.  Humbling experience.

reviews.name: Katja Ficko
reviews.text:
Been there today. One of the best (and cheapest) Thai massages I have experienced. When I told my bling therapist about my backpain, she massaged my back with care and precision. Helped me a lot. Also, when you see locals coming in, you know you are in the right place. Highly recommend!

Working hours are till 7pm and not till 9pm, as stated on google maps.

reviews.name: Silviu Cadere
reviews.text: I had one of the best Thai massages I’ve experienced so far in Thailand, and it was provided by a blind therapist. Their skill and technique were truly exceptional, with an impressive attention to detail that left me feeling completely relaxed and rejuvenated. It’s clear they have honed their craft to perfection. Highly recommend this unique and deeply therapeutic experience!

reviews.name: Marijke Van Dam
reviews.text: Best massage ever, I did many. I was in pain, but my body was so sore. They are very skilled. Also the close 7pm, not 9pm

reviews.name: Beyond the moon
reviews.text: Good skills, really know how to do the joint relaxing.

reviews.name: Michael Kieft
reviews.text: Very good Thai traditional Thai massage. Therapist has good feeling what and how to do. Excellent

reviews.name: Rosie
reviews.text: 치앙마이에 세번째 방문해서 님만, 올타에 있는 수많은 마사지샵을 다녀봤지만 여기가 가성비 최고다. 다른 마사지샵은 안마사가 누구냐에 따라 케바케가 심한데 여긴 딱 두분이서 운영하므로 복불복 가능성이 매우 적다. 다른 마사지샵처럼 처음에 발을 씻겨주거나, 옷을 마사지 전용 옷으로 갈아입거나 하진 않지만 충분히 시간을 내어 방문할 가치가 있는 곳이다.
reviews.textTranslated: This is my third visit to Chiang Mai, and although I have been to countless massage shops in Nimman and Olta, this place offers the best value for money. At other shops, the experience can vary greatly depending on the masseuse, but since this place is run by just two people, the chances of a bad experience are very low. They don't wash your feet at the beginning or have you change into special massage clothes like other places, but it is definitely worth making the time to visit.

reviews.name: [용이] Harry jung
reviews.text:
예약없이  지나가다가  들어갔는데
다행이 바로 이용  굿 타이밍
베드 2개  1번  2번 에 안내에  누워서 입던  옷  그대로 입고 시작.

적당히 강한 압으로 조금은 다른 방식의 마사지
굿
reviews.textTranslated:
I just happened to walk in without a reservation,

Fortunately, I was able to use the service right away—good timing.

There were two beds, number 1 and 2. I was instructed to lie down, and the session began with the clothes I was wearing still on.

It was a slightly different style of massage with moderately strong pressure.

Good.

reviews.name: YE B
reviews.text:
후기가 너무 좋아서 11시 30분경 방문했는데 오후 2시에 가능하다고 해서 2인 480바트 결제하고 작은 예약증을 받았어요. 2시에 맞추어 갔는데 지금까지
받았던 마사지와는 다른 느낌이었어요. 손으로 주무르지 않고 손바닥과 팔로 누르면서 리듬타듯 하는 마사지인데 다 받고난 뒤 이상할 정도로 시원했어요. 처음에 강도에 대해 아무말 없이 시작했는데 아픈거 잘 못참는 저에겐 강도가 너무 세서 살살해달라고 요청드리니 미디움마사지? 라고 말씀 하시더라구요. 그 다음부터는 노곤노곤 너무 좋았습니다. 다만 에어컨이 저는 많이 추웠어요 ㅜㅜ 다음에 갈 땐 에어컨 조절해달라고 부탁드리려구요~
reviews.textTranslated: I saw so many good reviews that I visited around 11:30 AM. They said they were available at 2 PM, so I paid 480 baht for two and received a small reservation slip. I arrived at 2 PM, and it felt different from any massage I've had before. Instead of kneading with their hands, they pressed rhythmically with their palms and arms. I felt strangely refreshed afterward. They didn't ask about the intensity, but since I have a low tolerance for pain, it was too intense. I asked them to be gentler, and they said, "Medium?" After that, I was completely relaxed and completely satisfied. However, the air conditioning was a bit too cold for me. ㅜㅜ Next time, I'll ask them to adjust the air conditioning.

reviews.name: Chris Choe
reviews.text: 마사지는 두분이서 하시는데 저는 남자분에게 받았어요 가격도 합리적이고 마사지도 잘 해주세요 베드가 2개 밖에 없어서 예약없이 가면 기다리거나 못 받을수도 있어요 추천합니다
reviews.textTranslated: Two people work on the massage, and I received it from the male masseur. The price is reasonable, and he gives a great massage. There are only two beds, so if you go without a reservation, you might have to wait or not be able to get a massage. I recommend it.

reviews.name: 슈퍼펭귄
reviews.text:
나만 알고 싶은 치앙마이 마사지샵이다.
부부가 운영하시는데 최고의 압이다.
치앙마이와서 마사지 많이 받았지만 여기가
최고다..1시간 240바트
예약은 필수인곳!
reviews.textTranslated:
This is a Chiang Mai massage shop I want to keep all to myself.

It is run by a married couple, and the pressure is top-notch.

I’ve had many massages since coming to Chiang Mai, but this place is the best.. 240 baht for 1 hour

Reservations are a must!

reviews.name: 나영호
reviews.text:
정말 시원하고 친절합니다 여태 이런 마사지받은경험 처음입니다 강추 꼭가보세요
압도좋고 퀄리티가 어마무시합니다
reviews.textTranslated:
It is really refreshing and the staff are friendly. This is the first time I’ve ever received a massage like this. I highly recommend it; you must visit.

The pressure is great and the quality is incredible.

reviews.name: 이승현
reviews.text: 타이마사지 기준 한시간 200바트로 저렴하다. 200바트의 값어치는 충분히 한다. 갈아입을 옷은 주지 않으며 베드가 에어컨 바로 아래라 약간 춥다
reviews.textTranslated: It is affordable at 200 baht for an hour of Thai massage. It is well worth the price. They do not provide clothes to change into, and the bed is right under the air conditioner, so it is a bit cold.

reviews.name: toto ming
reviews.text: 리뷰 보고 갔는데 글쎄요... 여자분이 해주셨는데 1시간 내내 꾹꾹 누르기만 하시고 다리도 정강이 앞쪽이랑 무릎 같은 데를 대중없이 꾹꾹 누르셔서 너무 아팠어요. 중간에 아픈 티 내니까 힘 조절은 하셨는데 치앙마이 도착하고 처음 받아본 마사지라 이게 원래 태국 마사진가...? 싶네요. 도수치료나 카이로프랙틱도 많이 받아봤는데 시원한지는 모르겠어요. 1시간 내내 강한 꾹꾹이 받고 나온 기분...돈 아까울 정도까진 아닌데 재방문은 안 할 것 같습니다. 다른 마사지샵 가보면 비교가 될 것 같아요. 호불호가 갈리는 것 같네요~
reviews.textTranslated: I went based on the reviews, but... well. A woman gave me the massage, and for the entire hour, she just kept pressing hard. She also pressed indiscriminately on the front of my shins and knees, so it hurt a lot. She did adjust the pressure when I showed signs of pain midway through, but since it was the first massage I'd had since arriving in Chiang Mai, I wondered if this is what authentic Thai massages are supposed to be like. I've had manual therapy and chiropractic treatments many times, but I don't know if this was refreshing. It felt like I just walked out after being subjected to intense pressing for an entire hour... It wasn't bad enough to make me feel like I wasted my money, but I don't think I'll visit again. I think I'll be able to compare it to other massage shops. It seems like opinions are divided on this place.

reviews.text: 타이마사지 기준 1인당 240바트, 2명에 500바트 드렸습니다. 아저씨는 41세고 한 쪽 눈이 살짝 보이는 거 같고, 여자 안마사는 전혀 안 보이는 것 같았습니다. 갈 때마다 시원하고 성의 있게 해 주셨어요. 다만 여자 안마사님은 쉬는 시간 없이 두세명 연속으로 하면 체력상 보통 때 보다 조금 약할 때가 있는데, 이 때도 다른 곳 보다 낫습니다. 한국 손님들이 유독 많이 온다는데, 이유를 모르길래 한국인들이 유투브나 리뷰에 평이 좋아서 추천하는 글 보고 온다고 알려줬더니 고맙다고 하며 더 잘 눌러 주네요.
reviews.textTranslated: I paid 240 baht per person for a Thai massage, or 500 baht for two. The man is 41 years old and seems to have a slight glint in one eye, while the female masseuse didn't seem to see anything at all. Every time I go, she gives me a refreshing and sincere massage. However, the female masseuse sometimes feels a little weaker than usual when she does two or three massages without a break, but even then, she's better than other places. I heard that there are a lot of Korean customers, and since I didn't know why, I told her that I come here because of the good reviews Koreans posted on YouTube and in reviews. She thanked me and pressed the massage button even harder.

reviews.name: 이한석
reviews.text:
태국온지 10일째, 10번째 마사지중 최고네요
40대? 여성 맹인분이 해주시는데 베리굿 입니다
reviews.textTranslated: It's been 10 days since I arrived in Thailand, and this is the best massage I've had out of 10. A blind woman in her 40s did it, and it was very good.

reviews.name: Hoon Jung
reviews.text:
치앙 마이 마사지 중에 가장 시원 합니다 압이 좀 있어서 아프다고 할수는 있지만 대신 효과는 확실해요 뭉친 부분을 정확히 풀어줄주 압니다
남자 마사지사 분에게 받았고 가격또한 다른곳에 비해 저렴 합니다 1시간 기준 240 바트

다만 맹인 안마라서 그런지 코스가 한개 뿐 입니다  그리고 옷 입은 그대로 관리를 받아서 조금 불편할수 있고 위치가 도로가라 조금 시끄럽다는점.

평점 좋은곳 다 다녀 봤지만 마사지 자체가 제일 좋은곳은 이곳이네요 여행 기간 동안 재방 한곳은 여기뿐 추천 드려요
reviews.textTranslated:
This is the most refreshing massage I've had in Chiang Mai. It's a bit painful due to the pressure, but it's definitely effective. They're great at precisely relieving tension. I had a male masseuse, and the price is also cheaper than other places: 240 baht for an hour.

However, because it's a blind massage, there's only one course. The massage is performed with clothes on, which can be a bit uncomfortable. The location is on the street, so it's a bit noisy.

I've been to all the highly rated places, but this one is by far the best. I highly recommend this place for the only massage I've had during my trip.

reviews.name: YoungJin Jeon
reviews.text:
체중싣고 리듬타가면서 괜찮은지도 물어보고
꾹꾹 열심히 해주십니다.

모든 포인트가 시원하진 않지만
제대로 눌러주시는 포인트들은 엄청 시원해요.

싼가격에 마사지 잘 받았습니다.
reviews.textTranslated:
They put their weight into the massage, following the rhythm, and ask if you’re okay.

They press hard and diligently.

Not every spot feels refreshing, but the ones they press properly are incredibly refreshing.

I received a great massage at a low price.

reviews.name: Jay Kim
reviews.text: 1시간 240바트. 여자 마사지하는 호불호가 갈렸는데 남자 마사지사는 엄청 실력 좋아요. 아픈 부위 잘 찾아서 정말 제대로 풀어줍니다.
reviews.textTranslated: 240 baht for one hour. Opinions on the female masseurs were mixed, but the male masseurs are incredibly skilled. They are good at finding painful spots and really loosen them up properly.

reviews.name: 주경미
reviews.text: 부부가 운영하시는데 맹인 맛사지 최고입니다. 12박 하면서 1일 1 맛사지 했어요.  올드타운서 리뷰 좋은 곳 두곳 갔는데  아프기만 했어요. 해서  라오스서도 맹인 맛사지 효과를 봤기에  일부러 맹인 마사지 찾아서 갔는데 진짜 훌륭합니다. 240바트에 부부맛사지 최고예요. 여자분께는 세게 해달라 하면 해주시고  손님에 맞춰 잘해주세요. 저희 남편은 남자 사장님께 받았는데 압세기와 맛사지 정도가 다른 맛사지샵은 못 따라 온다고 하네요. 진짜  추천합니다.
reviews.textTranslated: It is run by a married couple, and the blind massage is the best. I got a massage every day during my 12-night stay. I visited two places in the Old Town with good reviews, but they were just painful. Since I had seen the effectiveness of blind massages in Laos, I made a point of seeking one out, and it is truly excellent. For 240 baht, the couple's massage is the best. If you ask the female masseuse to massage harder, she will do so, and she really tailors her services to the customer. My husband received a massage from the male owner, and he says that other massage shops can't match the pressure and the quality of the massage. I highly recommend it.

title: BUA CHOMPU massage & aroma
subTitle: บัวชมพู นวดเพื่อสุขภาพ

plusCode: PGGJ+6G Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: JunJie Laio (JieStyle)
reviews.text:
First time have foot massage, feeling so good and the price also good too.
If you are in Silom area can try the massage here.
🤟🏻JieStyle🇹🇼

reviews.name: Colin
reviews.text:
No frills fuss free massage.

Slightly cheaper than those along the main silom road area and nearby silom 6.

Appreciate the good service where they even brought our shoes in from outside when it rained.

300 baht for an hour long foot massage.

They have wifi available too if you need.

reviews.name: Giorgia Madella
reviews.text: I recently visited Bua Chompu for a Thai massage, and it was by far the worst experience I've ever had. The therapist didn't perform the stretches symmetrically, using way too much pressure on some areas and completely neglecting others. Additionally, he kept laughing throughout the session, which made it impossible to relax. When I politely mentioned my concerns, he dismissively told me to go to another shop. This level of unprofessionalism is unacceptable. I strongly advise looking elsewhere for a massage if you're seeking a relaxing and balanced experience.

reviews.name: Dennis Snider
reviews.text: After a 30,000+ step day it was nice to come in to this relaxing massage place and get one of the best hour long foot massages ever !. The lady was welcoming and very professional, I'll be back for sure to this little hidden gem tucked away in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Reno
reviews.text: Order one hour but the therapist not do even until one hour. And always like that i Silom place.

reviews.name: Robbie
reviews.text: Best Thai massage I've ever had, great value.  Highly trained masseuse made me feel incredibly relaxed.  Seamless integration of chiropractic knowledge.  I wasn’t going to review until I had a bad massage elsewhere… this is genuinely the best massage in Bangkok.  I wish I could have it everyday.

reviews.name: 葉堅偉
reviews.text: Been going to Bangkok for more than 20 years! Finally found the most suitable masseur  (ก้อย ) last year! Very professional and comfortable workmanship! It’s really worth the  Cheap charges ! Highly recommended ~

reviews.name: Kelly Waye
reviews.text: Nice, clean, and air-conditioned. Reasonable priced and professional massage. I had the foot and thai massage for 450bt. It was a cool relaxing oasis after the busy streets of Silom

reviews.name: Lars Kämpgen
reviews.text: Nice massage for very good price! I had foot 1 Hour for 250 baht… much cheaper than in silom road. Staff is friendly

reviews.name: Evgeny Knoblokh
reviews.text: at 20:30 they asked to come later by 22:00. at 22:00 they were informed that they were no longer accepting today. went to another place. returning home from the massage salon, a guy ran out either to apologize, or to offer a massage. I consider this an unacceptable oversight and do not recommend visiting

reviews.name: Laura R
reviews.text: Cheap compared to average but a waste of money...Freezing room and the massage had no technique. It was very weak and was suppose to be a full massage, but it was mostly at the legs. Overall, worst massage in Thailand.

reviews.name: Bridget Tan
reviews.text: Read the good reviews and wanted to come. Walked over twice on different days at around 11am, which is the stated opening time. Both times the guy inside shook his head and indicated they weren't open. This place needs to update their opening hours to avoid time wastage.

reviews.name: Kassie McIlvaine
reviews.text: Excellent quality - I had a bad migraine and she figured out the pressure points and worked it all out. Nice and friendly and quiet. compared to the row of places on mainstream near by this is much much better quality

reviews.name: Naomi S
reviews.text: The woman went too strong on my body and caused me pain many days after that. They also got quite upset when we didn't give tips.

reviews.name: Nguyen Duyen
reviews.text: Friendly staff, really good massage, I’ve come here everyday during the time i was in bangkok, i done searched for massage shop around and this massage shop got cheapest price compare to others, others massage shop around are so expensive.

reviews.name: Chris Murphy
reviews.text: Clean, comfortable and excellent service.  I enjoy Traditional Thai massage.

reviews.name: Benjamin Ong
reviews.text: Foot massage 250 baht is reasonable as of December 2022 and good service.

reviews.name: Ricky Pombo
reviews.text: Amazing experience, we went there two days in a row. Super friendly people. Thank you

reviews.name: Maria Solei Järvet
reviews.text: Thank you! Very nice massage!

unprofessional and expensive
