reviews.name: living-bike Thomas
reviews.text:
Been there today and it was a really relaxing and calm atmosphere. Friendly reception, explaining and not talking into something.
I had a great masseur, called Ya (hope it's the right pronunciation). He did a professional job, taking time, without any rush. He is highly recommended. I feel much better now. Thanks a lot and hopefully see you again.

reviews.name: Pedro
reviews.text: No need to go. Massage is just ok. Small and unremarkable facilities. Cannot select masseur. Indifferent staff. Many better places in Bangkok at same prices.

reviews.name: Benjamin Hey
reviews.text: Lovely venue, great massage, lovely guys! Such a lovely, relaxing experience. No high-pressure nonsense. Professional with negotiable extras. Good rates.

reviews.name: SpunkyRansom Ohm
reviews.text:
Mr. Wine's expertise is highly commendable.
He is a personable and professional individual.
We anticipate future engagements with him.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your recommendation 🙏

reviews.name: Robert S
reviews.text: I had an absolutely fantastic experience at Paradise Massage this afternoon! The venue exudes professionalism from the moment you walk in, with a clean, welcoming atmosphere that immediately puts you at ease. My masseur, Pop, was exceptional—his professionalism and care were truly outstanding. He checked in with me multiple times during the session to ensure I was comfortable, which made the experience even more relaxing and personalized. The in-room shower was a delightful touch, adding to the overall comfort and convenience. After the massage, I was offered refreshing green tea, which was the perfect way to unwind. I can’t recommend Paradise Massage highly enough—The venue make this a must-visit for anyone seeking a top-notch massage in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your recommendation 🙏

reviews.name: Danny Chan
reviews.text:
Wine was good masseur, excellent service.
One of the best massage place.
Good environment.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your recommendation.

reviews.name: Mike Talampas
reviews.text:
What a horrible experience. Thailand is well known for great massage but this place is definitely up to standards. I was assigned a small man who can barely give pressure. The masseur makes no effort at all despite agreeing to a hard massage. It is insulting what he calls a “massage”. They dont make you pick a masseur either. I wonder if they also assign the masseur for white people? Very very disappointing experience from a highly recommended place. I didnt bother finishing the massage. They were just being insulting and demeaning.
What a waste of time and money.

reviews.name: Nick Toonen
reviews.text:
I had a great overall experience today - especially my massage with Wine.

The reception was friendly and the rooms comfortable and private, including a private shower.

The massage with Wine was excellent. He was attentive, skilled, and very friendly. I will certainly be coming back again to experience his great touch and lovely style.

reviews.name: Treble
reviews.text:
First, let me comment about others’ negative reviews. Why in the world would you go to a gay spa that expects to give “happy endings” for a nominal tip and be turned off by wasting their & your time with just a straight hetero massage? They count on these extended massage tips to make a living. There’s plenty of other straight spas you can go to get a 90 minute inexpensive Swedish massage.

My masseur named Tata was beyond awesome! The salon itself was clean, well decorated and relaxing. After walking in, I was presented with a menu of regular spa services with pricing broken up by duration (60, 90 & 120 minutes). I chose the 90 minute Swedish oil massage for 850 baht ($25 USD). I was escorted to a very clean room with the massage table, shower, sink, and several towels & a few pillows. The entire experience was incredible!  Based on my enjoyable “happy endingS”, I chose to give an additional 1000 baht tip ($30 USD). I’d give six stars if  I could!!  I highly recommend Paradise (gay) men’s spa!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your 5 stars review if you come next time you can get from my shop

reviews.name: Filippo Lupatelli
reviews.text: Really nice massage from Leo 88, I had love it

reviews.name: Masha Wanchan
reviews.text: I went to many countries,this is the nicest place I would suggest anyone to visit.The best massage &Spa in Silom Clean and nice place with a very professional therapist here ,friendly and very helpful people specially Mr.Alex .I will back again for my next trip visit to Thailand.See you again soon

reviews.name: Alex Chen
reviews.text: I've been to this massage place several times already, and every time has been a wonderful experience. Jo, my massage therapist, is absolutely amazing — he’s super dedicated (and cute) and really puts his heart into every session. Plus, he’s just the sweetest person! The foot massage area in the lobby and the VIP room are also really cozy and relaxing, perfect for winding down to enjoy a massage. Everything feels  comfortable. If you’re coming here, I highly recommend asking for Jo🌝
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏

reviews.name: Geum Hyeon Yim
reviews.text: Leo is amazing! His pressure is just right — strong and really hits all the sore spots. You can tell he knows exactly what he’s doing. On top of that, he’s super friendly and funny. He throws in some cute jokes that instantly make you feel relaxed and at ease. It’s not just a massage, it’s a whole feel-good experience. Highly recommend if you want both relief and a good vibe!

reviews.text: Welcome to new The paradise the good environment for massage shop in Silom 6 alley if you want to take a relaxed massage you can come here
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks krubb. Let’s celebrate

I will definitely be going back! Leo your simply the best!!!

reviews.name: Thongsri Saencom
reviews.text:
I passed by this shop near my the hotel and decided to walk in for a session.
I decided on Thai + oil massage. I was assigned, Mr. Top. Mr. Top was a very attentive therapist and periodically checked in  to see how I felt throughout the massage.

reviews.name: G W
reviews.text: Did a walk in on Saturday night and they were very accommodating. The rooms are very modern and clean and the massage was almost perfect. Haggling over the tip mid way through was annoying!!

reviews.name: Explorewithme_
reviews.text: Better go to a professional place with all the services, in the end you shall be paying around f 2000 B and full satisfaction

reviews.name: namwann’s εïз
reviews.text: wayyy too many trainers giggling and talking. literally most machines are already occupied by them, no variety at all— most machines are old and not up-to-date. the locker room is on the third floor so you need to walk all the way up there to change and to get some water. but at least the staffs were nice

reviews.name: Luca Galletta
reviews.text: Great facility, close to a major transit point and mall. Prices are high, but equipment and classes are high quality. Well equipped gym with modern equipment but expensive and very overcrowded in the evening. Not exactly quiet in the afternoon either.

reviews.text:
Better than ramindra prominade branch and than crystal park branch

They provide towel (which lack in 2 mentioned branches)

It is not platinum level that basic membership can pass you through.

Soda were discontinue and fruit infused water were replacement. Which is not bad.

Coffee and tea remained.

reviews.name: Aik Sittichai
reviews.text:
A spacious three-storeys fitness centre outskirt of downtown Bangkok. The group exercise studio and the mind & body studio are quite large.
All the machines and equipments ate pretty much everywhere but the free weight training zone is relatively small.
The locker room is located on the third floor and if you are a platinum club member, you can access to free towels

reviews.name: Ahmed Al-Betar
reviews.text:
Stepping into Fitness First at CentralPlaza Rama 3 is a game changer for anyone serious about their health and fitness. My visit last Wednesday confirmed why this gym stands out in Bangkok. The expansive layout across multiple floors offers not just a vast range of equipment but also dedicated spaces for functional training and group classes, all under one roof.
The vibrant energy is palpable, with fitness enthusiasts engaged in varied workouts, from intense cardio sessions to focused strength training. The trainers are visible and accessible, offering advice and encouragement, contributing to an environment that motivates and supports progress.
The highlight for me was the functional training area with its turf zone. It's a refreshing change from the usual gym setting and perfect for mixing up my routine. Moreover, the cycling studio, with its immersive setup, promises an exhilarating group exercise experience.
Cleanliness and maintenance are clearly top priorities here, with every piece of equipment in top condition. Whether you're a fitness novice or a seasoned athlete, Fitness First at CentralPlaza Rama 3 offers a welcoming and highly conducive space to achieve your fitness goals.

reviews.name: Tony Zhu

reviews.name: Xia Taptara
reviews.text:
Overall, it is a great place to workout.  I like it fine.  Why two stars, you probably wonder?  Well,... The music from the cycling room is WAY TOO LOUD!!!  I was in the hall way wearing my earbuds, I can still hear the music very clearly.  Because they leave the door wide open so the people could breath.
Music from other rooms and common area are totally fine.  But ONLY THE CYCLING ROOM is too damn loud.
Noise that loud could damage your hearing long term or short term.  Yes, the music could give you adrenaline rush in the moment, but it it isn’t worth for hearing loss later in their late 30s.  Please inform your staffs to be caution about the noise over 80-90 dB.  You probably don’t want those in class to come back later with class action lawsuit like many did in the USA.  Learn from it.

Also if you are going to open the door, please turn down the music in the room because there are a lot of people outside who are paying for your membership fees too.  Be courteous to your neighbors.  This is just a common courtesy.

I know that fitness usually have loud music around the training area.  And I absolutely understand that I’m in the environment.  Believe me, I know my environment.  The gyms are like my 2nd or 3rd home.  I’ve been to the gym all over the world for the pass 25 yrs consistently.  But this is unusually and extremely LOUD.

Thank you very much.

reviews.name: Riduwan Abu Bakar
reviews.text:
I recently visited MAHA Massage in Silom, Bangkok, and unfortunately, my experience was far from satisfactory. The establishment is located at 128/8 Silom Soi 6, Bangkok 10500.

Upon entering, I was immediately struck by an unpleasant odor permeating the facility, which made the environment uncomfortable. The massage itself was subpar; the therapist seemed inexperienced, applying inconsistent pressure that left me feeling more tense than relaxed.

The standard price for a traditional Thai massage was 1,000 THB, which I found to be overpriced given the quality of service provided. To make matters worse, at the end of the session, the staff pressured me into giving a substantial tip, which added to my discomfort.

Overall, I would not recommend MAHA Massage in Silom. The combination of the unpleasant smell, poor massage quality, high prices, and the forced tipping left me with a negative impression.

reviews.name: Sean
reviews.text:
I visited this massage parlour with a friend recently. We both found the environment relaxing and the massage technique very good. 5-star ratings for these two factors.

Unfortunately the overall experience was made worse by the following:

- Pushiness of the staff when we only wanted a 300 THB foot massage. They insisted multiple times on the more expensive options but we didn’t want these.

- My friend’s masseur requesting a tip. We were intending to tip anyway but it’s awkward to be asked.

- Unhappy reactions to 100 THB tips given to each masseur. I’ve had massages elsewhere in Thailand and the staff have always been happy with our tips. It seemed like the staff here had unrealistic expectations.

While I mention again that the technique and environment was very good, we would be reluctant to go back here due to the problems above. The business needs to be aware of how their behaviour impacts on customer experience and work to improve on this aspect.

reviews.textTranslated: I tried a massage today, and it wasn't very good. I've been to many places, but never encountered anything like this. The masseuse wasn't very enthusiastic. I told her it hurt, but she kept massaging, saying my tendons were tense. The areas she massaged didn't hurt, but the areas that did hurt, she didn't. After a while, I told her it hurt. Initially, I wanted a two-hour massage, but I asked if I could just have one hour. The masseuse said, "Then I won't massage you anymore." It hurt wherever she touched; she didn't seem to know how to massage properly. She didn't massage me from the start; even after I told her it hurt, she kept going. And when she did massage, she didn't massage gently or relaxingly; she only massaged hard or forcefully at the end. The massage wasn't good for me, and she wasn't very polite either. She didn't hit the right muscles or tendons. So I said, "Okay, then half an hour is enough," and she walked away. Then another masseuse came and said she would continue for the full hour. That one was much better; she massaged the muscles and tendons from my back down to my heels. If I come again, I won't go back to the same masseuse. She talked a lot but didn't hit the right muscles or tendons. Be careful when choosing a masseuse. I once saw one with two braids.

The rice was real sushi rice, slightly sour and sweet. The fish was fresh; the salmon was firm, bouncy, and not mushy.

The grouper had firm, fatty, and crispy flesh.

reviews.name: tiago koch
reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience at ITM Chiang Mai. The quality of teaching is exceptional, with knowledgeable and patient instructors who take the time to ensure every student understands not only the techniques but also the philosophy behind traditional Northern Thai Massage. The learning environment is welcoming, professional, and supportive, making it suitable for both complete beginners and experienced therapists.

One of my favourite parts of the course was the daily morning ritual. Each day began with gentle stretching, Tai Chi, and breathing exercises, creating a calm and focused atmosphere before classes started. It was a wonderful way to prepare both body and mind for a full day of learning.

Another highlight was the beautiful breakfast served every morning. The school provides a selection of delicious local Thai delicacies, and the mango sticky rice quickly became one of my favourites. It was a thoughtful touch that made every morning feel special and brought students together before class.

The hands on practice each day gave me the confidence to apply what I learned, and the instructors were always happy to provide individual feedback and corrections. I also appreciated the emphasis on body mechanics, helping students work effectively while protecting their own bodies.

Beyond the course itself, the staff were friendly and well organised, and the international community created an inspiring environment to learn from people from all over the world. Studying at ITM has not only improved my massage skills but also deepened my appreciation for Thai culture and the healing art of traditional Thai massage.

I wholeheartedly recommend ITM to anyone looking for authentic, world class Thai massage training in Chiang Mai. It has been one of the most rewarding educational experiences of my life, and I hope to return for more advanced courses in the future.

reviews.name: Israel Skuri
reviews.text:
I am posting this review here as well because if the main school of ITM takes pride in SpaMantra as its official branch, both the management and potential students should know what is actually happening on the ground...

Leaving a course halfway through, especially after paying a non-refundable 7,900THB - is not something I take lightly.

As a professional massage therapist who spent a full month taking intensive courses across Chiang Mai, I enrolled in the 2-day Hand Reflexology course at ITM SpaMantra expecting high-level instruction. Instead, the quality, structure, and time management were so poor that walking away and cutting my losses was the only sensible choice.

​When a course is advertised as a 15-hour program running from 09:00 to 17:30 over two days with a one-hour lunch break, I expect to receive 15 actual hours of education and practice.
What I experienced was artificially stretched to justify a two-day duration that could have easily been covered in a single day course.
​Throughout both days, practical hands-on application was severely lacking.
On day one, after the instructor demonstrated techniques on both of my hands, I was able to practice only once before being dismissed for lunch a half an hour early, at 11:30 AM. Class then ended completely at 15:30 PM instead of 17:30 PM.
On the second day, we finished the entire course booklet within just one hour, and out of the two hours I was in class, I practiced for merely 15 minutes on a single hand.

To make matters worse, Throughout both days, every 20 to 30 minutes the instructor would leave for an unscheduled "bathroom break" disappearing for 10 to 15 minutes each time without explanation, leaving me sitting alone in the room.

​The breaking point came at 11:15 AM on day two when the instructor dismissed me again for a nearly two-hour lunch break until 13:00 PM. When I asked if I should return at 12:15 PM to keep practicing, he simply replied that class starts at 13:00 PM, but I could "come back early and take a nap in the classroom." That was the moment I realized no further educational value or professional guidance would be gained. While the instructor gave me a pleasant massage, and offerd Thai herbal tea, I did not pay 7,900 THB for a spa session, I paid to learn!

​I spoke with the polite manager, requested my certificate, and left.
While the staff were very friendly and the facilities were clean, politeness does not replace proper education. As an institution with an international reputation charging premium fees, this level of training is completely unacceptable. If you are a serious, practicing therapist looking for active guidance, anatomy-focused learning, and real respect for your time, I cannot recommend this course.

reviews.name: FNFA FNFIDIS
reviews.text:
My first massage school. I was working as a personal trainer and i wanted to expand my services introducing stretching and massage for my clients. Thai massage is exactly that so i decided to start here in December 2022. I did lvl 1-2-3-4a-4b and then teacher training for lvl 1 in January 2023. Came back November 2023 to finish CAPT 68 to become also lvl 2 teacher. Did extra courses (foot, table, elbows and knees x2, lanna 1 x2, lanna 2 x2, applied anatomy) and also i stayed more to practice teaching lvl 1 and 2 as an internship for 29 weeks in total till now, every winter that i come to Chiang Mai to practice.m. They give you all necessary tools to understand and start doing Thai massage. I suggest people to take lvl 1-2 to begin with the basics and be able to offer relaxing massage. Then lvl 3-4 to offer a more personalized massage (therapeutic) for specific areas that need more attention. Teachers know what they teach and are happy to help. School is clean and modern. They ask for feedback every week and they take it seriously always trying to improve. Students are from every single corner of the world, with many different backgrounds (from beginners to professionals) and that helps to understand other cultures. Everyone speaks english. I highly recommend ITM school 🙏
Feel free to follow me on IG at @Alexandroskouk if you have more questions you need to be answered

reviews.name: Andressa Chikazawa
reviews.text: A very serious school but with a huge heart. You truly immerse yourself in Thai tradition. They make a point of teaching the fundamentals of traditional Thai medicine. Every day is a different routine. I love the yoga and Tai Chi classes before the main classes. All the teachers are super attentive and caring. One of the best experiences in my life, a transformation. I highly recommend the school.

reviews.name: Izzie M.
reviews.text:
I recently completed the 2-day Thai Foot Reflexology course at ITM and left feeling disappointed by the overall educational value of the program.

On the positive side, the instructors and students were friendly, the facilities were clean and well-maintained, and the school’s location is convenient and accessible.

However, the course itself felt poorly organized and did not meet my expectations for a professional training program. A significant amount of time was spent on tray setup, towel wrapping, and other logistical details, while insufficient time was devoted to learning reflexology points, anatomy, and hands-on practice. There were also numerous breaks, an early dismissal on the first day, and schedule changes that further reduced instructional time. Although advertised as a 12-hour course, the actual educational and practice time felt considerably less.

I also found it frustrating that most of the practical work focused on only the left foot, leaving the right foot and its reflex points inadequately covered. In addition, there was a graded practical exam and pressure evaluation despite the limited time available for practice beforehand. I believe additional hands-on training would have been far more valuable than formal assessment in a short introductory course.

The classroom atmosphere was friendly and relaxed, but there were frequent interruptions and off-topic discussions that sometimes took time away from learning.

For a course priced at 5,000 baht, I expected a more structured curriculum, deeper coverage of reflexology theory and point location, and substantially more supervised practice. While I appreciate the welcoming environment, I do not feel the course delivered value consistent with its price or fully achieved its stated learning objectives.

reviews.text:

I appreciated the positive and relaxed atmosphere, but at times the teachers seemed more focused on enjoying themselves than on helping students master key positions and techniques.
We did learn the basics, but the handouts were poorly designed and often confusing, especially when different teachers gave conflicting explanations. reviews.text:
I've graduated 1st and 2nd level at ITM this year and I can say without any shadow of a doubt that I would recommend this school for anyone who wants to learn traditional Thai massage but also to those who want to experience the Thai culture and traditions.

A BIG THANK YOU to the ITM teachers that not only taught us with patience, but also helped in creating this great community  among us students, persons from all over the world that have never met before, and that in the end got to share personal stories and keep communicating even after we have left.

I want to praise the ITM staff for the joyful way in which they have shared all that knowledge (not always easy to grasp :P ) and for the coziness of the setup (the tasty sweets, the flavoured teas as well as the cultural significance of those).

I don't know if this is part of the Thai culture or if this school has really a special approach to welcoming students, but I know it made me feel at home every time I arrived at school (even if it was my 1st time in Asia and the cultural shock was big at the beginning).

Thank You!

reviews.name: Hai le
reviews.text:
For anyone who's reading this review and is currently researching for a legitimate school all around thailand that offers professional thai massages, then look no further. I too was lost with so many schools on offer in Thailand, but unsure where or which one. I'm sure glad I chose ITM in Chang Mai. Initially I emailed them some questions and the response was prompt and very professional. Classes has schedules, prices were provided and options were available. This gave me the confidence to go ahead and booked my flights and accommodation. My course itself for Level 1 was M-F, so a 5 day course. The training was thorough, you learn new things every day, so was a healthy challenge. The teachers spoke clear English, super friendly and approachable, I was comfortable to ask many questions. I was impressed and in awe of their skill level. The place is very clean and quite spacious.

I'm inspired to do level 2 in the future, so will definitely come back, thus would also recommend others to come to this school too.

reviews.name: Sabrina Fedeli
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, I wouldn't recommend ITM after having spent 5 weeks there, unless you are only doing level 1&2 "just for fun". There are many things that are good, e.g. the teachers are aaabsolutely lovely, the manuals are of good quality, BUT...

I feel like the school is too focused on money and doesn't really equip you to practise Thai Massage unless you do their CAPT program.
For example, you are only taught and practicing massage during ~23h in your 30h course. The rest of the time, you have coffe/tea breaks (free + free bananas!), you do "exercise", you chant the mantra (paying respect to the teacher); on Friday, you have an 'exam' and someone performs the exam on you and a certification ceremony...I am not saying all these things are bad, because they are not, but they shouldn't count towards a 30h certificate.
The exams cannot really be taken seriously, either, as hardly anybody ever fails, sometimes 1 teacher is watching 5 people at the same time, and you never have to demonstrate that you actually "know" something.
After 5 weeks, I still don't know how perform a 1h or 1.5h massage. I will have to figure it out by trial and error. Every other massage course I have done at least gave me a guideline or even a sample routine to follow.
In addition to this, we were, at times, 28 students crammed into one classroom, with only 2 teachers.

The advertisement and pricing of the weekend courses is not really fair, either. All 2 of the 3 weekend courses I took were shorter than advertised (11-12h instead of 15h). When I complained I was first asked whether I would like the hours on my certificate to be changed. I said I would like to get what I paid for or get a partical refund and the founder Chongkol/John just said I could have stayed and practiced more. Fact is, people had left and teachers told us to go home. For one course, they did tell me I could attend it again, free of charge, which would have been nice, but I had already booked other courses... I have now seen that other (lower) reviews have previously stated similar issues.

Chulaluck/Kate (the daughter of the founder, Chongkol) is very lovely and understanding, finds individual solutions where necessary and tries to make sure people leave the school happy and I really thank her for that, I honestly think she is the future of this school.
As initially stated, not everything was bad and I have learned a lot, but unfortunately I can't leave a good review just because of that.

reviews.name: David Rock
reviews.text:
I have been coming to Mum Sabah Massage Salon for the past two years, and at this point I simply wouldn’t consider going anywhere else. What truly sets this place apart is the consistency and genuine quality of care.

In particular, I have been fortunate to find, in Khun O, quite possibly the best massage therapist I have ever experienced. She has an exceptional instinct for identifying exactly where tension and pain sit, and she works with remarkable precision on the areas that truly need attention. Every session feels tailored rather than routine, which is rare and deeply appreciated.

While her English is very limited, this has never been a barrier. Her skill, attentiveness, and intuitive understanding more than compensate for any language gap. In fact, it almost reinforces the sense that she communicates through her work rather than words.

The overall service is consistently excellent, the atmosphere calm and welcoming, and the professionalism evident in every visit. If you are looking for a place where genuine expertise meets heartfelt service, I can recommend Mum Sabah Massage Salon without hesitation.

reviews.name: YY
reviews.text:
My friends and I decided to visit this place while looking for somewhere to relax, and it immediately caught our attention with its grand and luxurious ambience.

We all had facials + foot massage but it seemed that each therapist / masseur had a different level of skill, so the experience wasn't very consistent across the group. The facial treatment is also conducted in an open-concept area, which made it a little difficult to fully unwind. With the surrounding lights, conversations, and general activity, it wasn't quite as peaceful or private as we had expected for a relaxing spa experience

reviews.name: subhasri acharya
reviews.text:
✨ A little slice of calm I didn’t know I needed… ✨

Stepped into Pimnara Spa and instantly felt the chaos melt away. The space is spotless—minimal, serene, and beautifully maintained (swipe to see how clean and calming it looks 🤍).

We started with a 30-minute foot massage that set the tone perfectly, followed by a 90-minute full body oil massage—and honestly, it was pure bliss. The therapists were gentle yet precise, hitting all the right pressure points. At one point, I was so relaxed I almost drifted off to sleep… and that’s when you know it’s GOOD.

What really stood out:
✔️ Impeccable hygiene & cleanliness
✔️ Calm, soothing ambience
✔️ Professional and skilled therapists
✔️ Thoughtful little touches (tea + treats at the end 🍵)

If you’re looking to unwind, de-stress, and truly switch off—this place is a must-visit. Your body will thank you later.

⭐️ Highly recommend for anyone needing a deep reset.

reviews.name: Shimi
reviews.text:
DON’T DO IT! WALK THE OTHER WAY!
Extremely disappointing experience. This place looks luxurious and professional from the outside, but unfortunately the actual treatments were very poor. It felt like style over substance.

They require full payment upfront, and after experiencing the service it became pretty obvious why. The staff were not particularly welcoming or attentive, communication was difficult due to very limited English, and the overall atmosphere was unpleasant — including a noticeable sewage smell upon entering.

The massage and treatments themselves felt very basic, rushed, and nowhere near the standard you would expect from a spa presenting itself as premium and catering to international tourists.

Overall, this was one of the most underwhelming spa experiences we’ve had in Phuket and we would not return.

reviews.name: Samia Berrendou
reviews.text:
Very bad experience in this supposedly well-known beauty institute in Phuket.

I left with a burn on my eyebrow, including a fairly deep wound, as well as a burn on my lip after an eyebrow waxing. I paid 1000 baht to literally get burned.

What shocked me the most was the behavior of the beautician: she applied wax on my eyelashes. Then she looked at me with scissors and said that she had no choice but to cut them.
➡️ She actually cut my eyelashes.

This is completely unacceptable. How can a professional apply wax on a client’s eyelashes and then cut the eyelashes instead of acknowledging a serious mistake and handling the situation properly?

When I explained that I was in severe pain, that the burns were visible, and that my eyebrows were not even properly finished, the only response from the staff and managers was:
“Just apply some cream, it will go away.”

They minimized the situation, calling it simple redness, while the burn was clearly visible and very painful.
No apology, no responsibility taken, no professionalism or respect, from the reception staff to the management.

This was the worst experience of my life in a beauty salon. I left shocked and traumatized.

I am writing this to warn anyone considering going there:
👉 Terrible customer service
👉 Unprofessional and unsafe staff
👉 Irresponsible management

This place should be avoided at all costs.

The treatments were great, but I wanted to leave this review because Dream really stood out. She's the kind of person who makes you want to come back. Thank you, Dream!

reviews.name: Amit Chahal
reviews.text:
A Mixed Experience Turned Around by Exceptional Customer Service

My wife and I recently visited Pimnara Spa at Jungceylon for a relaxing afternoon, booking a full facial and Thai body massage. While the experience had its highs and lows, I’m writing this review to highlight the individuals who truly made a difference and ensured we left satisfied.

First, the facial treatment was outstanding. My therapist, Faree, was absolutely incredible — attentive, gentle, and meticulous. She demonstrated great attention to detail throughout the session, and it was one of the best facials I’ve had. My wife also thoroughly enjoyed her treatments and had no complaints.

However, my Thai body massage unfortunately didn’t meet expectations — not because of the therapist, but due to the poor etiquette of another client in the same room. During my massage, the client’s phone rang loudly, and to my disbelief, they proceeded to take the call and continued speaking for several minutes. This completely disrupted the relaxing environment and broke the immersion of the treatment. What disappointed me further was that the therapist did not intervene or ask the client to respect the shared space, which I felt should have been handled more professionally.

After the treatment, I voiced my concerns to the spa manager, Poo, and this is where the Pimnara Spa truly redeemed itself. Poo was incredibly understanding, patient, and genuinely apologetic for the experience. She acknowledged the issue right away and, without hesitation, offered me a complimentary 45-minute reflexology massage while I waited for my wife to finish her treatment. This thoughtful gesture went a long way in easing my frustration and showed true dedication to customer satisfaction.

Faree and Poo are both a credit to Pimnara Spa. Faree’s skill and care as a therapist made a lasting impression, and Poo’s professionalism and empathy in handling my complaint are the reason I would return. In fact, I can honestly say that if we do come back to Pimnara Spa, it will solely be because of the high level of customer service that Poo provided. She turned a potentially disappointing visit into a memorable one, and I truly appreciate how she took care of us.

I would recommend Faree without hesitation for facials, and if you ever have any concerns or issues, ask for Poo — she is outstanding and ensures the spa lives up to the standard its reputation suggests.

reviews.text: Самому салону я бы поставила 5 звезд: все чистое, красивое, приятный дизайн, выдержанный стиль, много пространства, перед массажем вам моют ноги, предлагают напиток до или после процедуры. Но я бы больше не пошла в этот салон на oil massage и вам не рекомендую. Во-первых, когда я попросила выключить кондиционер, потому что уже прям замёрзла, массажистка начала возмущаться, что ей жарко работать. Далее она закрывала меня всю полотенцами и оставляла открытой только часть тела, где делала массаж, но под горой полотенец мне было все равно холодно и дискомфортно. Так можно и заболеть. Во-вторых, ее кожа рук была грубая, как наждачная бумага, было просто неприятно. В третьих, когда тебе делают oil massage, ты без одежды и, когда тебе нужно перевернуться на другую сторону, тебя обычно тактично прикрывают полотенцем, тут же такого не было и я чувствовала себя дико дискомфортно. В первый раз я была на обычном тайском массаже и он был вполне себе ничего, но когда я пришла на oil, то ушла очень недовольная. И больше не захотелось возвращаться.
reviews.textTranslated: I'd give the salon itself 5 stars: everything is clean, beautiful, the design is pleasant, the style is consistent, there's plenty of space, they wash your feet before the massage, and offer you a drink before and after the procedure. But I wouldn't go to this salon for an oil massage again, and I don't recommend it. Firstly, when I asked to turn off the air conditioning because I was freezing, the masseuse started complaining that it was too hot for her to work. Then she covered me completely with towels, leaving only the part of my body where she was massaging me exposed, but under the mountain of towels I still felt cold and uncomfortable. You could get sick. Secondly, the skin on her hands was rough, like sandpaper, it was just unpleasant. Thirdly, when you get an oil massage, you're naked, and when you need to turn over, they usually tactfully cover you with a towel, but here that wasn't the case, and I felt incredibly uncomfortable. My first time was a regular Thai massage, and it was okay, but when I went for the oil treatment, I left very dissatisfied. And I never wanted to go back.

Distinctive Thai luxury encapsulates The Sukosol’s enchanting Lotus Spa, located alongside the swimming pool within easy walking distance of Phaya Thai BTS train station.

The Spa includes five private treatment rooms, a glorious open-air traditional teak massage pavilion beside the pool and a spacious suite specially designed for couples or friends wishing to share their spa experience.

Our certified therapists provide a complete range of massage, scrub, wrap and facial treatments for men and women, with traditional Thai, aromatic and Swedish techniques available.

Whether you are looking to rejuvenate tired skin, relieve stress, overcome jet lag or soothe away aches and pains, we invite you to stop by Lotus Spa.

reviews.text:
The salon is clean, nice, and the prices are reasonable. Unfortunately, my 2-hour treatment was not relaxing at all 😅. The movements were very rough from start to finish, with no real delicacy or gentleness, which made it difficult to enjoy the experience.

I was also served what was supposed to be hot tea, but it arrived completely cold and appeared to be leftover from a previous customer 😅, which was a bit surprising.

Overall, the salon itself is pleasant, but the service wasn’t for me, and I don’t think I would come back.

reviews.text: This is my second time visit. I choose 199 THB hair wash package as always. Service is smooth, amazing and relaxed. The therapist Yoyo is excellent and kind. Will visit next time for sure 😄

reviews.name: Immerunterwegs
reviews.text:
I did the "KH Relaxing Signature Sleep and Spa" for 698 Baht. The massage and the hair washing were good, even if I could not really relax, because the activities and tools changed often. But it was fine and I enjoyed the massages! Also the woman who treated me was very kind and lovely and I felt very comfortable with her. :)

Unfortunately the blow-drying the other college did afterwards took away all the relaxation and left my hair extremely dry and kind of destroyed. I was hoping to do something good for my recently very dry hair with the whole treatment, but the colleague blow-drying my hair did not use any product to protect my wet hair. Instead she just combed through the wet hair from top to bottom, ripping and pulling, making the ends matted, which is just unprofessional and very unhealthy for hair. She also used two different brushes while drying which were already full of hair from other people... Also while the blow-drying she combed through my hair kind of in the opposite direction which always created new knots in the end, which she brutally tried to part afterwards. The whole procedure just hurt and made me watch my hair being destroyed kind of...

I don't feel good about doing this review because I really liked the massage and the woman doing it, but I also came out of the treatment with hair that felt dryer and more broken than before. 🙁

reviews.name: Sam Ng
reviews.text:
Our family of nine, ranging from young adults to seniors, tried Muay Thai for the very first time here & it turned out to be the absolute highlight of our Thailand trip.

We were so grateful that Panniwat Muaythai Gym opened a special class for us on a holiday to fit our schedule. From the start, they were incredibly welcoming & responsive.

The instructors were the real stars—friendly, patient, professional & genuinely enthusiastic about teaching a group of complete beginners. They gave clear demonstrations & made sure we all understood, no matter our age or fitness level.

The session itself was a powerful (& truly humbling) experience for us city dwellers from Singapore. The warm-up alone was a workout. A unforgettable moment was watching a young Muay Thai prodigy from the gym spar with their star instructor. You could literally feel the power & precision behind each move—it was electrifying & mesmerizing watching from the ring side, up close.

The facility was clean & well-equipped. The whole two-hour journey, from warm-up to cool-down, was challenging but so rewarding. It was authentic, professional & surprisingly fun.

We couldn't have asked for a better introduction. Thank you, Panniwat Gym, for giving our family such a memorable & incredible experience. We highly recommend you to everyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. Hope to see your family again.

reviews.text:
숙련된분도 있을거고 진심으로 열심히 해주시는 마사지분들도 있으시겠지만
다만 오늘 내가 만난 마사지사만 그런거라 생각되네
파트너 마사지 시작하고 한참 지나서 오더니
중간에 아무말없이 2번 나갔다 오더니 팔하나 몸에 올려놓고 가만있기를 수번 두피마사지 한다고 하더니 수건도 아니고 베게커버로 이마부터 대충 문지르더니 동네 미용실에서 무료로해주는것보다 성의없고 감흥없는 마사지를 이곳에서 아주비싼값 지불하고 받자니 열받아 그만하고 나가라 했네
마사지 백번 받아보고 좋았던점 안좋앗던점은 있었어도 중간에 피니쉬 하고 내보내기는 첨이다. 잘들 판단하고 선택하시길
reviews.textTranslated:
I'm sure there are skilled masseurs and those who genuinely put in a lot of effort, but I feel like it was just the masseuse I met today.

She came over well after my partner had already started the massage,

she left and came back twice without saying a word, and just sat there several times with one arm resting on my body. She said she was going to give me a scalp massage, but instead of a towel, she just roughly rubbed my forehead with a pillowcase. It was less sincere and less impressive than the free massages I get at a neighborhood hair salon. I was so angry paying such a high price for this that I told her to stop and leave.

I've had massages a hundred times, and while there have been good and bad moments, this is the first time I've had to stop in the middle and kick someone out. Please judge carefully before choosing a place.

reviews.textTranslated:

title: 8 STAR MUAYTHAI GYM
subTitle: 8 สตาร์มวยไทย
ownerDescription: Muaythai sometimes referred as Thai boxing, is a Thai martial art and full-contact combat sport that uses stand-up striking, sweeps, and various clinching techniques.This discipline is known as the "art of eight limbs", as it is characterised by the combined use of fists, elbows, knees and shins.

reviews.name: Julia M
reviews.text:
Absolutely love 8 Star Muay Thai Gym!
This place has an incredible atmosphere that makes you want to come back every single day. The energy is positive, motivating, and welcoming – perfect for all levels. One of the trainers, in particular, is truly exceptional. He’s incredibly kind, passionate about what he does, and takes the time to clearly explain techniques in a way that’s easy to understand and apply. Whether you’re just starting out or looking to improve your skills, you’ll feel supported and inspired here. Highly recommend this gym if you’re in the area – it’s a real gem!

reviews.text:
I am the victim of social media & PK Saenchai. It looks nice and all on Social media but my experience there was bad. So I tried 8STAR, which is near my hotel.

I have no idea why this is not getting more reviews. The cost for drop-in is cheaper and you get multiple krus noticing you, paying attention to you (probably because they don’t have a lot of people showing up at 4pm), and if you tell them to help correct your Muay Thai, you will get it.

8STAR truly saves my Muay Thai training experience in Bangkok. Especially if you want to sharpen your Muay Thai, or if you’re around, just pay them a visit!

*Everyone is fun to be around.

reviews.textTranslated:
An excellent gym for practicing Muay Thai, for all levels, right in the heart of Bangkok, located in the Sathorn district. I started training there a little over three months ago, and my level has really improved thanks to the great advice from the coaches and my own dedication.
Open from 9 am to 12 pm and from 4 pm to 9 pm, the flexible hours are a real advantage for planning your day.
In short, I highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Lydia Pelin
reviews.text: Both of the women who work here are absolute miracle workers when it comes to actually addressing pain in the body. I had a very bad and painful issue with my sacrum being slightly out of place, and these women helped me so, so much with that. After only 1 session, I was able to walk with almost no pain and my range of motion was restored. After 2 sessions I am feeling so relieved.  I honestly am so blown away by the amount of knowledge, professionalism, and care they demonstrated. They both really worked deeply with pressure points, meridian lines, and muscular structure to help me in ways I wasn't expecting. The massage is definitely intense and sometimes painful because they are working deeply to correct the issue, so if you only want a relaxing massage, there are a million places in Chiang Mai for that. I mean, probably they can do relaxing massage too, but if you have a real issue you need solved, this is the place. Also, please be sure to tip well. In my opinion, they are worth way more than the humble price they are charging. I am very grateful for the care I received here. Thank you, Lalin!

reviews.name: Anastasia N
reviews.text: It was the best massage experience I ever had! I ended up prolonging for the second hour. Loved every minute of it! My back, neck and shoulders were hurting a lot and the masseuse gave attention to every muscle, she was cery caring and I felt the genuine concern. She also taught me some tricks to do self massage of neck at home which was suuuper helpful and honestly noone did it for me before. The best thing about it was that the massage was not by script and it really was adapted to my problematic areas. I am so grateful, I usually don’t write such a long reviews, but I feel like a completely new person and I will definitely come back once I’m in Chiangmay. Thank you so much!!!

reviews.textTranslated:
First time getting a foot massage.

The air conditioning was quite strong, but they thoughtfully provided two foot bath mats at the beginning.

The masseuse was very attentive, with skillful technique and just the right amount of pressure—no brute force. She was also very friendly.

They used a stick to press on the soles of my feet, hitting the right spots, and they even massaged my calves a little bit! 👏🏻

Not crowded, the environment was comfortable and quiet.

The location is a bit far from the city center, but the price is quite reasonable.

Except for the slight awkwardness at first due to the language barrier—I wasn't sure what they thought of me—overall, I was very satisfied. 👍🏻

26/6/25 HKer✨

reviews.name: 유보람
reviews.text:
글재주 없지만 한번 끄적여봐요..🥹

이번 일정 소화하다보면 밤10시는 훌쩍되더라구요 ㅠㅠ 뭐 한것도 없는데 시간이 이래빨리가는지,,

태사랑에서 많이 봤지만 저도 마사지는 마사지사마다 다르다는걸 알기에 시설만 참고했고, 구글맵으로 스파 쳐가지고 시설, 금액만 확인 후 당일로 많이 다녔어요 ,, 3일차때까지 아직 제대로된 마사지를 못 만났었는데

찾았어요!! 금액도 아로마 1:30 +스크럽 30 해서 1000바트라 저렴해요 다만 룸 형식이 아니고 커튼으로 쳐져있어서 그런거 싫어하시는 분은 별로시겠지만 제기준 배드에서 냄새 안나면 되고, 건물은 그냥 깔끔해서 만족했어요(제가 엄청 따지지 않는데 은근 따지려고 하는 성격 인 것 같아요 ㅋㅋ)

마사지는 진짜 너~무 좋았어요ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ

마사지가 끈김없고 부드럽게 이어져야 받는 사람도 편안한데 태국에서 3일차 전까지의 마사지들은 저기갔다 여기갔다 왔다갔다 정신이 없었는데 여기는 끊김없이 이어짐이 부드럽고 너무 편안했어요!

연륜 있으신 2분께서 해주셨는데 ,

제 지인은 첨에 스크럽 하기 싫다고 하다가 너무 좋데요. 문지르는 느낌도 뜨거운 물을 부어주시는 느낌도, 하고나서 깨끗해지는 느낌까지 (한국에서도 때 자주 밀어요) 스크럽 별로라는 글 많이 봤지만 저는 만족 스러웠어요 !!

그리고 무엇보다 친절해요! 완전완전 기분 좋아서 팁 넉넉히 드렸어요 샤워공간 있지만 깨끗한 샤워실은 아니라 그냥 원룸형 샤워실이에요 이층에서 받았지만 샤워실은 밖에있어 가운입고 내려갔어야 했어요 그것도 저는 불편함을 딱히 못느꼈어요!

어깨 날개죽지 잘 풀어주시고 너무 세심하고 부드럽고 시원한 마사지였어요 근육결을 이해하신듯 !!!

허벅지 안쪽은 살살 종아리는 조금더 강하게 강약 조절을 해주심에 놀랬구요 ,,

한국에 계셨다면 10회권 각이였어요 ㅠㅠ 2시간이 짧았어요...,,

시설은 커튼때문에 쏘쏘지만 저는 그런거 상관 없기에 100점 주고싶어요

마사지만을 바라시는 분이 계실까 하고 글올려요~

참고로 지금은 숙소 최대한 근처 마사지 샵에 와서 마사지 받는중인데 이게 뭔가 싶을정도로 어리둥절해요 ㅋㅋ 아프고 이시간이 언제 끝나나 싶을정도 ? 리뷰보니 한국인분들이 자주 애용하는 리뷰 좋음 곳 이더라구요 가격대도 있는 곳인데 좋은지 모르겠어요 ㅠㅠ 타이120분 1200바트거든여 ㅠㅠ

어제 그 마사지샵이 생각나 웁니다 ㅎㅎ

개인적인 제 생각이라 참고만 해주세요

혹시 도움 될까 하고 올립니다!

﻿
reviews.textTranslated:
I'm not very good at writing, but I'm just going to jot something down..🥹

While trying to get through this schedule, it was well past 10 PM in the blink of an eye ㅠㅠ I didn't even do much, but I can't believe time flies so fast...

I saw a lot of reviews on Taesarang, but knowing that massages vary by masseur, I only checked the facilities. I searched for "spa" on Google Maps to check the facilities and prices, and I went around a lot on the same day.. I hadn't found a proper massage until the third day, but

I found one!! The price is also affordable at 1,000 baht for a 1:30 aroma massage plus a 30 scrub. However, it isn't a private room format with only curtains, so it might not be to your liking if you dislike that. But personally, as long as the bed doesn't smell, that's fine, and the building was just clean, so I was satisfied (I don't usually picky, but I guess I have a personality that tends to be a bit picky haha).

The massage was seriously sooooo good.

A massage needs to flow smoothly without interruption for the recipient to feel comfortable. The massages I had before day 3 in Thailand were chaotic, jumping from place to place, but here, the flow was smooth and so relaxing!

Two experienced masseuses gave the massages.

My friend initially said she didn't want the scrub, but she said she loved it. From the rubbing sensation and the feeling of the hot water being poured, to the clean feeling afterward (I scrub my skin often in Korea too). I saw a lot of posts saying the scrub wasn't good, but I was satisfied!!

And above all, they are kind! I felt absolutely amazing, so I gave a generous tip. There is a shower area, but it isn't a clean shower room; it's just a studio-style shower. I was on the second floor, but since the shower was outside, I had to wear a robe to go down. I didn't really find that inconvenient, though!

They really loosened up my shoulder blades, and the massage was so meticulous, gentle, and refreshing. It felt like they understood the muscle fibers!!!

I was surprised by how well they adjusted the pressure—gently on the inner thighs and a bit stronger on the calves...

If I were in Korea, I would definitely have bought a 10-session package. Two hours just wasn't enough...

The facilities are just so-so because of the curtains, but since I don't really care about that, I want to give it a perfect score.

I'm posting this in case there are people who are looking for a massage only~

For reference, I am currently at a massage shop as close to my accommodation as possible to get a massage, and I'm so bewildered I wonder what is going on lol. It hurts, and I keep wondering when this will end? Looking at the reviews, it seems to be a highly-rated place frequently visited by Koreans. It is on the pricier side, so I'm not sure if it's actually that good. ㅠㅠ A 120-minute Thai massage is 1,200 baht. ㅠㅠ

I'm crying thinking about that massage shop from yesterday. Haha.

This is just my personal opinion, so please take it with a grain of salt.

I'm posting this in case it might be of any help!

reviews.textTranslated:
I've lived in Thailand for six years, and this is the worst massage parlor I've ever been to. The air conditioning was poorly designed, blowing directly on the customers. I was covered with three towels, and they were still laughing at me (I understand Thai). I was so cold during the 90-minute massage that I left halfway through.

The massage chairs faced the street directly, and the masseuses chatted during the massage; it was incredibly noisy.

I highly do not recommend this place.

reviews.name: philip camileri
reviews.text:
I came here for a 250-baht massage, which seemed really cheap. A woman started the massage, but after about five minutes I felt that she wasn’t applying enough pressure, so they changed to a male therapist. Given that I have some issues with my right back, I thought a stronger massage would make sense.

The massage itself was actually really good, and he had excellent technique. However, he crossed a boundary that made me very uncomfortable. At one point, his hands were over my genitals, and then he tried to put his hands behind my pants. I didn’t really know what to say or whether I should say anything, but I stopped him from going any further.

I won’t be going back to this place. Even though the massage itself was very good, I feel that he completely overstepped the boundaries of what is appropriate during a massage, and I felt violated by what happened. I honestly don’t understand why he would think that was something I wanted or consented to. It was completely inappropriate and really disturbing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Customer,

We are deeply, sincerely, and truly sorry for what happened during your visit. Please accept our heartfelt apologies for the distress, discomfort, and sense of violation you experienced. We are deeply saddened and ashamed that a customer who trusted us and came to our establishment for a massage was made to feel this way.

What happened was completely inappropriate and is absolutely not the standard of conduct we expect from anyone working at our establishment. We understand that you were placed in an extremely uncomfortable situation, and we are truly sorry that you had to experience something that should never have happened during a massage.

We want to sincerely assure you that we have not ignored or taken this matter lightly. As soon as we became aware of your experience, we took the matter seriously and conducted an internal investigation. We have thoroughly reviewed the incident and have identified the staff member responsible. We are taking appropriate and strict action regarding what happened.

We understand that an apology cannot undo what you experienced or the feelings that it caused. We also understand that the fact that you initially found the massage itself to be good does not excuse or lessen the seriousness of what happened afterward. There are clear boundaries that must always be respected during a massage, and those boundaries must never be crossed without the customer's explicit consent.

We are profoundly sorry that we failed to provide you with the safe, respectful, and professional experience you deserved. Your trust was important to us, and we deeply regret that it was violated.

Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention. Your review has made us take an even more serious look at our standards, staff training, supervision, and customer-safety procedures. We will do everything within our responsibility to ensure that an incident like this does not happen again.

Once again, from the bottom of our hearts, we are truly, deeply sorry. We sincerely apologize for the unacceptable experience you went through and for the hurt and discomfort it caused you.

With our deepest apologies and sincere regret,

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We acknowledge the error you reported. We have investigated and discussed the matter internally, and we sincerely apologize for the negative experience. Absolutely outstanding experience. This massage place is a true gem in Chiang Mai and an absolute must-visit.

A huge thank you to Nok, the owner/partner, for creating such a warm, welcoming, and professional space. From the moment we arrived, everyone made us feel genuinely cared for.

My massage therapist Holly was exceptional. I saw her a few days in a row, and every single massage was consistently incredible, easily one of the best massage experiences I’ve ever had. Her skill, intuition, and attention to detail were next-level. She truly knows her craft.

We are visiting from California, and this place exceeded all expectations. My wife also had her nails done here and absolutely loved the experience, beautifully done and with the same friendly, attentive service.

Amazing people, incredible service, and a relaxing atmosphere. You can feel the care and pride they put into everything they do. We will absolutely return on our next visit to Chiang Mai and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for top-tier massage and nail services.

reviews.name: Amy Wong
reviews.text:
I do not recommend this nail salon at all and felt sad after cause it was a waste of time and money. I stay near this salon and see it all the time walking by and thought I’d give it a shot but was heavily disappointed.

Although the nail tech was looking at the example photo I showed her the whole time, the colours were not right and she didn’t ask if I wanted extensions, which is what I showed her in the photo but I just let that slide. While she was doing my nails, it started to look off, I gave her the benefit of the doubt and told myself to trust the process, but that was my fault for not saying anything.

She ended up cutting me on 2 of my finger drawing blood. Then, when it came to paying, the nail tech asked if cash or card and we told her card. She went to the back and another lady came out to tell us cash only.

My husband and I were going to also get a massage there after but we definitely did not trust them after that nail experience.

Photos below of what I wanted versus what I got🥲
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Sincere Apology and Expression of Deepest Regret

Dear Valued Customer,

We would like to express our deepest apologies for the disappointing and unfortunate experience you had during your nail service with us. We fully understand and acknowledge all of your concerns, and we are truly sorry for the loss of your time, money, and the pleasant experience you had hoped to receive from our salon.

Acknowledgment of Our Mistakes

We are profoundly sorry for the following mistakes that occurred:

Service quality and expectations:
We sincerely apologize that the final result of your nails did not match the reference photo you provided, particularly regarding the color and the lack of consultation about nail extensions, which you had intended to receive.

Safety and injury:
We are deeply regretful that our technician’s error caused injury and bleeding on two of your fingers. This incident should never have happened. We will immediately review and strengthen our service standards and safety procedures to ensure such a mistake never occurs again.

Payment confusion:
We apologize for the confusion and inconvenience caused by the last-minute notice that we could only accept cash payment. We understand that this situation made you feel uncomfortable and diminished your confidence in the other services you had planned to use.

Remedial Options and Our Commitment to Responsibility

As a sincere gesture of responsibility and goodwill, we would like to offer you the following options to choose from:

1. Refund: We are willing to refund 50% (half) of the total service fee you paid.
or


2. Complimentary service: You may return to our salon to have your nails redone or corrected free of charge, and we will assign one of our most experienced technicians to take care of you personally.



Contact for Resolution

Please contact us directly via Instagram: a.linamassage so that we can assist you promptly with your preferred option.

We sincerely appreciate your honest feedback and hope that you will give us the opportunity to improve and provide you with a better experience in the future.

With our deepest respect and apologies

사장님 넘 친절하시고 축제기간이라 택시도안잡히는데 계속 문안닫고 기다려주시고 정안되면 오토바이로 데려다주신다고까지 ㅠㅠ 가기전에 또 올게요~~번창하세요
reviews.textTranslated:
After going to the Loy Krathong festival, I walked around Khlong Mae Kha all day and my back and legs ached. I couldn't catch a taxi, so I spotted a massage place nearby and went right in. The masseuse was a total expert—I thought she was a physical therapist. When I first entered, I couldn't even bend over enough to put my shoes in the locker, haha. The pressure from the masseuse at Bang Home is killer. She really straightened my back and shoulders. I hope she studies hard in Korean so she can find a Korean boyfriend soon.

The owner was so kind. Even though taxis were hard to find during the festival, she kept the door open and waited for me. She even offered to give me a ride on her motorbike if necessary. I'll definitely come back before I leave. Wishing you great success!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
방문 해 주셔서 감사합니다.
만족 하셔서 저도 좋네요.
다음 여행에 오셔도 만족 할수 있도록 노력 하겠습니다.

title: Elite Atoll Reformer Pilates Retreats
ownerDescription:
Elite Atoll Pilates & Retreats is Phuket’s dedicated reformer Pilates and wellness retreat center, combining boutique accommodation with daily movement and recovery. Our private retreat villa features 8 luxury beds, making it an intimate space designed for small groups and personal attention.

Guests and members enjoy up to 4 classes per day, including reformer Pilates, functional strength, mobility, and restorative sessions led by expert instructors. Whether you’re here for a week-long retreat or dropping in for a single class, every program is designed to build strength, improve posture, and restore balance.

Located inside Elite Atoll Fitness & Retreats, we provide a full wellness environment with access to training facilities.

I went to Reformer Pilates with Sarah while I was in Phuket and it was absolutely amazing! The studio is spacious, bright, big mirrors and full of energy. The classes were fantastic, offering a great variety of exercises with clear, motivating instructions. I had so much fun and felt incredible afterwards! 🧡✨

There’s also a lovely café where you can relax with a matcha, coffee or breakfast after class — the perfect way to start the day. Highly recommend! 💫
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you 🙏🏼🥰

reviews.name: Yana Karimova
reviews.text:
Great Reformer Pilates Experience!

My husband and I recently visited Elite Atoll Fitness for a Reformer Pilates class, and we were both really impressed. My husband is a beginner while I’m more experienced, and the class worked perfectly for both levels. He has always wanted to try Pilates but was a bit unsure — after this class, he absolutely loved it and definitely recommends giving it a try!

One thing we really appreciated is that you can book a class without needing a membership, which makes it super convenient for visitors. Booking was quick and easy via WhatsApp, and Sarah responded very fast and was extremely helpful.

The studio is modern, clean, and beautifully designed, creating a really pleasant atmosphere for training.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to try Reformer Pilates in a welcoming and professional environment!

Instructor Sarah was very friendly, knowledgeable, and gave clear guidance throughout the entire session, so even for me as a first-timer easy to follow. The atmosphere was relaxed but focused

reviews.name: Ada
reviews.text: Najlepszy salon masażu w całej Kata! Właścicielka salonu jest niezwykle sympatyczną osobą. Jest bardzo profesjonalna. Najpierw przeprowadza wywiad dotyczący potrzeb klienta, a później przedstawia dopasowane dla klienta propozycje masażu. Istnieje możliwość modyfikacji sposobów masażu według potrzeb oraz zamiana olejków, którymi chcesz być masowany. Właścicielka przekazuje instrukcje dotyczące sposobów masażu klienta dla swoich pracowników. Jest to przytulne miejsce, w którym pracują same profesjonalistki. Byłam na kilku różnych masażach w tym miejscu i za każdym razem masaż bardzo mi odpowiadał. Polecam!!!
reviews.textTranslated: The best massage parlor in all of Kata! The owner is incredibly friendly and professional. She first conducts an assessment of the client's needs and then offers tailored massage suggestions. You can modify the massage methods to suit your needs and swap the oils you'd like to receive. The owner provides instructions on how to massage the client for her staff. It's a cozy place staffed exclusively by professionals. I've had several different massages here, and each time I've been very happy with the experience. I highly recommend it!

Нас встретила хозяйка Пияпхат , в честь нее назван массажный салон. Интуиция подсказала, что надо брать здесь, хоть и направлялись мы в другое место. Взяли байк  без проблем, небольшой залог. Байк был почти новым(500км пробега)! Потом ходили сюда же на массаж - у всех мастеров сильные руки, поэтому каждый массаж нам нравился. Хозяйка ну очень приветливая и доброй души человек - ради таких людей хочется возвращаться, ведь имеено люди делают места достойными! Желаем вам процветания и счастья, как и нашей любимой стране - Таиланд 💘
reviews.textTranslated: We're tourists from Russia and big fans of Thailand, a place we've been returning to time and time again. This time, we also immediately decided to get a bike and, as soon as we left the hotel, we discovered this place. We were greeted by the owner, Piyaphat, the massage parlor named after her. Our intuition told us to rent a bike here, even though we weren't heading there. We rented a bike without any problems, with a small deposit. The bike was practically new (500 km on the clock)! We then went here for massages – all the massage therapists have strong hands, so we enjoyed every one. The owner is incredibly welcoming and kind – people like her make you want to come back, because it's the people who make a place worthwhile! We wish you prosperity and happiness, as well as our beloved country, Thailand 💘

reviews.text: I had my first Pilates reformer class here and was amazed by how complete it was as a workout. I worked on my balance, my mobility, my strength and my flexibility. reviews.name: Priya
reviews.text:
My time at Pilates Social Club Phuket was unlike any other studio. It wasn’t just a workout — it was a full experience. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted by the loveliest hosts and such a genuinely warm, welcoming team that instantly makes you feel at home.

The space itself is stunning, with an effortlessly calming yet elevated vibe that sets the tone for the entire session. Every detail feels intentional. The instructor- Charlie,  is not only highly skilled but incredibly attentive — she guides you through each movement with care while still pushing you to challenge yourself in the best way possible.

What makes this place stand out is how it transforms Pilates into something more than just exercise. It’s energizing, empowering, and honestly something you look forward to. You walk out feeling stronger, more aligned, and completely recharged — both physically and mentally.

It’s rare to find a studio that nails both the experience and the workout so perfectly, but Pilates Social Club Phuket truly does.

The instructors were great at guiding me as a beginner and I loved the whole environment from the music to the aesthetics. reviews.text: Never had done Pilates before but was totally put at ease, the staff were so friendly and explained clearly what I needed to do, the studio is so cute, and the class was so good, I used muscles I didn’t even know existed, can’t wait to do my next one!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Awe Marissa thank you so much 🥹🥹🥹 means so much 🫶🏼

reviews.name: Jindara P.
reviews.text: I went with my boyfriend to a class and we both loved it. It’s our first time doing Pilates. Our instructor is very helpful and kind. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Holly
reviews.text: Would 100% recommend this to anyone coming to Phuket who wants to try some reformer pilates. We did the Booty Builder class which was super difficult but the instructor Charlie was very patient and super friendly. They do a range of different classes to choose from which is great. The studio is very clean and very nicely decorated. The classes are affordable and the vibes are really good!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Awe Holly that is so so kind of you thank you so much 🥹🥹🥹🥹 
I hope you come back soon!!! ❤️

reviews.name: Sara
reviews.text: Highly recommend this place. It was amazing. I did the power class, definitely challenging but in a great way! Really lovely and friendly instructor, easy to find and decor is beaut. Hidden gem🫶🏽
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for coming Sara!!! You absolutely killed that power Pilates class 💪🏻❤️

reviews.name: Kia Hanson
reviews.text: I have attended many Pilates classes all over the world and Pilates Social Club blew my expectations out of the water. The studio itself is a vibe and the instructors are so down to earth and have a great balance of making the classes fun but also challenging and really focus on proper form which is so important. Loved my time here and can’t wait to come back 💕🤸🏽💪🏼
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: STOP IT 🥹🥹 thank you so so much Kia ❤️ can’t wait to have you back!!

reviews.name: Cicely Taylor
reviews.text:
I just had my first class here and loved it! The studio has a beautiful relaxing vibe and is well equipped with top quality reformers.

The teacher was really caring and attentive, and it was lovely to meet the owner Charlie, who was super warm and friendly.

If you’re in Phuket and looking for a place that combines excellent equipment, thoughtful instruction, and a truly welcoming spirit, this is the perfect choice!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Awe Cicely thank you so much that’s so kind of you 🥹❤️ 
Can’t wait to see more of you next week! ☺️

reviews.name: Tamara Henry
reviews.text: The best Pilates! I was there for 3 weeks straight and loved every class, it never felt repetitive and was such a great workout. Chaliesa was also so kind and funny during the workouts I loved it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Awee Tamara! It definitely feels different without you 🥹 
Thank you for the review and I hope you’re doing well 🥰

reviews.name: Fabricio Gaia MMA
reviews.text: After years of traveling and meeting the best professionals in the field, I can say that Pilates Social Club is a place of excellence with a relaxed atmosphere and an incredible, super kind and attentive team. I will continue attending because after years of high-performance training, I have accumulated several injuries, and the Pilates sessions have helped me a lot.

reviews.name: Corinna Müller
reviews.text: I have been to many Reformer Pilates studios in different countries but Pilates Social Club is one of my favorites!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Awe thank you Corinna that’s so sweet of you 🥹🥹

reviews.name: Thu Ya
reviews.text: Waste of money here . Massage shop is at old and scary place . Just rubbing with massage oil , no skills . Massage boy named Zee is rude and asking tip money again and again without doing anything . I paid him 2000 baht and I left the shop
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I think there might be a misunderstanding. Ploen Spa is a completely different business from the one you visited on 2nd floor. We simply share the same location and are not affiliated with them in any way.

reviews.name: Miki
reviews.text: Amazing spa in the center of Bangkok. Every masseuse is very skillful and my migraine has gotten so much better since i started getting head and shoulder massages here. Totally recommend!

reviews.name: Pierrick Bonnifay
reviews.text: Very good and professional massage place. I always come here and I recommend ir

reviews.name: P K
reviews.text: 10/10 - friendly staff, good massage, clean and spacious spa, affordable price. We love it here and will be back next time. 👍

reviews.name: Cel ine
reviews.text: I am a hotel guest from tivoli hotel. The Massage salon is behind the hotel and you get 50 baht discount as a hotel guest. So I want to try it. Now I can say: It was the best massage I every had here in Thailand!!!🩷 I chose Back Neck and Shoulder Massage for 1 hour and I feel so good now. I am a Massage therapist too and she really press the right points and the pressure was perfect! 😍  Her name is “Oh” (I don’t know how to write). She is very good and professional. I will come back soon 😊 thanks very much!

reviews.name: Michael Wilke
reviews.text: Very nice atmosphere,  great massage for a reasonable price.

reviews.name: Joeyote W.

reviews.name: Olivier QUESNEAU
reviews.text:
Great services with professional therapists.
2 hours session highly recommended if you have time for it 👍

reviews.name: Yada Yuwa
reviews.text: This place is the hidden gem. Those who have long sitting hours would love ‘Thai Balm’ and ‘Office Syndrome’ - unique choices offered in their spa menu.

reviews.name: Folcolini Alain
reviews.text: Very good and steady massage in comfortable rooms.

reviews.name: Waranthorn T

reviews.text: Great

reviews.name: Aek Slv
reviews.text: Very good massage and good service absolutely I will come back !!!

reviews.name: pop sing
reviews.text: Great spa, very relax

reviews.name: Olivier Brottier
reviews.text: Ne vous laissez pas impressionner par le faste de l’entrée. Laissons de côté l’incompétence de la masseuse, les discussions avec les autres collègues, le manque de concentration. Que dire des multiples rots et le summum : la masseuse qui répond à son téléphone d’une main et masse négligemment de l’autre. En tant que professionnel du massage et plutôt bon connaisseur du Thai, je me devais de réagir. A éviter absolument!
reviews.textTranslated: Don't be fooled by the ostentatious entrance. Let's ignore the masseuse's incompetence, her conversations with other colleagues, and her lack of focus. And what about the frequent belching, and the absolute worst part: the masseuse answering her phone with one hand while carelessly massaging with the other? As a massage professional and quite knowledgeable about Thai massage, I felt compelled to speak out. Avoid at all costs!

reviews.name: Lucas
reviews.text: Harn按的特别用心，服务态度也很好，我觉得算是我在曼谷体验的按摩非常不错的一家，而且价格也很实惠，下次还会再来
reviews.textTranslated: Harn was incredibly attentive during the massage, and their service was excellent. I think it's one of the best massage parlors I've had in Bangkok, and the prices are very reasonable. I'll definitely come back next time.

reviews.name: Kate Rosalin
reviews.text:
ร้านนวดสะอาด บรรยากาศดีหรูหรา มี 2 ชั้น
พนักงานบริการดี ยิ้มแย้มแจ่มใส นวดหนัก นวดเก่ง
วันนี้ไปขัดผิวและนวดอโรม่าค่ะ ประทับใจ เดี๋ยวกลับไปอุดหนุนอีก
reviews.textTranslated:
The massage parlor is clean, has a nice and luxurious atmosphere, and is spread over two floors.
The staff are friendly, cheerful, and provide excellent, strong massages.
Today I had a body scrub and an aromatherapy massage. I was very impressed and will definitely be back again.

reviews.name: Leanning Finnish
reviews.text: หมอพี่นิคือที่สุด นวดดีมากๆ น้ำหนักมือ perfect มีความเป็นมืออาชีพ เราเป็นสายนวดมายาวนาน ใช้เวลาหลายปีกว่าจะเจอหมอที่เก่งและเข้าใจการนวดกดจุดที่ถูกต้อง ไปซ้ำแน่นอนค่ะ แม้คิวพี่หมอจะยาว
reviews.textTranslated: Doctor P'Ni is the best! Her massage was amazing, the pressure was perfect, and she's incredibly professional. I've been into massages for a long time, and it took me years to find a doctor who's so skilled and understands the correct acupressure technique. I'll definitely be back, even though her schedule is long.

reviews.name: Jennie
reviews.text: นวดไมเกรนกับพี่เจี๊ยบคือที่หนึ่ง แก้อาการเก่ง นวดสบาย ไม่เจ็บ แต่หายปวดจริง นิสัยดี คุยสนุกค่า ❤️
reviews.textTranslated: Migraine massage with Jeab is the best! She's excellent at relieving symptoms, the massage is relaxing and painless, but truly works. She's also nice and fun to talk to. ❤️

reviews.name: kanwara Thongsiri
reviews.text:
หมอนวดดีมากๆเลยค่ะ นวดจนหลับเลย
แต่เรามานวดช่วงดึกๆ 2-3 ทุ่ม ตรงห้องนวดจะมีกลุ่มผชจับกลุ่มคุยกันตรงที่นั่งพนักงาน พูดคุยกันเสียงดังมาก ไม่แน่ใจว่าเป็นหมอนวด หรือเป็นหุ้นส่วนร้าน แต่นินทาลูกค้า (เรา) แบบเผาขนมาก แถมมองเราหัวจรดเท้า ตอนแรกแฮปปี้มากกะมานวดอีก พอเจอคนกลุ่มนี้อาจจะไม่มาแล้วค่ะ ไม่ชอบโดนนินทา
reviews.textTranslated:
The masseuse was amazing! I even fell asleep during the massage.
However, I went for a massage late at night, around 8-9 PM. There was a group of men sitting near the staff seating area in the massage room, talking very loudly. I'm not sure if they were the masseuses or partners in the shop, but they were gossiping about me, the customer, in a very nasty way. They also stared at me from head to toe. I was initially very happy and planned to come back for another massage, but after encountering this group, I might not come again. I don't like being gossiped about.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ต้องขอโทษด้วยนะคะ🙏 เป็นน้องเด็กฝึกงานค่ะ 
ที่มาฝึกงานช่วง 2 เดือนนี้ กับทางรร. และสปา

พนักงานสปาเราจะใส่เครื่องแบบสปาค่ะ 
ส่วนร้านจะเป็นเจ้าของคนเดียวไม่มีหุ้นส่วนค่ะ
 
ทางร้านต้องขออภัยอย่างมากเลยค่ะ กับเรื่องที่เกิดขึ้นด้วยนะคะ แล้วจะตักเตือนน้องเด็กฝึกงานทั้งหมด ที่อยู่ในเหตุการณ์ค่ะ ที่แสดงออกไม่มารยาท และทำพฤติกรรมไม่เหมาะสมดังกล่าวไป

ทางร้านขอบคุณที่มาใช้บริการด้วยนะคะ ยินดีมากค่ะที่ชอบฝีมือพี่หมอนวด และจะนำข้อร้องเรียนนี้ไปปรับปรุงค่ะ🙏
